The resulting maps reveal spatially localized connection mismatches correlated with an enhanced ferroelectric transition temperature and stress-related optical anisotropy. Local order parameters and angular-gradient analyses confirm that these loop-level signals are distinct from orientational disorder and simple spatial variation. The signed holonomy of the temperature-evolution modes further resolves positive and negative connection structures under a fixed frame convention. These results demonstrate that the data-induced connection geometry of temperature trajectories provides an experimentally accessible diagnostic of electromechanical inhomogeneity in SrTiO$_3$ under stress, without explicitly reconstructing hidden strain or electric-polarization fields.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/数据分析文章。判断依据：develop a data-induced geometric framework、treating the measured response as an observable projection、Singular value decomposition、Holonomies are defined。；研究对象：应力诱导铁电体 SrTiO₃（钛酸锶）中的光学偏振温度轨迹，以及与之相关的电机械不均匀性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将光学偏振响应沿温度轴视为轨迹，并定义实空间闭环上的和乐（holonomy），发现空间局域的连接失配与增强的铁电转变温度及应力相关光学各向异性相关。和乐图能够区分取向无序和简单空间变化，并分辨正负连接结构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将光学偏振响应沿温度轴视为轨迹，并定义实空间闭环上的和乐（holonomy），发现空间局域的连接失配与增强的铁电转变温度及应力相关光学各向异性相关。和乐图能够区分取向无序和简单空间变化，并分辨正负连接结构。；创新点：提出了一种数据诱导的连接几何框架，通过分析温度轨迹的和乐来诊断应力下 SrTiO₃ 中的电机械不均匀性，无需显式重构隐藏的应变或电极化场。
papers.method_zh: 基于温度依赖的双折射成像实验数据，采用奇异值分解（SVD）分离轨迹诱导的几何对象（光学偏振方向结构和温度演化模式），并在实空间闭环上定义和乐（holonomy）进行几何分析。同时使用局域序参量和角梯度分析进行验证。

papers.title: Collective alignment controls rotation frustration in granular flows of elongated particles
papers.abstract: Dense granular flows made of elongated particles exhibit a strong inhibition of particle rotation compared to spherical grains, but the mechanisms responsible for this effect remain unclear. Using three-dimensional discrete element simulations, we investigate the angular dynamics of elongated particles in dense, confined shear flows. We systematically vary particle aspect ratio, interparticle friction, and boundary conditions to elucidate their respective roles. We show that the reduction of the average angular velocity cannot be attributed to particle shape, friction, or solid fraction alone. Instead, it is controlled by the degree of collective alignment developed under shear, quantified by a nematic order parameter. Based on this observation, we propose a simple scaling law linking the average angular velocity to the local shear rate through a hampering parameter that depends solely on the orientational order via the nematic order parameter. This scaling successfully collapses data obtained for different particle properties (shape, friction), different flow patterns, and, remarkably, remains valid for two additional flow configurations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：three-dimensional discrete element simulations（三维离散元模拟）。；研究对象：由细长颗粒（elongated particles）组成的密集颗粒流（dense granular flows），具体研究颗粒在受限剪切流（confined shear flows）中的旋转动力学（angular dynamics）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 细长颗粒在密集颗粒流中平均角速度的降低并非由颗粒形状、摩擦或固体分数单独决定，而是由剪切作用下颗粒集体排列（collective alignment）的程度控制，该程度可用向列序参量（nematic order parameter）量化。基于此，作者提出了一个仅依赖于向列序参量的标度律，成功统一了不同颗粒属性与流动构型下的数据。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：细长颗粒在密集颗粒流中平均角速度的降低并非由颗粒形状、摩擦或固体分数单独决定，而是由剪切作用下颗粒集体排列（collective alignment）的程度控制，该程度可用向列序参量（nematic order parameter）量化。基于此，作者提出了一个仅依赖于向列序参量的标度律，成功统一了不同颗粒属性与流动构型下的数据。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用三维离散元模拟（3D discrete element simulations），系统变化颗粒长径比（aspect ratio）、颗粒间摩擦系数（interparticle friction）以及边界条件（boundary conditions），以阐明各自作用。

papers.title: A solvable model for unsupervised federated learning
papers.abstract: We introduce a theoretical framework for analyzing federated learning in a generative setting through a teacher-multiple interacting students scenario, in which each student receives a distinct realization of the data, either through a different noise corruption or by accessing a different subset, possibly of varying size. Using theoretical tools in equilibrium disordered system, we analytically show that interactions among students systematically enhance learning performance: highly noisy students require fewer samples to recover the underlying pattern, while low-noise students achieve a larger overlap with the ground-truth signal. We derive the optimal Bayesian conditions for teacher recovery as functions of the sample complexity, noise level, and interaction strength, and validate these predictions through numerical simulations. The resulting dynamics can be mapped onto equilibrium sampling in a Restricted Boltzmann Machine with a structured hidden layer, providing a principled theoretical understanding of how interactions improve distributed generative modeling.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“introduce a theoretical framework”“using theoretical tools in equilibrium disordered system”“derive the optimal Bayesian conditions”等，属于理论建模与分析，辅以数值模拟验证。；研究对象：无监督联邦学习中的生成式模型，具体为“教师-多学生”交互学习场景，每个学生接收不同噪声或不同子集的数据，研究学生间相互作用如何影响学习性能。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 学生之间的相互作用系统性地提升了学习性能：高噪声学生需要更少样本即可恢复底层模式，低噪声学生则能获得与真实信号更大的重叠。该动力学可映射为具有结构化隐藏层的受限玻尔兹曼机中的平衡采样。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：学生之间的相互作用系统性地提升了学习性能：高噪声学生需要更少样本即可恢复底层模式，低噪声学生则能获得与真实信号更大的重叠。该动力学可映射为具有结构化隐藏层的受限玻尔兹曼机中的平衡采样。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用平衡态无序系统理论（equilibrium disordered system）进行解析分析，推导出教师恢复的最优贝叶斯条件（作为样本复杂度、噪声水平和交互强度的函数），并通过数值模拟验证理论预测。

papers.title: A Geometric Design Principle for $\mathbb{Z}_2$ Topological Phases in Twisted Triangular-Lattice Bilayers
papers.abstract: Twisted van der Waals bilayers provide a versatile platform for engineering moiré electronic states, yet a general design principle for time-reversal-invariant topological moiré bands remains elusive. Here, we establish a geometry-driven principle for triangular-lattice bilayers: symmetry-related minima of the stacking-energy landscape are promoted by twist and relaxation into the two sublattices of an emergent honeycomb moiré lattice. First-principles calculations for BiTeBr reveal robust $Γ$-valley moiré valence bands with a nontrivial $\mathbb{Z}_2$ index over a range of twist angles. A four-band Wannier Hamiltonian in the emergent honeycomb basis quantitatively maps these bands onto an extended Kane--Mele model. An out-of-plane electric field drives a transition to a trivial phase by enhancing the Rashba coupling $λ_R$ relative to the intrinsic Kane--Mele coupling $λ_{\rm SO}$. The same honeycomb reconstruction and Kane--Mele mechanism are verified in representative additional triangular-lattice bilayers, establishing stacking reconstruction as a general, geometry-controlled route to electrically tunable moiré quantum spin Hall materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提及“First-principles calculations”（第一性原理计算）、“Wannier Hamiltonian”（瓦尼尔哈密顿量）以及“Kane-Mele model”（Kane-Mele模型）等理论计算与建模方法。；研究对象：扭曲三角晶格双层体系（twisted triangular-lattice bilayers），具体以BiTeBr为代表，研究其莫尔能带中的拓扑相。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现了一个由几何驱动的设计原理：扭曲和弛豫将堆叠能量景观中对称性相关的极小点提升为蜂窝状莫尔晶格的两个子格，从而在三角晶格双层中实现具有非平庸$\mathbb{Z}_2$拓扑指数的莫尔能带。该机制可通过外加垂直电场进行调控，实现拓扑相变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现了一个由几何驱动的设计原理：扭曲和弛豫将堆叠能量景观中对称性相关的极小点提升为蜂窝状莫尔晶格的两个子格，从而在三角晶格双层中实现具有非平庸$\mathbb{Z}_2$拓扑指数的莫尔能带。该机制可通过外加垂直电场进行调控，实现拓扑相变。；创新点：提出了一个普适的、基于几何（堆叠重构）的设计原理，用于在扭曲三角晶格双层中实现时间反演对称的拓扑莫尔能带，并验证了该机制在多种代表性体系中的普适性，为电可调的莫尔量子自旋霍尔材料提供了通用路径。
papers.method_zh: 采用了第一性原理计算（First-principles calculations）对BiTeBr的莫尔价带进行模拟；构建了基于涌现蜂窝晶格的四带瓦尼尔哈密顿量（four-band Wannier Hamiltonian），并将其定量映射到扩展的Kane-Mele模型上。

papers.title: Observation of orbital-angular-momentum-driven temperature modulation via the spin Peltier effect
papers.abstract: Angular-momentum transport provides a pathway for controlling energy flow in solids beyond conventional charge-based mechanisms. While spin currents are known to mediate spin-caloritronic phenomena such as the spin Peltier effect (SPE), the role of orbital angular momentum in heat transport remains largely unexplored. Here we demonstrate orbital-angular-momentum-driven temperature modulation via the SPE in yttrium iron garnet/Pt/CuOx heterostructures. Using wedge-shaped CuOx layers combined with spatially resolved active thermal measurement techniques, we map the continuous thickness dependence and quantitatively disentangle the spin- and orbital-current-mediated contributions within a single device. The orbital-mediated component exhibits a pronounced maximum at an intermediate thickness, revealing a characteristic length scale for interfacial orbital-angular-momentum generation and propagation at the Cu/CuOx interface. These results provide direct experimental evidence that charge-current-driven orbital angular momentum can drive SPE-induced temperature modulation, establishing interfacial orbital processes as an additional channel for heat transport and providing a pathway toward spin-orbit caloritronics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“使用楔形CuOx层结合空间分辨主动热测量技术”等实验手段，并展示了厚度依赖的连续映射和定量分离结果。；研究对象：钇铁石榴石（YIG）/Pt/CuOx异质结构中的轨道角动量驱动温度调制现象，具体涉及自旋佩尔捷效应（SPE）和轨道角动量在热输运中的作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 实验证明电荷电流驱动的轨道角动量可以通过自旋佩尔捷效应引起温度调制，并在Cu/CuOx界面处观测到轨道角动量产生和传播的特征长度尺度，表明界面轨道过程可作为额外的热输运通道。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：实验证明电荷电流驱动的轨道角动量可以通过自旋佩尔捷效应引起温度调制，并在Cu/CuOx界面处观测到轨道角动量产生和传播的特征长度尺度，表明界面轨道过程可作为额外的热输运通道。；创新点：首次直接实验证明轨道角动量可以驱动自旋佩尔捷效应引起的温度调制，揭示了界面轨道角动量生成与传播的特征长度尺度，为自旋-轨道热电子学提供了新途径。
papers.method_zh: 采用楔形CuOx层结合空间分辨主动热测量技术，在单个器件中连续映射厚度依赖关系，并定量分离出自旋电流和轨道电流介导的贡献。

papers.title: A micromagnetic model with bidirectional magneto-thermal coupling
papers.abstract: Most conventional micromagnetic frameworks in spin caloritronics rely on a unidirectional coupling approximation, wherein thermal fluctuations drive magnetization dynamics while the feedback of magnetic dissipation onto the thermal reservoir is neglected. Here, we establish a rigorously self-consistent bidirectional magneto-thermal coupling model by integrating the stochastic Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert (sLLG) equation with a generalized heat transfer equation. In this closed-loop framework, the local temperature acts as a dynamical variable, and the damping-induced dissipation alongside stochastic work dynamically feeds back into the thermal bath as localized heat sources. Utilizing Ito stochastic calculus, we analytically prove that this coupled system strictly obeys the first law of thermodynamics and spontaneously recovers the correct Boltzmann statistics at equilibrium. Spatially resolved micromagnetic simulations further validate the energy exchange mechanism, capturing the finite-bath temperature reduction induced by spatial variation of magnetic moments and the modified density of states under exchange interactions. This bidirectional framework provides a robust microscopic foundation for investigating complex nonequilibrium magneto-thermal dynamics, such as the unidirectional spin-wave heat conveyer effect, paving the way for advanced spin-caloritronic applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：micromagnetic model, stochastic Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert equation, generalized heat transfer equation, Ito stochastic calculus, analytically prove）；研究对象：自旋热电子学中的磁热耦合动力学，具体为微磁学框架下磁化动力学与热库之间的双向能量交换机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 建立了严格自洽的双向磁热耦合模型，证明该模型严格遵循热力学第一定律并在平衡态自发恢复正确的玻尔兹曼统计；模拟揭示了磁矩空间变化导致的有限热库温度降低以及交换相互作用下态密度的修正。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：建立了严格自洽的双向磁热耦合模型，证明该模型严格遵循热力学第一定律并在平衡态自发恢复正确的玻尔兹曼统计；模拟揭示了磁矩空间变化导致的有限热库温度降低以及交换相互作用下态密度的修正。；创新点：突破了传统自旋热电子学中单向耦合近似（仅考虑热涨落驱动磁化动力学而忽略磁耗散对热库的反馈），首次建立了磁化动力学与热库温度作为动态变量的闭环双向耦合框架。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导：将随机Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert (sLLG)方程与广义热传导方程耦合，利用Ito随机微积分进行解析证明；数值模拟：空间分辨的微磁学模拟。

papers.title: Conditional spinodal decomposition in Li-Mg anodes for lithium metal batteries
papers.abstract: The development of batteries with high energy density, short charging times and use of sustainable materials is critical for decarbonization. Magnesium (Mg)-based anodes for lithium (Li) metal batteries promote homogeneous Li plating, thereby avoiding the formation of Li dendrites that cause short circuits and battery failure. However, microstructural modifications induced by Li-alloying and their influence on battery operation remain elusive. Here, we unveil the previously unknown formation of an ordered B2 phase, which creates a conditional spinodal decomposition with the \b{eta}-body-centered cubic phase. Chemical fluctuations characteristic of spinodal decomposition give rise to uniformly dispersed Li-rich \b{eta}-BCC and Li-poor B2 continuous interconnected phases, with the former providing a fast diffusion pathway for Li diffusion towards the anode, hence decreasing the propensity for dendrite formation at elevated current density. This is achieved using Earth-abundant and inexpensive Mg.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“unveil the previously unknown formation”（揭示未知形成）、“microstructural modifications”（微观结构变化）等实验发现性描述，未提及计算或理论方法。；研究对象：锂金属电池中锂-镁（Li-Mg）合金负极的微观结构，特别是调幅分解（spinodal decomposition）导致的相分离行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现Li-Mg负极中会形成一种有序B2相，该相与β-体心立方（β-BCC）相之间发生条件性调幅分解，产生均匀分散的富锂β-BCC相和贫锂B2相连续互穿结构，其中富锂相为锂扩散提供快速通道，从而抑制高电流密度下的枝晶形成。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现Li-Mg负极中会形成一种有序B2相，该相与β-体心立方（β-BCC）相之间发生条件性调幅分解，产生均匀分散的富锂β-BCC相和贫锂B2相连续互穿结构，其中富锂相为锂扩散提供快速通道，从而抑制高电流密度下的枝晶形成。；创新点：首次揭示了Li-Mg负极中B2有序相的存在及其与β-BCC相之间的条件性调幅分解机制，并阐明了该微观结构对抑制锂枝晶生长的积极作用。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体实验手段（如X射线衍射、透射电镜、电化学测试等），仅提及对微观结构变化和电池运行影响的观察。

papers.title: Continuum Neural Momentum Eigenstate for Variationally Solving Quasiparticles
papers.abstract: We design the first neural quantum state for continuum particles that, for any chosen allowed momentum $\mathbf{k}$, is by construction an exact eigenstate of total momentum with eigenvalue $\mathbf{k}$. Our architecture, EVE, enables off-the-shelf VMC to solve for momentum-sector ground states. We test EVE on 2D bosons with mutual $1/r$ interactions, finding that a single unified ansatz is capable of describing four qualitatively different states: superfluid, roton, crystal, and phonon. At different densities, we extract the underlying phase of matter from the dispersion's shape. At $r_s = 20.0$, we see the roton minimum at finite $k$ expected of a superfluid. At $r_s = 100.0$, we see striking zone folding indicative of crystalline order, with periodically spaced minima representing floating crystals connected by phonon arcs in between. Using density-density correlation functions, we confirm the phase diagnoses and probe the excitations' correlation structures. Finally, we analyze the roton's phase texture and find unexpected multi-particle phase strings, formed when several vortex dipoles merge, leaving two vortices connected by a phase slip.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：neural quantum state、VMC（变分蒙特卡洛）、architecture、ansatz。；研究对象：连续空间中的量子多粒子系统，具体为二维玻色子体系，粒子间具有1/r相互作用（库仑相互作用），研究其在不同密度下的基态和激发态（超流、旋子、晶体、声子）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 设计了一种名为EVE的连续体神经量子态架构，能够通过构造精确满足任意给定总动量本征值，并成功用单一变分波函数描述了二维玻色子体系中的超流、旋子、晶体和声子四种截然不同的物态，揭示了从超流到浮晶的相变以及旋子激发中的多粒子相位弦结构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：设计了一种名为EVE的连续体神经量子态架构，能够通过构造精确满足任意给定总动量本征值，并成功用单一变分波函数描述了二维玻色子体系中的超流、旋子、晶体和声子四种截然不同的物态，揭示了从超流到浮晶的相变以及旋子激发中的多粒子相位弦结构。；创新点：首次设计了针对连续空间粒子的、能精确满足任意指定总动量本征值的神经量子态架构（EVE），使得VMC可以直接求解动量空间的激发态，并利用单一统一变分形式描述了多种不同物态及其激发谱。
papers.method_zh: 使用变分蒙特卡洛（VMC）方法，结合专门设计的神经网络波函数（EVE架构），该波函数通过构造自动成为总动量算符的精确本征态，从而允许直接求解特定动量扇区的基态。

papers.title: Quantum charge pumping in helical systems: A comparative study of short- and long-range hopping
papers.abstract: Using the Keldysh non-equilibrium Green's function approach, we investigate charge pumping through a single-stranded helical structure described by a tight-binding model that includes either short-range hopping (SRH) or long-range hopping (LRH). While quantum pumping has been studied in various low-dimensional systems, the detailed behavior of the spectral current and the pumped dc current in helical geometries in the presence of higher-order electron hopping (beyond nearest neighbors) has not yet been systematically explored. Here, we focus on the interplay between helicity and extended hopping ranges, analyzing how they jointly control the energy-resolved and dc pumped currents under time-periodic end potentials. For LRH, the pumped dc current exhibits pronounced plateau-like regions as a function of chemical potential when energy levels are sparsely spaced -- consistent with adiabatic transport -- whereas SRH yields more parameter-sensitive currents without clear plateaus. The plateau stability is controlled by the drive frequency: at higher frequencies, Floquet side-band mixing destroys the plateaus, leading to oscillatory currents. The phase dependence remains nearly sinusoidal, and the current vanishes at zero phase lag, confirming the necessity of out-of-phase potentials. Crucially, in helical systems, the decay exponent $(\ell_c)$ acts as an effective structural parameter that can tune both the magnitude and sign of the pumped current, offering a geometric knob for controlling quantum pumping. Our findings not only fill a gap in the understanding of spectral and pumped currents in helical systems with extended hopping but also provide tools that can be applied to analyze similar phenomena in other chiral or quasi-one-dimensional systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：使用Keldysh非平衡格林函数方法进行理论计算，无实验数据。；研究对象：单链螺旋结构中的量子电荷泵浦现象，具体研究短程跳跃（SRH）与长程跳跃（LRH）对泵浦电流的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 长程跳跃（LRH）在能级稀疏时产生明显的泵浦直流电流平台，而短程跳跃（SRH）则无此平台；螺旋结构的衰减指数（ℓ_c）可作为有效结构参数，调控泵浦电流的大小和符号。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：长程跳跃（LRH）在能级稀疏时产生明显的泵浦直流电流平台，而短程跳跃（SRH）则无此平台；螺旋结构的衰减指数（ℓ_c）可作为有效结构参数，调控泵浦电流的大小和符号。；创新点：首次系统研究了高阶电子跳跃（超越最近邻）对螺旋几何结构中谱电流和泵浦直流电流的详细行为，揭示了螺旋性与扩展跳跃范围之间的相互作用，并指出衰减指数可作为几何调控旋钮。
papers.method_zh: 采用Keldysh非平衡格林函数方法，对基于紧束缚模型的单链螺旋结构进行理论分析，考虑短程跳跃（仅最近邻）和长程跳跃（超越最近邻），并在时间周期端电势驱动下计算能量分辨谱电流和直流泵浦电流。

papers.title: Leveraging rapid sintering to retain metastable zirconia in copper
papers.abstract: Cermets combining metastable ceramics and ductile metals promise superior toughness and strength. However, retaining metastability often requires high-temperature sintering that coarsens microstructures and relaxes matrix constraint. Here we introduce an ultrafast high-temperature sintering (UHS) strategy to overcome this trade-off in zirconia-copper cermets. By applying Joule heating at around 100 degrees C per second to 900 degrees C with only a 20 second hold, we obtained cermets containing up to 50 weight percent of metastable austenite in zirconia at room temperature within a fine-grained and homogeneous microstructure. The rapid sintering kinetically favors semi-thermal austenite formation while suppressing copper grain growth and matrix relaxation, thereby stabilizing the high-temperature phase and simultaneously preserving microstructural refinement. This approach offers significant potential for copper-based composites in applications such as transformation toughening, self-healing, and crack detection.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：ultrafast high-temperature sintering (UHS) strategy、Joule heating、实验获得cermets。；研究对象：氧化锆-铜金属陶瓷（zirconia-copper cermets），具体研究如何通过快速烧结保留亚稳态氧化锆（metastable zirconia）在铜基体中的问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过超快高温烧结（UHS）策略，在极短时间（20秒）内加热至900°C，成功在室温下保留了高达50重量%的亚稳态奥氏体氧化锆，同时获得了细晶均匀的微观结构，克服了传统烧结中高温导致晶粒粗化和基体弛豫的权衡。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过超快高温烧结（UHS）策略，在极短时间（20秒）内加热至900°C，成功在室温下保留了高达50重量%的亚稳态奥氏体氧化锆，同时获得了细晶均匀的微观结构，克服了传统烧结中高温导致晶粒粗化和基体弛豫的权衡。；创新点：提出并验证了利用超快高温烧结（UHS）策略，在金属陶瓷中同时实现亚稳态陶瓷相的保留和微观结构细化的新方法，解决了传统高温烧结中相稳定性与微观结构粗化之间的矛盾。
papers.method_zh: 采用超快高温烧结（UHS）技术，以约100°C/秒的速率进行焦耳加热至900°C，并仅保持20秒。通过该快速烧结过程，动力学上有利于半热奥氏体形成，同时抑制铜晶粒长大和基体弛豫。

papers.title: A wrong ground-state structure of HfO$_2$ predicted by machine-learning interatomic potentials based on the PBE functional
papers.abstract: Machine-learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) have become powerful tools for material simulations. Many MLIPs are trained based on density functional theory (DFT) datasets generated with the Perdew-Burke-Ernzerhof (PBE) exchange-correlation functional. Using a PBE-based MLIP for HfO2, we identify a previously unreported low-energy I41/amd structure, which is predicted to be more stable than the well-known ground-state structure, the monoclinic P21/c structure. Since experiments show clearly that HfO2 takes the P21/c structure as the ground state, this is obviously a wrong prediction. Unfortunately, the same prediction is also made by widely used PBE-based foundation models such as NequIP-OAM-L and MatterSim-v1-5M. Comparisons among different DFT functionals show that this error originates from the PBE functional, which overstabilizes low-density structures containing sixfold Hf-O octahedral units, such as the I41/amd and Pbcn phases. The error also affects the calculated energy landscapes and barrier heights along ferroelectric HfO2 polarization switching paths when there are large lattice relaxations. Fortunately, the error can be largely suppressed by other functionals such as PBEsol and local density approximation. Our study serves as a warning about the impact of errors in exchange-correlation functional approximations on the reliability of MLIP simulations of crystal structures and phase transitions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：基于机器学习原子间势（MLIP）和密度泛函理论（DFT）计算，比较不同泛函的预测结果。；研究对象：二氧化铪（HfO₂）的基态晶体结构，特别是单斜P21/c结构与四方I41/amd结构的相对稳定性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于PBE泛函训练的机器学习原子间势错误地预测I41/amd结构比实验已知的基态P21/c结构更稳定，该错误源于PBE泛函本身对含有六配位Hf-O八面体单元的低密度结构（如I41/amd和Pbcn相）的过度稳定化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：基于PBE泛函训练的机器学习原子间势错误地预测I41/amd结构比实验已知的基态P21/c结构更稳定，该错误源于PBE泛函本身对含有六配位Hf-O八面体单元的低密度结构（如I41/amd和Pbcn相）的过度稳定化。；创新点：首次明确指出并系统论证了PBE泛函的误差会通过机器学习原子间势传播，导致对HfO₂基态结构的错误预测，并揭示了该误差对铁电极化翻转路径上能量势垒计算的影响。
papers.method_zh: 使用基于PBE泛函的机器学习原子间势（MLIP）进行结构预测，并与PBE泛函的DFT计算结果对比；进一步采用PBEsol和局域密度近似（LDA）等其他泛函进行交叉验证；还使用了广泛使用的PBE基基础模型（如NequIP-OAM-L和MatterSim-v1-5M）进行验证。

papers.title: When proofreading improves both speed and accuracy
papers.abstract: Proofreading is generally thought to improve accuracy at the expense of speed. We show that this trade-off can be reversed in stochastic processes with long-lived stalled states. Using a non-Markovian renewal framework, we derive exact expressions for the error rate and completion time under proofreading for arbitrary stall-time distributions. Our analysis reveals that fluctuations in stall durations, rather than their mean alone, determine whether proofreading can simultaneously increase speed and accuracy. In the limit of strong stalling, this regime emerges when the coefficient of variation of the stall time exceeds a threshold set by the intrinsic error rate. These results provide a general criterion for proofreading in systems ranging from self-assembly and polymer replication to immune recognition and other nonequilibrium information-processing systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：non-Markovian renewal framework、exact expressions、theoretical analysis。；研究对象：生物物理与信息处理系统中的校对（proofreading）过程，具体涵盖自组装、聚合物复制、免疫识别等非平衡信息处理系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在具有长寿命停滞态（long-lived stalled states）的随机过程中，校对可以同时提高速度和准确性，打破了传统上认为校对以牺牲速度为代价换取准确性的权衡关系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在具有长寿命停滞态（long-lived stalled states）的随机过程中，校对可以同时提高速度和准确性，打破了传统上认为校对以牺牲速度为代价换取准确性的权衡关系。；创新点：揭示了停滞时间的涨落（而非仅其平均值）是决定校对能否同时提升速度与准确性的关键因素，并给出了强停滞极限下该机制出现的普适阈值条件。
papers.method_zh: 采用非马尔可夫更新框架（non-Markovian renewal framework），推导了任意停滞时间分布下校对过程的错误率和完成时间的精确表达式，并通过分析停滞时间涨落（特别是变异系数）与内在错误率的关系给出判据。

papers.title: Molecular reference corrections for quantum Monte Carlo adsorption energies
papers.abstract: Accurate surface thermochemistry requires balanced error cancellation between extended slabs and molecular reference states. This balance can fail whenever the electronic-structure error is not transferable across the chemically distinct species entering a thermodynamic cycle. Here we examine this problem in single-determinant fixed-node diffusion Monte Carlo (SD-FNDMC) for oxygenated ORR intermediates on Pt(111). Gas-phase thermochemistry is used to diagnose the reference-state imbalance, and a hybrid cycle is introduced to separate slab-adsorbate binding from molecular formation. The hybrid cycle keeps the surface binding term at the SD-FNDMC level, where cancellation is expected to be most favorable, and replaces the molecular formation contribution with a benchmark coupled cluster reference. For Pt(111), the resulting correction is small for O and OH but larger for OOH, while the geometry-matched refinement gives only a secondary correction. Applying the same cycle to HCO and COH on Cu(111) gives corrections of opposite sign, showing that the bias is controlled primarily by the electronic structure of the molecular reference rather than by adsorbate geometry alone. This decomposition identifies molecular reference imbalance as a separable source of error in SD-FNDMC surface thermochemistry and reduces the corresponding bias without modifying the SD-FNDMC slab-binding contribution.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：quantum Monte Carlo (量子蒙特卡洛)、coupled cluster (耦合簇)、thermochemistry (热化学)。；研究对象：论文研究的具体体系是氧还原反应（ORR）中间体（O, OH, OOH）在Pt(111)表面的吸附，以及HCO和COH在Cu(111)表面的吸附。核心物理现象是表面热化学计算中，由于电子结构误差在不同化学物种间不可转移而导致的参考态能量不平衡问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在单行列式固定节点扩散蒙特卡洛（SD-FNDMC）计算表面吸附能时，分子参考态的能量不平衡是一个可分离的误差来源。通过引入混合循环，用高精度的耦合簇（CC）基准替换分子形成能部分，可以修正该偏差，且修正量主要取决于分子参考态的电子结构，而非吸附质几何结构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在单行列式固定节点扩散蒙特卡洛（SD-FNDMC）计算表面吸附能时，分子参考态的能量不平衡是一个可分离的误差来源。通过引入混合循环，用高精度的耦合簇（CC）基准替换分子形成能部分，可以修正该偏差，且修正量主要取决于分子参考态的电子结构，而非吸附质几何结构。；创新点：该工作首次明确识别并量化了SD-FNDMC表面热化学计算中，分子参考态能量不平衡是一个可分离的、独立的误差来源。提出的混合循环方法可以在不修改SD-FNDMC表面结合能计算的前提下，有效减少该偏差。
papers.method_zh: 主要采用单行列式固定节点扩散蒙特卡洛（SD-FNDMC）方法计算表面吸附能。为了诊断和修正参考态不平衡，引入了混合热化学循环：表面结合能部分保留在SD-FNDMC水平，而分子形成能部分则替换为基准耦合簇（coupled cluster）计算结果。

papers.title: Revealing nonvolatile behaviors in magneto-thermal switching using microstructure-controlled superconducting composites
papers.abstract: Thermal conductivity in a conductor changes by the application of an external magnetic field, which functions as a magneto-thermal switch. For superconductors, a large magneto-thermal switching can occur through a superconducting-to-normal conducting phase transition due to the change in the electron contribution in thermal conductivity. Arima et al. recently reported a nonvolatile nature of the magneto-thermal switching for superconducting solders, which consist of phase-separated Sn and Pb domains. Although they clarified that magnetic flux trapping is required to induce the nonvolatile magneto-thermal switching, a rule for such material design is still unclear. Here, we investigate the microstructure dependence of magneto-thermal switching in superconducting Sn/Pb multilayered composites, which are created by an accumulative roll bonding method. The thickness of each layer, that is the scale of microstructure, can be systematically controlled by the repetition number of roll bonding while the whole sample size and average composition are unchanged. We find that, as the formation of micro-scaled Sn domains proceeds by increasing the repetition number, a nonvolatility in the magneto-thermal conductivity gradually appears in correlation with the remanent magnetization. This study directly confirms that the inclusions with a size comparable to or less than the magnetic vortex in superconducting matrix is essential for magnetic flux trapping, enabling the nonvolatile magneto-thermal switching in superconducting composites.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了“we investigate”、“we find”、“this study directly confirms”等实验研究表述，并具体说明了样品制备方法（accumulative roll bonding method）和测量手段（磁热导率、剩磁测量）。；研究对象：超导Sn/Pb多层复合材料的微观结构依赖的磁热开关非易失性行为。具体物理现象为超导-正常态相变引起的磁热导率开关效应及其非易失性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当超导基体中包含尺寸与磁通涡旋相当或更小的夹杂物时，能够有效捕获磁通，从而在超导复合材料中实现非易失性磁热开关效应。具体而言，随着轧制次数增加形成微米级Sn畴，磁热导率的非易失性逐渐出现，并与剩磁相关。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当超导基体中包含尺寸与磁通涡旋相当或更小的夹杂物时，能够有效捕获磁通，从而在超导复合材料中实现非易失性磁热开关效应。具体而言，随着轧制次数增加形成微米级Sn畴，磁热导率的非易失性逐渐出现，并与剩磁相关。；创新点：通过系统控制微观结构尺度（层厚），直接证实了夹杂物尺寸与磁通涡旋尺度的关系是决定磁通捕获和非易失性磁热开关的关键因素，为这类材料的设计提供了明确的微观结构规则。
papers.method_zh: 采用累积叠轧焊（accumulative roll bonding）方法制备Sn/Pb多层复合材料，通过改变轧制重复次数系统控制各层厚度（即微观结构尺度），同时保持样品整体尺寸和平均成分不变。测量了磁热导率及剩磁（remanent magnetization）。

papers.title: Intrinsic Ductility from Shear Amorphization: From Pure Metals to Multi-Principal-Element Alloys
papers.abstract: Direct links between electronic structure and intrinsic ductility remain elusive for metals. A framework is proposed that reduces the complexities of valence charge distribution, band filling, and shear strain effects into structure-property relationships describing the intrinsic ductility of metals and alloys. Rather than relying on crystal cleavage and dislocation nucleation at preexisting crack tips, we show that a lower energy fracture criterion, i.e., the activation energy density for amorphization, enables accurate predictions of both intrinsic ductility and ductile-to-brittle transition temperatures. From analytical expressions and tabulated ab-initio stiffness constants, lattice parameters, and binary interaction energies, we present a unified theory that reconciles ductile flow in pure metals and solid-solution alloys. Phase diagrams generated for the Nb-Ta-V-Ti system simultaneously explain its high strength and room-temperature tensile ductility, validating this framework as a practical one for rapid design of structural multi-principal-element alloys.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：framework proposed、analytical expressions、ab-initio stiffness constants、phase diagrams generated）；研究对象：金属与多主元合金的本征延展性，以及剪切非晶化机制
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出以非晶化激活能密度作为更低能量的断裂判据，能够准确预测金属与合金的本征延展性及韧脆转变温度，并统一解释了纯金属与固溶合金的延性流动行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出以非晶化激活能密度作为更低能量的断裂判据，能够准确预测金属与合金的本征延展性及韧脆转变温度，并统一解释了纯金属与固溶合金的延性流动行为。；创新点：摒弃传统依赖预存裂纹尖端解理与位错成核的判据，首次将剪切非晶化激活能密度作为本征延展性的统一判据，并实现了从纯金属到多主元合金的延性理论统一。
papers.method_zh: 基于电子结构分析，结合从头算（ab-initio）刚度常数、晶格参数和二元相互作用能，建立解析表达式与结构-性能关系框架，并生成Nb-Ta-V-Ti体系的相图。

papers.title: Water Flow Through Polar and Non-Polar Nanopores: Insights from Multiscale Simulations
papers.abstract: Global water stress has emerged as a critical challenge, driving the search for advanced membrane materials that enable efficient, selective water filtration and transport. In this context, two-dimensional nanoporous membranes provide an ideal platform to elucidate how atomic-scale structure and electronic polarization govern water flow under extreme confinement. In this study, we employ multiscale simulations to investigate the effect of water flow through nanopores in graphene and hexagonal boron nitride (hBN) membranes. Our results reveal significantly higher water flow in hBN membranes than in graphene. This enhanced flow is attributed to the asymmetry of the hBN pores, which induces an electric dipole moment, as confirmed by quantum-mechanical (QM) calculations. Classical molecular dynamics simulations further demonstrate that water molecules exhibit a random distribution with no preferential orientation near the graphene pores, whereas hBN induces strong structuring. Furthermore, hybrid quantum mechanics/molecular mechanics (QM/MM) simulations indicate that the dipole moment of the hBN pore increases in the presence of water, as evidenced by the average charge distribution. Conversely, the symmetric nature of graphene pores results in non-polar characteristics, as verified by both QM/MM and QM calculations. These findings provide valuable insights into the distinct water-transport properties when flowing through graphene and hBN nanopores, with potential implications for designing advanced nanofiltration membranes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：multiscale simulations、classical molecular dynamics、hybrid quantum mechanics/molecular mechanics (QM/MM) simulations、quantum-mechanical (QM) calculations）；研究对象：水在石墨烯和六方氮化硼（hBN）纳米孔中的流动行为，以及原子尺度结构和电子极化对极端受限条件下水输运的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 水在hBN纳米孔中的流动显著高于石墨烯，原因是hBN孔的不对称性诱导了电偶极矩，而石墨烯孔具有对称的非极性特征；水分子在hBN孔附近呈现强有序结构，在石墨烯孔附近则随机分布。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：水在hBN纳米孔中的流动显著高于石墨烯，原因是hBN孔的不对称性诱导了电偶极矩，而石墨烯孔具有对称的非极性特征；水分子在hBN孔附近呈现强有序结构，在石墨烯孔附近则随机分布。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 多尺度模拟，包括：量子力学（QM）计算、经典分子动力学（MD）模拟、以及混合量子力学/分子力学（QM/MM）模拟。

papers.title: How alignment controls heat transport in polymer chains with kinks?
papers.abstract: Thermal transport in long polymer molecules is commonly attributed to ballistic propagation of long-wavelength acoustic phonons, which act as Goldstone modes arising from translational symmetry, while the transport of other phonons is suppressed by Anderson localization. This mechanism leads to thermal conductivity that increases with molecular length. Consistent with this picture, strongly aligned polymers exhibit exceptionally high thermal conductivity, whereas poorly aligned polymers are orders of magnitude less conductive and function as thermal insulators. Here we show that this strong sensitivity to molecular alignment originates from phonon scattering by molecular kinks. Even in the long-wavelength limit, the kink scattering remains strong because kinks break translational symmetry both for longitudinal and transverse phonons. As a result, randomly oriented kinks cause a rapid decrease in thermal conductivity with increasing molecular length. These findings identify alignment control by means of kink engineering as a route for tuning thermal transport in polymers.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“we show that”“originates from”“identify”等理论分析表述，未提及实验或计算具体方法。；研究对象：聚合物分子链中的热输运现象，特别是分子链中“扭结”（kinks）对热传导的控制机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 聚合物分子链中热导率对分子取向的强敏感性源于扭结对声子的散射：即使在长波极限下，扭结仍能破坏纵向和横向声子的平移对称性，导致随机取向的扭结使热导率随分子链长度增加而快速下降。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：聚合物分子链中热导率对分子取向的强敏感性源于扭结对声子的散射：即使在长波极限下，扭结仍能破坏纵向和横向声子的平移对称性，导致随机取向的扭结使热导率随分子链长度增加而快速下降。；创新点：揭示了扭结作为破坏平移对称性的关键缺陷，在长波极限下仍能强烈散射声子，从而解释了高度取向与无序取向聚合物之间热导率相差数个数量级的物理根源，并提出“扭结工程”作为调控聚合物热输运的途径。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体理论框架或计算方法，仅基于声子弹道输运与安德森局域化的物理图像进行理论分析。

papers.title: Nonmonotonic temperature dependence of the thermopower of atomic-size gold contacts
papers.abstract: We report measurements of the thermopower of atomic-size gold contacts realized by the mechanically controllable break junction (MCBJ) technique over a temperature range from 18 K to 295 K. A thermometer included in the lithographic structure close to the constriction provides a direct measurement of the temperature increase generated by heating one side of the contact with a focused laser beam. While the conductance histograms confirm the quantum nature of the transport, we observe a nonmonotonic temperature dependence of the ensemble-averaged thermopower with a minimum of $-2\,μ$VK$^{-1}$ at about 150 K. The values for the thermopower obtained at the lowest and the high temperature are compatible with values reported in the literature, but the nonmonotonic behavior in between disagrees with the expected linear dependence for quantum coherent conductors described by the Landauer formula. We develop a theoretical model based on an energy dependent transmission function that qualitatively reproduces the nonmonotonic behavior, but fails quantitatively. We therefore interpret our data as a result of phonon contributions to the thermopower beyond the Landauer model and with opposite sign than the classical phonon drag known from bulk systems. Our findings show that, firstly, the thermopower gives important insight into the transport properties of atomic-size structures and second that the linear approximation of the Landauer model has to be used with caution when studying more complex transport properties even for atomic contacts from free-electron metals.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：measurements、MCBJ technique、measurements of the thermopower）；研究对象：原子尺寸金接触（atomic-size gold contacts）的热电势（thermopower）随温度的变化行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 原子尺寸金接触的系综平均热电势随温度呈非单调变化，在约150 K处出现最小值（-2 μV/K），这与Landauer公式预期的线性温度依赖关系不符，表明声子贡献（phonon contributions）在热电势中起重要作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：原子尺寸金接触的系综平均热电势随温度呈非单调变化，在约150 K处出现最小值（-2 μV/K），这与Landauer公式预期的线性温度依赖关系不符，表明声子贡献（phonon contributions）在热电势中起重要作用。；创新点：首次在原子尺寸金接触中观察到热电势的非单调温度依赖行为，并指出该行为无法由Landauer模型定量解释，揭示了超出经典声子拖曳效应的声子贡献，提示在自由电子金属的原子接触中研究复杂输运性质时需谨慎使用Landauer模型的线性近似。
papers.method_zh: 采用机械可控断裂结（MCBJ）技术制备原子尺寸金接触，在18 K至295 K温度范围内测量热电势；通过集成在光刻结构中的温度计直接测量聚焦激光加热一侧接触引起的温升；结合电导直方图确认量子输运特性；并构建基于能量依赖透射函数的理论模型进行定性分析。

papers.title: Extending the La Solubility Limit in Sr$_3$Ir$_2$O$_7$ through High-Pressure High-Temperature Synthesis
papers.abstract: La-doped bilayer iridates provide an important platform for studying the evolution of the spin-orbit-assisted Mott state under electron doping, but the La solubility achieved by conventional ambient-pressure synthesis is limited. Here, we report the synthesis and physical properties of nominally La-doped (Sr$_{1-x}$La$_x$)$_3$Ir$_2$O$_7$ (x = 0.05, 0.10, 0.15, and 0.20) prepared using high-pressure high-temperature techniques. Single-crystal X-ray diffraction refinements, supported by scanning electron microscopy-energy-dispersive X-ray spectroscopy (SEM-EDX), reveal significantly enhanced La incorporation, with nominal x = 0.05 and 0.15 corresponding to actual compositions of approximately (Sr$_{0.89}$La$_{0.11}$)$_3$Ir$_2$O$_7$ and (Sr$_{0.77}$La$_{0.23}$)$_3$Ir$_2$O$_7$, respectively. At nominal x = 0.20, the bilayer phase is no longer stabilized and instead transforms into cubic perovskite Sr$_{1-x}$La$_x$IrO$_3$. (Sr$_{0.89}$La$_{0.11}$)$_3$Ir$_2$O$_7$ exhibits a ferromagnetic-like transition near 186 K accompanied by magnetic hysteresis and subtle lattice anomalies indicative of spin-lattice coupling. Despite its high electron-doping level, the compound remains strongly insulating, consistent with a heavily doped localized magnetic insulating state distinct from both parent Sr$_3$Ir$_2$O$_7$ and ambient-pressure La-doped samples. In contrast, (Sr$_{0.77}$La$_{0.23}$)$_3$Ir$_2$O$_7$ displays metal-like electronic behavior, weakened magnetic order, and enhanced carrier delocalization, although disorder-driven localization persists at low temperatures. These results demonstrate that high-pressure synthesis substantially extends the accessible doping range of bilayer iridates and reveals electronic and magnetic states inaccessible through conventional synthesis routes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确描述了“合成”、“物理性质”、“单晶X射线衍射”、“扫描电子显微镜-能量色散X射线光谱”等实验手段。；研究对象：La掺杂的双层铱氧化物 (Sr$_{1-x}$La$_x$)$_3$Ir$_2$O$_7$。具体研究在高压高温合成条件下，La掺杂对该体系电子和磁性质的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过高压高温合成技术，可以显著提高La在Sr$_3$Ir$_2$O$_7$中的溶解度，从而获得常规环境压力合成无法实现的电子掺杂浓度，并揭示出从重掺杂局域磁性绝缘体到类金属行为的电子态演化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过高压高温合成技术，可以显著提高La在Sr$_3$Ir$_2$O$_7$中的溶解度，从而获得常规环境压力合成无法实现的电子掺杂浓度，并揭示出从重掺杂局域磁性绝缘体到类金属行为的电子态演化。；创新点：利用高压高温合成方法突破了常规环境压力合成下La在Sr$_3$Ir$_2$O$_7$中的溶解度极限，成功获得了更高电子掺杂浓度的双层铱氧化物，并发现了常规合成路线无法实现的、从重掺杂局域磁性绝缘体到弱化磁有序的类金属态的电子态转变。
papers.method_zh: 主要采用高压高温合成技术制备样品；使用单晶X射线衍射和扫描电子显微镜-能量色散X射线光谱进行结构表征和成分分析；通过测量磁化率、电阻率等物理性质来研究其电子和磁行为。

papers.title: Role of quantum confinement in semiconductor-superconductor core-shell nanowires
papers.abstract: This work is motivated by the experimentally observed coherence of the supercurrent in semiconductor nanowires covered by a half-shell metallic superconductor, which leads to flux dependent supercurrent oscillations with period h/2e, as expected for a tubular superconductor, i.e. Little-Parks oscillations. We perform microscopic model calculations and compare the results for full and half metallic shells. We use an effective Hamiltonian derived from the Green's function of the proximitized semiconductor nanowire, where the presence of the superconductor is represented by a self energy. Furthermore, we incorporate the electrostatic band-bending at the metal-semiconductor interface as a rectangular narrow quantum well on the semiconductor side. The properties of the eigenstates of the effective Hamiltonian are determined by the spatial profile of the corresponding transverse modes in the normal state. For half-shell wires, transverse modes with high-enough energy expand outside the interface quantum well and generate eigenstates with mixed electron-hole character that surround the entire circumference of the nanowire, similar to eigenstates of the full-shell system. We identify these states as being responsible for the observed Little-Parks effect.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论计算文章。判断依据：关键词“microscopic model calculations”、“effective Hamiltonian”、“Green's function”、“self energy”。；研究对象：半导体-超导体核壳纳米线（semiconductor-superconductor core-shell nanowires），具体研究全壳（full shell）与半壳（half shell）金属超导覆盖层对体系超流相干性的影响，以及由此产生的Little-Parks振荡现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在半壳纳米线中，能量足够高的横向模式会扩展到界面量子阱之外，产生环绕整个纳米线圆周的、具有混合电子-空穴特征的本征态，这些态是导致实验观测到的Little-Parks效应的原因。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在半壳纳米线中，能量足够高的横向模式会扩展到界面量子阱之外，产生环绕整个纳米线圆周的、具有混合电子-空穴特征的本征态，这些态是导致实验观测到的Little-Parks效应的原因。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于近邻化半导体纳米线的格林函数推导有效哈密顿量，其中超导体的存在通过自能项表示；在金属-半导体界面处引入静电能带弯曲，将其建模为半导体侧的一个矩形窄量子阱；通过分析正常态下横向模式的空间分布来确定有效哈密顿量本征态的性质。

papers.title: Site Preferences and "Coloring Problem" in Cu-doped BiMn$_7$O$_{12}$ Quadruple Perovskite
papers.abstract: Lightly Cu-doped BiMn$_7$O$_{12}$ (x = 0.05, 0.10, and 0.15) was investigated using high-pressure synthesis, single-crystal X-ray diffraction, pair distribution function (PDF) analysis, STEM, magnetic measurements, and first-principles calculations. All compositions retain an average monoclinic $I$2/$m$ structure, while Cu substitution progressively suppresses the monoclinic distortion and drives the lattice toward a pseudo-cubic metric symmetry. PDF analysis reveals increasing local structural disorder and reduced medium-range coherence with increasing Cu concentration, despite preservation of the overall quadruple-perovskite framework. Single-crystal refinements indicate enhanced electron density at the octahedral Mn B sites, suggesting preferential Cu occupation within the MnO$_6$ network rather than the conventional square-planar sites expected for Cu$^{2+}$. Magnetic measurements reveal two characteristic anomalies near $T_1$ ~ 100-120 K and $T_2$ ~ 50-60 K, together with pronounced magnetic irreversibility, field-dependent hysteresis, and unsaturated magnetization. Increasing Cu concentration progressively suppresses the low-temperature magnetic state and weakens the field-induced moment. First-principles calculations favor Cu occupation at the square-planar sites, contrasting with the experimental refinements and highlighting strong competitions among local bonding, short-range disorder, and metastability in this highly frustrated quadruple perovskite system.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。关键词：高压合成、单晶X射线衍射、PDF分析、STEM、磁性测量、第一性原理计算。；研究对象：Cu掺杂的BiMn₇O₁₂四重钙钛矿材料（Cu浓度x=0.05, 0.10, 0.15），重点关注Cu的占位偏好及由此引发的“着色问题”（即阳离子在晶格中有序/无序分布问题）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 实验表明Cu优先占据八面体Mn B位（MnO₆网络），而非预期的Cu²⁺常规方形平面位；但第一性原理计算却倾向于Cu占据方形平面位，揭示了该高度阻挫四重钙钛矿体系中局域成键、短程无序与亚稳态之间的强烈竞争。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：实验表明Cu优先占据八面体Mn B位（MnO₆网络），而非预期的Cu²⁺常规方形平面位；但第一性原理计算却倾向于Cu占据方形平面位，揭示了该高度阻挫四重钙钛矿体系中局域成键、短程无序与亚稳态之间的强烈竞争。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 高压合成、单晶X射线衍射、对分布函数（PDF）分析、扫描透射电子显微镜（STEM）、磁性测量、第一性原理计算。

papers.title: Optical pulse-induced quantum geometric waves in graphene
papers.abstract: We show that, under a short optical pulse, the quantum metric of Bloch states in the momentum-time (kx, ky , t) of graphene becomes dynamic and exhibits a wave-like behavior near Dirac points. This quantum metric wave reflects the Floquet-band structure caused by the pulse, as revealed by solving the time-dependent Schrödinger equation assuming that correlations and out-of-equilibrium effects can be ignored. The momentum and temporal components of the metric have very distinct time dependence that persists even after the pulse has passed. In addition, the pulse also generates a Berry curvature wave that is otherwise absent in static graphene. The time-dependent electron densities in conduction and valence bands also give arise to a Fisher information wave that constitutes part of the quantum metric wave, and is readily measurable by pump-probe experiments.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“solving the time-dependent Schrödinger equation”，并基于理论模型（忽略关联和非平衡效应）进行分析，未涉及实验或计算模拟细节。；研究对象：石墨烯中由短光脉冲诱导的量子几何波，具体包括动量-时间空间中的量子度量波、贝里曲率波以及Fisher信息波。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在短光脉冲作用下，石墨烯狄拉克点附近的布洛赫态量子度量表现出类似波的动力学行为，并产生原本静态石墨烯中不存在的贝里曲率波；这些几何波在脉冲结束后仍持续存在。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在短光脉冲作用下，石墨烯狄拉克点附近的布洛赫态量子度量表现出类似波的动力学行为，并产生原本静态石墨烯中不存在的贝里曲率波；这些几何波在脉冲结束后仍持续存在。；创新点：首次揭示了光脉冲可在石墨烯中激发量子度量波和贝里曲率波，并指出Fisher信息波作为量子度量波的一部分，可通过泵浦-探测实验直接测量。
papers.method_zh: 通过求解含时薛定谔方程，在忽略关联和非平衡效应的近似下，分析光脉冲诱导的Floquet能带结构，并提取量子度量、贝里曲率及Fisher信息的时间演化。

papers.title: Hall conductivity reveals the nature of quantum coherence in strongly correlated metals
papers.abstract: Linear-in-temperature resistivity is a hallmark for strange metallic transport, and appears universally in many strongly correlated electron systems. However, the focus on the longitudinal channel often overshadows the profound microscopic insights contained within the transverse response. Here, we utilize numerically exact determinantal quantum Monte Carlo simulations of the doped Hubbard model in a magnetic field to calculate longitudinal and transverse transport. We demonstrate that while the resistivity is robustly $T$-linear across parameter sets, the Hall response is highly sensitive to particle-hole asymmetry, Fermi surface topology, and many-body correlation effects. Specifically, the combination of these effects determine a crossover scale in which the system becomes quantum-coherent, and is reflected in the Hall conductivity. Our results demonstrate that while the $T$-linearity in resistivity appears universal, the Hall response reveals a crossover from semi-classical to quantum-coherent transport otherwise masked in the longitudinal channel.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：determinantal quantum Monte Carlo simulations（行列式量子蒙特卡洛模拟）。；研究对象：强关联金属中的奇异金属输运现象，具体为掺杂Hubbard模型在磁场下的纵向和横向输运，重点关注霍尔电导率与量子相干性的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 电阻率的温度线性行为（T-linear）在不同参数下表现普适，但霍尔响应高度敏感于粒子-空穴不对称性、费米面拓扑和多体关联效应；霍尔电导率能揭示系统从半经典输运到量子相干输运的交叉，而这一交叉在纵向电导通道中被掩盖。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：电阻率的温度线性行为（T-linear）在不同参数下表现普适，但霍尔响应高度敏感于粒子-空穴不对称性、费米面拓扑和多体关联效应；霍尔电导率能揭示系统从半经典输运到量子相干输运的交叉，而这一交叉在纵向电导通道中被掩盖。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 利用数值精确的行列式量子蒙特卡洛模拟（determinantal quantum Monte Carlo），对磁场下的掺杂Hubbard模型计算纵向和横向输运系数。

papers.title: Lock-In Infrared Thermography: Phase Analysis for Rapid, Wide-Range Thermal Conductivity Measurements
papers.abstract: We report on a phase-based lock-in thermography approach, combined with a multilayered thermal model (often employed in thermoreflectance analysis), to measure the thermal conductivity of bulk materials and layered structures. The spatial distribution of the material's thermal phase is monitored with an infrared camera, which is locked into the frequency of a modulated laser used to heat the material. This phase distribution is then fit with a thermal model, in which properties such as thermal conductivity are extracted as fit parameters. This approach enables non-contact, front-side measurements, which are insensitive to surface roughness. The technique does not strictly require the application of a transducer layer, but we highlight the practical benefits of applying a removable adhesive layer to serve as a near-surface absorber. We demonstrate the efficacy of the method by measuring materials with thermal conductivities that span over three orders of magnitude (approximately 1 W/m/K to > 2000 W/m/K).
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词“lock-in thermography approach”、“infrared camera”、“measurements”、“demonstrate the efficacy”。；研究对象：块体材料和层状结构的热导率测量。具体涵盖热导率范围约1 W/m/K至>2000 W/m/K的材料。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种基于锁相红外热成像的相位分析方法，结合多层热模型，能够非接触、正面测量热导率，且对表面粗糙度不敏感，可测量跨越三个数量级的热导率范围。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种基于锁相红外热成像的相位分析方法，结合多层热模型，能够非接触、正面测量热导率，且对表面粗糙度不敏感，可测量跨越三个数量级的热导率范围。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段：锁相红外热成像（lock-in thermography），使用红外相机监测材料热相位的空间分布，并与调制激光频率锁定；结合多层热模型（常用于热反射分析）对相位分布进行拟合，提取热导率等参数。技术细节：不严格要求使用换能层，但建议使用可移除的粘附层作为近表面吸收体。

papers.title: Resolving Finite-Size Errors in EOM-CCSD Band Gaps of Solids with Interacting-Bath Dynamical Embedding Theory
papers.abstract: Periodic equation-of-motion coupled-cluster theory with single and double excitations (EOM-CCSD) has shown promise for quantitative calculations of band structures in solids. However, its steep computational scaling has limited calculations to relatively coarse $k$-point meshes, leading to sizable finite-size errors and discrepant estimates of thermodynamic-limit band gaps in recent benchmarks. In this work, we revisit EOM-CCSD band gaps for ten semiconductors and insulators using interacting-bath dynamical embedding theory (ibDET), a systematically improvable Green's function embedding framework that enables dense Brillouin-zone sampling at modest computational cost. By pushing the $k$-point sampling up to $10\times10\times10$, well beyond the system sizes accessible in canonical periodic EOM-CCSD calculations, we significantly reduce finite-size errors and obtain stable thermodynamic-limit extrapolations. We further compare $G_0W_0$@PBE, $G_0W_0$@HF, and EOM-CCSD on an equal footing using the same numerical settings in PySCF. We find that EOM-CCSD yields a mean absolute error of 0.27 eV relative to experimental band gaps for a test set of ten semiconductors and insulators, lower than that of $G_0W_0$@PBE. For ZnO, EOM-CCSD also accurately describes the Zn $3d$-band binding energy, despite overestimating the band gap. These results demonstrate that ibDET offers a practical route to high-accuracy many-body electronic structure calculations in periodic systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：EOM-CCSD、ibDET、Green's function embedding、PySCF。；研究对象：十种半导体和绝缘体（包括ZnO）的能带结构，特别是带隙和Zn 3d带结合能。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过相互作用浴动力学嵌入理论（ibDET）实现密集布里渊区采样，显著降低了EOM-CCSD计算固体带隙的有限尺寸误差，得到热力学极限下稳定的带隙值；EOM-CCSD对十种半导体和绝缘体的带隙预测平均绝对误差为0.27 eV，优于G₀W₀@PBE。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过相互作用浴动力学嵌入理论（ibDET）实现密集布里渊区采样，显著降低了EOM-CCSD计算固体带隙的有限尺寸误差，得到热力学极限下稳定的带隙值；EOM-CCSD对十种半导体和绝缘体的带隙预测平均绝对误差为0.27 eV，优于G₀W₀@PBE。；创新点：将ibDET应用于周期性EOM-CCSD计算，以克服其因计算量过大而只能使用粗k点网格导致的有限尺寸误差，从而获得更可靠的热力学极限带隙。
papers.method_zh: 使用相互作用浴动力学嵌入理论（ibDET），这是一种可系统改进的格林函数嵌入框架，在适度计算成本下实现密集k点采样（最高10×10×10）。在PySCF中采用相同数值设置，将G₀W₀@PBE、G₀W₀@HF与EOM-CCSD进行同等比较。

papers.title: Spontaneous symmetry breaking under Bose--Einstein condensation
papers.abstract: Due to high current interest to Bose-Einstein condensation, the related topics, such as spontaneous gauge symmetry breaking, ergodic decomposition, and particle fluctuations, are intensively discussed in literature. These discussions, unfortunately, involve quite a number of controversies and confusions. The goal of the present brief survey is to clarify some of these confusions, concentrating on the principal points, such as the relationship between the conditions of Bose-Einstein condensation, the Bogolubov method of quasiaverages, spontaneous gauge symmetry breaking, ergodic decomposition, the presumed existence of nonthermodynamic particle fluctuations leading to the so-called ``grand canonical catastrophe", and the requirements for system stability.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：brief survey、clarify confusions、Bogolubov method of quasiaverages、theoretical discussion）；研究对象：玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚（Bose-Einstein condensation）相关的理论问题，包括自发规范对称性破缺、遍历分解、粒子数涨落及系统稳定性等。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 论文旨在澄清当前文献中关于玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚条件下自发规范对称性破缺、遍历分解、非热力学粒子数涨落（即“巨正则系综灾难”）以及系统稳定性要求等关键问题上的争议与混淆。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：论文旨在澄清当前文献中关于玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚条件下自发规范对称性破缺、遍历分解、非热力学粒子数涨落（即“巨正则系综灾难”）以及系统稳定性要求等关键问题上的争议与混淆。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论综述与概念澄清，重点基于Bogolubov准平均方法（Bogolubov method of quasiaverages）进行分析。

papers.title: Multiband Superconductivity and Charge Density Wave in HfxZr1-xTe3 single crystals
papers.abstract: We report on the bulk multiband superconductivity and charge density wave (CDW) in HfxZr1-xTe3 single crystals. The parent compound ZrTe3 is a layered van der Waals material that undergoes a CDW transition near 63 K and exhibits only filamentary superconductivity below 2.0 K. Upon the introduction of a small amount of Hf (x = 0.02), the CDW transition temperature is reduced to TCDW ~ 53 K, while a robust bulk superconducting state emerges at Tc ~ 3.3 K, underscoring a subtle competition between CDW order and superconductivity in this quasi-one-dimensional system. Electrical resistivity, magnetic susceptibility, Hall effect, Seebeck coefficient, and specific heat measurements consistently confirm the bulk nature of the superconducting phase. The temperature dependence of the upper critical field Hc2(T) deviates markedly from single-band behavior, and it is well described by a two-band model, consistent with multiband superconductivity. Analysis of the Hall effect, and thermoelectric behavior reveal pronounced electronic anisotropy, with enhanced effective carrier masses, indicating that the subtle structural modification introduced by Hf substitutions affects the Fermi surface topology, as well as electronic correlations. Measurements of electrical resistivity in hydrostatic pressures up to ~ 2 GPa reveal that pressure drives TCDW to higher temperatures while suppressing Tc. These findings show that Hf doping can be used to fine-tune the balance between the CDW instability and superconductivity, possibly by means of chemical pressure effects, stabilizing a multiband superconducting state in Hf-doped ZrTe3.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：单晶生长、电阻率、磁化率、霍尔效应、塞贝克系数、比热、静水压测量。；研究对象：HfxZr1-xTe3单晶中的多带超导电性与电荷密度波（CDW）。具体体系为准一维层状范德瓦尔斯材料ZrTe3及其Hf掺杂衍生物。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在ZrTe3中掺入少量Hf（x=0.02）可抑制CDW转变温度（从~63 K降至~53 K），同时诱导出体态多带超导电性（Tc~3.3 K），表明CDW与超导电性之间存在微妙竞争；上临界场Hc2(T)偏离单带行为，可用两带模型完美描述。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在ZrTe3中掺入少量Hf（x=0.02）可抑制CDW转变温度（从~63 K降至~53 K），同时诱导出体态多带超导电性（Tc~3.3 K），表明CDW与超导电性之间存在微妙竞争；上临界场Hc2(T)偏离单带行为，可用两带模型完美描述。；创新点：首次在Hf掺杂ZrTe3中实现从丝状超导到体态多带超导的转变，并通过化学压力效应精细调控CDW与超导电性的平衡。摘要未突出说明与纯ZrTe3或其他掺杂（如Se、Ti等）的详细对比。
papers.method_zh: 单晶生长（方法未明确说明）；电输运测量（电阻率、霍尔效应、塞贝克系数）；磁化率测量；比热测量；静水压（~2 GPa）下的电阻率测量。

papers.title: Computationally efficient method for determining limiting velocities of edge dislocations in anisotropic crystals
papers.abstract: The continuum-limit theory of dislocations in crystals predicts divergences in the elastic energy at crystal-geometry dependent limiting velocities $v_L$, which separate subsonic, transsonic, and supersonic dislocation glide regimes and are therefore import for material strength models at high strain rates. Although it is known how to calculate those limiting velocities, there is one special case - edge dislocations with reflection symmetry, but non-vanishing elastic constants $c'_{16}$ or $c'_{26}$ - where previous methods have been notoriously slow. In this letter, we address this deficiency by deriving a computationally efficient method for determining the limiting velocities of edge dislocations with reflection symmetry.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：continuum-limit theory（连续极限理论）、computationally efficient method（高效计算方法）、deriving（推导）。；研究对象：各向异性晶体中具有反射对称性的刃型位错的极限速度（limiting velocities），以及这些速度对材料高应变率强度模型的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 针对具有反射对称性但弹性常数c'16或c'16非零的刃型位错，传统计算方法极其缓慢，本文推导出一种计算效率更高的新方法来确定其极限速度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：针对具有反射对称性但弹性常数c'16或c'16非零的刃型位错，传统计算方法极其缓慢，本文推导出一种计算效率更高的新方法来确定其极限速度。；创新点：解决了已有方法在计算具有反射对称性但c'16或c'26非零的刃型位错极限速度时计算速度极慢的缺陷，首次提供了该特殊情形下的高效计算方案。
papers.method_zh: 基于位错连续极限理论，通过数学推导提出一种新的高效计算方法，专门解决特定对称性条件下（反射对称性且c'16或c'26非零）刃型位错极限速度的计算瓶颈。

papers.title: The formation of magnetic reentrancy in the Ising model on a decorated square lattice
papers.abstract: In our work, based on an exact solution of the Ising model on a decorated square lattice with an arbitrary number of decorating spins, we have demonstrated the fundamental possibility of describing the phenomenon of multiple magnetic phase transitions (magnetic reentrancy) in the regime of competing exchange interactions. We analyzed the magnetic behavior of the system and established the conditions for the occurrence of magnetic reentrancy. We have determined the relationships of the model parameter under which the formation of one, three, and even five magnetic phase transitions is possible, which is confirmed by a complicated magnetic phase diagram. We have also proposed a unique method for finding critical temperatures that allows for the precise determination of their number and values, including those at extremely low temperatures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：exact solution（精确解）、Ising model（伊辛模型）、magnetic phase diagram（磁相图）。；研究对象：在具有竞争交换相互作用的装饰方格（decorated square lattice）上，伊辛模型中的多重磁相变现象（磁回滞，magnetic reentrancy）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过精确求解装饰方格上任意数量装饰自旋的伊辛模型，证明了在竞争交换相互作用下描述多重磁相变（磁回滞）现象的基本可能性，并确定了可发生一次、三次甚至五次磁相变的模型参数关系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过精确求解装饰方格上任意数量装饰自旋的伊辛模型，证明了在竞争交换相互作用下描述多重磁相变（磁回滞）现象的基本可能性，并确定了可发生一次、三次甚至五次磁相变的模型参数关系。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于装饰方格伊辛模型的精确解（exact solution），分析系统的磁行为，并建立磁回滞发生的条件；提出了一种寻找临界温度的独特方法，可精确确定临界温度的数量和数值（包括极低温下的临界温度）。

papers.title: Compositional gradient engineering for enhanced ferroelectricity in ultrathin AlScN
papers.abstract: Ferroelectric AlScN is promising for CMOS-compatible non-volatile memory, but thickness scaling is limited by leakage, premature breakdown, and defect-mediated failure. Here we show that compositional grading within a continuous wurtzite AlN-AlScN lattice mitigates these limitations by distributing structural and polarization discontinuities across the film thickness, reducing defect formation and local field concentration. In a 20 nm graded heterostructure, monotonic Sc incorporation and AlN-rich boundaries produce reversible ferroelectric switching, an as-grown metal-polar state, a 21% higher breakdown field, 10% enhanced remanent polarization, and 40x higher resistivity relative to homogeneous AlScN. Time-domain PUND measurements reveal strongly suppressed post-switching leakage, consistent with reduced defect-assisted and polarization-coupled conduction. This improved dielectric robustness enables ferroelectric functionality in 5 nm graded stacks containing only a 2 nm $\mathrm{Al}_{0.64}\mathrm{Sc}_{0.36}\mathrm{N}$ region, with measurable switching near 1 V. These results establish compositional grading as a defect- and field-management strategy for scalable ultrathin wurtzite ferroelectrics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“Time-domain PUND measurements”等实验测量手段，以及“20 nm graded heterostructure”“5 nm graded stacks”等具体样品结构。；研究对象：论文研究的具体材料是组分梯度化的纤锌矿结构AlN-AlScN薄膜，物理现象是铁电性及其在超薄尺度下的增强与可靠性提升。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过组分梯度工程（compositional grading），在连续纤锌矿AlN-AlScN晶格中分布结构和极化不连续性，可有效抑制缺陷形成和局部电场集中，从而在超薄（5 nm）薄膜中实现可逆铁电开关，并显著提升击穿场强、剩余极化和电阻率。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过组分梯度工程（compositional grading），在连续纤锌矿AlN-AlScN晶格中分布结构和极化不连续性，可有效抑制缺陷形成和局部电场集中，从而在超薄（5 nm）薄膜中实现可逆铁电开关，并显著提升击穿场强、剩余极化和电阻率。；创新点：首次提出并实验验证了组分梯度工程作为缺陷和电场管理策略，用于实现可扩展的超薄纤锌矿铁电体，突破了传统均匀组分AlScN在厚度缩小时因漏电和击穿导致的性能瓶颈。
papers.method_zh: 主要采用组分梯度外延生长（monotonic Sc incorporation, AlN-rich boundaries）制备异质结构，结合时间域PUND（正-负-正-负脉冲）测量表征开关后漏电流，以及击穿场强、剩余极化、电阻率等电学性能测试。

papers.title: Hierarchical Interdiffusion Kinetics in Nanoscale Ni/Al Multilayers
papers.abstract: Nanoscale mass transport governs the onset of intermetallic formation in reactive metallic multilayers, yet the underlying mechanisms remain poorly understood. Here, we combine fast differential scanning calorimetry (FDSC) of free-standing Ni/Al multilayers (20 nm bilayer thickness) with correlative STEM to resolve the early interdiffusion regime. Varying the heating rate over five orders of magnitude (0.1 to 10,000 K/s) enables isoconversional Kissinger-Akahira-Sunose (KAS) analysis, linking heat-flow signatures to microstructural evolution. The as-deposited multilayers are nanocrystalline and exhibit pronounced premixing, with significant Ni enrichment throughout the Al layers. Upon annealing, mass transport proceeds hierarchically: at low temperatures, Ni diffusion is confined to Al grain boundaries (~81 kJ/mol), while at higher temperatures lattice diffusion from grain boundaries into the grain interiors becomes active (~168 kJ/mol), leading to increased mass transport and heat release. These findings identify grain boundaries as the dominant transport pathways controlling reaction onset and as key microstructural design parameters in reactive multilayers. By providing access to transient kinetic regimes and intermediate states, the combined FDSC-microscopy approach opens new opportunities for studying defect-mediated transport and non-equilibrium phase transformations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：fast differential scanning calorimetry (FDSC)、correlative STEM、Kissinger-Akahira-Sunose (KAS) analysis。；研究对象：纳米尺度Ni/Al多层膜（双层厚度20 nm）中的早期互扩散动力学，以及由此引发的金属间化合物形成过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 纳米Ni/Al多层膜中的质量输运呈现层级性：低温下Ni扩散局限于Al晶界（激活能约81 kJ/mol），高温下晶界向晶粒内部的晶格扩散被激活（激活能约168 kJ/mol），导致质量输运和放热增加。晶界是控制反应起始的主导输运通道。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：纳米Ni/Al多层膜中的质量输运呈现层级性：低温下Ni扩散局限于Al晶界（激活能约81 kJ/mol），高温下晶界向晶粒内部的晶格扩散被激活（激活能约168 kJ/mol），导致质量输运和放热增加。晶界是控制反应起始的主导输运通道。；创新点：通过跨越五个数量级的加热速率结合FDSC与STEM，首次解析了纳米Ni/Al多层膜早期互扩散的层级动力学，并定量区分了晶界扩散与晶格扩散的激活能，将晶界识别为关键微结构设计参数。
papers.method_zh: 结合快速差示扫描量热法（FDSC，加热速率跨越五个数量级：0.1至10,000 K/s）与关联扫描透射电子显微镜（STEM），并采用等转化率Kissinger-Akahira-Sunose（KAS）分析方法将热流信号与微观结构演化关联。

papers.title: Dynamical Control of Superconductivity in Superconductor-Ferromagnet Bilayers
papers.abstract: We study a simplified model of a ferromagnetic metal proximitized by a fully-gapped $s-$wave superconductor and integrated with a microwave resonator. The low-energy excitations in the combined system consist of ferromagnetic magnons, Bogoliubov excitations of the superconductor, and cavity photons. We show here that when the magnons and photons have comparable frequencies and are subject to an external drive, the hybridized driven magnon-polaritons induce a non-equilibrium crossover from the expected proximitized nodal $p-$wave superconductor to a fully gapped $(p_x+ip_y)-$superconductor. Moreover, the characteristic crossover temperature is inversely related to the magnon-photon detuning. We compute the temperature-dependent renormalization of the cavity photon frequencies across this nodal to nodeless evolution, which modifies the kinetic inductance of the resonator, and find a number of non-trivial features tied to the non-equilibrium (i.e., driven) nature of the problem. We compare and contrast these results with a recent circuit quantum electrodynamics (cQED) based experiment studying a permalloy-niobium bilayer, where a non-trivial dependence of the low-temperature cavity response on the magnon-photon detuning was observed. Our results pave the way for a principled exploration of engineering novel states of matter by coupling cavity photons to electronic collective modes in correlated two-dimensional materials and interfaces.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：study a simplified model, show, compute, compare and contrast with experiment）；研究对象：超导体-铁磁体双层膜（fully-gapped s-wave superconductor proximitized ferromagnetic metal）与微波谐振腔耦合的混合系统，以及其中的磁子-光子杂化激发（magnon-polaritons）对超导态的非平衡调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当磁子与光子频率相近并受外部驱动时，杂化的驱动磁子-极化激元会诱导系统从预期的近邻化节状p波超导体转变为全能隙的(p_x+ip_y)超导体；该转变的特征温度与磁子-光子失谐量成反比。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当磁子与光子频率相近并受外部驱动时，杂化的驱动磁子-极化激元会诱导系统从预期的近邻化节状p波超导体转变为全能隙的(p_x+ip_y)超导体；该转变的特征温度与磁子-光子失谐量成反比。；创新点：揭示了通过驱动磁子-光子杂化模式（驱动磁子-极化激元）实现超导配对对称性从节状到无能隙的动力学调控，并指出腔光子频率的温度依赖性与非平衡驱动特性相关。摘要未突出说明与纯平衡态理论相比的具体新机制。
papers.method_zh: 采用简化模型理论分析，计算了非平衡（驱动）条件下腔光子频率随温度的重整化，并与基于电路量子电动力学（cQED）的坡莫合金-铌双层膜实验进行对比。

papers.title: Influence-solvability: a systematic theory of $(1+1)D$ solvability and its application to brickwork circuits
papers.abstract: `Solvable' circuits, such as dual unitaries and its generalisations, have arisen as paradigmatic examples of tractable chaotic non-equilibrium dynamics, both in classical and quantum systems. However, while increasingly more complicated sufficient conditions have been proposed, a systematic theory classifying and understanding general features of solvable circuits is missing. We develop such a theory by introducing influence-solvable circuits, a class of $(1+1)D$ circuits whose influence matrix, which represents the `bath' generated by its own evolution, is given by a uniform MPS with finite bond-dimension $χ$. This property allows for efficient computation of subsystem dynamics and essentially contains all known examples of solvable circuits. We derive a set of necessary and sufficient local conditions by using a version of the fundamental theorem of MPS for open boundary conditions. Next we apply our theory to brickwork circuits with $χ=1$ influence-solvability and perform a systematic classification of classical brickwork circuits with local dimension up to $d=3$ and quantum brickwork circuits with $d=2$. Our search reveals new solvable circuits that are not captured by known solvability conditions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“develop such a theory”、“derive a set of necessary and sufficient local conditions”、“perform a systematic classification”，属于理论框架构建与分类研究。；研究对象：可解电路（solvable circuits），特别是(1+1)维砖墙电路（brickwork circuits），包括经典和量子两种情况，局部维度分别为d≤3（经典）和d=2（量子）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了“影响可解电路”（influence-solvable circuits）这一新概念，其影响矩阵由有限键维χ的均匀MPS表示，从而系统性地分类和理解了所有已知可解电路，并发现了未被已有条件覆盖的新可解电路。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了“影响可解电路”（influence-solvable circuits）这一新概念，其影响矩阵由有限键维χ的均匀MPS表示，从而系统性地分类和理解了所有已知可解电路，并发现了未被已有条件覆盖的新可解电路。；创新点：首次建立了可解电路的系统性理论框架，将此前零散的充分条件统一为基于影响矩阵MPS表示的必要充分条件，并通过分类搜索发现了新的可解电路。
papers.method_zh: 利用开放边界条件下MPS基本定理的变体，推导出影响可解性的必要充分局部条件；随后对χ=1的影响可解砖墙电路进行系统分类，涵盖经典d≤3和量子d=2的情形。

papers.title: Hidden antiferromagnetism, persistent valley fluctuations, and $U(6)$ crossovers in triangular-lattice M-point moiré materials via determinantal quantum Monte Carlo
papers.abstract: A new moiré material platform was recently proposed based on twisting two-dimensional atomic monolayers whose low-energy states lie at the three M-points of the Brillouin Zone. Continuum and ab initio modeling suggest that electrons in the conduction bands of these materials realize three-valley Hubbard models with valley-selective, quasi-one-dimensional hopping. Remarkably, the onsite Hubbard repulsion is almost $U(6)$-symmetric without fine-tuning. Here, we show that this class of systems naturally admits sign-free determinantal Quantum Monte Carlo simulations at a filling of three electrons per moiré unit cell. We use these to explore the phase diagram for interactions of various strengths and $U(6)$-breaking anisotropies. We show that for near-isotropic interactions as relevant to, e.g., AA-stacked twisted SnSe$_2$, the system exhibits an extended intermediate-coupling regime in which local-moment formation and itinerancy compete, and the crossover to a putative low-temperature ordered state can be understood in terms of fluctuating $U(6)$ local moments. We argue that many of these features persist beyond the idealized sign-problem-free limit.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：determinantal Quantum Monte Carlo（行列式量子蒙特卡洛）、modeling（建模）、phase diagram（相图）。；研究对象：三角晶格M点莫尔材料中的三谷Hubbard模型。具体体系为通过扭转二维原子单层（如AA堆叠的扭曲SnSe₂）构建的新型莫尔材料平台，其低能态位于布里渊区的三个M点。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在每莫尔原胞填充三个电子的条件下，该体系在近各向同性相互作用下存在一个扩展的中等耦合区间，其中局域磁矩形成与巡游性相互竞争，且向低温有序态的交叉可由涨落的U(6)局域磁矩来理解。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在每莫尔原胞填充三个电子的条件下，该体系在近各向同性相互作用下存在一个扩展的中等耦合区间，其中局域磁矩形成与巡游性相互竞争，且向低温有序态的交叉可由涨落的U(6)局域磁矩来理解。；创新点：首次证明了该类三谷Hubbard模型在特定填充下天然适合无符号问题的DQMC模拟，并利用该优势系统探索了不同相互作用强度和U(6)破缺各向异性下的相图，揭示了隐藏的反铁磁序和持续的谷涨落行为。
papers.method_zh: 主要采用无符号问题的行列式量子蒙特卡洛（determinantal Quantum Monte Carlo, DQMC）模拟，并结合连续模型和从头算（ab initio）建模。

papers.title: Composite Quantum Geometry and Semiclassical Dynamics
papers.abstract: We derive semiclassical equations of motion for general composite bound states in insulators and semiconductors, covering excitations such as excitons and trions. For neutral composites we find that a uniform external electric field does not couple to a Berry curvature term, contrary to the naive expectation from single-electron dynamics. Instead, a distinct quantum geometric quantity appears generically in the equations of motion. This quantity is the difference between inequivalent Berry connections that can be defined for the composite, generalising the concept of the quantum geometric dipole previously studied for excitons. In the case of charged composites such as trions, we find an additional Berry curvature contribution to the equations of motion. As we demonstrate, however, there is an infinite family of inequivalent composite Berry curvatures, and so care must be taken to make the correct choice that describes the physical dynamics. We explain how this choice should be made dependent on the definition of a spatial centre for the composite. We end by discussing composite dynamics that have no single-electron counterpart. We find that trions in magic-angle twisted bilayer graphene undergo a transverse drift under an applied electric field and that this is driven not only by the Berry curvature contribution but also by the quantum geometric dipole. The interplay of these two geometric contributions further imprints itself on the trion's internal dynamics, causing its dipole moment to oscillate in time.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“derive”（推导）、“equations of motion”（运动方程）、“quantum geometric quantity”（量子几何量）等，属于理论推导与模型分析。；研究对象：绝缘体和半导体中的复合束缚态，具体包括激子（excitons）和三子（trions）等激发态，以及魔角扭曲双层石墨烯中的三子动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 中性复合粒子（如激子）在均匀外电场中不产生贝里曲率项，而是出现一种新的量子几何量——不等价贝里连接之差（推广了量子几何偶极子概念）；带电复合粒子（如三子）则存在贝里曲率贡献，但需根据复合粒子的空间中心定义正确选择无穷多不等价贝里曲率中的一种。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：中性复合粒子（如激子）在均匀外电场中不产生贝里曲率项，而是出现一种新的量子几何量——不等价贝里连接之差（推广了量子几何偶极子概念）；带电复合粒子（如三子）则存在贝里曲率贡献，但需根据复合粒子的空间中心定义正确选择无穷多不等价贝里曲率中的一种。；创新点：揭示了复合粒子（中性及带电）中量子几何效应的新形式，特别是中性复合粒子中贝里曲率项的缺失与量子几何偶极子的推广，以及带电复合粒子中贝里曲率选择依赖于空间中心定义。此外，发现了三子中量子几何偶极子与贝里曲率共同驱动的横向漂移及内禀偶极矩振荡，这些动力学行为无单电子对应。
papers.method_zh: 采用半经典运动方程（semiclassical equations of motion）理论框架，对一般复合束缚态进行推导，并应用于魔角扭曲双层石墨烯中的三子动力学分析。

papers.title: Charting the emergent low-dimensional manifold of quantum materials
papers.abstract: The periodic table of elements transformed chemistry by revealing simple organizing principles underlying atomic behavior. Despite decades of effort, no analogous framework has emerged for crystalline materials -- their microscopic complexity and vast configurational space have defied reduction to fundamental organizing principles. Current databases catalog thousands of synthesized materials, but extracting predictive, interpretable models from this wealth of data remains a formidable challenge. Here we demonstrate that the materials landscape possesses a hidden geometric organization that can be unveiled through unsupervised nonlinear dimensionality reduction. Applying differential geometry techniques to the Inorganic Crystal Structure Database (ICSD), we reveal that just a few combinations of microscopic descriptors capture the vast majority of variance in material properties. This low-dimensional embedding autonomously segregates superconductors from ordinary materials and further distinguishes superconducting families in ways that transcend chemical similarity alone. Remarkably, the discovered geometric organization directly governs critical temperatures ($T_c$) across diverse superconducting families, enabling accurate $T_c$ predictions without any knowledge of the pairing mechanism. Our approach uncovers emergent organizing principles that control macroscopic quantum behavior, offering a new paradigm in how we build models of complex quantum materials directly from experimental data.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：unsupervised nonlinear dimensionality reduction、differential geometry techniques、low-dimensional embedding。；研究对象：晶体材料（基于无机晶体结构数据库 ICSD 中的数千种合成材料），特别是超导材料及其临界温度（\(T_c\)）的预测。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 材料性质空间存在一个低维几何结构，仅需少数微观描述符的组合即可捕捉大部分性质差异；该几何结构能自动区分超导体与普通材料，并直接控制不同超导家族的临界温度，无需依赖配对机制即可准确预测 \(T_c\)。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：材料性质空间存在一个低维几何结构，仅需少数微观描述符的组合即可捕捉大部分性质差异；该几何结构能自动区分超导体与普通材料，并直接控制不同超导家族的临界温度，无需依赖配对机制即可准确预测 \(T_c\)。；创新点：首次通过无监督几何方法揭示材料景观中隐藏的低维流形结构，并证明该结构可直接用于预测超导临界温度，超越了传统基于化学相似性的分类框架。
papers.method_zh: 无监督非线性降维（unsupervised nonlinear dimensionality reduction）、微分几何技术（differential geometry techniques），应用于无机晶体结构数据库（ICSD）中的微观描述符数据。

papers.title: Cyclotron mass-selective de Haas-van Alphen measurements using temperature modulation
papers.abstract: We present a temperature-modulated de Haas-van Alphen measurement technique that allows selective addressing of quantum oscillations with different effective masses $m^{\ast}$ using a non-monotonic amplitude evolution with temperature and magnetic field, governed by the temperature derivative of the Lifshitz-Kosevich factor. The technique relies on harmonic modulation of the sample temperature and phase-sensitive detection of quantum oscillations in the voltage induced in a pick-up coil. We use a set of frequencies with strong Zeeman-driven harmonic content in the compensated topological semimetal MoSi$_{2}$ as a natural linear mass comb ranging from 1$m^{\ast}$ to 13$m^{\ast}$ to demonstrate the tunability of the mass-dependent quantum oscillation amplitudes experimentally. The technique allows to reliably isolate weak contributions of heavy orbits that are inaccessible in conventional de Haas-van Alphen frequency spectra because their frequency peaks overlap with much stronger frequency peaks of lighter orbits.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了“temperature-modulated de Haas-van Alphen measurement technique”的实验实现，并进行了“experimentally”的演示。；研究对象：补偿型拓扑半金属 MoSi₂ 中的量子振荡现象，特别是不同有效质量（m*）的轨道对应的 de Haas-van Alphen 效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种温度调制型 de Haas-van Alphen 测量技术，能够通过温度导数控制的非单调振幅演化，选择性地探测具有不同有效质量的量子振荡，从而分离出传统频谱中因与强峰重叠而无法分辨的重轨道弱信号。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种温度调制型 de Haas-van Alphen 测量技术，能够通过温度导数控制的非单调振幅演化，选择性地探测具有不同有效质量的量子振荡，从而分离出传统频谱中因与强峰重叠而无法分辨的重轨道弱信号。；创新点：利用温度调制实现有效质量选择性探测，能够可靠地分离出传统 de Haas-van Alphen 频谱中因频率峰与更轻轨道强峰重叠而无法观测的重轨道弱贡献。
papers.method_zh: 温度调制 de Haas-van Alphen 测量技术。具体包括：对样品温度进行谐波调制，利用锁相放大技术检测拾取线圈中感应电压的量子振荡信号，并结合 Lifshitz-Kosevich 因子的温度导数来调控振幅。

papers.title: Spin correlations, low-energy scales, and anisotropy scaling in kagome frustrated magnets
papers.abstract: Neutron scattering is central to identifying quantum states of magnetic materials. In the search for quantum spin liquids, broad spectral features of inelastic spectra have been cited as evidence for spinon excitations, but can also arise from magnon excitations excitations in the presence of quenched disorder and strong magnon interactions. We develop a new approach to this problem, based on the adiabatic continuity in the $XXZ$ Heisenberg model on geometrically frustrating (GF) lattices as a function of the model's anisotropy. Using this approach, we identify universal features and energies of finite-temperature spin correlators. Focusing on the kagome lattice, we show that the low-energy spin spectral function contains robust, momentum-independent peaks with frequencies: $ω_1 \approx 3.4 T^*$ and $ω_2 \approx 6.3 T^*$, where the ``hidden energy scale'' $T^*$ is the characteristic scale of a low-temperature peak in the heat capacity, at which many GF magnets also display spin-glass freezing. We show that the spectral features at low energies $ω\lesssim T^*$ arise from single-magnon scattering and identify the magnetizations of the respective excitations. We explore the evolution of the spectral features with temperature and discuss extensions to other GF lattices. Our results provide a sharp spectroscopic criterion for interpreting neutron scattering in kagome and other GF quantum magnets.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“develop a new approach”“identify universal features”“explore the evolution”等，未涉及具体实验数据或计算模拟，主要基于模型分析和理论推导。；研究对象：几何阻挫（GF）晶格上的XXZ海森堡模型，重点聚焦于kagome（笼目）晶格上的阻挫磁体，研究其自旋关联、低能标度以及各向异性标度行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在kagome晶格上，低能自旋谱函数中存在两个与动量无关的稳健峰，频率分别为ω₁≈3.4 T*和ω₂≈6.3 T*，其中T*是热容低温峰的特征能标，也是许多GF磁体出现自旋玻璃冻结的能标；低能（ω≲T*）谱特征源于单磁子散射。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在kagome晶格上，低能自旋谱函数中存在两个与动量无关的稳健峰，频率分别为ω₁≈3.4 T*和ω₂≈6.3 T*，其中T*是热容低温峰的特征能标，也是许多GF磁体出现自旋玻璃冻结的能标；低能（ω≲T*）谱特征源于单磁子散射。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于XXZ海森堡模型在几何阻挫晶格上的绝热连续性，通过分析模型各向异性参数的变化，识别有限温度自旋关联函数的普适特征和能量标度。

papers.title: Mixed-dimensional quantum Monte Carlo studies of M-point moiré materials
papers.abstract: A new moiré-material platform has recently been proposed based on twisting two-dimensional triangular-lattice monolayers whose low-energy states lie at the three M points of the Brillouin zone. Continuum models derived from extensive ab initio simulations suggest that electrons in the conduction bands of one such M-point moiré material, twisted AA-stacked SnSe$_2$, realize a three-orbital Hubbard model with orbitally-selective, quasi-one-dimensional (quasi-1D) hopping, protected by a projective mirror symmetry. Here, we show that the resulting "mixed-dimensional" limit -- in which the hopping is exactly quasi-1D in each valley, while the valleys are coupled by interactions into a fully two-dimensional network -- can be sampled with Stochastic Series Expansion (SSE) quantum Monte Carlo (QMC) without a sign problem at any filling. We develop an efficient new SSE QMC algorithm that combines custom global updates with parallel tempering to overcome the equilibration challenges posed by the mixed-dimensional setting. We then use this algorithm to explore the phase diagram of M-point twisted AA-stacked SnSe$_2$. Over extended and realistic ranges of twist angles and interaction strengths, we find that at integer fillings the system supports correlated insulators whose nature and strength depend strongly on angle. At certain commensurate fractional fillings, we further find evidence for Wigner-Mott insulators. We analytically account for the main features observed numerically using a strong-coupling description. Finally, we discuss perturbations away from the mixed-dimensional limit and the possibility of applying our method to other realizations of mixed-dimensional Hubbard models.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：quantum Monte Carlo、continuum models、strong-coupling description。；研究对象：M点莫尔材料，具体为扭曲AA堆叠SnSe₂中由导带电子实现的三轨道Hubbard模型，以及其“混合维度”极限下的相图。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在整数填充下，系统支持关联绝缘体，其性质与强度强烈依赖于扭转角；在某些有理分数填充下，存在Wigner-Mott绝缘体的证据。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在整数填充下，系统支持关联绝缘体，其性质与强度强烈依赖于扭转角；在某些有理分数填充下，存在Wigner-Mott绝缘体的证据。；创新点：首次将SSE QMC方法应用于M点莫尔材料中由轨道选择性准一维跳跃与相互作用耦合形成的混合维度体系，并开发了针对该体系平衡化挑战的高效算法。
papers.method_zh: 采用随机级数展开（SSE）量子蒙特卡洛（QMC）方法，结合自定义全局更新与并行回火算法，对无符号问题的混合维度Hubbard模型进行数值模拟，并用强耦合描述解析解释数值结果。

papers.title: Electric-Field Mapping of Optically Perturbed CdTe Radiation Detectors
papers.abstract: In radiation detectors, the spatial distribution of the electric field plays a fundamental role in their operation. Access to this field distribution is of strategic importance, especially when investigating the perturbing effects induced by incident radiation. For example, one dangerous effect that prevents their proper operation is the accumulation of internal space charge. Here, we probe the two-dimensional electric field in a Schottky CdTe detector using the Pockels effect and report on its local perturbation after exposure to an optical beam at the anode electrode. Our electro-optical imaging setup, together with a custom processing routine, allows the extraction of the electric-field vector maps and their dynamics during a voltage bias-optical exposure sequence. The results are in agreement with numerical simulations, allowing us to confirm a two-level model based on a dominant deep level. Such a simple model is indeed able to fully account for both the temporal and spatial dynamics of the perturbed electric field.
