papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：非互易相互作用驱动的活性固体中，形状空间演化方程（非线性反应-平流-扩散系统）会产生稳态、振荡和混沌图案，这些图案分别表现为刚性运动、游泳运动和混沌运动，从而将非互易弹性流体动力学与几何图案形成联系起来。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于欧几里得对称性不变性假设，推导了非互易细长体的形状空间弹性流体动力学公式，将内在变形与刚性运动分离，得到非线性反应-平流-扩散系统作为几何流方程。

papers.title: Bulk-like Compressibility of the Au-Au Metallic Bond in the Atomically Precise $\mathrm{Au}_{25}$ Cluster
papers.abstract: We present a high-pressure single-crystal X-ray diffraction study of the atomically precise $\mathrm{Au}_{25}(\mathrm{PET})_{18}^{q}$ cluster ($q=-1,0$) up to 10 GPa under strictly hydrostatic conditions. Our crystallographic analysis provides direct evidence for the pressure-induced phase transitions previously suggested by spectroscopic studies. Structural refinements reveal that the cluster accommodates compression through the reorganization of the flexible ligand shell and secondary distortions of the staple motifs, while the $\mathrm{Au}_{13}$ icosahedral core remains intact. Notably, the internal Au-Au distances exhibit a monotonic contraction that quantitatively mirrors the compressibility of bulk gold. This invariant rigidity at the sub-nanometer scale demonstrates that the fundamental stiffness of the metallic bond is preserved regardless of size. Our findings reconcile previous contradictions in the elasticity of metal nanostructures by isolating the intrinsic mechanical response of the gold kernel from extrinsic structural and experimental artifacts.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：high-pressure single-crystal X-ray diffraction study（高压单晶X射线衍射研究）、crystallographic analysis（晶体学分析）、structural refinements（结构精修）。；研究对象：原子精确的Au₂₅(PET)₁₈^q团簇（q = -1, 0），具体研究其在高压下金属键的压缩行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Au₂₅团簇内部的Au-Au键距在高压下呈现单调收缩，其压缩性与块体金定量一致，表明亚纳米尺度下金属键的本征刚度与尺寸无关。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Au₂₅团簇内部的Au-Au键距在高压下呈现单调收缩，其压缩性与块体金定量一致，表明亚纳米尺度下金属键的本征刚度与尺寸无关。；创新点：通过直接晶体学证据，将金团簇内核的固有力学响应与外在结构及实验伪影分离，解决了此前关于金属纳米结构弹性行为的矛盾结论。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 高压单晶X射线衍射（high-pressure single-crystal XRD），在严格静水压条件下（最高10 GPa）进行结构解析与精修。

papers.title: Berry-phase-based Topological Charge in Quasicrystals and their Observable Features in Photonic System
papers.abstract: Topological charges based on Berry phase play the fundamental role in the topological physics. However, such topological charges remain unexplored in quasicrystals, impeding the systematic understanding of topological states in such quasiperiodic systems. In this work, by deriving all the allowed topological charges according to group representation theory and the corresponding low-energy effective Hamiltonians, we establish a universal framework for Berry-phase-based topological charges in two-dimensional quasicrystals. Taking the $C_{8v}$ quasicrystal as an example, we demonstrate and characterize a higher topological charge of $C=4$, which is inaccessible in conventional periodic systems. Applying our framework to photonic quasicrystals, we uncover that the circling of photon momentum around the charge gives a $C$ times winding of the electromagnetic field distribution pattern. Such observable feature provides a direct experimental method to probe the topological charges. Our work paves the way for exploring topological charges in quasiperiodic matter, and fundamentally bridges periodic and quasiperiodic topological band theories.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“根据群表示理论推导”、“建立通用框架”、“以光子准晶为例”等理论推导和模型分析关键词，未提及具体实验操作或数值计算。；研究对象：二维准晶中基于贝里相位的拓扑电荷，特别是C₈ᵥ对称性准晶，以及光子准晶体系中的可观测特征。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在二维准晶中建立了基于贝里相位的拓扑电荷的通用理论框架，发现并表征了常规周期系统中无法实现的高阶拓扑电荷C=4，并揭示了光子准晶中光子动量绕拓扑电荷旋转时电磁场分布模式会缠绕C次的实验可观测特征。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在二维准晶中建立了基于贝里相位的拓扑电荷的通用理论框架，发现并表征了常规周期系统中无法实现的高阶拓扑电荷C=4，并揭示了光子准晶中光子动量绕拓扑电荷旋转时电磁场分布模式会缠绕C次的实验可观测特征。；创新点：首次在准晶体系中系统研究基于贝里相位的拓扑电荷，建立了连接周期与准周期拓扑能带理论的基础框架，并提出了通过电磁场分布模式缠绕直接探测拓扑电荷的实验方法。
papers.method_zh: 群表示理论推导所有允许的拓扑电荷及其对应的低能有效哈密顿量；以C₈ᵥ准晶为例进行理论表征；将框架应用于光子准晶体系分析电磁场分布模式。

papers.title: A stochastic model for elastoplastic contact of rough surfaces incorporating scale-dependent hardness
papers.abstract: The stress concentrations caused by inherent roughness of natural and manufactured surfaces often induce plastic deformation at contact interfaces, a challenge compounded by competing influences of the size effect of plastic deformation and self-affine rough surface topography. To address this, we developed a novel methodology based on stochastic theory using compounded Chapman-Kolmogorov equations, for the first time, to solve elastoplastic contact problems involving scale-dependent hardness. Our approach formulates three integral equations describing the evolution of probability density functions of elastic contact pressure, relative plastic contact area, and relative non-contact area across geometrical scales. We thoroughly investigate the effects of scale-dependent hardness on contact pressure distribution, relative elastic and plastic contact areas, and the area-to-load relationship. By adjusting various mechanical and material properties, our model predicts a smooth transition from linear elasticity to elastic-plastic behavior and finally to full plasticity. A key advancement is the derivation of a new topographic yield parameter incorporating a wider range of material and geometrical properties, aiding identification of contact status. Numerical solutions enable highly precise determination of elastic and plastic limits via curve-fitting, and we also provide a new diagram for rapid identification of contact status. This study pioneers a stochastic process framework for applying the compounded Chapman-Kolmogorov equation to rough surface contact analysis, and the integral equations characterizing how interfacial properties evolve with scale could offer valuable insights for other multidisciplinary fields where multiscale roughness is critical, such as earthquakes, electrical contact, and contact electrification.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：stochastic theory（随机理论）、compounded Chapman-Kolmogorov equations（复合Chapman-Kolmogorov方程）、numerical solutions（数值解）。；研究对象：粗糙表面弹塑性接触问题，具体涉及自仿射粗糙表面形貌与尺度相关硬度（scale-dependent hardness）共同作用下的接触界面力学行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过引入尺度相关硬度，模型预测了从线弹性到弹塑性再到完全塑性的平滑过渡；推导出一个新的地形屈服参数（topographic yield parameter），可帮助识别接触状态，并提供了快速识别接触状态的新图表。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过引入尺度相关硬度，模型预测了从线弹性到弹塑性再到完全塑性的平滑过渡；推导出一个新的地形屈服参数（topographic yield parameter），可帮助识别接触状态，并提供了快速识别接触状态的新图表。；创新点：首次将复合Chapman-Kolmogorov方程应用于粗糙表面接触分析，建立了描述界面性质随尺度演化的积分方程框架；提出了包含更广泛材料与几何性质的新地形屈服参数。
papers.method_zh: 基于随机理论，首次采用复合Chapman-Kolmogorov方程建立弹塑性接触模型；推导出描述弹性接触压力、相对塑性接触面积和相对非接触面积概率密度函数随几何尺度演化的三个积分方程；通过数值求解实现弹性极限和塑性极限的高精度确定。

papers.title: Spin-Orbit Torque and Magnetization Switching in 2D Ferromagnetic Devices
papers.abstract: Current-induced spin-orbit torque has emerged as a powerful technique for manipulating magnetization switching of ferromagnet/nonmagnet (FM/NM) based memory cell. By investigating nonequilibrium spin torque effect in a van der Waals heterobilayer, trigonal $\text{Cr}_{3}\text{Te}_{4}/\text{PtTe}_{2}$, the first-principles quantum transport calculations are applied to determine both local spin induction, resulting from Rashba-Edelstein effect in the FM layer, and spin current injection, flowing from the NM to the FM layer. Our work reveals that local spin induction significantly generates the fieldlike torque, which primarily governs the switching current in systems with strong in-plane magnetic anisotropy. Our work emphasizes the importance of optimizing spin Hall effect in the NM layer for perpendicular magnetic anisotropy (PMA)-based magnetization switching and maximizing the Rashba effect in the FM layer for in-plane magnetic anisotropy (IMA)-based switching.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据关键词：first-principles quantum transport calculations（第一性原理量子输运计算）。；研究对象：二维铁磁器件中的自旋轨道矩与磁化翻转，具体材料体系为范德华异质双层：三角晶格 Cr₃Te₄/PtTe₂。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在具有强面内磁各向异性的体系中，局域自旋感生（源于铁磁层中的Rashba-Edelstein效应）主要产生类场力矩，并主导翻转电流；对于垂直磁各向异性翻转，需优化非磁层的自旋霍尔效应；对于面内磁各向异性翻转，需最大化铁磁层的Rashba效应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在具有强面内磁各向异性的体系中，局域自旋感生（源于铁磁层中的Rashba-Edelstein效应）主要产生类场力矩，并主导翻转电流；对于垂直磁各向异性翻转，需优化非磁层的自旋霍尔效应；对于面内磁各向异性翻转，需最大化铁磁层的Rashba效应。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理量子输运计算（first-principles quantum transport calculations），用于确定局域自旋感生（Rashba-Edelstein效应）和自旋电流注入（从非磁层流向铁磁层）。

papers.title: Ambient and Pressure Dependent Superconductivity with Hydrogen Storage Potential in Quaternary Hydride LiMgZr2H12: A Comprehensive First-principles Insights
papers.abstract: Molecular hydrides have attracted relatively less attention in the search for high Tc superconductors because their hydrogen quasi-molecular units tend to be electronically inactive for superconductivity. In contrast, hydrogen rich compounds under high pressure have been widely considered strong candidates for achieving room-temperature superconductivity. However, their dependence on extreme pressure conditions significantly constrains their practical applicability. This work investigates hydrogen-rich superconducting materials that may be stable under ambient pressure conditions. Motivated by recent studies on the MgZrH2n family, a LiMgZr2H12 structure with Pmmm symmetry was designed. The mechanical, thermodynamic, and dynamical stability of the compound, together with its electronic and optical properties, were systematically investigated using first-principles calculations. Li doping in LiMgZr2H12 significantly increases the hydrogen derived contribution near the Fermi level (EF) and strengthens the electron-phonon coupling constant (λ) compared with MgZrH6. LiMgZr2H12 exhibits a critical temperature of 72.76 K at ambient pressure, which is further enhanced by applying pressure. At 10 GPa the critical temperature increases to 77.3 K. Elastic property analysis shows that the material remains mechanically stable over the pressure range studied (0-10 GPa). It also behaves like a ductile material suitable for current carrying applications. The material has a high machinability index, which is much higher than that of stainless steels. In addition, LiMgZr2H12 exhibits a gravimetric hydrogen storage capacity of 5.36 wt%, indicating its potential as a promising candidate for hybrid hydrogen storage technologies. This work offers a new direction for designing high-Tc hydrides at ambient conditions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据关键词：first-principles calculations、DFT（隐含）、理论预测。；研究对象：四元氢化物 LiMgZr₂H₁₂（Pmmm 对称性），一种可能兼具超导与储氢性能的材料。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: LiMgZr₂H₁₂ 在常压下具有 72.76 K 的超导临界温度，在 10 GPa 下提升至 77.3 K，同时具备 5.36 wt% 的储氢容量，是一种潜在的环境压力稳定的高温超导与储氢双功能材料。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：LiMgZr₂H₁₂ 在常压下具有 72.76 K 的超导临界温度，在 10 GPa 下提升至 77.3 K，同时具备 5.36 wt% 的储氢容量，是一种潜在的环境压力稳定的高温超导与储氢双功能材料。；创新点：通过 Li 掺杂设计出常压稳定的四元氢化物 LiMgZr₂H₁₂，显著增强了费米能级附近的氢贡献和电子-声子耦合，克服了传统分子氢化物中氢准分子单元对超导电性不活跃的局限，并首次在同一材料中同时预测了高温超导与储氢潜力。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations），具体包括：力学稳定性、热力学稳定性、动力学稳定性分析，电子结构计算，光学性质计算，以及电子-声子耦合常数（λ）和超导临界温度（Tc）的估算。

papers.title: Integrated magnonic neural circuits based on nonlinear wave neurons
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence is driving intense interest in alternative computing hardware capable of neural information processing beyond conventional charge-based electronics. Among emerging approaches, wave-based computing promises highly parallel and energy-efficient operation, but scalable physical neural hardware has remained elusive because wave systems generally lack cascadable nonlinear neurons with signal regeneration and phase-robust operation. Here we demonstrate integrated magnonic neural circuits based on nonlinear threshold neurons realized in nanoscale yttrium iron garnet waveguides. The neurons perform weighted summation of multiple spin-wave inputs, while a pump-controlled nonlinear activation defines continuously tunable firing thresholds. Owing to deeply nonlinear spin-wave dynamics, the activated neurons emit self-normalized outputs whose intensities are largely independent of the input amplitudes, while nonlinear phase self-adjustment suppresses sensitivity to the relative input phases, enabling deterministic neuron-to-neuron cascading without external signal restoration. We experimentally realize programmable threshold neurons, reconfigurable weighted classification and deterministic cascading between sequential neuronal stages, and further demonstrate reconfigurable physical pattern recognition in a seven-neuron integrated magnonic circuit through experimental classification of the binary letter patterns 'HUST'. These results establish nonlinear magnons as a scalable platform for integrated neural hardware and position nonlinear wave dynamics as a general paradigm for physical neuromorphic computing.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“we experimentally realize”、“experimental classification”等关键词，并描述了具体实验实现过程。；研究对象：基于非线性磁振子的集成神经电路，具体材料为纳米尺度的钇铁石榴石（YIG）波导，物理现象为非线性自旋波动力学及其在神经形态计算中的应用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过泵浦控制的非线性激活函数，实现了可级联、相位鲁棒的磁振子神经元，并成功在七神经元集成磁振子电路中完成了可重构的二进制字母模式识别（“HUST”）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过泵浦控制的非线性激活函数，实现了可级联、相位鲁棒的磁振子神经元，并成功在七神经元集成磁振子电路中完成了可重构的二进制字母模式识别（“HUST”）。；创新点：首次在集成磁振子电路中实现了可级联的非线性阈值神经元，解决了波基计算系统长期缺乏信号再生和相位鲁棒性的难题，并展示了可重构的物理模式识别。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段：纳米尺度钇铁石榴石波导制备、自旋波加权求和、泵浦控制非线性激活、多神经元级联实验。未使用计算或理论框架，摘要未提及DFT、DMRG等具体计算方法。

papers.title: Observation of coherently modulated phonon band and lifetime in superlattice
papers.abstract: Similar to the behavior of elementary particles, such as photons and electrons, the interference of phonon waves in artificial periodic nanostructures coherently modulates phonon band structures, serving as the foundation for phonon band engineering. However, direct observation of such coherently modulated phonon band structures remains challenging despite substantial insights from existing literature. Here, utilizing high-resolution inelastic X-ray scattering, we observed coherently modulated phonon band structures with phononic band gaps in a short-period GaAs/AlAs superlattice at 300 K and 500 K. Our findings provide the first direct evidence of phonon coherence at and above room temperatures, signifying a major advancement in the artificial engineering of phonon band structures. Furthermore, our experimental observations and ab initio lattice dynamics revealed that the coherently modulated phonon band structure enhances three-phonon scattering channels, strengthening high-order anharmonic effects such as three-phonon scattering and optical phonon softening. Our observations demonstrate the robustness of phonon coherence at high temperatures, and opens new routes for engineering phonon band structure and high-order phonon-phonon scattering by employing a flexible, bottom-up nanostructuring approach, with extensive applications in phononic metamaterials, microelectronics, and thermoelectrics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（兼有计算分析）。判断依据关键词：high-resolution inelastic X-ray scattering（实验手段）、ab initio lattice dynamics（第一性原理计算）。；研究对象：短周期GaAs/AlAs超晶格中的相干调制声子能带结构及声子寿命。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在300 K和500 K下直接观测到由人工周期性纳米结构相干调制的声子能带结构（含声子带隙），首次提供了室温及以上温度下声子相干性的直接实验证据，并发现该调制增强了三声子散射通道及高阶非谐效应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在300 K和500 K下直接观测到由人工周期性纳米结构相干调制的声子能带结构（含声子带隙），首次提供了室温及以上温度下声子相干性的直接实验证据，并发现该调制增强了三声子散射通道及高阶非谐效应。；创新点：首次在室温及以上温度（300 K和500 K）直接观测到超晶格中相干调制的声子能带结构，证实了声子相干性在高温下的鲁棒性，并揭示了相干调制对高阶声子-声子散射（如三声子散射和光学声子软化）的增强作用。
papers.method_zh: 高分辨率非弹性X射线散射（IXS）实验测量；结合第一性原理晶格动力学（ab initio lattice dynamics）计算分析。

papers.title: DSpinGNN: A Physics-Informed Equivariant Graph Neural Network for Dynamic Magnetic Exchange Prediction in Strain-Deformed Monolayer CrI$_3$
papers.abstract: Resolving the instantaneous, position-dependent isotropic magnetic exchange coupling $J_{ij}$ across a dynamically deforming crystal lattice requires a computational approach that simultaneously handles structural forces and magnetic interactions at length scales inaccessible to first-principles methods. Here we introduce DSpinGNN, a bifurcated machine-learning architecture comprising an $E(3)$-equivariant graph neural network (E-GNN) for classical Langevin structural dynamics and a physics-informed $Δ$-MLP that maps instantaneous local Cr-I-Cr bond geometry to isotropic exchange couplings, with the Goodenough-Kanamori superexchange relationship embedded as an analytical inductive bias. Trained on 345 DFT+U configurations of monolayer CrI$_3$ and evaluated on a strictly withheld 61-configuration test set, DSpinGNN simultaneously achieves an energy MAE of $1.1$ meV/atom, a force MAE of $6.5$ meV/Å, and an exchange coupling MAE of $0.18$ meV ($R^2 = 0.91$). Deployed at 400$\times$ scale in a 3,200-atom supercell under a collinear Ising-constrained adiabatic approximation at $5$ K, the model maps the local exchange response to a propagating biaxial strain wave. Wave reflection at periodic boundaries generates transient constructive interference regions where local compressive strain exceeds the DFT-established FM-to-AFM threshold, producing spatially heterogeneous exchange coupling textures that damp as the wave dissipates. Quantitative analysis yields a domain wall width of $ξ= 1.7 \pm 0.3$~nm and a constructive-interference oscillation period of $τ= 0.27$~ps -- mesoscopic observables inaccessible to direct DFT and constituting testable predictions for cryogenic magnetic force microscopy. DSpinGNN provides a reproducible, transferable framework for mesoscale exchange mapping in strain-driven 2D magnetic materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“DFT+U”“机器学习架构”“E(3)-equivariant graph neural network”等计算与理论建模方法，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：应变变形单层CrI₃中的动态磁交换耦合（各向同性海森堡交换耦合J_ij），以及双轴应变波传播过程中产生的空间异质交换耦合纹理和畴壁等介观现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: DSpinGNN模型能够在大尺度（3200原子超胞）下同时精确预测结构动力学和位置依赖的磁交换耦合，并揭示应变波反射导致的瞬态相干干涉区域中局部压缩应变超过铁磁-反铁磁转变阈值，产生空间异质的交换耦合纹理，其畴壁宽度约为1.7 nm，相干干涉振荡周期约为0.27 ps。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：DSpinGNN模型能够在大尺度（3200原子超胞）下同时精确预测结构动力学和位置依赖的磁交换耦合，并揭示应变波反射导致的瞬态相干干涉区域中局部压缩应变超过铁磁-反铁磁转变阈值，产生空间异质的交换耦合纹理，其畴壁宽度约为1.7 nm，相干干涉振荡周期约为0.27 ps。；创新点：将物理先验（Goodenough-Kanamori超交换关系）直接嵌入机器学习模型作为归纳偏置，实现了对动态应变下介观尺度磁交换耦合的实时映射，获得了直接DFT无法达到的介观可观测量的定量预测（畴壁宽度和振荡周期）。
papers.method_zh: 采用分叉机器学习架构：E(3)-等变图神经网络（E-GNN）用于经典朗之万结构动力学，结合物理信息Δ-MLP将瞬时局域Cr-I-Cr键几何映射为各向同性交换耦合，并以Goodenough-Kanamori超交换关系作为分析性归纳偏置嵌入。训练数据来自345个DFT+U构型，测试集为61个严格保留构型。在5 K下采用共线Ising约束绝热近似进行3200原子超胞模拟。

papers.title: Consistent Evaluation of Operators Involving the Position Operator in the Bloch Representation: Application to the Orbital Moment
papers.abstract: The position operator plays a central role in condensed-matter observables such as velocity, orbital moment, and electric polarization. In solid-state physics, the evaluation of operators incorporating the position operator has not reached a consensus, as observed in the operator-level discrepancy between the local circulation of Wannier functions and the self-rotation of wave packets. Here, to achieve a consistent evaluation of such operators, we propose three rules for evaluating operators involving the position operator in the Bloch representation. The rules are devised to satisfy physical conditions: independence from the choice of unit cell, preservation of Hermitian conjugacy for the product of operators, and recovery of the correct intraband velocity. We further address the gauge dependence of the position operator and introduce a scheme termed gauge filtration, which systematically removes gauge-dependent contributions from the operators containing the position operator. This methodology ensures that the quantities obtained from the operator evaluation correspond to observable physical phenomena. By applying our framework, we reconcile the results concerning the self-rotation of the wave packet and the local circulation of the Wannier function. We expect our proposal to establish a consistent framework for evaluating operators involving the position operator.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中主要讨论的是理论框架的构建（“propose three rules”、“introduce a scheme termed gauge filtration”），旨在解决一个理论上的不一致性（“operator-level discrepancy”），并未提及任何实验或计算模拟的具体实施。；研究对象：凝聚态物理中涉及位置算符的物理量，具体以轨道磁矩（orbital moment）为例，并特别关注波包自旋转（self-rotation of wave packets）与万尼尔函数局域环流（local circulation of Wannier functions）之间的不一致性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一套包含三条规则和“规范过滤”（gauge filtration）方案的理论框架，能够一致地评估布洛赫表象中包含位置算符的算符，从而调和了波包自旋转与万尼尔函数局域环流这两个概念之间的分歧。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一套包含三条规则和“规范过滤”（gauge filtration）方案的理论框架，能够一致地评估布洛赫表象中包含位置算符的算符，从而调和了波包自旋转与万尼尔函数局域环流这两个概念之间的分歧。；创新点：针对凝聚态物理中评估包含位置算符的算符这一长期存在的共识缺失问题（“has not reached a consensus”），首次提出了一套明确、自洽的规则和规范处理方案，并成功解决了波包自旋转与万尼尔函数局域环流之间的算符级别不一致性。

papers.title: A quantitative approach to flowing supercooled liquids: From microscopic heterogeneities to rheology
papers.abstract: Soft glassy materials display rich and complex flow behaviors across both macroscopic and molecular scales, and a fundamental understanding of these phenomena remains an outstanding challenge. Here, we propose a theoretical model for the flow of supercooled liquids -- a typical class of glassy fluids -- based on a two-state paradigm that conceptualizes the flow as a dynamic coexistence of transient solid-like and liquid-like regions. The model rests on two essential physical ingredients: a correlation length that captures medium-range structural order, and a localized elasticity-mediated interaction that restricts stress propagation within solid-like regions. Remarkably, with all parameters determined solely from equilibrium state, the model quantitatively reproduces rheological responses -- including both steady-state and start-up shear -- for a broad range of shear rates. Furthermore, it simultaneously captures the evolution of molecular dynamic heterogeneity. This dual success -- spanning macroscopic rheology and microscopic spatiotemporal fluctuations -- underscores the pivotal role of structural and dynamic heterogeneities in governing the rheological response. Moreover, it provides a direct understanding of how the flow behaviors of a supercooled liquid are embedded in its equilibrium properties.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“theoretical model”、“two-state paradigm”、“quantitatively reproduces”。；研究对象：过冷液体（supercooled liquids）的流动行为，属于软玻璃态材料（soft glassy materials）范畴。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于两态范式（瞬态类固体与类液体区域动态共存）的理论模型，仅使用平衡态参数即可定量复现过冷液体在宽剪切速率范围内的流变响应（包括稳态和启动剪切），并同时捕捉分子动态异质性的演化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：基于两态范式（瞬态类固体与类液体区域动态共存）的理论模型，仅使用平衡态参数即可定量复现过冷液体在宽剪切速率范围内的流变响应（包括稳态和启动剪切），并同时捕捉分子动态异质性的演化。；创新点：该模型首次实现了从平衡态性质出发，同时定量预测宏观流变学响应与微观动态异质性演化，揭示了结构异质性和动态异质性在流变响应中的核心作用。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模：提出一个基于两态范式的流动模型，包含两个关键物理要素——描述中程结构有序的相关长度（correlation length）和限制应力在类固体区域内传播的局域弹性介导相互作用（localized elasticity-mediated interaction）。所有参数均由平衡态确定。

papers.title: Unveiling Orbital-mediated Ultrafast Demagnetization in Rare Earth-Transition-Metal Ferrimagnets
papers.abstract: The ultimate speed limit of magnetic recording and spintronic devices is set by the efficiency of angular-momentum transfer during ultrafast demagnetization, yet its microscopic pathway in Rare-Earth-Transition-Metal (RE-TM) ferrimagnets remains debated. Here, we establish an orbital-mediated framework in which 3d spin-orbit coupling (SOC) governs angular momentum (AM) dissipation. Strong 3d-SOC in RE-Co enables sub-picosecond, single-step demagnetization via direct orbital-to-lattice transfer, whereas weak 3d-SOC in RE-Fe redirects AM into 4f orbitals, producing slower two-step dynamics. The second-stage rate scales with 4f-SOC strength, revealing a distinct orbital-mediated dissipation channel. Using time-resolved magneto-optical Kerr measurements, supported by an extended four-temperature model, corroborate this picture across diverse RE-TM systems (RE = Sm, Gd, Tb, Dy, Ho and TM = Fe, Co, CoNi). Our results identify the SOC-driven competition between 3d and 4f orbital channels as the universal mechanism governing ultrafast demagnetization in RE-TM ferrimagnets, enabling rational design of the switching speed for next-generation spintronic devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（判断依据：time-resolved magneto-optical Kerr measurements）；研究对象：稀土-过渡金属（RE-TM）亚铁磁体中的超快退磁过程，具体体系包括RE = Sm, Gd, Tb, Dy, Ho 和 TM = Fe, Co, CoNi。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 建立了轨道介导的超快退磁框架，指出3d自旋轨道耦合（SOC）的强弱决定了RE-TM亚铁磁体中的角动量耗散路径和退磁动力学：强3d-SOC（如RE-Co）导致亚皮秒单步退磁，弱3d-SOC（如RE-Fe）则导致较慢的两步动力学，其中第二步速率由4f-SOC强度决定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：建立了轨道介导的超快退磁框架，指出3d自旋轨道耦合（SOC）的强弱决定了RE-TM亚铁磁体中的角动量耗散路径和退磁动力学：强3d-SOC（如RE-Co）导致亚皮秒单步退磁，弱3d-SOC（如RE-Fe）则导致较慢的两步动力学，其中第二步速率由4f-SOC强度决定。；创新点：揭示了3d和4f轨道通道之间的SOC驱动竞争是控制RE-TM亚铁磁体超快退磁的普适机制，为设计下一代自旋电子器件的开关速度提供了理性设计依据。
papers.method_zh: 时间分辨磁光克尔效应（time-resolved magneto-optical Kerr effect）测量，并结合扩展的四温度模型（extended four-temperature model）进行理论分析。

papers.title: Chiral Magnons and Cycloidal Phonons in Altermagnetic CuF$_{2}$ Monolayer
papers.abstract: Altermagnetism establishes momentum-dependent spin splitting through non-symmorphic crystal symmetries, yet whether these same symmetries simultaneously govern spin and lattice collective excitations remains open. Here we show, using first-principles calculations and linear spin-wave theory, that monolayer CuF$_2$ hosts both chirality-split magnons and cycloidal phonons controlled by the same $P2_1/c$ symmetry operations. The altermagnetic order drives strongly anisotropic magnon chirality via symmetric anisotropic exchange, with Dzyaloshinskii--Moriya interactions acting as a weak secondary modulation. Crucially, the phonon and magnon chiral responses are directionally complementary: cycloidal phonon angular momentum emerges precisely where magnon chirality is symmetry-suppressed, and vice versa. The magnon bands further carry quantized Chern numbers $C^M = \pm 2$, confirming non-trivial altermagnetic topology. These results establish monolayer CuF$_2$ as a platform where a single symmetry framework engineers magnonic, phononic, and topological responses, providing a direct connection between altermagnetism and spin-lattice chirality in two-dimensional materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：first-principles calculations, linear spin-wave theory）；研究对象：单层CuF₂中的交错磁序（altermagnetic order）及其自旋和晶格集体激发，具体包括手性磁振子（chiral magnons）和摆线声子（cycloidal phonons）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 单层CuF₂中，相同的P2₁/c对称性操作同时控制手性分裂的磁振子和摆线声子，且两者的手性响应在方向上互补；磁振子能带携带陈数C^M = ±2，证实了非平庸的交错磁拓扑。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：单层CuF₂中，相同的P2₁/c对称性操作同时控制手性分裂的磁振子和摆线声子，且两者的手性响应在方向上互补；磁振子能带携带陈数C^M = ±2，证实了非平庸的交错磁拓扑。；创新点：首次在单一对称性框架下证明交错磁序可以同时调控磁振子、声子和拓扑响应，并揭示了自旋-晶格手性在二维材料中的直接关联。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations）和线性自旋波理论（linear spin-wave theory）。

papers.title: Polarization-Resolved Photon Statistics of Cavity Quantum Materials
papers.abstract: By forming hybrid light-matter states, optical cavities offer a route for engineering material properties, however, unambiguously probing the effects of light-matter coupling remains difficult. Here, we show that the polarization-resolved statistics of photons transmitted through a cavity, measurable via $g^{(2)}$, provide one such diagnostic. By relating $g^{(2)}$ to matter correlation functions such as the Raman structure factor, we link photon bunching and antibunching to material properties. By applying this method to the stripy-to-antiferromagnetic transition in the Kitaev-Heisenberg spin model, we find that polarization-dependent patterns of bunching and antibunching encode the magnetic point-group symmetries of each phase and characterize the behavior at the phase boundary. Finally, we predict measuring $g^{(2)}$ for output photon pairs polarized orthogonal to the input field will isolate higher-order light-matter scattering processes that probe higher-order material correlations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“we show”“we find”“we predict”等理论推导和预测性表述，未提及实验数据或计算模拟细节。；研究对象：腔量子材料中光与物质耦合形成的混合态，具体以Kitaev-Heisenberg自旋模型中的条状反铁磁相变为例。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过测量透过腔体的光子偏振分辨统计量（g^(2)），可以诊断光-物质耦合效应，其中光子聚束与反聚束模式编码了材料的磁点群对称性，并能表征相边界行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过测量透过腔体的光子偏振分辨统计量（g^(2)），可以诊断光-物质耦合效应，其中光子聚束与反聚束模式编码了材料的磁点群对称性，并能表征相边界行为。；创新点：提出利用偏振分辨的光子统计（g^(2)）作为探测光-物质耦合效应的新诊断工具，并预测通过测量与输入场正交偏振的输出光子对g^(2)可隔离高阶光-物质散射过程，从而探测高阶物质关联。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：将光子二阶关联函数g^(2)与物质关联函数（如拉曼结构因子）建立联系，并应用于Kitaev-Heisenberg自旋模型的相变分析。未使用具体实验手段或数值计算方法。

papers.title: Invariants of Sequential Circuits and Generalized Non-Abelian Statistics
papers.abstract: Non-invertible symmetries in quantum many-body systems generally give rise to sequential unitary circuits that move symmetry defects. In this paper, we investigate invariants defined by sequences of such circuits, which move non-invertible defects and generate a Berry phase evaluated on quantum states with defects. We show that this Berry phase generally defines an invariant under local deformations, provided that the sequential circuits preserve the locality of those deformations. This invariant also rules out a short-range-entangled state that preserves the non-invertible symmetry, thereby signaling the 't Hooft anomaly of a non-invertible symmetry purely in terms of unitary operators acting on a state. We then apply this framework to loop excitations in three spatial dimensions and identify a new loop excitation in the (3+1)D $\mathbb{D}_4$ topological order, which we dub a non-Abelian fermionic loop. Using the invariant of sequential circuits, we characterize the statistics of non-Abelian fermionic loops. In addition, we find a new (3+1)D mixed topological order with a single non-Abelian fermionic loop, whose long-range entanglement is protected by an invariant of sequential circuits.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：non-invertible symmetries, invariants, Berry phase, topological order。；研究对象：量子多体系统中的非可逆对称性、顺序电路（sequential circuits）及其定义的拓扑不变量，以及三维空间中的环激发（loop excitations）和拓扑序。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现顺序电路定义的Berry相位在局域形变下构成一个不变量，该不变量可排除具有非可逆对称性的短程纠缠态，从而纯粹通过作用于态上的幺正算符揭示非可逆对称性的't Hooft反常。此外，在(3+1)D $\mathbb{D}_4$拓扑序中识别出一种新的非阿贝尔费米子环激发，并利用顺序电路不变量表征其统计性质。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现顺序电路定义的Berry相位在局域形变下构成一个不变量，该不变量可排除具有非可逆对称性的短程纠缠态，从而纯粹通过作用于态上的幺正算符揭示非可逆对称性的't Hooft反常。此外，在(3+1)D $\mathbb{D}_4$拓扑序中识别出一种新的非阿贝尔费米子环激发，并利用顺序电路不变量表征其统计性质。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：通过顺序电路移动非可逆缺陷，并计算带缺陷量子态上的Berry相位，证明该相位在局域形变下构成不变量；将该框架应用于(3+1)D拓扑序中的环激发，分析其统计性质。

papers.title: Unveiling the Interplay of Charge and Magnetic Excitations in HgBa$_2$Ca$_2$Cu$_3$O$_{8+δ}$
papers.abstract: Unraveling the mechanism that binds electrons into Cooper pairs in cuprate high-temperature superconductors remains one of the most fundamental challenges in condensed-matter physics. While both magnetic interactions and lattice vibrations are known to govern key electronic properties, their possible cooperation has never been directly observed. We investigate HgBa$_2$Ca$_2$Cu$_3$O$_{8+δ}$ (Hg1223) - the cuprate with the highest $T_{\mathrm{c}}$ at ambient pressure - as a magnifying glass to probe the possible entwining of the excitations at the core of the pairing. Using resonant inelastic X-ray scattering, we find that the charge response is dominated by dynamic charge density fluctuations (CDF) extending up to several hundred meV, where magnetic excitations reside. At the same momentum where CDF are most intense, the paramagnon energy exhibits a pronounced softening, revealing a strong interplay among charge, lattice, and spin excitations. Our results point to a cooperative mechanism in which dynamic charge fluctuations mediate the coupling between lattice, charge and spin degrees of freedom-shedding new light on the fundamental origin of high-$T_{\mathrm{c}}$ superconductivity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：使用“resonant inelastic X-ray scattering”（共振非弹性X射线散射）实验手段。；研究对象：铜氧化物高温超导体 HgBa₂Ca₂Cu₃O₈₊δ（Hg1223），具体研究其电荷激发与磁激发之间的相互作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在Hg1223中，电荷响应由动态电荷密度涨落主导，且在与电荷涨落最强动量对应的位置，磁激发（paramagnon）能量出现显著软化，表明电荷、晶格和自旋激发之间存在强耦合，指向一种动态电荷涨落介导的协同配对机制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在Hg1223中，电荷响应由动态电荷密度涨落主导，且在与电荷涨落最强动量对应的位置，磁激发（paramagnon）能量出现显著软化，表明电荷、晶格和自旋激发之间存在强耦合，指向一种动态电荷涨落介导的协同配对机制。；创新点：首次直接观测到铜氧化物高温超导体中电荷、晶格与自旋激发之间的协同相互作用，揭示了动态电荷密度涨落可能作为连接这些自由度的中介，为理解高温超导配对机制提供了新视角。
papers.method_zh: 共振非弹性X射线散射（RIXS）。

papers.title: Superconductivity near quarter- and half-filling of a strongly correlated triangular Hubbard band in twisted trilayer WSe2
papers.abstract: The triangular-lattice Hubbard model is one of the paradigmatic settings for studying correlated electronic systems with geometric frustration that can give rise to a variety of phases. Recently, twisted bilayer TMD systems have emerged as attractive experimental platforms for realising such a model in the moderate-correlation regime. Alternating twisted trilayer TMD systems are expected to realise stronger correlations than bilayer systems owing to their mirror symmetry. Here we report the discovery of superconductivity near quarter- and half-filling, together with various correlated phases, in alternating twisted trilayer WSe2 (TTWSe2). At half filling, a robust correlated insulating state persists over a broad range of displacement fields, signalling the strongly correlated regime. Upon doping, superconductivity emerges over an extended region of the phase diagram. Near quarter filling, another superconducting state appears flanked by correlated metals. Our results establish the TTWSe2 system as a compelling platform for studying strongly correlated triangular-lattice Hubbard physics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：discovery, report, results establish。；研究对象：交替扭曲三层WSe₂（TTWSe₂）中的强关联三角晶格哈伯德模型，具体研究其四分之一填充和半填充附近的超导电性及相关关联相。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在交替扭曲三层WSe₂中，于半填充和四分之一填充附近均发现了超导电性，并在半填充处观测到强关联绝缘态，表明该体系是实现强关联三角晶格哈伯德物理的可靠平台。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在交替扭曲三层WSe₂中，于半填充和四分之一填充附近均发现了超导电性，并在半填充处观测到强关联绝缘态，表明该体系是实现强关联三角晶格哈伯德物理的可靠平台。；创新点：相较于扭曲双层过渡金属硫族化合物（TMD）体系，交替扭曲三层结构因镜像对称性可实现更强的关联效应，并在四分之一填充和半填充两个不同填充区域同时观测到超导电性，扩展了三角晶格哈伯德模型的实验研究范围。
papers.method_zh: 通过构建交替扭曲三层WSe₂异质结，施加位移电场调控填充数，测量电输运性质（如电阻、相图）来探测超导态和关联绝缘态。摘要未明确说明具体测量温度或磁场条件。

papers.title: Nucleation instability preempts relativistic domain wall transport in high-exchange ferrimagnetic nanowires
papers.abstract: Current-driven domain wall motion in ferrimagnets can approach the spin-wave velocity, giving rise to relativistic-like dynamics. While this regime has been experimentally observed in crystalline ferrimagnetic garnets and amorphous GdFeCo, the material conditions that determine whether it can be accessed remain unresolved. Here, we investigate spin-orbit-torque-driven domain wall motion in high-exchange GdCo nanowires using magneto-optical Kerr effect microscopy. We find that nucleation preempts relativistic transport. In GdCo, no velocity saturation or high-field collapse is observed. Instead, the large exchange interaction raises the maximum spin-wave group velocity to $\approx 7\text{--}9~\mathrm{km/s}$, far above the experimentally accessible domain wall velocities. Before this limit can be approached, increasing current density and in-plane magnetic field induce domain nucleation, disrupting steady-state propagation. We map the boundary separating domain wall transport from nucleation instability and show that the nucleation threshold decreases with pulse duration, consistent with thermally assisted barrier crossing. These results identify nucleation as the mechanism that prevents access to the relativistic regime in high-exchange ferrimagnets and establish a dynamical phase boundary between steady propagation and nucleation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：magneto-optical Kerr effect microscopy（磁光克尔效应显微镜）、experimentally observed、investigate。；研究对象：高交换耦合的GdCo铁磁纳米线中的电流驱动畴壁运动，具体关注自旋轨道矩驱动的畴壁动力学及其与相对论性输运的竞争。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在高交换耦合铁磁体GdCo中，畴壁无法进入相对论性运动区域，因为高电流密度和面内磁场会诱发成核不稳定性，破坏稳态传播，从而阻止相对论性输运的实现。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在高交换耦合铁磁体GdCo中，畴壁无法进入相对论性运动区域，因为高电流密度和面内磁场会诱发成核不稳定性，破坏稳态传播，从而阻止相对论性输运的实现。；创新点：首次明确指出成核不稳定性（而非速度饱和或高场崩塌）是阻止高交换铁磁体进入相对论性畴壁运动区域的关键机制，并建立了稳态传播与成核之间的动力学相边界。
papers.method_zh: 采用磁光克尔效应显微镜（magneto-optical Kerr effect microscopy）直接观测GdCo纳米线中自旋轨道矩驱动的畴壁运动，并通过改变电流密度、面内磁场和脉冲持续时间来系统测量畴壁传播与成核不稳定性之间的边界。

papers.title: Synthetic Altermagnetism Beyond the Crystal Limit
papers.abstract: Altermagnetic magnons in crystalline materials exhibit momentum-dependent splitting whose nodal structure and chiral character are governed by the point-group symmetry of the magnetic sublattice rotation. Here, we demonstrate the first synthetic realization of altermagnetic magnonics in a continuum platform composed of antiferromagnetically coupled ferromagnetic films with alternating in-plane exchange anisotropies, showing that the key signatures of altermagnetic magnonics emerge beyond the crystalline setting. Solving the linearized Landau-Lifshitz equation within a dipole-exchange framework, we show that this architecture reproduces the characteristic momentum-dependent splitting, nodal directions, and anisotropic isofrequency contours of A-type altermagnets. Long-range dipolar interactions qualitatively reconstruct this exchange-driven spectrum by lifting the nominal nodal degeneracy, hybridizing opposite-chirality modes, and producing a finite, thickness-dependent wave-vector splitting along directions that are nodal in the exchange-only limit. Extending the bilayer to finite multilayers reveals that synthetic altermagnetism undergoes a parity-dependent reconstruction that separates surface and bulk altermagnetic excitations. These results establish altermagnetic magnon phenomenology as an engineerable collective response of dipole-exchange multilayers beyond microscopic crystal symmetries.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：demonstrate、solving、linearized Landau-Lifshitz equation、dipole-exchange framework。；研究对象：人工合成交变磁（altermagnetic）自旋波（magnon）的连续介质平台，具体为反铁磁耦合的铁磁薄膜多层结构，其中各层具有交替的面内交换各向异性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在非晶态连续介质中首次实现了交变磁自旋波的人工合成，其动量依赖的劈裂、节线方向和等频轮廓与A型交变磁体一致；长程偶极相互作用会重构该交换驱动的能谱，而多层结构则展现出宇称依赖的表面与体交变磁激发分离。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在非晶态连续介质中首次实现了交变磁自旋波的人工合成，其动量依赖的劈裂、节线方向和等频轮廓与A型交变磁体一致；长程偶极相互作用会重构该交换驱动的能谱，而多层结构则展现出宇称依赖的表面与体交变磁激发分离。；创新点：将交变磁自旋波现象从晶体对称性限制拓展至可工程化设计的连续介质多层膜体系，突破了传统交变磁体对微观晶格对称性的依赖。
papers.method_zh: 基于线性化的Landau-Lifshitz方程，在偶极-交换（dipole-exchange）理论框架下进行解析与数值求解。

papers.title: Screening of the Coulomb interaction in Carbon Nanotubes: A First-Principles cRPA study
papers.abstract: We investigate the electronic screening of long-range Coulomb interactions in carbon nanotubes with different chiralities using first-principles calculations within the random-phase approximation. Depending on their wrapping vector, carbon nanotubes exhibit either metallic or semiconducting behavior, providing an ideal platform to explore how reduced dimensionality and electronic structure govern screening in one-dimensional systems. The strength of on-site Coulomb interactions in these compounds falls within the range of 3.5 to 5 eV, which is approximately 2-3 eV smaller than the corresponding values in nanoribbon compounds. This reduction subsequently affects the value of long-range interactions, consistent with experimental results regarding the smaller binding energy of excitons in nanotubes. Despite their common carbon backbone, we find that the effective interaction landscape depends not only on metallicity but also sensitively on chirality and band topology. In particular, armchair and zigzag nanotubes with similar electronic character exhibit markedly different screening efficiencies. Our results establish a unified microscopic picture of electronic screening in carbon nanotubes and place them in direct context with previous first-principles studies of low-dimensional carbon nanostructures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词为“first-principles calculations”（第一性原理计算）、“random-phase approximation”（随机相位近似）。；研究对象：不同手性（chirality）的碳纳米管（Carbon Nanotubes）中的长程库仑相互作用的电子屏蔽效应（electronic screening）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 碳纳米管中的在位库仑相互作用强度（3.5-5 eV）比纳米带（nanoribbon）小约2-3 eV，且有效相互作用不仅取决于金属性，还对手性和能带拓扑结构敏感。例如，具有相似电子特性的扶手椅型和锯齿型碳纳米管表现出显著不同的屏蔽效率。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：碳纳米管中的在位库仑相互作用强度（3.5-5 eV）比纳米带（nanoribbon）小约2-3 eV，且有效相互作用不仅取决于金属性，还对手性和能带拓扑结构敏感。例如，具有相似电子特性的扶手椅型和锯齿型碳纳米管表现出显著不同的屏蔽效率。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用基于随机相位近似（RPA）的第一性原理计算，具体为约束性随机相位近似（cRPA）方法。

papers.title: Extrinsic quantum geometry in the quadrupolar bulk photovoltaic effect
papers.abstract: The bulk photovoltaic effect has become a valuable probe of the quantum geometry of Bloch bands. While it is restricted to inversion-broken systems within the dipole approximation, the finite momentum of light is appreciated to give rise to this effect even in centrosymmetric crystals, an effect referred to as "photon drag." In this work, we recast the photon drag effect at leading order in the optical wavevector, highlighting a previously neglected contribution arising intuitively from the electric quadrupole correction to light-matter coupling. In the language of band geometry, we identify this interband quadrupole as a multiband metric tensor that quantifies the variation of two resonantly driven states extrinsic to the subspace they span. We predict that systems in which three or more bands strongly admix in momentum space, such as twisted MoTe$_2$ bilayers, will have anomalously large photon drag due to this quadrupolar effect. Our work provides a conceptual bridge between band-geometric organizing principles and electromagnetic multipole corrections in nonlinear optics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“recast”“identify”“predict”，以及理论框架“band geometry”“multiband metric tensor”。；研究对象：体光伏效应中的外禀量子几何，具体聚焦于光子拖曳效应（photon drag effect）在中心对称晶体中的电四极贡献，并以扭曲MoTe₂双层为例进行预测。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在光波矢主导阶下，光子拖曳效应中存在一个此前被忽略的贡献，该贡献源于光-物质耦合的电四极修正，可被理解为一种多能带度规张量，量化了共振驱动态在其子空间之外的几何变化。预测扭曲MoTe₂双层等具有强能带混合的系统会因该四极效应产生异常大的光子拖曳。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在光波矢主导阶下，光子拖曳效应中存在一个此前被忽略的贡献，该贡献源于光-物质耦合的电四极修正，可被理解为一种多能带度规张量，量化了共振驱动态在其子空间之外的几何变化。预测扭曲MoTe₂双层等具有强能带混合的系统会因该四极效应产生异常大的光子拖曳。；创新点：首次将光子拖曳效应中的电四极贡献与能带几何中的多能带度规张量建立概念联系，揭示了外禀量子几何在非线性光学多极修正中的新角色。
papers.method_zh: 采用能带几何理论框架，将电四极修正重新表述为多能带度规张量，分析共振驱动态的外禀量子几何，并基于此对扭曲MoTe₂双层进行理论预测。

papers.title: Dynamics of repeated BEC formation and extraction in dimple traps
papers.abstract: We investigate repeated Bose-Einstein-condensate (BEC) formation and extraction in a dimple trap embedded in a reservoir of thermal atoms using a kinetic model. The model includes pulsed extraction, evaporation, three-body losses, and thermal-atom replenishment. Three extraction protocols are compared: extraction of all atoms from the dimple (BEC and thermal atoms), full and partial extractions of the BEC, but not of the thermal atoms. Residual atoms in the dimple after extraction seed subsequent Bose-stimulated growth and reduce the recovery time between extractions, but also enhance density-dependent losses. For all protocols, repeated extraction of BECs can be achieved without replenishment, but the number of BEC formations is limited by reservoir depletion and heating. With continuous replenishment, the system can reach a periodic steady-state regime, after an initial transient period, controlled by the externally imposed rates of extraction pulses and thermal-atom input. Within the explored parameter range, partial BEC extraction gives the highest efficiency, particularly for short extraction periods and high input rates. These results identify seeding by residual populations of BECs and thermal atoms as a kinetic mechanism for improving repeated condensate production in dimple traps.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到使用“kinetic model”（动力学模型）进行研究，并比较了不同的提取方案，属于理论建模与数值模拟范畴。；研究对象：论文研究的具体物理现象是：在嵌入热原子库的“dimple trap”（凹阱）中，重复形成和提取玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体（BEC）的动力学过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 研究发现，通过部分提取BEC（而非全部提取），可以利用阱内残留的原子作为“种子”加速后续BEC的再生长，从而在周期性提取中实现更高的效率，尤其是在短提取周期和高输入速率条件下。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：研究发现，通过部分提取BEC（而非全部提取），可以利用阱内残留的原子作为“种子”加速后续BEC的再生长，从而在周期性提取中实现更高的效率，尤其是在短提取周期和高输入速率条件下。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但根据内容推断，其创新点在于系统地比较了不同提取协议对重复BEC形成效率的影响，并揭示了残留原子“播种”效应（seeding）作为提高重复凝聚体产率的关键动力学机制。
papers.method_zh: 采用了一个包含脉冲提取、蒸发、三体损失和热原子补充等过程的动力学模型，对三种不同的BEC提取协议（全部提取、完全提取BEC、部分提取BEC）进行了比较分析。

papers.title: Topological Phase Transition in Mechanical Honeycomb Lattice
papers.abstract: Topological materials provide a new tool to direct wave energy with unprecedented precision and robustness. Three elastic topological phases, the valley Hall, Chern and spin Hall insulators, are currently studied, and they are achieved separately in rather distinct configurations. Here, we explore analytically various topological phase transitions for in-plane elastic wave in a unified mass-spring honeycomb lattice. It is demonstrated that the three elastic topological phases can be realized in this single lattice by designing mass, stiffness or introducing Coriolis' effect. In particular, the interface between valley Hall and Chern insulators is found to support topological interface mode for the first time. Perturbation method is used to derive the analytic effective continuum model in the neighbor of band degeneracy, and the physics in topological phase transitions are revealed through evaluation of topological invariants. The topologically protected interface states, their decaying profile as well as the pseudo-spin-indicating polarization specific for elastic wave are systematically analyzed, and these results are further confirmed numerically by Bloch wave analysis of domain wall strip and transient simulation of finite sized sample. This study offers a concise and unified analytical model to explore topology nature of elastic wave, and can provide intuitive guidance to design of continuum mechanical topological materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（含数值验证）。判断依据：关键词“analytically explore”“perturbation method”“analytic effective continuum model”“numerically confirmed”。；研究对象：机械蜂窝晶格中面内弹性波的拓扑相变，具体研究谷霍尔、陈绝缘体、自旋霍尔绝缘体三种弹性拓扑相在同一晶格中的实现与转变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过设计质量、刚度或引入科里奥利效应，可在单一质量-弹簧蜂窝晶格中实现三种弹性拓扑相；首次发现谷霍尔与陈绝缘体之间的界面支持拓扑界面模式。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过设计质量、刚度或引入科里奥利效应，可在单一质量-弹簧蜂窝晶格中实现三种弹性拓扑相；首次发现谷霍尔与陈绝缘体之间的界面支持拓扑界面模式。；创新点：在统一的质量-弹簧蜂窝晶格中同时实现三种弹性拓扑相，并首次发现谷霍尔与陈绝缘体界面支持的拓扑界面模式，提供了简洁统一的解析模型。
papers.method_zh: 解析推导：采用微扰方法在能带简并点附近建立有效连续模型，通过拓扑不变量评估揭示相变物理机制；数值验证：布洛赫波分析畴壁条带结构，以及有限尺寸样品的瞬态模拟。

papers.title: Defect Tolerance in Trigonal Selenium Photovoltaics
papers.abstract: Understanding how point defects fundamentally influence photovoltaic performance remains a central question for emerging wide-band gap absorbers. Trigonal selenium (t-Se) has recently re-emerged as a promising photovoltaic material due to its near-optimal band gap for tandem and indoor applications. Here we quantify defect-assisted Shockley-Read-Hall (SRH) recombination in t-Se using first principles calculations across a large and chemically diverse set of point defects. Our results suggest that t-Se is intrinsically defect tolerant. Despite the presence of multiple deep levels in the gap, recombination via nonradiative multi-phonon emission processes is strongly suppressed by large lattice reorganizations and large energy releases of at least 0.5 EG per recombination event, while radiative defect-assisted capture also remains too small to account for the observed device losses. Consequently, SRH recombination mediated by realistic concentrations of point defects cannot account for the observed efficiency limitations in selenium photovoltaics. We explore trends in both radiative and nonradiative SRH recombination rates across the defect data set, highlighting their complex dependence on defect level position, lattice relaxation, charge state, and doping conditions. These findings establish trigonal selenium as a defect-tolerant wide-band-gap absorber and provide transferable design principles for optimizing next-generation photovoltaic materials for tandem and indoor applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词为“first principles calculations”（第一性原理计算）。；研究对象：论文研究的具体材料为三角相硒（trigonal selenium, t-Se），具体物理现象为点缺陷对光伏性能的影响，特别是缺陷辅助的Shockley-Read-Hall（SRH）非辐射复合。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 三角相硒本质上是一种缺陷容忍的宽带隙光伏材料。尽管存在多种深能级缺陷，但由于非辐射多声子发射过程被强烈抑制，实际浓度的点缺陷无法解释实验中观察到的硒光伏器件效率限制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：三角相硒本质上是一种缺陷容忍的宽带隙光伏材料。尽管存在多种深能级缺陷，但由于非辐射多声子发射过程被强烈抑制，实际浓度的点缺陷无法解释实验中观察到的硒光伏器件效率限制。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但该工作首次通过大规模第一性原理计算，系统量化了三角相硒中多种点缺陷的SRH复合行为，并揭示了其缺陷容忍性的物理根源（大晶格弛豫和大能量释放），为理解该材料的效率限制机制提供了新视角。
papers.method_zh: 采用第一性原理计算方法，对一个包含多种化学类型点缺陷的大数据集进行了定量分析，计算了缺陷辅助的SRH复合速率，包括辐射和非辐射复合过程。

papers.title: Compressed minimum-purity time evolution for late-time quantum dynamics
papers.abstract: Unitary time evolution of initially simple quantum many-body states rapidly generates entanglement and complex correlations, which limits direct numerical simulations. The late-time dynamics of physical observables, however, typically exhibits an effective simplicity in the form of hydrodynamics or kinetic theory. This leads to the question whether microscopic equations of motion can remain accurate and tractable up to long time scales by discarding irrelevant information in a controlled manner. Here, we introduce compressed minimum-purity time evolution (CoMPuTE) as an approach to keep track of a consistent set of reduced local density matrices, closing the hierarchical equations of motion using a minimum-purity principle. In benchmark applications we demonstrate (i) accurate description of energy diffusion in the one-dimensional mixed-field Ising model, (ii) the applicability to genuinely out-of-equilibrium Floquet dynamics starting from a pure state, and (iii) the limitations of the local reduced density matrix approximation when describing transport in the XXZ chain at $Δ=1$ that is governed by increasingly non-local integrals of motion. The CoMPuTE method enhances computational efficiency in comparison to the closely related local-information time evolution algorithm, opening a possible route towards an extension to systems in higher spatial dimensions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算方法文章。关键词：unitary time evolution、numerical simulations、hierarchical equations of motion、algorithm。；研究对象：量子多体系统在长时间尺度下的动力学行为，具体包括一维混合场伊辛模型中的能量扩散、Floquet动力学以及XXZ链中的输运现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种名为“压缩最小纯度时间演化”（CoMPuTE）的方法，能够在长时间尺度下准确且高效地模拟量子多体系统的动力学，同时揭示了局域约化密度矩阵近似在描述由非局域守恒量主导的输运时的局限性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种名为“压缩最小纯度时间演化”（CoMPuTE）的方法，能够在长时间尺度下准确且高效地模拟量子多体系统的动力学，同时揭示了局域约化密度矩阵近似在描述由非局域守恒量主导的输运时的局限性。；创新点：CoMPuTE方法通过压缩表示和最小纯度原理，在保持精度的同时显著提升了计算效率，为扩展到更高空间维度的系统提供了可能。摘要未突出说明与已有方法在具体算法实现上的差异细节。
papers.method_zh: 基于最小纯度原理闭合局域密度矩阵的运动方程，提出CoMPuTE算法，并与已有的局域信息时间演化算法进行对比，通过基准测试验证其准确性。

papers.title: Unusual half-metallic state in unconventional magnets
papers.abstract: Half-metallic ferromagnets exhibit a gap in the density of states for one spin projection while remaining gapless for the opposite spin. We show that in helimagnets an unusual half-metallic state can exist, where the spin projection that experiences the gap is determined by the direction of the wave vector. This state originates from the nontrivial topology of the band structure, specifically from the dispersion forming a multi-sheeted covering over the Brillouin zone. We present two-dimensional tight-binding models for $p$-wave and $f$-wave half metals. These structures can be realized in crystalline and van der Waals systems. The complex band structure of the unusual $p$-wave half metal in nanostructures is also discussed. In a quantum well, a standing wave with a helical spin structure is formed, and a persistent spin current exists.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：show、present、discuss（理论推导与模型构建）。；研究对象：非常规磁体中的半金属态，具体为螺旋磁体（helimagnets）中的p波和f波半金属。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在螺旋磁体中存在一种不寻常的半金属态，其能隙所对应的自旋投影方向由波矢方向决定；该态源于能带结构的非平凡拓扑，即色散在布里渊区上形成多叶覆盖。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在螺旋磁体中存在一种不寻常的半金属态，其能隙所对应的自旋投影方向由波矢方向决定；该态源于能带结构的非平凡拓扑，即色散在布里渊区上形成多叶覆盖。；创新点：首次提出在螺旋磁体中存在波矢方向决定自旋能隙的非常规半金属态，并揭示了其与能带拓扑（多叶覆盖色散）的关联。摘要未突出说明与已有半金属铁磁体研究的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 构建二维紧束缚模型（tight-binding models）进行理论分析，并讨论了纳米结构（如量子阱）中的复杂能带结构。

papers.title: Reconfigurable Strain Gradient Polarity in Crystalline Oxide Nanomembranes for Controlled Bending of Functional Materials
papers.abstract: We report the fabrication and mechanical characterization of a "bubble" geometry for accessing local strain gradients using freestanding, single-crystalline manganite nanomembranes: a switchable bistable nanodrum, with opposite strain gradient polarities. By leveraging epitaxial strain as a source of pre-strain and with control of geometrical and mechanical boundary conditions, the fabricated device can support strain gradients with strain variation ranging from 0.01% to 1%. Switching energetics can be designed to configure the bubble morphology. By providing a mechanical framework for sustained strain gradients, this platform supports scalable oxide membrane applications such as the mechanical manipulation of magnetism, coupled to local probes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词“fabrication”、“mechanical characterization”、“device”。；研究对象：单晶锰氧化物（manganite）纳米薄膜制成的可重构“气泡”结构，具体研究其局域应变梯度极性的切换与调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过外延应变作为预应变源，并控制几何与力学边界条件，成功制备了具有相反应变梯度极性的双稳态纳米鼓（bistable nanodrum），可实现应变梯度极性的可逆切换。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过外延应变作为预应变源，并控制几何与力学边界条件，成功制备了具有相反应变梯度极性的双稳态纳米鼓（bistable nanodrum），可实现应变梯度极性的可逆切换。；创新点：实现了在晶体氧化物纳米薄膜中可重构的应变梯度极性（双稳态切换），为利用应变梯度机械操控功能材料（如磁性）提供了可扩展的平台。
papers.method_zh: 实验制备了自支撑单晶锰氧化物纳米薄膜，构建了“气泡”几何结构；通过控制外延预应变、几何形状和力学边界条件来设计切换能量，并进行了力学表征。

papers.title: Chiral anomaly and planar Hall conductance in pseudospin-$1$ Fermions
papers.abstract: Positive longitudinal magnetoconductance (LMC) and planar Hall conductance (PHC) are hallmark transport signatures of the chiral anomaly in Weyl semimetals. Recent theoretical developments have extended Weyl fermions to multifold Fermionic systems with higher-pseudospin quasiparticle excitations, motivating the study of their magnetotransport properties. Here, we employ semiclassical Boltzmann transport theory within the relaxation-time approximation to investigate magnetotransport in pseudospin-1 Weyl semimetals, incorporating momentum-dependent scattering, orbital magnetic moment corrections, and charge-conservation constraints. To obtain a finite PHC, we break azimuthal symmetry through either a generic tilt of the quasiparticle dispersion or a finite misalignment between the electric and magnetic fields. In the untilted case, the PHC is positive and scales quadratically with magnetic field strength. Increasing the scattering strength induces a sign reversal of the PHC, producing a transition from positive to negative values. The PHC further exhibits the characteristic angular dependence $\sin 2γ$, where $γ$ is the angle between the magnetic field and the $x$-axis. Tilt qualitatively alters this behavior: tilt along the $x$- and $z$-directions changes the angular response to $\sinγ$ and $\cosγ$, respectively, generating strong anisotropy in the planar Hall signal. Moreover, the PHC shows a nonmonotonic dependence on tilt magnitude, revealing the interplay between tilt-induced symmetry breaking and chiral-anomaly-driven transport. Our results provide experimentally accessible signatures of multifold fermions and a framework for interpreting magnetotransport measurements in candidate materials of space groups 199, 214, and 220.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“semiclassical Boltzmann transport theory”、“relaxation-time approximation”、“theoretical developments”。；研究对象：赝自旋-1 外尔半金属（pseudospin-1 Weyl semimetals）中的磁输运现象，具体包括纵向磁导（LMC）和平面霍尔电导（PHC）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在赝自旋-1 外尔半金属中，平面霍尔电导（PHC）在无倾斜时为正且与磁场平方成正比，散射强度增大会导致PHC符号反转；引入能带倾斜会改变PHC的角度依赖关系（从sin2γ变为sinγ或cosγ），并产生强各向异性与非单调的倾斜幅度依赖。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在赝自旋-1 外尔半金属中，平面霍尔电导（PHC）在无倾斜时为正且与磁场平方成正比，散射强度增大会导致PHC符号反转；引入能带倾斜会改变PHC的角度依赖关系（从sin2γ变为sinγ或cosγ），并产生强各向异性与非单调的倾斜幅度依赖。；创新点：将手征反常的磁输运特征（如正纵向磁导和平面霍尔电导）从传统外尔费米子推广到更高赝自旋（赝自旋-1）的多重费米子系统，并系统揭示了能带倾斜、散射强度等因素对平面霍尔电导符号和角度依赖性的调控作用。摘要未突出说明与已有赝自旋-1模型理论工作的具体区别。
papers.method_zh: 采用弛豫时间近似下的半经典玻尔兹曼输运理论，并考虑了动量依赖的散射、轨道磁矩修正以及电荷守恒约束。

papers.title: Universal critical behavior in ideal Bose-Einstein condensation
papers.abstract: Ideal Bose-Einstein condensation (BEC) remains a paradigmatic example of a continuous phase transition and a cornerstone for understanding quantum degenerate bosonic matter. We demonstrate that critical behavior of the ideal Bose gas near the BEC phase transition falls into three distinct classes, determined exclusively by the low-energy scaling of the density of states. Depending on its scaling exponent, which is controlled by dimensionality and confinement, the transition displays either the usual algebraic divergences of thermodynamic susceptibilities, divergent behavior with marginal logarithmic corrections, or a more subtle form of criticality, where only the correlation length diverges. Our work provides a unified framework for criticality in noninteracting bosonic systems. This classification applies broadly to atomic, photonic, polaritonic, and magnonic condensates, where dimensionality, confinement, and spectral engineering can strongly reshape the density of states.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：demonstrate、provides a unified framework、classification。；研究对象：理想玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚（BEC）中的临界行为，涵盖原子、光子、极化激元、磁振子等凝聚体。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 理想玻色气体在BEC相变附近的临界行为可分为三类，完全由态密度的低能标度指数决定，该指数受维度和约束控制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：理想玻色气体在BEC相变附近的临界行为可分为三类，完全由态密度的低能标度指数决定，该指数受维度和约束控制。；创新点：摘要未突出说明，但提供了非相互作用玻色子系统中临界性的统一分类框架，并指出该分类广泛适用于多种玻色凝聚体系。
papers.method_zh: 基于态密度的低能标度分析，通过标度指数对热力学量的发散行为进行分类，包括代数发散、对数修正发散以及仅关联长度发散的情形。

papers.title: Exact Dynamics of Topological Order Across a CDW--SPT Transition
papers.abstract: We investigate the nonequilibrium dynamics of a one-dimensional interacting system across a transition from a charge-density-wave (CDW) phase to a symmetry-protected topological (SPT) phase. Starting from a CDW initial state, we study both sudden quenches and slow ramps into the SPT regime. While the CDW order melts under both protocols, the fate of topological order is sharply different. Following a sudden quench, long-range SPT order does not emerge because the post-quench state contains a finite density of excitations above the topological ground state. In contrast, slow ramps allow the system to follow the instantaneous ground state away from the critical region, enabling the buildup of SPT order with deviations governed by Kibble-Zurek defect production. The dynamics is solvable via a unitary mapping to a quadratic fermionic Hamiltonian, allowing us to compute the Loschmidt echo, correlation functions, and string correlator. The Loschmidt rate function exhibits cusps signaling dynamical quantum phase transitions, while the correlation dynamics reveal the contrasting mechanisms governing quenches and ramps across the transition. These results demonstrate that entering the topological regime is not sufficient for the emergence of topological order; the decisive factor is the suppression of excitation production during the evolution.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“solvable via a unitary mapping to a quadratic fermionic Hamiltonian”等理论方法，且无实验或计算模拟细节描述。；研究对象：一维相互作用系统从电荷密度波（CDW）相到对称性保护拓扑（SPT）相的量子相变及其非平衡动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 进入拓扑相本身并不足以使拓扑序涌现，关键在于演化过程中能否抑制激发产生：突然淬火后拓扑序无法建立，而缓慢斜坡（ramp）过程可通过绝热跟随基态实现拓扑序的积累。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：进入拓扑相本身并不足以使拓扑序涌现，关键在于演化过程中能否抑制激发产生：突然淬火后拓扑序无法建立，而缓慢斜坡（ramp）过程可通过绝热跟随基态实现拓扑序的积累。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 通过幺正映射将相互作用系统转化为可解的二次费米子哈密顿量，解析计算Loschmidt回波、关联函数和弦关联函数，并利用Kibble-Zurek机制分析缺陷产生对拓扑序的影响。

papers.title: Ferromagnetism from the geometry of localized wavefunctions in moiré systems
papers.abstract: We present a mechanism for ferromagnetism in narrow bands consisting of Anderson-localized states. We exploit single-particle localization to derive a controlled theory of exchange interactions within the narrow band. For quasiperiodic systems with a half-filled moiré band, we show that the critical interaction strength for ferromagnetism is highly sensitive to the geometry of real-space overlaps between localized orbitals: we find well-defined resonances at which ferromagnetism sets in for interaction energies that are far lower than the gap to other bands. Near these resonances, all the approximations in our theory are controlled, so our critical point predictions are quantitative. We show examples both in one and two dimensions. Our work identifies a route to ferromagnetism based on the geometry of real-space wavefunctions, distinct from previously found mechanisms based on the quantum geometry of Bloch bands.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：present a mechanism、derive a controlled theory、show examples。；研究对象：莫尔系统中由安德森局域态构成的窄带中的铁磁性机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在准周期莫尔系统中，当窄带半填充时，铁磁性的临界相互作用强度对局域轨道实空间重叠的几何结构高度敏感；存在明确的共振点，使得铁磁性在远低于其他能带间隙的相互作用能量下出现。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在准周期莫尔系统中，当窄带半填充时，铁磁性的临界相互作用强度对局域轨道实空间重叠的几何结构高度敏感；存在明确的共振点，使得铁磁性在远低于其他能带间隙的相互作用能量下出现。；创新点：提出了一种基于实空间波函数几何结构的铁磁性实现路径，区别于以往基于布洛赫带量子几何的铁磁机制。
papers.method_zh: 利用单粒子局域化推导窄带内交换相互作用的可控理论，并通过一维和二维的示例进行理论验证。

papers.title: Numerical simulations of the spread from the mean of the SLE and Multiple SLE dynamics
papers.abstract: The Schramm-Loewner Evolution (SLE) describes a family of fractal curves that arise in the study of the scaling limits of many planar Statistical Physics models. These curves are modeled using the Loewner Differential Equation for the conformal maps $g_t(z)$ with a Brownian motion driver. Using Euler's Method, in the current work we performed numerical experiments to study at a fixed time the quantities $|g_t(z) - \overline{g_t(z)}|$ and $Re(g_t(z)) - Re(\overline{g_t(z)})$, where $Re$ denotes the real part and $\overline{g_t(z)}$ refers to the sample average. These random variables measure the 'spread' of the dynamics from the average behavior at fixed time. One of the scopes of this work is to give numerical predictions for future theoretical investigations on these quantities. When investigating these quantities in the SLE case our experiments predict that the distribution is bimodal when the dynamics started close to the origin, and it can become bell-shaped if the dynamics is started further from the origin. In the second part, we performed experiments for a Multiple SLE model whose driver is Dyson Brownian Motion. Due to singularity in the dynamics of the drivers and the many data points needed, this part is challenging from a computational perspective. In the multiple SLE case, our experiments predict that the distribution is bell-shaped in all cases. In addition, we check the changes in the distributions as we vary the parameter $κ$ in the SLE case and $β$ in the Multiple SLE case.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词为“numerical simulations”、“numerical experiments”、“Euler’s Method”。；研究对象：Schramm-Loewner Evolution（SLE）和Multiple SLE动力学中，共形映射 \( g_t(z) \) 在固定时刻相对于样本平均的“离散程度”（spread from the mean），具体研究随机变量 \( |g_t(z) - \overline{g_t(z)}| \) 和 \( Re(g_t(z)) - Re(\overline{g_t(z)}) \) 的分布行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于SLE动力学，当初始点靠近原点时，该离散量的分布呈双峰分布；当初始点远离原点时，分布变为钟形（单峰）。对于Multiple SLE动力学（驱动为Dyson布朗运动），在所有情况下分布均为钟形。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于SLE动力学，当初始点靠近原点时，该离散量的分布呈双峰分布；当初始点远离原点时，分布变为钟形（单峰）。对于Multiple SLE动力学（驱动为Dyson布朗运动），在所有情况下分布均为钟形。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用欧拉方法（Euler’s Method）对Loewner微分方程进行数值模拟。对于SLE情况，驱动为布朗运动；对于Multiple SLE情况，驱动为Dyson布朗运动。通过改变参数 \( \kappa \)（SLE情况）和 \( \beta \)（Multiple SLE情况）来观察分布的变化。

papers.title: Quantifying the Distribution of Biexciton Emission Efficiencies in Colloidal Quantum Shells
papers.abstract: The efficiency of multi-photon emission is an important characteristic of quantum light sources. Bright multi-photon emission is desirable for high-power lighting and lasers, while its complete suppression is required for high-purity single-photon generation. In colloidal quantum emitters, multi-photon emission can vary significantly between individual particles. Resolving this heterogeneity remains challenging with conventional particle-by-particle approaches. Here, we introduce a crosstalk-suppressed SPAD-array photon-correlation approach for high-throughput quantification of multi-photon emission from more than 1000 colloidal quantum shells. By projecting two images of the same sample onto distant regions of the detector array, we avoid short-range crosstalk between detector pixels. Time gating suppresses dark-count coincidences and distinguishes individual emitters from clusters. Applying this method to quantum shells reveals a near-Gaussian distribution of biexciton emission efficiencies, with a mean of 0.55 and an estimated intrinsic standard deviation of 0.12. Intra-batch correlations between the biexciton efficiency and the particle brightness are consistent with the volume scaling of Auger quenching. These results establish SPAD-array photon correlation as a scalable route to resolve multi-photon heterogeneities in nanoparticle ensembles.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中描述了具体的实验方法（SPAD-array photon-correlation approach）和测量结果（分布、均值、标准差等）。；研究对象：胶体量子壳（colloidal quantum shells）中的双激子发射效率分布。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过高通量测量超过1000个胶体量子壳，发现双激子发射效率呈近高斯分布，均值为0.55，估计本征标准差为0.12。批次内双激子效率与粒子亮度的相关性符合俄歇淬灭的体积标度关系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过高通量测量超过1000个胶体量子壳，发现双激子发射效率呈近高斯分布，均值为0.55，估计本征标准差为0.12。批次内双激子效率与粒子亮度的相关性符合俄歇淬灭的体积标度关系。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用串扰抑制的SPAD阵列光子关联方法（crosstalk-suppressed SPAD-array photon-correlation approach），通过将同一物镜的两个图像投影到探测器阵列的远距离区域来避免像素间短程串扰，并利用时间门控抑制暗计数符合事件、区分单个发射体与团簇。

papers.title: Nonadditivity in Quantum Field Theory: Replica Energies, Scaling Filters, and the Renormalization Group
papers.abstract: Extensive systems have a simple thermodynamic signature: the logarithm of the partition function scales homogeneously with the size of the system. We show that the failure of this scaling, measured by the replica energy ${\cal E}$, provides a useful bridge between statistical mechanics and quantum field theory. The associated differential operator $(1-\frac1d L\partial_L)$ removes the leading bulk contribution to $W=\log Z$ and isolates the part that is sensitive to boundaries, topology, defects, long-range forces, or other sources of nonadditivity. In quantum field theory this thermodynamic idea has two closely related uses. For ordinary finite-volume or spherical partition functions, suitable higher-order versions of the same filter remove local counterterms and extract universal fixed-point data such as the central charge, the sphere free energy $F$, and the Euler anomaly coefficient $a$. For replica geometries with entangling defects, the same filtering principle gives the renormalized defect free energy. In $2+1$ dimensions, its $n\to1$ limit is precisely the entropic $F$-function. We use this perspective to distinguish ordinary finite-size corrections, topology-dependent constants in gapped phases, subextensive fracton degeneracies, and genuinely nonextensive systems with long-range interactions such as self-gravitating thermal matter. Replica energy therefore offers a common thermodynamic language for additivity, defect free energies, and renormalization-group irreversibility.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：quantum field theory, renormalization group, thermodynamic signature, statistical mechanics。；研究对象：量子场论中非加和性（nonadditivity）的物理效应，具体涉及有限体积系统、边界、拓扑、缺陷、长程力以及自引力热物质等体系中的非广延性行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 复制能量（replica energy）ℰ 是衡量系统非加和性的有效热力学量，它通过微分算子 (1 - (1/d) L ∂_L) 从配分函数的对数中提取出对边界、拓扑、缺陷等敏感的部分，并可作为重正化群不可逆性的统一热力学语言。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：复制能量（replica energy）ℰ 是衡量系统非加和性的有效热力学量，它通过微分算子 (1 - (1/d) L ∂_L) 从配分函数的对数中提取出对边界、拓扑、缺陷等敏感的部分，并可作为重正化群不可逆性的统一热力学语言。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于统计力学与量子场论的理论框架，引入复制能量概念，并利用微分滤波算子（scaling filters）从有限体积或球面配分函数中去除体贡献，提取普适固定点数据（如中心荷、球面自由能 F、欧拉反常系数 a）；对于带有纠缠缺陷的复制几何，该滤波原理给出重正化后的缺陷自由能，并在 2+1 维中其 n→1 极限对应熵 F 函数。

papers.title: Deterministic Single-Photon Emitter Arrays in Hexagonal Boron Nitride by Carbon-Assisted Focused Ion Beam Engineering
papers.abstract: The realization of on-chip photonic circuits requires scalable and deterministic single-photon emitters (SPEs) at room temperature, which remain a challenge in van der Waals materials. In this work, we report a novel three-step fabrication process for the generation of spatially controlled SPE arrays in hexagonal boron nitride (hBN). The process comprises site-selective gallium (Ga) focused ion beam milling, nanoscale conformal carbon deposition over the patterned regions, and subsequent thermal annealing. The synergistic combination of these steps resulted in a site-correlated emitter yield of ($\sim 89\%$) across 100 fabrication sites. Second-order autocorrelation measurements revealed pronounced three-level emitter dynamics where the best emitters exhibited high purity ($g^{(2)}(0)=0.15 \pm 0.09$).To the best of our knowledge, this is the first lithography-free, direct-write approach combining Ga-ion milling, selective carbon engineering, and thermal annealing to deterministically generate \hBN{} \SPE{}s. The reproducibility of the method is validated across multiple independently fabricated samples. These results establish a scalable, lithography-free pathway toward on-demand SPE arrays relevant to integrated quantum photonics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要描述了具体的“三步制备工艺”（three-step fabrication process），并报告了实验测量结果（如二阶自相关测量、产率统计）。；研究对象：六方氮化硼（hBN）中的确定性单光子发射体（SPE）阵列。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过结合镓（Ga）聚焦离子束刻蚀、纳米级保形碳沉积和热退火的三步工艺，在六方氮化硼中实现了空间可控的单光子发射体阵列，其位点相关发射体产率高达约89%，且最佳发射体具有高纯度（g²(0)=0.15±0.09）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过结合镓（Ga）聚焦离子束刻蚀、纳米级保形碳沉积和热退火的三步工艺，在六方氮化硼中实现了空间可控的单光子发射体阵列，其位点相关发射体产率高达约89%，且最佳发射体具有高纯度（g²(0)=0.15±0.09）。；创新点：这是首个无需光刻（lithography-free）、采用直接写入（direct-write）方式，结合镓离子刻蚀、选择性碳工程和热退火来确定性生成六方氮化硼单光子发射体的方法。该方法具有可扩展性，并在多个独立制备的样品上验证了其可重复性。
papers.method_zh: 实验方法：1）位点选择性镓聚焦离子束（Ga FIB）刻蚀；2）在图案化区域进行纳米级保形碳沉积；3）后续热退火处理。表征手段：二阶自相关（g²(0)）测量。

papers.title: Effects of microstructural heterogeneity on the macroscopic spectrum of elastically accommodated grain-boundary sliding
papers.abstract: Elastically accommodated grain-boundary sliding (EAGBS) is a plausible source of upper-mantle seismic attenuation and dispersion, yet classical theory predicts a localized Debye-like peak that is absent or only weakly expressed in dry olivine experiments. Here we test whether microstructural heterogeneity can explain this discrepancy using 2-D finite-element simulations on periodic Voronoi tessellations. We find that irregular grain geometry changes the baseline EAGBS response relative to the regular hexagonal benchmark, but increasing grain-size variance alone produces only modest changes in modulus and peak height, with little spectral broadening. In contrast, a broad distribution of grain-boundary viscosities progressively suppresses and broadens the Debye-like loss peak into a weak background spanning a wide frequency interval. This broadening arises from the superposition of many localized relaxation processes with distinct characteristic timescales and motivates a reduced-order 0-D description of the aggregate response. These results suggest that the absence of a pronounced EAGBS peak in dry olivine does not necessarily imply the absence of EAGBS mechanism itself. If grain boundaries sample a sufficiently broad viscosity distribution, the macroscopic EAGBS contribution may appear experimentally only as part of a broad attenuation background, while still remaining relevant for upper-mantle seismic attenuation and velocity dispersion.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：2-D finite-element simulations（二维有限元模拟）、periodic Voronoi tessellations（周期性Voronoi剖分）。；研究对象：弹性协调的晶界滑移（EAGBS）机制，及其对地幔上部地震波衰减和频散的影响，具体关注微观结构非均匀性（晶粒几何不规则性、晶界粘度分布）对宏观频谱的调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 晶粒几何不规则性本身对EAGBS响应影响有限，但晶界粘度的宽分布会显著抑制并展宽Debye型损耗峰，使其变为覆盖宽频段的弱背景。这表明干橄榄石实验中未观察到明显EAGBS峰并不排除该机制本身的存在。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：晶粒几何不规则性本身对EAGBS响应影响有限，但晶界粘度的宽分布会显著抑制并展宽Debye型损耗峰，使其变为覆盖宽频段的弱背景。这表明干橄榄石实验中未观察到明显EAGBS峰并不排除该机制本身的存在。；创新点：首次通过数值模拟系统区分了晶粒尺寸分布与晶界粘度分布对EAGBS宏观频谱的不同影响，揭示了粘度分布是导致经典Debye峰消失的关键因素，并提出了降阶的零维（0-D）模型来描述集合响应。
papers.method_zh: 采用二维有限元方法，在周期性Voronoi剖分（模拟多晶微观结构）上模拟弹性协调的晶界滑移过程，并与规则六边形晶粒基准结果对比。

papers.title: Phase Transitions in Attention: A Bayesian Theory of Copy Head Emergence
papers.abstract: Attention is the key mechanism underlying in-context learning in transformers, and attention patterns have been observed empirically to emerge abruptly during training. We present a Bayesian theory of feature learning in attention; we then focus on how the copy subcircuit in the first layer of an induction head is learned by analyzing a single-layer softmax attention network trained on a copy task. We derive a closed-form posterior over the attention matrix and reduce it to a low-dimensional order parameter space. This reduction reveals a phase transition in the amount of training data, which we verify using both Bayesian sampling and standard training with Adam. We contrast our results with linear attention and find that softmax attention exhibits a \emph{first-order phase transition} while in linear attention an initial \emph{second-order phase transition} is followed by a smooth, continuous evolution toward the structured attention pattern (\emph{crossover}). Our work provides a first-principles theoretical account of the abrupt emergence of the copy subcircuit, reminiscent of the one observed in training large language models.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“Bayesian theory”、“closed-form posterior”、“phase transition”等理论分析框架，并结合贝叶斯采样和Adam训练进行验证，属于理论推导与计算模拟结合的研究。；研究对象：注意力机制中的相变现象，具体研究Transformer中第一层注意力头（copy subcircuit）在复制任务训练过程中的涌现行为，类比凝聚态物理中的相变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在softmax注意力网络中，随着训练数据量的增加，copy子电路的出现表现为一级相变（first-order phase transition）；而在线性注意力中，则先经历二级相变（second-order phase transition），随后平滑演化为结构化注意力模式（crossover）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在softmax注意力网络中，随着训练数据量的增加，copy子电路的出现表现为一级相变（first-order phase transition）；而在线性注意力中，则先经历二级相变（second-order phase transition），随后平滑演化为结构化注意力模式（crossover）。；创新点：首次从第一性原理出发，用贝叶斯理论严格解释了注意力模式在训练中突然涌现的相变行为，并对比了softmax与线性注意力在相变阶数上的本质差异。
papers.method_zh: 采用贝叶斯理论推导注意力矩阵的后验分布，并将其约化为低维序参量空间；通过贝叶斯采样和Adam优化器进行标准训练来验证理论预测。

papers.title: Searching for cosmic vortices
papers.abstract: Our study focuses on the strong tidal disruption of a cold helium white dwarf passing a black hole. We model the white dwarf as a Bose-Fermi droplet and use quantum hydrodynamic equations to simulate the binary system's evolution. As the white dwarf passes through periastron, it loses a significant amount of mass. This mass falls onto the black hole and forms an accretion disc. Quantized vortices appear in the accretion disc, manifesting as strong electromagnetic radiation signals that exhibit characteristic flickering patterns changing on a timescale of a few seconds. Meanwhile, the white dwarf moves away from the black hole. As the white dwarf moves through space, vortices run along its surface. This elongates its geometry, causing it to rotate and emit gravitational waves.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：量子流体动力学方程、模拟、Bose-Fermi液滴模型。；研究对象：强潮汐瓦解事件中，一颗冷氦白矮星经过黑洞时形成的吸积盘及白矮星表面涡旋现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 白矮星被黑洞潮汐瓦解后，吸积盘中出现量子化涡旋，这些涡旋产生具有特征闪烁模式的强电磁辐射信号（时间尺度约几秒）；同时，白矮星表面涡旋使其几何拉长、旋转并发射引力波。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：白矮星被黑洞潮汐瓦解后，吸积盘中出现量子化涡旋，这些涡旋产生具有特征闪烁模式的强电磁辐射信号（时间尺度约几秒）；同时，白矮星表面涡旋使其几何拉长、旋转并发射引力波。；创新点：首次将量子化涡旋引入黑洞吸积盘及白矮星表面动力学，并指出涡旋可同时产生可观测的电磁辐射闪烁信号和引力波信号。
papers.method_zh: 将白矮星建模为Bose-Fermi液滴，使用量子流体动力学方程模拟双星系统的演化过程。

papers.title: Tensor-Network Algorithm for Many-Body Trace Norms
papers.abstract: Trace norms are fundamental to quantum information theory, yet in many-body systems their evaluation remains a major computational bottleneck, as it generally requires diagonalizing exponentially large operators. Here, we overcome this bottleneck by introducing a controlled tensor-network algorithm for estimating the trace norm of matrix product operators without full diagonalization. The key idea is to combine Zolotarev's rational approximation to the sign function with a variational formulation solved using a density-matrix-renormalization-group-like algorithm. The resulting approximation is systematically improvable, with its accuracy controlled by the rational approximation parameters and the spectral weight near zero. Beyond the reach of exact diagonalization, we demonstrate controlled trace-norm calculations for entanglement negativity, quantum fidelity and quantum Fisher information, achieving substantially improved accuracy over polynomial-based Lanczos approaches. Our results establish trace-norm-based quantities as practical tensor-network observables, opening a route toward tensor-network studies of quantum information in mixed states.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：tensor-network algorithm、variational formulation、density-matrix-renormalization-group-like algorithm。；研究对象：多体量子系统中迹范数（trace norms）的计算，具体应用于纠缠负性（entanglement negativity）、量子保真度（quantum fidelity）和量子Fisher信息（quantum Fisher information）等量子信息量。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种基于张量网络的受控算法，可在无需完全对角化指数级大算符的情况下，高效且可系统改进地估计矩阵乘积算符的迹范数，其精度优于基于多项式的Lanczos方法。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种基于张量网络的受控算法，可在无需完全对角化指数级大算符的情况下，高效且可系统改进地估计矩阵乘积算符的迹范数，其精度优于基于多项式的Lanczos方法。；创新点：首次将迹范数相关的量子信息量（如纠缠负性、量子Fisher信息）转化为可实际计算的张量网络可观测量，突破了传统需要完全对角化的计算瓶颈。
papers.method_zh: 将Zolotarev有理逼近（用于符号函数）与变分公式相结合，并采用类似密度矩阵重整化群（DMRG）的算法进行求解。通过有理逼近参数和零附近谱权重控制计算精度。

papers.title: Breakdown of the classical rupture theory and earthquake propagation in the "forbidden" super-Rayleigh range
papers.abstract: Earthquakes propagating faster than the shear wave-speed are commonly thought to undergo a super-shear transition upon which they discontinuously jump from the sub-Rayleigh regime to the super-shear one. The super-Rayleigh regime, i.e., the range of propagation speeds between the Rayleigh and shear wave-speeds, is regarded as "forbidden" by the two-dimensional classical rupture theory. Here, we revisit the assumptions underlying the classical theory and develop a rupture theory that takes into account the dependence of the fault strength (frictional resistance) on the slip rate. The theory quantitatively agrees with numerical simulations nearly up to the Rayleigh wave-speed. Yet, very close to the latter, two-dimensional rupture solutions change their character due to frictional rate nonlinearity and rupture continuously propagates through the "forbidden" super-Rayleigh range into the super-shear regime, without a sharp super-shear transition. These results demonstrate that frictional rate dependence, generically observed in experiments, can have profound implications for fast earthquake propagation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（含数值模拟）。判断依据：关键词“develop a rupture theory”、“quantitatively agrees with numerical simulations”。；研究对象：地震破裂传播过程中的速度跃迁现象，特别是“超瑞利范围”（介于瑞利波速与剪切波速之间的传播速度区间）的破裂动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 经典二维破裂理论认为超瑞利范围是“禁止”的，但考虑断层强度（摩擦阻力）对滑移速率的依赖性后，破裂可以连续地通过该“禁止”范围进入超剪切状态，而不发生不连续的跃迁。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：经典二维破裂理论认为超瑞利范围是“禁止”的，但考虑断层强度（摩擦阻力）对滑移速率的依赖性后，破裂可以连续地通过该“禁止”范围进入超剪切状态，而不发生不连续的跃迁。；创新点：揭示了摩擦速率依赖性（实验中普遍观测到的现象）对快速地震传播的深刻影响，推翻了经典理论中关于超瑞利范围不可通过的结论。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 发展了一种考虑断层摩擦阻力随滑移速率变化的新型破裂理论，并通过数值模拟进行定量验证。

papers.title: Range-Aware Bayesian Optimization for Discovering Diverse Designs within Target Property Windows
papers.abstract: In many materials and product design problems, desirable candidates exhibit properties that fall within an acceptable range rather than achieve a single optimum. Recovering multiple, distinct solutions that satisfy such specifications is also practically valuable, as some candidates may be preferred for reasons of cost, processability, or robustness that are difficult to encode directly in an objective function. Here, we develop a range-aware Bayesian optimization (BO) framework in which the acquisition function directly scores the posterior probability that a candidate satisfies a target range. The framework naturally extends to parallel pursuit of multiple distinct specifications over a shared candidate space.
