Across benchmark tasks, range-aware acquisition consistently recovers larger and more diverse sets of valid designs than standard BO baselines and recent goal-seeking methods. Its utility is further demonstrated in two practically motivated design case studies involving optimizing reaction conditions for polymer synthesis and sequence-defined oligomer discovery for prescribed optical absorption bands, supported by quantum chemical calculations. These results suggest that range-aware BO can provide a practical and sample-efficient foundation for specification-driven design, particularly when design flexibility and solution diversity are important considerations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：Bayesian optimization（贝叶斯优化）、acquisition function（采集函数）、quantum chemical calculations（量子化学计算）。；研究对象：材料与产品设计问题中，目标性质落在可接受范围内的候选方案（如聚合物合成反应条件、序列定义低聚物的光学吸收带）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种“范围感知”贝叶斯优化框架，其采集函数直接评估候选方案满足目标性质范围的后验概率，相比标准贝叶斯优化和近期目标搜索方法，能更高效地恢复更大、更多样化的有效设计集合。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种“范围感知”贝叶斯优化框架，其采集函数直接评估候选方案满足目标性质范围的后验概率，相比标准贝叶斯优化和近期目标搜索方法，能更高效地恢复更大、更多样化的有效设计集合。；创新点：将贝叶斯优化的目标从寻找单一最优值扩展为直接搜索满足目标性质范围的多样化设计方案，并支持并行多规格搜索，特别适用于设计灵活性和解多样性重要的场景。
papers.method_zh: 采用贝叶斯优化框架，开发了新的“范围感知”采集函数，用于评分候选方案满足目标性质范围的后验概率；该框架自然扩展到在共享候选空间中并行追求多个不同规格；通过基准任务和两个实际设计案例（聚合物合成反应条件优化、基于量子化学计算的序列定义低聚物光学吸收带发现）验证其效用。

papers.title: Diffusive Relaxation of Participation Entropy in U(1)-symmetric Dynamics
papers.abstract: Participation entropy (PE) quantifies the spread of a many-body wavefunction across configuration space. While PE relaxes rapidly in generic chaotic systems, we show that $\mathrm{U}(1)$ conservation laws slow it down by imprinting with the slow hydrodynamic modes. Using a cluster expansion around equilibrium, we show that, after local density inhomogeneities decay, the leading PE deficit is dominated by squared connected density correlations. The long time relaxation is therefore controlled by diffusive correlation spreading, giving $ΔS(t)\sim t^{-1/2}$ in the hydrodynamic regime and crossing over to $\sim \exp[-O(t/L^2)]$ when $t\geq L^2$. We confirm this entropy correlation relation using exact computation and infinite system tensor network simulations in various quantum $\mathrm{U}(1)$ conserving circuits. Our results establish PE as a sensitive probe of hydrodynamic memory and suggest that slow relaxation is a generic consequence of conservation laws.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有数值计算）。判断依据：cluster expansion、tensor network simulations、exact computation。；研究对象：U(1)对称性量子动力学中参与熵（Participation Entropy）的弛豫行为，具体研究守恒律如何影响多体波函数在组态空间中的扩散。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: U(1)守恒律通过将参与熵与缓慢的流体动力学模式耦合，使其弛豫变慢：在流体动力学区域，参与熵的亏损ΔS(t)按t^{-1/2}衰减，当时间t≥L²时交叉到指数衰减形式。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：U(1)守恒律通过将参与熵与缓慢的流体动力学模式耦合，使其弛豫变慢：在流体动力学区域，参与熵的亏损ΔS(t)按t^{-1/2}衰减，当时间t≥L²时交叉到指数衰减形式。；创新点：揭示了参与熵可作为探测流体动力学记忆（hydrodynamic memory）的灵敏探针，并指出慢弛豫是守恒律的普遍结果。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 围绕平衡态进行集团展开（cluster expansion）分析，推导出参与熵亏损与平方连通密度关联函数的关系；结合精确计算和无限系统张量网络模拟（infinite system tensor network simulations），在多种量子U(1)守恒线路中验证熵-关联关系。

papers.title: A Cryogenic Uniaxial Strain Cell for Quantum Devices
papers.abstract: Mechanical strain is a powerful resource for tuning quantum systems, but existing piezoelectric strain cells are generally optimized for fragile, high-aspect-ratio single crystals rather than the thick, square-profile chips typical of semiconductor quantum devices. Furthermore, adapting these cells for qubits requires accommodating dense RF and DC wiring while maintaining strict electrical isolation from high-voltage piezo actuators. Here, we present a piezoelectric uniaxial strain cell designed to homogeneously strain thick, square-profile substrates. We introduce a highly symmetric dual-chip loading configuration that effectively suppresses flexural deformation and shear stress. The cell integrates a high-density RF/DC interposer to support standard wire bonding and encloses the actuators in a grounded Faraday cage to prevent unwanted Stark shifts in the device layer. Finite element simulations confirm that combining stiff actuators with this symmetric mounting drastically improves strain homogeneity. Finally, we validate the apparatus experimentally by applying uniaxial strain to a 200 $μ$m thick silicon die. Surface strain measurements demonstrate an applied strain of 215 $με$ for 200 V applied piezo bias.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：present、validate experimentally、surface strain measurements。；研究对象：用于量子器件的低温单轴应变装置，具体针对厚方形硅芯片（200 μm厚硅片）的均匀应变施加。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 设计并验证了一种压电单轴应变装置，能够对厚方形基片施加均匀应变，在200 V压电偏压下实现了215 με的表面应变，且通过对称双芯片加载配置有效抑制了弯曲变形和剪切应力。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：设计并验证了一种压电单轴应变装置，能够对厚方形基片施加均匀应变，在200 V压电偏压下实现了215 με的表面应变，且通过对称双芯片加载配置有效抑制了弯曲变形和剪切应力。；创新点：针对半导体量子器件常用的厚方形芯片（而非传统脆性高长宽比单晶）设计应变装置，并引入高度对称的双芯片加载构型以提升应变均匀性，同时集成高密度射频/直流布线及电隔离措施以适应量子比特需求。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用压电单轴应变装置，结合高密度RF/DC转接板支持标准引线键合，并将致动器封装在接地法拉第笼中以防止器件层产生不必要的斯塔克位移；理论上使用有限元模拟验证致动器刚度与对称安装对应变均匀性的改善。

papers.title: Handbook of Error-Correcting Codes
papers.abstract: Barcode scans, clear phone calls, reliable data storage, satellite communication, and large-scale quantum computation are all made possible by error correction. We present a handbook version of The Error Correction Zoo, a curated reference of methods for protecting classical or quantum information from errors during storage and transmission. The handbook includes descriptions of these error-correcting codes and a classification according to the symbols they use. It also catalogues relations among codes and related objects such as sphere packings, lattices, designs, groups, and classical and quantum phases of matter. The collection is intended both as a rigorous reference and as a practical aid for tracing the web of code relationships and uncovering new connections.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：handbook version、classification、reference、catalogues relations）；研究对象：纠错码（error-correcting codes），包括经典纠错码和量子纠错码，以及与之相关的球堆积、格点、设计、群、经典与量子物相等对象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 本文以手册形式系统整理了“纠错码动物园”（The Error Correction Zoo）中的各类纠错码，并按照其使用的符号进行分类，同时编录了不同纠错码之间以及纠错码与相关数学物理对象（如球堆积、格点、设计、群、经典与量子物相）之间的关系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：本文以手册形式系统整理了“纠错码动物园”（The Error Correction Zoo）中的各类纠错码，并按照其使用的符号进行分类，同时编录了不同纠错码之间以及纠错码与相关数学物理对象（如球堆积、格点、设计、群、经典与量子物相）之间的关系。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 文献综述与分类整理（curated reference），构建关系网络（web of code relationships）。

papers.title: Pulse-Duration Scaling of Ultrafast Laser-Induced Damage Threshold in Hybrid Gratings
papers.abstract: High damage threshold gratings are in demand worldwide as critical components for next generation ultrahigh intensity lasers. Here we investigate the pulse-duration dependence of ultrafast laser-induced damage thresholds (LIDT) in hybrid multilayer dielectric gratings, touted to combine superior performance properties of both metallic and multilayer dielectric (MLD) gratings, using a dynamic finite-difference time-domain model incorporated with linear and non-linear absorption models. Simulations agree with reported experimental LIDT values for three representative designs and predict scaling exponents which vary with pulse durations ranging from 10 to 500 fs. The results reveal strong dependence on both material bandgap and grating field distribution, providing guidance for designing high LIDT gratings.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：dynamic finite-difference time-domain model incorporated with linear and non-linear absorption models，simulations）；研究对象：混合多层介质光栅（hybrid multilayer dielectric gratings）在超快激光作用下的损伤阈值（LIDT）及其随脉冲宽度的标度行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 混合光栅的超快激光诱导损伤阈值（LIDT）随脉冲宽度（10–500 fs）的标度指数会发生变化，且该标度行为强烈依赖于材料带隙和光栅内部的电场分布。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：混合光栅的超快激光诱导损伤阈值（LIDT）随脉冲宽度（10–500 fs）的标度指数会发生变化，且该标度行为强烈依赖于材料带隙和光栅内部的电场分布。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用动态时域有限差分（FDTD）方法，并结合线性和非线性吸收模型进行数值模拟。

papers.title: Mean-field limits for stochastic particle systems on dense graphs
papers.abstract: We study stochastic interacting particle systems whose interaction structure is described by dense weighted directed graphs converging to a graphon. In the thermodynamic limit, we prove a law of large numbers for the empirical measure process and derive a deterministic nonlinear master equation describing the macroscopic evolution. The limiting equation retains the heterogeneous interaction structure of the microscopic system through the limiting graphon, allowing for spatially non-homogeneous behaviors such as localized or community-type interactions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：stochastic interacting particle systems（随机相互作用粒子系统）、law of large numbers（大数定律）、nonlinear master equation（非线性主方程）。；研究对象：稠密加权有向图上的随机相互作用粒子系统，其相互作用结构由稠密加权有向图描述，并收敛于图极限（graphon）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在热力学极限下，证明了经验测度过程的大数定律，并推导出一个描述宏观演化的确定性非线性主方程。该极限方程通过极限图保留了微观系统的异质相互作用结构，允许出现空间非均匀行为（如局域化或社区型相互作用）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在热力学极限下，证明了经验测度过程的大数定律，并推导出一个描述宏观演化的确定性非线性主方程。该极限方程通过极限图保留了微观系统的异质相互作用结构，允许出现空间非均匀行为（如局域化或社区型相互作用）。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用随机相互作用粒子系统的数学理论框架，结合图极限（graphon）方法，通过热力学极限分析推导宏观演化方程。

papers.title: Color-Rule-Function Encoding for Combinatorial Memory
papers.abstract: Combinatorial memory is a class of memory in which information is encoded in the set of paths through a structured mesh. In this work, we introduce a systematic encoding framework, referred to as the Color-Rule-Function (CRF) approach, for representing information in combinatorial memory. The method consists of four key steps: selecting a sequence of paths in the mesh, assigning values (e.g., colors) to each cell, defining a set of rules based on the values encountered along each path, and constructing a Boolean function that determines the state of each path. . The coding procedure is illustrated by several examples. The design space scales of the CRF scale fundamentally faster compared to conventional memory. This apparent advantage arises from the use of rule-based and functional representations but is accompanied by increased hardware complexity. A possible hardware realization of the CRF framework is discussed. Importantly, the hardware overhead can be substantially reduced through the use of customized modules. The examples of the customized design are described in the text. The combination of CRF coding with customized module design may lead to a practical advantage in data storage density. According to the estimates, the data storage density may exceed Exabit per centimeter squared. A key problem that requires further investigation is related to the minimum Hamming distance between an arbitrary target bit sequence and the closest sequence realizable within the CRF framework under fixed hardware constraints.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：encoding framework, Boolean function, design space scaling, estimates）；研究对象：组合存储器（combinatorial memory），一种通过结构化网格中的路径集合编码信息的存储器体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种名为“颜色-规则-函数”（CRF）的系统编码框架，其设计空间扩展速度远超传统存储器，理论上数据存储密度可超过每平方厘米艾字节（Exabit/cm²）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种名为“颜色-规则-函数”（CRF）的系统编码框架，其设计空间扩展速度远超传统存储器，理论上数据存储密度可超过每平方厘米艾字节（Exabit/cm²）。；创新点：首次将基于规则和函数的表示方法系统性地引入组合存储器的编码框架，实现了设计空间的超快扩展，并提出了通过定制化模块大幅降低硬件开销的途径。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架设计：包括选择网格中的路径序列、为每个单元赋值（如颜色）、基于路径上遇到的值定义规则集、构建决定每条路径状态的布尔函数。通过示例说明编码过程，并讨论了可能的硬件实现及定制化模块设计。

papers.title: Observable signatures of exceptional points from left-right eigenstate distinction
papers.abstract: Non-Hermitian quantum systems exhibit qualitatively distinct physical behavior compared to Hermitian systems, a prime example being spectral singularities known as exceptional points. Their relevance in, e.g., quantum sensing, unidirectional transport, and robust lasing makes it important to be able to identify exceptional points through observable features of a many-body system. Here, using as an example a one-dimensional complex XY spin chain realizing both rotation-time RT- and parity-time PT-symmetric regimes, we develop a framework for detecting exceptional points based on the distinction between left and right eigenvectors of the Hamiltonian, which in a non-Hermitian system are no longer the adjoint of each other. We first show that a global measure constructed from the difference between the Hamiltonian and its adjoint locates exceptional points via distinct non-analytic behavior. At the level of observables, differences in local spin correlations evaluated on the right and left eigenstates provide a reliable static detection scheme. In contrast, static bipartite entanglement measures fail to capture this distinction, urging us to study the quantum dynamics of the model. Following a sudden quench, we demonstrate that the time-averaged right-left entanglement entropy difference directly encodes signatures of the exceptional point. In the RT-symmetric regime, it exhibits a pronounced peak at the exceptional point, whereas in the PT-symmetric regime it behaves as an order-parameter-like quantity, remaining finite in one phase and vanishing at the transition. Our results establish a direct link between the structure of non-Hermitian eigenstates and observable signatures of exceptional points, providing a practical route to identify them in existing quantum simulators.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：develop a framework、demonstrate、study the quantum dynamics。；研究对象：非厄米量子系统中的奇异点（exceptional points），具体以实现RT对称和PT对称的一维复杂XY自旋链为例。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于非厄米哈密顿量左右本征矢的差异，构建了全局度量（如哈密顿量与其伴随算符的差）和局域可观测信号（如左右本征态上的自旋关联差异、时间平均的左右纠缠熵差），这些信号在奇异点处表现出非解析行为或峰值，从而提供可观测的奇异点探测方案。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：基于非厄米哈密顿量左右本征矢的差异，构建了全局度量（如哈密顿量与其伴随算符的差）和局域可观测信号（如左右本征态上的自旋关联差异、时间平均的左右纠缠熵差），这些信号在奇异点处表现出非解析行为或峰值，从而提供可观测的奇异点探测方案。；创新点：建立了非厄米本征态结构与奇异点可观测信号之间的直接联系，提出了基于静态和动力学可观测量的实用探测方案，并揭示了RT对称与PT对称区域中奇异点信号的不同行为（峰值 vs. 序参量式行为）。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析结合数值计算。具体包括：构造左右本征矢差异的全局度量；计算左右本征态上的局域自旋关联和二分纠缠熵；通过突然淬火后的量子动力学，研究时间平均的左右纠缠熵差。

papers.title: Learning from almost nothing: How neural networks survive heavy input corruption
papers.abstract: Learning from imperfect data is a central theme in machine learning, connecting practical questions of robustness to fundamental questions of learnability. Here we examine attribute noise: learning from corrupted inputs while keeping the labels intact, a setting that has received considerably less analytical attention than its label-noise counterpart. We consider two types of corruption models: additive noise and replacement noise. Through experiments with multi-layer perceptrons (MLPs) on corrupted classification datasets, we find that neural networks remain robust, maintaining well-above-chance accuracy even when inputs are >90% corrupted -- far beyond human recognition. To understand this robustness, we analyze infinite-width networks in the heavy-corruption regime using a mean-field-inspired approach and derive a leading-order decision rule for the classification outcome: the network implements a prototype rule, the nearest-class-mean, assigning each test point to the class whose training-set average it most closely resembles. This leading-order decision rule is universal across a broad range of MLP architectures, holding for any depth, as well as a wide class of activation functions and noise distributions. The same centroid mechanism closely matches finite-width network behavior in our experiments and provides an interpretable and analytically tractable account of why learning can succeed even when individual training examples carry almost no signal.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有实验验证）。判断依据：mean-field-inspired approach（平均场启发方法）、derived a leading-order decision rule（推导出主导阶决策规则）、experiments with multi-layer perceptrons（多层感知机实验）。；研究对象：神经网络在输入数据遭受严重损坏（属性噪声，包括加性噪声和替换噪声）时的学习行为与鲁棒性机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 即使在输入数据超过90%被破坏的情况下，神经网络仍能保持远高于随机猜测的分类准确率；其鲁棒性源于网络在重噪声极限下实现了一种“最近类均值”原型决策规则，该规则对网络深度、激活函数和噪声分布具有普适性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：即使在输入数据超过90%被破坏的情况下，神经网络仍能保持远高于随机猜测的分类准确率；其鲁棒性源于网络在重噪声极限下实现了一种“最近类均值”原型决策规则，该规则对网络深度、激活函数和噪声分布具有普适性。；创新点：首次从理论上严格证明，在输入严重损坏（属性噪声）条件下，神经网络通过实现“最近类均值”原型规则维持分类能力，并揭示该机制对多种网络架构、激活函数和噪声类型的普适性。
papers.method_zh: 采用多层感知机（MLP）在受噪声污染的分类数据集上进行实验；利用平均场方法分析无限宽度网络在重噪声极限下的行为，推导出分类结果的主导阶决策规则。

papers.title: Lectures on Semiclassical Methods for Composite Operators
papers.abstract: These lecture notes are intended as a coherent introduction to conformal field theory in general, and composite operators in particular, through a semiclassical framework for computing scaling dimensions, with emphasis on operators of the form $φ^n$. In doing so, they aim to fill a gap in the literature and to help decode some of the relevant concepts. The physical idea is that at large $n$ an (heavy) operator creates a highly occupied state. Through the state-operator correspondence, this state lives on the cylinder $\mathbb{R}\times S^{d-1}$, and its scaling dimension is the corresponding energy of the theory on the cylinder. The notes are organized as a self-contained route from conformal symmetry to semiclassical dynamics. Part I reviews the conformal group, primary operators, radial quantization, the state-operator correspondence, and operator mixing. Part II builds the semiclassical framework, first in the free scalar theory, where the dimension of $φ^n$ is recovered in three independent ways, and then through the double-scaling limit, the action variable, and Bohr-Sommerfeld quantization. Part III develops the general machinery of periodic saddles, Floquet theory, fluctuation determinants, the Gel'fand-Yaglom method, and the Gutzwiller trace formula. Part IV applies the framework to the $O(N)$ $φ^4$ theory in $d=4-ε$ at the Wilson-Fisher fixed point, deriving the classical elliptic solution, the Lamé fluctuation spectrum, the zero modes, and the one-loop contribution to the large-$n$ scaling dimensions. Beyond the explicit computation, the notes emphasize the role of composite operators as probes of collective sectors of quantum field theory, with extensions to gauge theories, conformal windows, and asymptotically safe field theories.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：lecture notes、semiclassical framework、conformal field theory、scaling dimensions、state-operator correspondence。；研究对象：共形场论中的复合算符，特别是形如 φ^n 的算符，以及其在圆柱时空上的半经典动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过半经典框架，利用态-算符对应，将大 n 下重算符的标度维数转化为圆柱上理论的能量，从而系统计算复合算符的标度维数，并在 O(N) φ^4 理论的 Wilson-Fisher 不动点处给出大 n 标度维数的单圈贡献。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过半经典框架，利用态-算符对应，将大 n 下重算符的标度维数转化为圆柱上理论的能量，从而系统计算复合算符的标度维数，并在 O(N) φ^4 理论的 Wilson-Fisher 不动点处给出大 n 标度维数的单圈贡献。；创新点：摘要未突出说明，但该工作以讲义形式系统填补了文献中关于通过半经典框架计算复合算符标度维数的空白，并强调复合算符作为量子场论集体扇区探针的作用，扩展至规范理论、共形窗口和渐近安全场论。
papers.method_zh: 半经典方法：包括径向量子化、态-算符对应、双标度极限、作用量变量、Bohr-Sommerfeld 量子化、周期鞍点、Floquet 理论、涨落行列式、Gel'fand-Yaglom 方法、Gutzwiller 迹公式，以及 Lamé 涨落谱和零模分析。

papers.title: Exact Entanglement Dynamics Beyond Nearest-Neighbor Dual-Unitary Floquet Systems
papers.abstract: Exact results using dual-unitarity largely rely on nearest-neighbor structures, while finite-range interactions typically lead to complications. Going beyond the usual nearest-neighbor setting, we introduce an analytically tractable family of finite-range kicked Ising models that admit exact closed-form entanglement dynamics. The construction is based on a staggered structure in which dual-unitarity is present on sublattices that are then coupled to each other. The central observation is that these inter-sublattice couplings do not obstruct the dual-unitarity of the resulting model. For the minimal interaction range of $r= 2$, we derive exact expressions for all the $n-$Rényi entanglement entropies at all times and show that the result is the sum of the two coupled sublattice contributions. Our framework extends naturally to larger finite interaction ranges and to systems with heterogeneous local Hilbert spaces, without additional assumptions. It thus provides a controlled setting for studying exact entanglement growth beyond strictly nearest-neighbor dual-unitary models.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：analytically tractable、exact closed-form entanglement dynamics、derived exact expressions。；研究对象：有限程（finite-range） kicked Ising 模型中的纠缠动力学，具体为超越最近邻相互作用的双幺正（dual-unitary）Floquet 系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过引入交错结构（staggered structure），在子格上保持双幺正性，并允许子格间耦合，从而构建了一类可精确求解的有限程 kicked Ising 模型。对于最小相互作用范围 r=2，所有 n-阶 Rényi 纠缠熵的精确表达式可写为两个耦合子格贡献之和。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过引入交错结构（staggered structure），在子格上保持双幺正性，并允许子格间耦合，从而构建了一类可精确求解的有限程 kicked Ising 模型。对于最小相互作用范围 r=2，所有 n-阶 Rényi 纠缠熵的精确表达式可写为两个耦合子格贡献之和。；创新点：将双幺正性方法从严格最近邻系统推广到有限程相互作用系统，并提供了可精确求解的模型族，无需额外假设即可自然扩展到更大相互作用范围和异质局域希尔伯特空间。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析框架：基于交错子格结构的双幺正性构造，推导了有限程 kicked Ising 模型的精确纠缠动力学闭式解。

papers.title: Stabilizing Role of Uninformed Participants in Collective Decision Making
papers.abstract: For groups without strict hierarchy, collective decisions often emerge through compromise. We develop a second-order network model of collective decision-making using a dissipative Hamiltonian formulation, in which informed agents introduce preferred directions while uninformed participants contribute only direction-free dissipation. We show that under low conflict, the model admits a locally unique, exponentially stable compromise state. Using a structured modular network we further show that as conflict increases the local compromise branch terminates through a saddle-node fold rather than through a smooth mean-field symmetry-breaking transition. Modular polarized states persist on branches that are locally separated from the compromise branch. Direction-free dissipation does not shift the static structural threshold, but it delays escape from the saddle-node ghost and pushes the observable onset of polarization to larger conflicts. Our work identifies a dissipation-mediated mechanism, complementary to connectivity-based accounts, through which uninformed participants stabilize collective behavior in biological and engineered swarms.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用了“develop a second-order network model”、“dissipative Hamiltonian formulation”等理论建模和数学分析的关键词。；研究对象：集体决策中的群体行为，特别是包含有信息个体（informed agents）和无信息个体（uninformed participants）的混合群体在冲突条件下的决策动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 无信息参与者（仅提供无方向耗散）不会改变系统发生极化的静态结构阈值，但会通过延迟系统从鞍-结点幽灵（saddle-node ghost）中逃逸，从而将极化现象的可观测起始点推迟到更大的冲突强度，起到稳定集体行为的作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：无信息参与者（仅提供无方向耗散）不会改变系统发生极化的静态结构阈值，但会通过延迟系统从鞍-结点幽灵（saddle-node ghost）中逃逸，从而将极化现象的可观测起始点推迟到更大的冲突强度，起到稳定集体行为的作用。；创新点：识别出一种与传统的基于连接性（connectivity-based）解释互补的、由耗散（dissipation）介导的稳定化机制，揭示了无信息参与者通过纯粹的能量耗散而非信息输入来稳定集体行为的作用。
papers.method_zh: 采用耗散哈密顿量（dissipative Hamiltonian formulation）构建了集体决策的二阶网络模型。通过分析模型在低冲突条件下的局部指数稳定性，并利用结构化模块网络（structured modular network）研究高冲突下的分岔行为（鞍-结点折叠，saddle-node fold）。

papers.title: APTLAS: An Indexed APT Literature Repository
papers.abstract: Atom probe tomography (APT) literature is broad, rapidly growing, and dispersed across a wide range of journals, which can make it difficult to identify prior work on a given material system, instrument, or analytical approach. Conventional search engines (e.g., Google Scholar) excel at general retrieval but do not preserve the domain-specific metadata that often determines the relevance of an APT publication (e.g., analysis mode, laser wavelength, or instrument configuration). Herein, APTLAS is presented, which is an indexed repository of published APT literature. At present, the database contains ~2,300 records, each accompanied by metadata extracted from the source publication. The accompanying web tool, available at https://aptlas.bavleyguerguis.com/, allows users to browse and filter by material system, instrument, application, publication type, or keyword search.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：非实验/计算/理论文章，属于数据库与工具开发类。判断依据：关键词“indexed repository”、“metadata”、“web tool”。；研究对象：原子探针层析技术（APT）领域的文献资源，涵盖材料体系、仪器、分析方法等。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 摘要未明确说明物理结论或发现，主要贡献是构建了一个包含约2300条记录的APT文献索引数据库及配套网络工具。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：摘要未明确说明物理结论或发现，主要贡献是构建了一个包含约2300条记录的APT文献索引数据库及配套网络工具。；创新点：相对于通用搜索引擎（如Google Scholar），该工作专门保留了APT领域特有的元数据（如分析模式、激光波长、仪器配置），使研究者能按材料体系、仪器、应用类型等专业维度进行精准筛选和检索。
papers.method_zh: 通过人工或自动方式从已发表APT文献中提取元数据（如分析模式、激光波长、仪器配置等），构建可检索的数据库，并开发了基于网页的浏览与筛选工具（https://aptlas.bavleyguerguis.com/）。

papers.title: Physically Constrained Ensemble Gaussian Process Modelling for Expensive Quantum Systems with Heteroskedastic Noise
papers.abstract: Accurate modeling of quantum many-body systems often requires computationally expensive simulations such as Density Matrix Renormalization Group (DMRG) or Quantum Monte Carlo (QMC) calculations. These methods, while precise, impose significant time and resource constraints, limiting their use in exhaustive parameter exploration. Moreover, these expensive simulations can contain variable errors over the large unknown parameter space, which needs to be quantified and propagated. Thus, predictive modelling is required to estimate the functional space accurately over scarcely sampled data with heteroskedastic noise, while preserving the physical relevance of the estimation. Therefore, we present a Physically Constrained Ensemble Gaussian Process (pc-EGP) framework designed to efficiently model complex and noisy quantum systems under physical consistency constraints. The proposed method first enforces physical constraints as a user controlled weighted penalty to the data-driven loss function of the Gaussian Process (GP) surrogates. Then an ensemble of such GP models is trained with variable noisy simulations via numerical quadrature method where these multiple GP(s) at different nodes is integrated as a quadrature weighted average. We first demonstrate the framework on synthetically generated data before applying to quantum systems. In the first case study, we leverage DMRG simulations of the Bose-Hubbard Model to predict the critical interaction parameter Uc governing the superfluid-to-Mott-insulator transition. In the second case study, we demonstrate our method on QMC simulations, of a quantum liquid confined inside a nanoporous silicate with the goal of optimizing a chemical environment to realize a one-dimensional superfluid. Compared to conventional GP, pc-EGP achieves a better balance of accuracy and physically meaningful predictions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论混合类型。判断依据：摘要提及“DMRG”“QMC”等计算方法，以及“高斯过程”“数值求积”等理论建模框架。；研究对象：量子多体系统，具体包括：Bose-Hubbard模型中的超流-莫特绝缘体相变（临界相互作用参数Uc），以及纳米多孔硅酸盐中受限量子液体的化学环境优化（以实现一维超流）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种物理约束集成高斯过程（pc-EGP）框架，相比传统高斯过程，能在异方差噪声下更准确地建模昂贵量子模拟数据，同时保持预测的物理合理性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种物理约束集成高斯过程（pc-EGP）框架，相比传统高斯过程，能在异方差噪声下更准确地建模昂贵量子模拟数据，同时保持预测的物理合理性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用物理约束集成高斯过程（pc-EGP）框架。具体包括：将物理约束作为加权惩罚项加入高斯过程代理模型的数据驱动损失函数；通过数值求积方法训练多个高斯过程模型，并以求积加权平均集成。案例中使用了DMRG（密度矩阵重正化群）和QMC（量子蒙特卡洛）模拟数据。

papers.title: Collective Emission in LH2 Assembly Beyond the Point-Dipole Approximation
papers.abstract: Collective emission in light-harvesting assemblies is governed by the local transition dipole and finite geometry of emitting units, a fact that point-dipole approximation obscures. To go beyond this picture, we develop a non-Hermitian Hamiltonian using the quantum electrodynamic dyadic Green's tensor for a purple bacteria. We construct it for the isolated 24-bacteriochlorophyll conical frustum and its P42$_1$2 crystallographic assembly. The P42$_1$2 unit-cell symmetry is found to invert the bright-dark ordering of the single ring, placing subradiant states at the low-energy end and revealing the entire crystal to be the energy-harvesting entity. Tilt-driven switching is activated only in crystal geometries where the finite dipole-carrier (LH2) lies perpendicular to the growth plane. Vacancy and orientational disorder work only in cooperation to renormalize the switching threshold from higher polar angles to lower values.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：非厄米哈密顿量、量子电动力学并矢格林张量、点偶极近似之外）；研究对象：紫色细菌中LH2（捕光复合体2）组装体的集体发射行为，具体为24个细菌叶绿素构成的锥形环及其P42₁2晶体学组装结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: P42₁2晶胞对称性反转了单个环的亮-暗态顺序，使亚辐射态位于低能端，揭示整个晶体才是能量捕获实体；倾斜驱动的开关效应仅在有限偶极载体（LH2）垂直于生长平面的晶体几何中被激活。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：P42₁2晶胞对称性反转了单个环的亮-暗态顺序，使亚辐射态位于低能端，揭示整个晶体才是能量捕获实体；倾斜驱动的开关效应仅在有限偶极载体（LH2）垂直于生长平面的晶体几何中被激活。；创新点：首次在超越点偶极近似的框架下，系统研究LH2组装体中有限几何与跃迁偶极对集体发射的调控，并揭示晶胞对称性对能级排序的反转作用以及空位与取向无序的协同效应。
papers.method_zh: 基于量子电动力学并矢格林张量构建非厄米哈密顿量，超越点偶极近似，对孤立LH2锥形环及其P42₁2晶体组装进行计算建模。

papers.title: Scaling law of asymptotic freedom in collective charging of quantum batteries
papers.abstract: We establish a universal scaling law for collective charging of quantum batteries, independent of microscopic details. We prove that the ergotropy-to-energy ratio approaches unity at least as fast as $\sim N^{-1}$ with the number of batteries $N$, implying generic asymptotic freedom. We further show how the universal $1/N$ scaling can be overcome: when the battery state becomes asymptotically pure, the convergence can be substantially faster, including $\sim N^{-b}$ with $b>1$ and even exponential scaling in $N^2$. Rigorous finite-$N$ upper and lower bounds on the ergotropy-to-energy ratio are further derived, providing nonasymptotic guarantees for the universal $1/N$ scaling.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：establish a universal scaling law、prove、derive rigorous bounds。；研究对象：量子电池（quantum batteries）的集体充电过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 量子电池集体充电时，ergotropy（可提取功）与能量之比随电池数量N增加至少以~1/N的标度律趋近于1，即存在普遍的渐近自由；当电池态趋于纯态时，收敛速度可显著加快，甚至达到N的指数标度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：量子电池集体充电时，ergotropy（可提取功）与能量之比随电池数量N增加至少以~1/N的标度律趋近于1，即存在普遍的渐近自由；当电池态趋于纯态时，收敛速度可显著加快，甚至达到N的指数标度。；创新点：首次证明集体充电中渐近自由的普适标度律（1/N）独立于微观细节，并揭示了通过纯态实现超快收敛的机制。
papers.method_zh: 基于量子信息与统计物理的理论推导，建立了ergotropy-to-energy比值的通用标度律，并推导了有限N的严格上下界。

papers.title: Negative heat capacities in spherically symmetric sectors of $d$-matrix quantum mechanics
papers.abstract: We consider the $SO(d)$ and $O(d)$ invariant sectors of the bosonic $d$-matrix harmonic oscillator with $U(N)$ gauge symmetry. The micro-canonical degeneracy $\mathcal{Z}( N , d , k )$ for fixed energy $k$ is expressed as a pairing between an $N$-dependent vector and a $d$-dependent vector in the space of partitions of the integer $k$. This pairing formula is derived by counting invariant words in multi-matrix variables $X^i_{j,a}$, using properties of Clebsch-Gordan multiplicities (Kronecker coefficients) for the symmetric group $S_k$, Schur-Weyl duality and harmonic analysis on the homogeneous space $U(d)/SO(d)$. Analytic formulae for large $N$ and $k$ with $ k \le N $ are obtained using group integrals over $U(N)$ and $SO(d)$ (or $ O(d)$). The micro-canonical heat capacity in this regime is negative and turns positive, at a critical value $k_{\rm crit}$, due to finite $N$ modifications to the counting, thus forming what we denote as a characteristic caloric fold in the $ E $ versus $T$ curve. Data from the pairing formula is well fitted by $k_{\rm crit} \sim { N^2 \over 4 }$ for small values of $d$. A derivation of this large $N$ formula is given using a matrix model approximation and semi-classical analysis of the eigenvalue density. The large $N,d$ limit of the degeneracies reveals a key role for ribbon graph combinatorics. The caloric fold is also notably a property of black hole thermodynamics in anti-de-Sitter spaces. We propose the spherically symmetric \(SO(d)\) and \(O(d)\) invariant sectors of \(d\)-matrix quantum mechanics as tractable matrix systems for capturing key features of dual descriptions of black-hole thermodynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：微正则简并度、配对公式、群积分、半经典分析、矩阵模型近似。；研究对象：具有U(N)规范对称性的玻色型d-矩阵谐振子模型中，SO(d)和O(d)不变扇区的负热容现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在k ≤ N的大N和k区域，微正则热容为负，并在临界值k_crit处转变为正，形成E-T曲线上的“热容折叠”；该行为与反德西特空间中黑洞热力学性质相似。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在k ≤ N的大N和k区域，微正则热容为负，并在临界值k_crit处转变为正，形成E-T曲线上的“热容折叠”；该行为与反德西特空间中黑洞热力学性质相似。；创新点：将d-矩阵量子力学中球对称扇区作为可解矩阵系统，用于捕捉黑洞热力学的关键特征（热容折叠），并给出了该折叠的解析刻画。
papers.method_zh: 通过计数多矩阵变量中的不变词，利用对称群S_k的Clebsch-Gordan重数（Kronecker系数）、Schur-Weyl对偶性以及齐次空间U(d)/SO(d)上的调和分析，推导出固定能量k的微正则简并度Z(N,d,k)的配对公式；在大N和k区域，使用U(N)和SO(d)（或O(d)）上的群积分获得解析公式；通过矩阵模型近似和本征值密度的半经典分析推导k_crit ~ N²/4；在大N,d极限下，利用ribbon图组合学分析简并度。

papers.title: Quantum statistics in an extended collider coupled to a qubit
papers.abstract: Mesoscopic colliders provide an effective platform for probing the mutual statistics of quantum particles. Recent experiments have successfully extracted the mutual statistics of fermions, and more exotic anyons using quantum point contacts (QPCs). Coupling a point-like collider, such as a quantum point contact, to a two-level impurity or qubit can induce statistical transmutation of fermions, causing them to display boson-like bunching tendencies. Here, we extend the analysis to an extended collider. We investigate the scattering of two incoming fermionic and bosonic wave packets in the presence of post-selection on the impurity state, and systematically analyze the possible benchmarks used to characterize bunching and infer the underlying mutual statistics. We show that only a specific benchmark faithfully captures the mutual statistics of the colliding particles, while alternative choices can produce spurious statistical signatures. Hence, the correct benchmark for probing the quantum statistics depends on the intricate details of the mesoscopic collider.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：investigate、analysis、systematically analyze。；研究对象：介观对撞机（extended collider）中两个入射波包的散射过程，以及该过程与一个二能级杂质（qubit）耦合时的量子统计效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 只有特定的基准（benchmark）才能忠实反映碰撞粒子的相互统计（mutual statistics），而其他基准可能产生虚假的统计信号；因此，探测量子统计的正确基准取决于介观对撞机的具体细节。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：只有特定的基准（benchmark）才能忠实反映碰撞粒子的相互统计（mutual statistics），而其他基准可能产生虚假的统计信号；因此，探测量子统计的正确基准取决于介观对撞机的具体细节。；创新点：将之前针对点状对撞机（如量子点接触）的统计嬗变分析扩展到扩展型对撞机（extended collider），并揭示了不同基准在提取相互统计时的可靠性差异。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：研究两个入射费米子或玻色子波包在杂质态后选择（post-selection）条件下的散射，系统分析用于表征聚束（bunching）和推断相互统计的多种基准。

papers.title: Roughness-robust surface altermagnetism in $PT$ antiferromagnets
papers.abstract: Surface altermagnetism extends spin splitting beyond bulk altermagnets through symmetry reduction at surfaces and interfaces. An existing classification applies to the local symmetry of atomically flat surface terraces. The present paper addresses the symmetry of macroscopic spin-momentum correlations that survive averaging over compensated rough surfaces. These correlations are governed by the surface antisymmetry Laue point group. Rough-surface altermagnetism is forbidden at any surface of a magnet whose antisymmetry space group contains antitranslations, and the classification therefore reduces to $PT$-symmetric antiferromagnets. By restoring all symmetries leaving the surface normal invariant, roughness can generate compensated surface altermagnets from uncompensated flat terminations, increase the surface symmetry, or suppress spin splitting. By combining bulk switchability with altermagnetic surface transport properties, roughness-robust surface altermagnetism in $PT$-symmetric antiferromagnets provides a route toward spintronic functionality.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中多次出现“symmetry”“classification”“group theory”等理论分析关键词，未提及实验或计算手段。；研究对象：PT对称反铁磁体中的粗糙表面交变磁（surface altermagnetism）现象，具体关注宏观自旋-动量关联在补偿性粗糙表面上的对称性行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在PT对称反铁磁体中，粗糙表面可以产生补偿性表面交变磁，且该效应具有粗糙度鲁棒性；同时，粗糙表面可能从非补偿的平坦端面生成补偿性表面交变磁，提高表面对称性或抑制自旋劈裂。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在PT对称反铁磁体中，粗糙表面可以产生补偿性表面交变磁，且该效应具有粗糙度鲁棒性；同时，粗糙表面可能从非补偿的平坦端面生成补偿性表面交变磁，提高表面对称性或抑制自旋劈裂。；创新点：首次系统研究了粗糙表面（而非理想原子级平坦表面）上交变磁的对称性分类，揭示了粗糙度鲁棒性表面交变磁仅在PT对称反铁磁体中存在，并指出其与体态可切换性结合可应用于自旋电子学。
papers.method_zh: 基于群论中的表面反对称劳厄点群（surface antisymmetry Laue point group）分类方法，分析宏观自旋-动量关联在粗糙表面上的对称性约束，并利用反平移对称性排除其他磁结构中的粗糙表面交变磁。

papers.title: Flower-like WO3-modified Vulcan carbon GDEs for photoelectro-Fenton process: Efficient ciprofloxacin degradation and mechanistic insights
papers.abstract: Electrochemical H2O2 synthesis was investigated using a 3 percent WO3 C gas diffusion electrode GDE. The catalyst outperformed bare Vulcan carbon, generating H2O2 concentrations of 423, 586, and 916 mg L at 50, 75, and 100 mA cm2, respectively, maintaining around 70 percent current efficiency. This performance and lower energy consumption are attributed to the WO3 carbon synergistic effect. In electro Fenton EF applications, the WO3 C GDE achieved rapid initial ciprofloxacin CIP degradation of around 70 percent in 30 min, though limited later by slow Fe2 regeneration. Incorporating UV light photoelectro Fenton overcame this constraint, yielding complete CIP removal within 90 min, while a boron doped diamond BDD anode enhanced total organic carbon TOC mineralization to 66 percent. The proposed degradation mechanism proceeds via hydroxyl radical attack on the piperazine ring with or without defluorination and quinolone ring oxidation, with theoretical analysis confirming reduced environmental toxicity of the transformation products. Overall, WO3 C GDEs represent a highly efficient strategy for H2O2 generation and wastewater remediation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：electrochemical H2O2 synthesis、gas diffusion electrode、photoelectro-Fenton process、degradation mechanism。；研究对象：WO3修饰的Vulcan碳气体扩散电极（WO3/C GDE），用于光电芬顿（photoelectro-Fenton）过程降解环丙沙星（ciprofloxacin）废水。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: WO3/C GDE在电化学合成H2O2中性能优于纯Vulcan碳，在100 mA cm⁻²下H2O2浓度达916 mg/L，电流效率约70%；引入紫外光后，光电芬顿过程可在90分钟内完全去除环丙沙星，且硼掺杂金刚石（BDD）阳极使总有机碳（TOC）矿化率达66%。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：WO3/C GDE在电化学合成H2O2中性能优于纯Vulcan碳，在100 mA cm⁻²下H2O2浓度达916 mg/L，电流效率约70%；引入紫外光后，光电芬顿过程可在90分钟内完全去除环丙沙星，且硼掺杂金刚石（BDD）阳极使总有机碳（TOC）矿化率达66%。；创新点：首次将WO3修饰的Vulcan碳气体扩散电极应用于光电芬顿过程，揭示了WO3与碳的协同效应提升H2O2生成效率，并通过理论分析确认降解产物环境毒性降低。
papers.method_zh: 电化学H2O2合成实验（不同电流密度50、75、100 mA cm⁻²）、电芬顿（EF）与光电芬顿（PEF）降解实验、UV光照、BDD阳极对比、理论分析（降解路径与产物毒性评估）。

papers.title: Hybrid Hamiltonian-diagrammatic quantum impurity solver
papers.abstract: Quantum impurity models, which describe the coupling between interacting orbitals and a non-interacting bath, play a central role in the physics of strongly correlated electron systems. Solving a quantum impurity model in general requires the use of non-perturbative numerical methods. Hamiltonian-based approaches, which rely on an explicit bath discretization, are typically limited to a small number of bath sites or small entanglement, and diagrammatic methods suffer from sign problems, slow convergence, or diagram truncation approximations. Here we show that these two classes of methods can be combined: augmenting diagrammatic methods with a small auxiliary bath can reduce the residual problem to a regime where low-order perturbation theory is highly accurate and rapidly converging. In a simple benchmark, the precision of the hybrid approach surpasses bold-line calculations by several orders of magnitude; for a strongly interacting two-orbital model with a severe sign problem, convergence is achieved at three orders of magnitude lower computational cost than competing methods; and convergence to the unknown exact result is rapidly accelerated in a difficult realistic problem. Our results establish a practical route to high-precision quantum impurity solutions in correlated quantum systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：hybrid Hamiltonian-diagrammatic quantum impurity solver（混合哈密顿量-图解量子杂质求解器）、non-perturbative numerical methods（非微扰数值方法）、diagrammatic methods（图解方法）。；研究对象：量子杂质模型（quantum impurity models），即描述相互作用轨道与非相互作用库耦合的模型，用于强关联电子系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 将哈密顿量方法（基于显式库离散化）与图解方法（基于微扰展开）相结合，通过引入一个小型辅助库，可将剩余问题简化到低阶微扰论高度精确且快速收敛的区域，从而大幅提升计算精度和效率。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：将哈密顿量方法（基于显式库离散化）与图解方法（基于微扰展开）相结合，通过引入一个小型辅助库，可将剩余问题简化到低阶微扰论高度精确且快速收敛的区域，从而大幅提升计算精度和效率。；创新点：首次展示了哈密顿量方法与图解方法这两类传统上独立的量子杂质求解方法可以互补结合，通过小型辅助库将问题推向微扰论高效区域，而非依赖大库或高阶微扰。
papers.method_zh: 提出一种混合哈密顿量-图解量子杂质求解器（hybrid Hamiltonian-diagrammatic quantum impurity solver）。该方法将哈密顿量方法中的小型辅助库与图解方法结合，使低阶微扰论在剩余问题上达到高精度。

papers.title: How to grow a straight filament
papers.abstract: How can a growing biological filament remain straight despite stochastic fluctuations in growth? Motivated by filamentary structures that develop reproducibly across biological systems, we study the stability of a noisy, growing elastic filament regulated by feedback. We formulate a minimal model in which growth responds to the filament's strain, curvature, and orientation through local or nonlocal spatiotemporal feedback laws. Linear stability analysis identifies the conditions under which these feedback mechanisms stabilize a straight configuration. In the presence of noise, we show that purely local feedback requires orientation sensing to suppress long-wavelength instabilities, whereas nonlocal feedback allows stabilization through proprioceptive (curvature) sensing alone. Coupling to an elastic substrate further suppresses large-scale fluctuations. Our results establish minimal control strategies that ensure robust straight growth and suggest experimental signatures for identifying the feedback mechanisms underlying morphogenesis.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：formulate a minimal model（构建最小模型）、Linear stability analysis（线性稳定性分析）。；研究对象：受生物系统中可重复发育的丝状结构启发，研究一根在随机涨落下生长的弹性细丝的稳定性问题。具体物理现象是：生长中的生物细丝如何在存在随机波动的情况下保持笔直。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 论文确定了确保细丝笔直生长的最小控制策略：纯局域反馈需要同时感知方向来抑制长波不稳定性，而非局域反馈仅通过本体感觉（曲率感知）即可实现稳定；与弹性基底耦合可进一步抑制大尺度涨落。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：论文确定了确保细丝笔直生长的最小控制策略：纯局域反馈需要同时感知方向来抑制长波不稳定性，而非局域反馈仅通过本体感觉（曲率感知）即可实现稳定；与弹性基底耦合可进一步抑制大尺度涨落。；创新点：摘要未突出说明与已有研究的具体区别，但核心创新在于提出了一个最小模型，系统地比较了局域与非局域反馈在噪声环境下稳定细丝生长的不同控制策略，并揭示了方向感知和基底耦合在其中的关键作用。
papers.method_zh: 构建了一个最小理论模型，其中细丝的生长响应其应变、曲率和方向，通过局域或非局域的时空反馈定律来调控。采用了线性稳定性分析方法来识别反馈机制稳定笔直构型的条件，并考虑了噪声的影响。

papers.title: Approaching the Limit of Intrinsic Crystalline Thermal Insulation
papers.abstract: Crystalline materials with ultralow thermal conductivity ($κ$) are potential thermal barrier coatings or thermoelectrics, yet the discovery of ultralow-$κ$ materials remains inefficient due to the limitations of trial-and-error approaches. Herein, we propose a state-of-the-art high-throughput workflow that integrates universal machine learning interatomic potentials with high-fidelity phonon transport theories to accelerate the exploration of thermal insulators. Applying this approach, we identify dozens of crystalline materials with intrinsic room-temperature $κ$ values below 0.2 $\rm W m^{-1} K^{-1}$. Among them, we report and experimentally validate CsTlI$_4$, a record-breaking material with an ultralow $κ$ of 0.14 $\rm W m^{-1} K^{-1}$ at 300 K. Structural and bond analyses reveal that a hierarchical bonding framework, consisting of multi-coordinated Cs-I and antibonding Tl-I interactions, leads to weak chemical bonding and a soft lattice. These features reduce phonon group velocities, enhance phonon scattering, and induce strong vibrational mismatch between sublattices, collectively suppressing both particle-like phonon propagation and wave-like tunneling. Beyond this specific system, we establish physically interpretable descriptors based on interatomic force constants that correlate strongly with ultralow $κ$ and capture the role of bonding hierarchy and coordination environments in governing thermal transport. This work demonstrates a robust data-driven strategy for accelerating the discovery of thermal insulators and provides microscopic insight into how hierarchical bonding and strong anharmonicity cooperate to impede heat-carrying vibrations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（计算+实验）。关键词：high-throughput workflow, machine learning interatomic potentials, phonon transport theories, experimentally validate。；研究对象：超低热导率晶体材料，特别是CsTlI₄，以及具有本征室温热导率低于0.2 W m⁻¹ K⁻¹的数十种晶体材料。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现并实验验证了CsTlI₄在300 K下具有0.14 W m⁻¹ K⁻¹的超低热导率，创下新纪录；揭示了层级键合框架（多配位Cs-I和反键Tl-I相互作用）导致弱化学键和软晶格，从而抑制热传导的微观机制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现并实验验证了CsTlI₄在300 K下具有0.14 W m⁻¹ K⁻¹的超低热导率，创下新纪录；揭示了层级键合框架（多配位Cs-I和反键Tl-I相互作用）导致弱化学键和软晶格，从而抑制热传导的微观机制。；创新点：提出了一个结合机器学习势与声子输运理论的高通量筛选策略，加速了超低热导率材料的发现；建立了与超低热导率强相关的基于原子间力常数的物理描述符，揭示了层级键合和配位环境对热输运的控制作用。
papers.method_zh: 高通量计算工作流（整合通用机器学习原子间势与高保真声子输运理论）+ 实验验证（具体实验手段摘要未明确说明）+ 结构/键合分析 + 基于原子间力常数的物理可解释描述符。

papers.title: Interplay between photon condensation and electron-electron interactions in molecular systems
papers.abstract: We investigate a minimal molecular model consisting of square planar plaquettes hosting multiple electrons, whose dynamics is governed by a tight-binding Hamiltonian supplemented by on-site Hubbard repulsion. By coupling this system to a spatially nonuniform cavity mode, we analyze the emergence of a magnetostatic instability, namely photon condensation, originating from the paramagnetic Van Vleck mechanism. The global behavior of the system is analyzed for different electronic filling factors, and we find that, except for the special cases of half-filling and single electron, where the transition, if it occurs, is necessarily a second order phase transition, the global system may also undergo a first order transition because of the action of the electron-electron interaction. The polaritonic excitation energies are analyzed, providing clear spectroscopic signatures of the magnetostatic instability and of its order.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：investigate、analyze、theoretical framework（紧束缚模型、Hubbard排斥项、腔耦合模型）。；研究对象：分子系统中的光子凝聚现象与电子-电子相互作用的竞争关系，具体为方形平面晶格（square planar plaquettes）上多电子体系与空间非均匀腔模的耦合。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 除半填充和单电子填充的特殊情况外，电子-电子相互作用可导致系统发生一级相变（而非二级相变）；通过分析极化激元激发能谱，可提供磁静态不稳定性（光子凝聚）及其相变阶数的光谱特征。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：除半填充和单电子填充的特殊情况外，电子-电子相互作用可导致系统发生一级相变（而非二级相变）；通过分析极化激元激发能谱，可提供磁静态不稳定性（光子凝聚）及其相变阶数的光谱特征。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于紧束缚哈密顿量并加入在位Hubbard排斥项描述电子动力学，将系统与空间非均匀腔模耦合，通过顺磁Van Vleck机制分析光子凝聚的磁静态不稳定性，并针对不同电子填充因子分析系统全局行为。

papers.title: In-situ total scattering investigation of crystalline ordering in amorphous ion-beam sputtered thin films for interferometric gravitational wave detectors
papers.abstract: Amorphous tantala is an important optical material used in a number of high-precision optical applications, including gravitational wave interferometry. In this paper, we study in-situ the structural changes that occur in amorphous ion-beam sputtered coatings during an annealing treatment by means of a synchrotron radiation scattering experiment. The scattering signal is measured as a function of time on a large range of the Q-space. X-Ray diffraction and Rietveld analysis are used to study crystallization during the annealing treatment, whereas pair distribution function analysis allows to inspect the structural changes occurring during the amorphous to crystalline transition. Our findings indicate that several structural rearrangements occur in parallel, namely a first quick establishment of a backbone structure in the cationic substructure appearing on a rather extended range (up to 100 Angstrom), followed by a progressive rearrangement of the oxygen atoms environment which gradually increases the crystallinity of the structure.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：in-situ synchrotron radiation scattering experiment（原位同步辐射散射实验）、X-Ray diffraction（X射线衍射）、Rietveld analysis（Rietveld分析）、pair distribution function analysis（对分布函数分析）。；研究对象：非晶态氧化钽（amorphous tantala）薄膜，具体为离子束溅射沉积的非晶薄膜在退火处理过程中的结构变化，应用于干涉引力波探测器。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 退火过程中，非晶态氧化钽薄膜的结构重排是并行的：首先在阳离子亚结构中快速建立长达约100埃的骨架结构，随后氧原子环境逐步重排，逐渐提高结构的结晶度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：退火过程中，非晶态氧化钽薄膜的结构重排是并行的：首先在阳离子亚结构中快速建立长达约100埃的骨架结构，随后氧原子环境逐步重排，逐渐提高结构的结晶度。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 原位同步辐射散射实验，在较大Q空间范围内随时间测量散射信号；使用X射线衍射和Rietveld分析研究退火过程中的结晶行为；使用对分布函数（PDF）分析研究非晶到晶态转变过程中的结构变化。

papers.title: On pseudogap phase as precursor to a superconducting dome in high-Tc cuprates: Non-analytic T* as a function of doping
papers.abstract: We generalize the condition under which a quantum material exhibiting a pseudogap phase is a precursor to a superconducting (SC) dome. The result reveals the non-analytic T* as a function of doping. A well-known example is the high-Tc cuprates. Essentially, the SC dome is generated under two conditions: (1) that the pseudogap T* is a decreasing function of doping, due to the decrease in size of extended pairing of doped holes with doping, and most importantly, (2) that the rate of configurational-ordering parameter is an increasing function of doping as a result of the decrease in extended length of the disordered pairs. These two conditions are provided by the new entanglement and confinement pairing mechanism of high-Tc cuprates. This is a theory that has recently been discussed in the literature by Buot et al. It hinges on a novel strong entanglement and confinement hole pairing (ECHP) mechanism that unravels the microscopic features of the entire phase diagram of both electron and hole-doped high-Tc cuprates.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“generalize the condition”“new entanglement and confinement pairing mechanism”“theory”。；研究对象：高温铜氧化物超导体（high-Tc cuprates）中的赝能隙相（pseudogap phase）及其与超导穹顶（superconducting dome）的关系，具体关注赝能隙温度T*随掺杂的非解析行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 赝能隙相作为超导穹顶的前驱体需要满足两个条件：1）T*随掺杂增加而下降；2）构型有序参数速率随掺杂增加而上升。这两个条件由纠缠与束缚空穴配对（ECHP）机制提供，并导致T*作为掺杂函数的非解析性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：赝能隙相作为超导穹顶的前驱体需要满足两个条件：1）T*随掺杂增加而下降；2）构型有序参数速率随掺杂增加而上升。这两个条件由纠缠与束缚空穴配对（ECHP）机制提供，并导致T*作为掺杂函数的非解析性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明与已有理论的具体差异，但指出该工作将赝能隙相作为超导前驱体的条件推广到更一般情形，并揭示了T*随掺杂的非解析行为。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导，基于Buot等人近期提出的强纠缠与束缚空穴配对（ECHP）机制，通过分析扩展配对尺寸与无序对扩展长度随掺杂的变化，推导出超导穹顶产生的条件。

papers.title: Extensible links in a broad class of single polymer chain models
papers.abstract: The physics of polymer chains is often probed using molecular stretching experiments and various idealized single-chain models. The majority of these models consist of a discrete sequence of links, which may be treated as rigid or extensible. Although such models are well established and many specific extensible variants have been proposed, no generally applicable theory has been presented. Moreover, most existing treatments are heuristic rather than systematically and rigorously derived. This critical gap is closed here through the development of a generally applicable asymptotic theory for including link extensibility in a broad class of discrete models for single-chain thermodynamics. The theory is verified analytically using the freely jointed chain and validated numerically using the freely rotating chain. The resulting approximation is first-order accurate in inverse link stiffness, with quadratically decreasing error, and recovers extensible behavior across all link stiffnesses from a single rigid-link reference calculation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“asymptotic theory”（渐近理论）、“systematically and rigorously derived”（系统严格推导）、“verified analytically”（解析验证）、“validated numerically”（数值验证）。；研究对象：单链高分子模型中的可扩展链接（extensible links），具体针对一类广泛的离散单链热力学模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发展了一种普遍适用的渐近理论，能够将链接可扩展性纳入离散单链模型，该近似在逆链接刚度上具有一阶精度，误差呈二次方递减，且仅需一次刚性链接参考计算即可恢复所有链接刚度下的可扩展行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发展了一种普遍适用的渐近理论，能够将链接可扩展性纳入离散单链模型，该近似在逆链接刚度上具有一阶精度，误差呈二次方递减，且仅需一次刚性链接参考计算即可恢复所有链接刚度下的可扩展行为。；创新点：首次为广泛类别的离散单链模型提供了系统、严格推导的普遍适用理论，填补了此前缺乏一般性理论且多数处理为启发式方法的空白。
papers.method_zh: 采用渐近分析理论框架，通过解析验证（自由连接链模型）和数值验证（自由旋转链模型）确认理论正确性。

papers.title: Synthetic pre-training of graph-network models for predicting solid-state NMR parameters
papers.abstract: Nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) is a powerful probe of atomic structure, but accurate quantum-mechanical predictions of tensorial NMR parameters are computationally demanding. This creates a bottleneck both for direct quantum-mechanical studies and for collecting high-quality training data for machine-learning (ML) models. Here, we introduce a synthetic pre-training and fine-tuning protocol for graph-based ML models of solid-state NMR parameters. We first pre-train models on synthetic tensorial data, as obtained using an existing ML model, and subsequently fine-tune those models on new ground-truth data. We observe a pronounced improvement in data efficiency when pre-training and fine-tuning span the same compositional and configurational space, and we carry out initial experiments regarding chemical transferability. Our work outlines a route toward future data-efficient training workflows for tensorial ML models for solid-state NMR, combining inexpensive synthetic supervision with targeted first-principles refinement.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：machine-learning models, synthetic pre-training, first-principles refinement）；研究对象：固态核磁共振（NMR）参数（张量性质）的机器学习预测模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过合成预训练（synthetic pre-training）与微调（fine-tuning）协议，可显著提升图神经网络模型在固态NMR参数预测中的数据效率；当预训练与微调覆盖相同的组成和构型空间时，数据效率提升尤为明显。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过合成预训练（synthetic pre-training）与微调（fine-tuning）协议，可显著提升图神经网络模型在固态NMR参数预测中的数据效率；当预训练与微调覆盖相同的组成和构型空间时，数据效率提升尤为明显。；创新点：提出了一种结合低成本合成监督数据与针对性第一性原理精修的预训练-微调工作流，用于固态NMR张量ML模型的高效训练，并初步探索了化学迁移性（chemical transferability）。
papers.method_zh: 采用基于图的机器学习模型（graph-based ML models），先利用已有ML模型生成的合成张量数据进行预训练，再在新获取的真实数据（ground-truth data）上进行微调。预训练数据来源为现有ML模型，微调数据来源为第一性原理计算。

papers.title: Influence of CeO$_2$MnO$_x$ heterostructure on Hydrogen Peroxide Electrogeneration on Carbon-Based Catalysts
papers.abstract: The sustainable electrogeneration of hydrogen peroxide (H2O2) via the two-electron oxygen reduction reaction (2e$^-$ ORR) represents a promising alternative to conventional production methods. In this study, CeO2 and CeO2MnOx nanoparticles were synthesized and supported on Vulcan XC-72 carbon at varying loadings (1, 3, and 5%), aiming to assess the lowest metal loading and high H2O2 electrosynthesis. Physicochemical characterizations confirmed the successful formation of CeO2 nanowires and the effectiveness of the MnOx surface modification. XRD, TEM, XPS, EPR, and contact angle analyses revealed that CeO2 loading increased surface hydrophilicity through the presence of oxygenated functional groups, thereby favoring electrochemical activity. On the other hand, all CeO2MnOx loadings were statistically equivalent to Vulcan XC-72 in terms of contact angle. Electrochemical evaluations using a rotating ring-disk electrode (RRDE) demonstrated enhanced ORR activity and high H2O2 selectivity for the 1% CeO2MnOx/C and 3% CeO2/C catalysts, achieving up to 90% selectivity and elevated ring currents. The results suggest that low metal loading and surface modification via MnOx improve the balance between active site exposure, oxygen adsorption, and intermediate stabilization, thus favoring the selective 2e$^-$ pathway. These findings support the development of cost-effective, non-noble-metal catalysts for green H2O2 production via electrosynthesis.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：synthesized、Physicochemical characterizations、Electrochemical evaluations、RRDE。；研究对象：CeO₂/C 和 CeO₂MnOₓ/C 异质结构催化剂，用于电化学生成过氧化氢（H₂O₂）的两电子氧还原反应（2e⁻ ORR）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 低负载量（1% CeO₂MnOₓ/C 和 3% CeO₂/C）的催化剂可实现高达90%的H₂O₂选择性，表明通过MnOₓ表面修饰和低金属负载能有效平衡活性位点暴露与中间体稳定，促进2e⁻ ORR路径。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：低负载量（1% CeO₂MnOₓ/C 和 3% CeO₂/C）的催化剂可实现高达90%的H₂O₂选择性，表明通过MnOₓ表面修饰和低金属负载能有效平衡活性位点暴露与中间体稳定，促进2e⁻ ORR路径。；创新点：系统评估了极低金属负载量（1%、3%、5%）下CeO₂及CeO₂MnOₓ对碳基催化剂H₂O₂电合成性能的影响，发现低负载量即可实现高选择性，为开发低成本非贵金属催化剂提供了新思路。
papers.method_zh: 纳米颗粒合成与负载（CeO₂纳米线、MnOₓ修饰）、XRD、TEM、XPS、EPR、接触角分析、旋转环盘电极（RRDE）电化学测试。

papers.title: Direction-Dependent Quantum Transport Properties of MoS$_2$ Integrated into Biphenylene Configuration
papers.abstract: Motivated by the experimental realization of the two-dimensional (2D) carbon biphenylene network (BPN), the theoretical extension of the BPN topology to various groups of elements was successfully implemented. In this work, we conducted first principles and quantum transport calculations to reveal the electronic, thermal, thermoelectric performance and current-voltage (\textit{I-V}) behavior of the pristine MoS$_2$-BPN by using density functional theory (DFT) combined with Non-Equilibrium Green's Function (NEGF) formalism. At room temperature, the phonon thermal conductance is remarkably low along both the armchair and zigzag orientations, with values of 0.28 nW/K and 0.23 nW/K, respectively. The directional dependence of the electronic and thermal transport properties is clearly reflected in the thermoelectric figure of merit ($zT$) values, which reach first peaks at 0.27 and 0.19 along the armchair and zigzag directions, respectively. The current-voltage ($I-V$) characteristics demonstrate an exceptionally strong transport anisotropy, characterized by a substantial current ratio of $I_{\text{armchair}}/I_{\text{zigzag}} \approx 7 \times 10^4$. Furthermore, while the current along the armchair direction increases steadily with the applied bias, transport along the zigzag direction is characterized by a pronounced intrinsic negative differential conductance (NDC). This contrast highlights fundamentally distinct charge transport mechanisms along the two orthogonal axes. Consequently, different directions of this BPN phase of MoS$_2$ can be tailored for distinct nanoelectronic applications, where the armchair and zigzag axes serve as a reliable current switch and an active NDC device, respectively.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“first principles and quantum transport calculations”、“density functional theory (DFT) combined with Non-Equilibrium Green's Function (NEGF) formalism”。；研究对象：将MoS₂集成到联苯烯网络（BPN）拓扑结构中的二维材料体系，具体研究其电子、热、热电输运性质以及电流-电压特性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: MoS₂-BPN沿扶手椅和锯齿方向表现出极强的输运各向异性：扶手椅方向电流与锯齿方向电流之比高达约7×10⁴，且锯齿方向呈现显著的本征负微分电导（NDC）效应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：MoS₂-BPN沿扶手椅和锯齿方向表现出极强的输运各向异性：扶手椅方向电流与锯齿方向电流之比高达约7×10⁴，且锯齿方向呈现显著的本征负微分电导（NDC）效应。；创新点：将BPN拓扑结构拓展至过渡金属硫族化物（MoS₂），并系统揭示了该体系中沿不同晶向截然不同的电荷输运机制（高开关比与负微分电导），为定向设计纳米电子器件提供了依据。
papers.method_zh: 基于密度泛函理论（DFT）结合非平衡格林函数（NEGF）形式的第一性原理计算。

papers.title: Optical fingerprints across the strain-driven semi-Dirac transition in Kekulé-O graphene
papers.abstract: We show that the strain-driven semi-Dirac transition in Kekulé-O graphene gives rise to a sequence of anisotropic optical fingerprints associated with band structure reconstruction. Across the transition, optical spectral weight is continuously redistributed among the dominant interband transitions, leading to a pronounced enhancement of the optical anisotropy. Combining numerical four-band calculations with analytical low-energy results, we identify three low-energy fingerprints that emerge with increasing strain: gapped absorption peaks, semi-Dirac critical scaling, and a pronounced van Hove optical resonance. At the semi-Dirac critical point, where the Kekulé gap closes at the $Γ$ point, the low-energy optical conductivity is characterized by $σ_{xx}(Ω)\proptoΩ^{1/2}$ and $σ_{yy}(Ω)\proptoΩ^{-1/2}$. Beyond the transition, the semi-Dirac point splits into two anisotropic Dirac cones, accompanied by the emergence of saddle points near the $Γ$ point. The resulting saddle-point excitations produce a pronounced van Hove optical resonance at energies well below those of graphene, while the split Dirac cones give rise to an anisotropic constant optical conductivity. We further show that the low-energy optical fingerprints can be traced to the continuous evolution of a dominant optical transition channel driven by strain-induced band reconstruction. Moreover, the fingerprints remain identifiable in the presence of moderate disorder broadening and finite-temperature effects, indicating their potential observability under experimentally realistic conditions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“combining numerical four-band calculations with analytical low-energy results”，即结合数值四带计算与解析低能结果，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：Kekulé-O 石墨烯中应变驱动的半狄拉克相变及其光学指纹。具体体系为具有Kekulé-O 序的石墨烯，物理现象为应变诱导的能带结构重构及半狄拉克相变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在应变驱动的半狄拉克相变过程中，光学谱权重在主导带间跃迁间连续重新分布，导致光学各向异性显著增强；在临界点处，低能光导率呈现各向异性幂律标度行为（σ_xx ∝ Ω^{1/2}，σ_yy ∝ Ω^{-1/2}），相变后出现低于石墨烯能量的范霍夫光学共振。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在应变驱动的半狄拉克相变过程中，光学谱权重在主导带间跃迁间连续重新分布，导致光学各向异性显著增强；在临界点处，低能光导率呈现各向异性幂律标度行为（σ_xx ∝ Ω^{1/2}，σ_yy ∝ Ω^{-1/2}），相变后出现低于石墨烯能量的范霍夫光学共振。；创新点：系统揭示了Kekulé-O石墨烯中应变驱动半狄拉克相变的全序列各向异性光学指纹（包括带隙吸收峰、半狄拉克临界标度、范霍夫光学共振），并证明这些指纹在实验现实条件下（有限无序和温度）仍可辨识。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 数值四带计算（numerical four-band calculations）与解析低能模型（analytical low-energy results）相结合，分析应变下能带重构对光学响应的影响；同时考虑了无序展宽（moderate disorder broadening）和有限温度效应（finite-temperature effects）对指纹可观测性的影响。

papers.title: Ab initio study of magnetism in pristine and defective MnBi2Te4
papers.abstract: The magnetic material MnBi2Te4 (MBT) has garnered significant attention due to its unique combination of long-range antiferromagnetism and nontrivial topological electronic properties. However, experimental measurements report inconsistent magnetizations, which could be attributed to a variety of intrinsic defects. To date, a comprehensive investigation of defect-engineered MBT systems has not yet been established. Employing state-of-the-art $ab~initio$ techniques, this work systematically investigates the influence of various experimentally reported defects on the magnetic properties of bulk and monolayer MBT at different concentrations. Mn-vacancy and Mn-rich defects are found to enhance the ferromagnetism of bulk MBT. The investigation of Mn-rich and intermixing defects in the monolayer reveals that subtle structural and electronic modifications can alter the magnetic coupling. Projection onto a Heisenberg Hamiltonian demonstrates that defects modify exchange interactions, thereby giving rise to distinct magnetic ground states. This work sheds light on magnetic coupling mechanisms and provides guidelines for the experimental control of magnetism in MnBi2Te4.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“ab initio techniques”（第一性原理计算）、“projection onto a Heisenberg Hamiltonian”（投影到海森伯哈密顿量）。；研究对象：磁性材料MnBi₂Te₄（MBT）的本征及缺陷态磁性，具体包括体相和单层MBT中各类实验报道缺陷对磁性的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Mn空位和富Mn缺陷会增强体相MBT的铁磁性；单层MBT中的富Mn和互混缺陷可通过微调结构和电子性质改变磁耦合，缺陷通过修改交换相互作用导致不同的磁基态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Mn空位和富Mn缺陷会增强体相MBT的铁磁性；单层MBT中的富Mn和互混缺陷可通过微调结构和电子性质改变磁耦合，缺陷通过修改交换相互作用导致不同的磁基态。；创新点：首次对缺陷工程化的MnBi₂Te₄体系进行系统全面的第一性原理研究，揭示了不同缺陷类型及浓度对磁耦合和磁基态的具体调控机制。
papers.method_zh: 采用第一性原理（ab initio）计算技术，系统研究不同浓度下多种缺陷对体相和单层MBT磁性的影响，并将结果投影到海森伯哈密顿量以分析交换相互作用。

papers.title: Geometry still matters in quasi-one-dimensional single-file transport
papers.abstract: Single-file transport means no overtaking: particles move in a narrow channel while preserving their longitudinal order. This simple constraint has profound dynamical consequences, most notably tracer subdiffusion, and has made single-file transport a paradigmatic form of confined many-body motion, observed from molecular transport in zeolites to single-file diffusion of colloids in narrow channels. The standard view is that, once overtaking is suppressed, collective transport reduces to that of a strictly one-dimensional file. Here we show that this reduction fails in experimentally relevant finite-width channels: even when exchange is forbidden, the transverse equilibrium structure controls the transport laws and can qualitatively reshape them. Starting from the Brownian dynamics in the full confined geometry, we derive an exact large-scale one-dimensional fluctuating hydrodynamics for the longitudinal density, whose coefficients are fixed by the confined equilibrium equation of state. In the minimal hard-core setting, this yields a collective diffusivity that can become non-monotonic in density. This geometric anomaly propagates to exact large-scale predictions for integrated-current fluctuations, tracer displacement fluctuations and the associated density profiles. The effect is robust to the interaction potential, channel geometry, initial preparation and microscopic dynamics. Quasi-one-dimensional single-file transport therefore defines a distinct regime in which forbidding overtaking does not erase geometry from collective transport.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“derive an exact large-scale one-dimensional fluctuating hydrodynamics”（推导精确的大尺度一维涨落流体动力学），属于理论推导。；研究对象：准一维单列输运（quasi-one-dimensional single-file transport）现象，即粒子在有限宽度的窄通道中运动且禁止超越（保持纵向顺序）的受限多体输运体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 即使在禁止超越的条件下，准一维有限宽度通道中的集体输运并不能简化为严格一维情况，而是由横向平衡结构（transverse equilibrium structure）决定输运规律，并可能产生非单调的集体扩散系数等定性新行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：即使在禁止超越的条件下，准一维有限宽度通道中的集体输运并不能简化为严格一维情况，而是由横向平衡结构（transverse equilibrium structure）决定输运规律，并可能产生非单调的集体扩散系数等定性新行为。；创新点：推翻了“一旦禁止超越，集体输运就等同于严格一维文件”的标准观点，揭示了准一维单列输运中几何结构（横向自由度）对集体输运的不可忽略的定性影响。
papers.method_zh: 从完整受限几何中的布朗动力学出发，推导出纵向密度的大尺度一维涨落流体动力学方程，其系数由受限平衡态状态方程确定。在最小硬核模型下进行解析计算，并验证了结果对相互作用势、通道几何、初始制备和微观动力学的鲁棒性。

papers.title: Field-Induced Up-Up-Down State and Frustrated Magnetism in a Non-Kramers Triangular Antiferromagnet
papers.abstract: A previously unreported triangular lattice (TL) antiferromagnet, TmZnGaO4, was synthesized as single crystals, and its crystal structure, magnetic susceptibilities, and specific heat were reported. Its crystal structure is isomorphic to that of the transverse-field Ising antiferromagnet TmMgGaO4, with Tm3+ ions located in the TLs, separated by a nonmagnetic bilayer composed mainly of Ga3+ and Zn2+ ions. The magnetic susceptibilities indicate the dominating antiferromagnetic interactions. The magnetization curves (M-H) exhibit strong easy-c-axis anisotropy, with a clear one-third magnetic plateau emerging, consistent with a field-induced up-up-down spin configuration. Instead of forming a conventional long-range magnetic order, the system exhibits two broad anomalies at 0.11 K and 2.81 K in zero-field specific heat measurements, highlighting the persistence of strong spin fluctuations and the potential for exotic quantum spin states. The above results reveal its future interest in exploring exotic quantum spin states in TmZnGaO4.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到合成了单晶样品，并报告了晶体结构、磁化率、比热等实验测量结果。；研究对象：一种此前未被报道的三角晶格反铁磁体 TmZnGaO4，其中 Tm³⁺ 离子位于三角晶格上，具有非克拉默斯（non-Kramers）离子特性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: TmZnGaO4 表现出强易 c 轴各向异性，在磁场诱导下出现清晰的 1/3 磁化平台，对应 up-up-down 自旋构型；零场比热测量显示两个宽峰（0.11 K 和 2.81 K），表明存在强自旋涨落和潜在的新奇量子自旋态，而非传统长程磁有序。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：TmZnGaO4 表现出强易 c 轴各向异性，在磁场诱导下出现清晰的 1/3 磁化平台，对应 up-up-down 自旋构型；零场比热测量显示两个宽峰（0.11 K 和 2.81 K），表明存在强自旋涨落和潜在的新奇量子自旋态，而非传统长程磁有序。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 单晶合成、晶体结构解析、磁化率测量、磁化曲线（M-H）测量、比热测量。

papers.title: Thermal Signatures of the Slater-Mott Crossover in the Hubbard Model: From Double Occupancy to Antiferromagnetic Correlation Length
papers.abstract: The interaction-driven crossover from a Slater insulator to a Mott insulator in the Néel-ordered ground state of the Hubbard model is a fundamental paradigm of strongly correlated electrons, yet its quantitative characterization has remained elusive. Here we establish a clear and experimentally accessible thermal criterion for this crossover via the sign change of the temperature derivative of double occupancy, $(\partial D/\partial T)_U$, near zero temperature. In the Slater regime, $(\partial D/\partial T)_U>0$ reflects the major role of charge fluctuations; in the Mott regime, the anomalous $(\partial D/\partial T)_U<0$, a manifestation of the Pomeranchuk effect, signals the dominance of low-energy spin superexchange physics. Using exact diagonalization and {\it numerically exact} quantum Monte Carlo simulations, we demonstrate that this criterion determines the crossover boundary at $U_{\rm cross}/t=4.0(2)$ for the half-filled two-dimensional Hubbard model. Furthermore, we obtain a consistent boundary independently from the maximum in the antiferromagnetic correlation length, which also arises from the superexchange physics. These two thermal signatures are theoretically unified through the local minimum of thermal entropy versus interaction $U$ at low temperatures. Our results offer a direct, measurable, and physically intuitive framework to identify the Slater-Mott crossover in optical lattice experiments.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。依据：使用了 exact diagonalization（精确对角化）和 numerically exact quantum Monte Carlo simulations（数值精确量子蒙特卡洛模拟）进行数值计算，并基于理论分析提出热力学判据。；研究对象：Hubbard模型中的 Slater-Mott 交叉（Slater绝缘体到Mott绝缘体的相互作用驱动交叉），具体针对半填充二维Hubbard模型，并关注其热力学特征（双占据温度导数、反铁磁关联长度、热熵）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 建立了通过双占据的温度导数在零温附近的符号变化来判定Slater-Mott交叉的清晰热力学判据：Slater区导数>0，Mott区导数<0（Pomeranchuk效应）。对于半填充二维Hubbard模型，交叉点位于U_cross/t=4.0(2)，该边界与反铁磁关联长度最大值给出的边界一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：建立了通过双占据的温度导数在零温附近的符号变化来判定Slater-Mott交叉的清晰热力学判据：Slater区导数>0，Mott区导数<0（Pomeranchuk效应）。对于半填充二维Hubbard模型，交叉点位于U_cross/t=4.0(2)，该边界与反铁磁关联长度最大值给出的边界一致。；创新点：提出了一个可直接测量、物理直观的热力学判据（双占据温度导数的符号变化）来定量刻画Slater-Mott交叉，并将该判据与反铁磁关联长度的最大值以及低温热熵的局部极小值统一起来，为光学晶格实验提供了可操作的识别框架。
papers.method_zh: 精确对角化（exact diagonalization）和数值精确量子蒙特卡洛模拟（numerically exact quantum Monte Carlo simulations）。

papers.title: Local density of states distribution and multifractal eigenvectors of weighted random networks via the cavity approach
papers.abstract: We study the local density of states (LDoS) distribution of a general class of weighted Erdős-Rényi graphs. Using the cavity method, we obtain a good approximation to the full LDoS distribution and compact expressions for its power-law tails, which we show to have exponent $3$ in the extended phase. We deduce that the eigenvectors in the continuous part of the spectrum are extended but (weakly) multifractal, and we extract expressions for the associated fractal dimensions and the singularity spectrum. We also demonstrate that the inverse participation ratio in this multifractal phase exhibits an unusual logarithmic scaling with system size, which is neither fully-extended nor localised by the usual definitions. Finally, we verify that some symmetry properties (derived from the non-linear sigma model), which have been shown to hold for many systems exhibiting multifractality, also hold in our case, both for the LDoS distribution and the singularity spectrum.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：cavity method（空腔方法）、non-linear sigma model（非线性sigma模型）、理论推导。；研究对象：加权随机网络（weighted Erdős-Rényi graphs）中的局域态密度（LDoS）分布、本征矢的多重分形性质以及逆参与率（IPR）的标度行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在扩展相中，局域态密度分布具有幂律尾巴（指数为3），本征矢是扩展但弱多重分形的；逆参与率随系统大小呈现对数标度，既非完全扩展也非局域化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在扩展相中，局域态密度分布具有幂律尾巴（指数为3），本征矢是扩展但弱多重分形的；逆参与率随系统大小呈现对数标度，既非完全扩展也非局域化。；创新点：首次通过空腔方法系统解析了加权随机网络中LDoS分布的完整形式及其幂律尾部指数，并揭示了本征矢在连续谱中的弱多重分形行为以及逆参与率的反常对数标度。摘要未突出说明与具体实验体系的对比。
papers.method_zh: 采用空腔方法（cavity method）近似计算完整的LDoS分布，并推导其幂律尾部的紧凑表达式；同时利用非线性sigma模型推导对称性性质，验证了LDoS分布和奇异谱的对称性。

papers.title: Degeneracy and trajectory control of spin eigenmodes excited by fs-optical pulses in a nearly compensated ferrimagnet
papers.abstract: We investigate optically excited spin dynamics in a uniaxial ferrimagnet near the magnetization compensation point under a magnetic field applied along the magnetic anisotropy axis. Experiment and numerical modeling reveal an unusual regime where the frequencies of two spin eigenmodes approach each other and become highly field sensitive. The modes, corresponding to opposite rotations of the Neel vector, simultaneously reverse their handedness at a critical field where their frequencies become degenerate. At this point, the two-frequency precessional dynamics collapses into a linear oscillations directed along the inverse-Faraday-effect excitation induced by a single pump pulse. We further show that a double-pulse excitation scheme enables control of the spin trajectory. These results uncover an unconventional dynamical regime in ferrimagnets and establish new opportunities for manipulating spin motion in magnonic systems and devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验与数值建模结合）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“Experiment and numerical modeling reveal...”。；研究对象：近补偿点的单轴亚铁磁体，在外加磁场沿磁各向异性轴方向时，由飞秒光脉冲激发的自旋动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在临界磁场下，两个自旋本征模的频率趋于简并，并同时反转其旋性，导致双频率进动动力学坍缩为沿逆法拉第效应激发方向的线性振荡。双脉冲激发方案可实现对自旋轨迹的控制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在临界磁场下，两个自旋本征模的频率趋于简并，并同时反转其旋性，导致双频率进动动力学坍缩为沿逆法拉第效应激发方向的线性振荡。双脉冲激发方案可实现对自旋轨迹的控制。；创新点：揭示了近补偿亚铁磁体中一种非传统的动力学 regime，其中两个自旋本征模在频率简并点同时反转旋性，并展示了通过双脉冲方案操控自旋轨迹的新可能性。
papers.method_zh: 飞秒光脉冲激发实验，结合数值建模（具体计算方法摘要未明确说明，但提及对自旋本征模频率、旋性及进动动力学的分析）。

papers.title: Thermodynamic Approach to Momentum Transport in Dense Fluids
papers.abstract: We present a new framework for extending Chapman-Enskog theory beyond the hard-sphere fluid model. Rather than relying on effective hard sphere diameters, the approach makes use of on an exchange function which can be related to the thermodynamic properties of the system. We show that two existing extensions, including modified Enskog theory (MET), fit into this new framework. Based on our approach, we propose an alternative to MET that takes into account the potential interaction energy associated with the inter-particle interactions in the fluid. The proposed expression is applied to predicting the shear viscosity of several different simulated fluid models across a wide set of densities $0.05 \leq ρ^* \leq 0.8$ and temperatures $1.5 \leq T^* \leq 4.0$ in Lennard-Jones units. The fluid models considered include both the Weeks-Chandler-Anderson (WCA) fluid and the Lennard-Jones (LJ) fluid. At low and intermediate density, here taken to be $ρ^* \leq 0.3$, we report mean relative prediction errors between $2\%$ and $4\%$ for both these. Across all densities considered, the largest mean relative errors reported are $4.4\%$ and $8.1\%$ for the WCA fluid and LJ fluid respectively. We also investigate other interaction models, including a diatomic molecular model, in order to better understand the limitations of our approach.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：new framework、extending Chapman-Enskog theory、thermodynamic approach）；研究对象：稠密流体中的动量输运（具体涉及硬球流体、Weeks-Chandler-Anderson流体、Lennard-Jones流体及双原子分子流体模型）
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种基于热力学交换函数的新框架，可替代传统有效硬球直径方法，用于预测稠密流体的剪切粘度，在低中密度下预测误差仅2%-4%，对WCA流体和LJ流体的最大平均误差分别为4.4%和8.1%。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种基于热力学交换函数的新框架，可替代传统有效硬球直径方法，用于预测稠密流体的剪切粘度，在低中密度下预测误差仅2%-4%，对WCA流体和LJ流体的最大平均误差分别为4.4%和8.1%。；创新点：摘要未突出说明（但可推断：首次将交换函数与热力学性质直接关联，而非依赖有效硬球直径，并提出了MET的替代方案）。
papers.method_zh: 基于交换函数的热力学框架，该函数与系统热力学性质相关；将修正Enskog理论（MET）纳入该框架，并引入考虑粒子间势相互作用能的替代表达式；通过模拟数据验证剪切粘度预测。

papers.title: Magnetism and Topology from Circularly Polarized Phonon Floquet Engineering
papers.abstract: We theoretically show that circularly polarized phonons induce electronic magnetization and drive a topological phase transition via phonon Floquet engineering. Considering the electronic states modulated by circularly polarized phonons on a honeycomb lattice, we show that such lattice dynamics generates an effective next-nearest-neighbor electron hopping, leading to a Haldane-type mass term. Circularly polarized phonon breaks time-reversal symmetry (TRS) and opens a gap at valley points, undergoing phase transition from a trivial insulator to a Chern insulator. Moreover, the orbital and spin magnetizations emerge due to the breaking of TRS. Our results show that circularly polarized phonons serve as an effective magnetic field to engineer magnetism and topology, offering new opportunities for phonon Floquet approaches.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据关键词：theoretically show、Floquet engineering、effective hopping、mass term。；研究对象：圆偏振声子驱动的电子系统，具体为蜂窝晶格（honeycomb lattice）上的电子态，研究其磁性和拓扑相变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 圆偏振声子通过Floquet工程在蜂窝晶格中诱导出有效的次近邻电子跳跃，产生Haldane型质量项，从而打破时间反演对称性，打开谷点能隙，驱动从平庸绝缘体到陈绝缘体的拓扑相变，并产生轨道和自旋磁化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：圆偏振声子通过Floquet工程在蜂窝晶格中诱导出有效的次近邻电子跳跃，产生Haldane型质量项，从而打破时间反演对称性，打开谷点能隙，驱动从平庸绝缘体到陈绝缘体的拓扑相变，并产生轨道和自旋磁化。；创新点：提出圆偏振声子可作为有效磁场来工程化磁性和拓扑，为声子Floquet方法提供了新的物理机制。摘要未突出说明与已有光Floquet工程的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析，基于Floquet工程框架，考虑圆偏振声子对蜂窝晶格上电子态的调制，推导有效哈密顿量中的次近邻跳跃项和Haldane质量项。

papers.title: Efficient analytic continuation approach to Bethe-Salpeter excitation spectra in selected energy windows
papers.abstract: We explore the merits of building the Bethe-Salpeter absorption spectrum in a specific energy range using analytic continuation techniques. Specifically, we calculate iteratively a few $\bar{\bar α}(z_k)$ polarizability tensors for a coarse set of $(z_k)$ frequencies in the complex-plane. These data allow constructing a continued-fraction representation for $\bar{\barα}(z)$ that is used to calculate the absorption spectrum close to the real energy axis in the desired energy range. The number and location of these sampling complex frequencies are discussed. The importance of building a continued-fraction representation of the full polarizability tensor with matrix-valued coefficients is emphasized. We show how to extract the poles of the continued fraction as a tool for analyzing the resulting spectra. We study as examples the valence excitations of a paradigmatic dipeptide, the C$_{60}$ fullerene and its PCBM derivative, together with the description of the surface plasmon resonance of the Ag$_{20}$ silver cluster. Further, the high-energy C$_{60}$ X-ray absorption spectrum is explored.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词为“analytic continuation techniques”、“continued-fraction representation”、“polarizability tensors”，属于理论计算方法开发与应用。；研究对象：论文研究的具体体系包括：二肽（dipeptide）的价激发、C₆₀富勒烯及其PCBM衍生物、Ag₂₀银团簇的表面等离激元共振，以及C₆₀的高能X射线吸收谱。物理现象为Bethe-Salpeter方程描述的激发光谱。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过解析延拓技术，仅需在复平面上计算少量粗网格频率点的极化率张量，即可构建连续分数表示，从而高效获得指定能量窗口内的Bethe-Salpeter吸收光谱。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过解析延拓技术，仅需在复平面上计算少量粗网格频率点的极化率张量，即可构建连续分数表示，从而高效获得指定能量窗口内的Bethe-Salpeter吸收光谱。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但可推断创新点在于：利用复平面上的稀疏采样和矩阵值连续分数表示，实现指定能量窗口内Bethe-Salpeter激发谱的高效计算，避免了全频段直接求解的高计算成本。
papers.method_zh: 采用解析延拓技术，在复平面上迭代计算少量极化率张量 \(\bar{\bar α}(z_k)\)，构建具有矩阵值系数的连续分数表示，并利用该表示计算靠近实轴的能量窗口内的吸收光谱。还展示了如何提取连续分数的极点以分析光谱特征。

papers.title: Continuous and discontinuous transitions in the Ising-Heisenberg model on the extended Lieb lattice in a magnetic field
papers.abstract: The spin-1/2 Ising-Heisenberg model on the extended Lieb lattice in a magnetic field is exactly mapped onto an effective spin-1/2 Ising model on the square lattice. The ground-state phase diagram comprises the quantum antiferromagnetic (QAF), quantum monomer-dimer (MD), classical ferrimagnetic (FRI), and classical ferromagnetic phase. The MD-FRI ground-state phase boundary extends to finite temperatures as a dome-shaped surface of discontinuous thermal transitions bounded by a line of Ising critical points. The QAF phase is enclosed by a surface of continuous thermal transitions evolving from the QAF-MD and QAF-FRI ground-state phase boundaries. Monte Carlo simulations fully confirm the existence and nature of both continuous and discontinuous thermal phase transitions obtained by exact and approximate analytical calculations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有数值计算）。判断依据：exactly mapped（精确映射）、ground-state phase diagram（基态相图）、Monte Carlo simulations（蒙特卡洛模拟）。；研究对象：扩展Lieb晶格上的自旋-1/2 Ising-Heisenberg模型在外磁场中的相变行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该模型在基态存在四种有序相，其中MD-FRI相边界在有限温度下表现为由Ising临界点线包围的圆顶形不连续热相变面，而QAF相被连续热相变面包围。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该模型在基态存在四种有序相，其中MD-FRI相边界在有限温度下表现为由Ising临界点线包围的圆顶形不连续热相变面，而QAF相被连续热相变面包围。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 通过精确映射将模型转化为正方晶格上的有效自旋-1/2 Ising模型，结合精确解析计算与近似解析计算，并使用蒙特卡洛模拟验证相变性质。

papers.title: Fractional shot noise of an SU(N) Kondo system
papers.abstract: We consider transport through a multi-level interacting quantum dot (N-QD) in Kondo regime. Using the Kotliar-Ruckentein slave boson approach (SBMFA) for N-level Anderson model we define effectively noninteracting quasiparticles of the SU(N) Kondo system ($N=2,3,4,5,6$). Kondo resonance transmission coefficients determine linear noise describing quasiparticle partitioning. To discuss nonlinear conductance, susceptibilities and shot noise in the strong coupling regime, we apply Fermi liquid theory with parameters expressed by susceptibilities of pseudofermions determined within SBMFA. Nonlinear shot noise is dominated by two-quasiparticle scattering. However, we demonstrate that for occupation regions distant from the electron-hole symmetry point, the role of three-body correlations must be revealed.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：Kotliar-Ruckenstein slave boson approach (SBMFA)、Fermi liquid theory、理论推导。；研究对象：SU(N) Kondo 体系中的多能级相互作用量子点（N-QD）在强耦合区的非线性输运与散粒噪声。
