papers.abstract_summary_zh: 非线性散粒噪声主要由两准粒子散射主导；但在远离电子-空穴对称点的占据区域，必须考虑三体关联的贡献。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：非线性散粒噪声主要由两准粒子散射主导；但在远离电子-空穴对称点的占据区域，必须考虑三体关联的贡献。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用 Kotliar-Ruckenstein 奴隶玻色子平均场方法（SBMFA）处理 N 能级安德森模型，定义 SU(N) Kondo 体系的有效无相互作用准粒子；利用费米液体理论，以 SBMFA 确定的赝费米子磁化率参数化强耦合区的非线性电导、磁化率和散粒噪声。

papers.title: Majorana fermions at self-generated interfaces
papers.abstract: The Kitaev model describing a one-dimensional topological superconducting chain is known to support two Majorana fermions localized at the systems endpoints when the parameters are tuned to the topological phase. In this work, we investigate the possibility that Majorana fermions may also emerge away from the physical boundaries of the chain. To this purpose, we generalize the Kitaev model by incorporating a local coupling between the electronic density and a classical elastic (lattice) field. This electron-lattice interaction can induce phase separation between superconducting regions characterized by distinct topological invariants, thereby generating internal interfaces that host Majorana bound states. Under these conditions, a dilute gas of Majorana fermions can be realized in the bulk of the system.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：investigate、generalize the Kitaev model、incorporating、induce。；研究对象：一维Kitaev拓扑超导链中，由电子-晶格耦合诱导的自生成界面所束缚的马约拉纳费米子。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过引入电子密度与经典弹性（晶格）场的局域耦合，可在Kitaev链内部产生具有不同拓扑不变量的超导区域之间的相分离，从而在系统内部（非物理边界）形成自生成界面，这些界面可束缚马约拉纳费米子，实现体相中的稀薄马约拉纳费米子气体。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过引入电子密度与经典弹性（晶格）场的局域耦合，可在Kitaev链内部产生具有不同拓扑不变量的超导区域之间的相分离，从而在系统内部（非物理边界）形成自生成界面，这些界面可束缚马约拉纳费米子，实现体相中的稀薄马约拉纳费米子气体。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：对标准Kitaev模型进行推广，加入电子-晶格相互作用，研究该耦合如何导致拓扑相分离并产生内部界面。

papers.title: Interplay between Aharonov-Bohm and Altshuler-Aronov-Spivak oscillations in phase-pure GaAs/InAs core/shell nanowires of different lengths
papers.abstract: In GaAs/InAs core/shell nanowires, comprising a tubular conducting shell, interference phenomena observed under an axial field and originating from closed-loop states encircling the insulating core, provide an ideal platform for superconducting quantum devices that utilize effects such as Aharonov--Bohm or Altshuler--Aronov--Spivak-type conductance oscillations. Both effects are different in nature with respect to phase rigidity because of interference of non-time-reversed or time-reversed paths, respectively. Since their occurrence is largely governed by averaging effects, which depend on sample dimensions and the transport regime, we present a systematic study of flux-periodic oscillations of phase-pure zinc-blende GaAs/InAs core/shell nanowires as a function of gate voltage for samples with different contact separation lengths. Our analysis shows that with increasing contact separation length, averaging effects result in gradual reduction of $h/e$-periodic Aharonov--Bohm-type oscillations, while the $h/2e$-periodic Altshuler--Aronov--Spivak oscillations and its $h/4e$-periodic higher harmonics are enhanced. The additional phase rigidity seen in the $h/3e$-periodic oscillations is attributed to phase rigidity propagating from the neighbouring lower harmonics. Our tight-binding transport simulations on nanowires of different lengths which contain only a few scattering centers confirm the experimental observations regarding the different harmonics and their phase rigidity. Together, our experimental and simulation findings indicate quasi-ballistic transport with persistent Aharonov--Bohm-, and phase-rigid Altshuler--Aronov--Spivak-type oscillations despite few scattering centers.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验与计算结合）。关键词：systematic study、tight-binding transport simulations、experimental observations。；研究对象：GaAs/InAs核/壳纳米线中的Aharonov-Bohm（AB）与Altshuler-Aronov-Spivak（AAS）振荡，以及两者在不同长度样品中的相互作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 随着接触间距增加，平均效应导致h/e周期的AB型振荡逐渐减弱，而h/2e周期的AAS振荡及其h/4e高次谐波增强；h/3e周期振荡的额外相位刚性来源于邻近低次谐波的相位刚性传播。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：随着接触间距增加，平均效应导致h/e周期的AB型振荡逐渐减弱，而h/2e周期的AAS振荡及其h/4e高次谐波增强；h/3e周期振荡的额外相位刚性来源于邻近低次谐波的相位刚性传播。；创新点：系统揭示了样品长度（接触间距）如何通过平均效应调控AB与AAS振荡的相对强度及高次谐波行为，并首次指出h/3e振荡的相位刚性源于低次谐波的传播。
papers.method_zh: 实验上对相纯闪锌矿GaAs/InAs核/壳纳米线进行不同接触间距样品的栅压依赖磁输运测量；理论上采用紧束缚模型对含少量散射中心的纳米线进行输运模拟。

papers.title: NANOG assembles into self-limiting aging micelles that drive a sol-gel transition and modulate DNA dynamics
papers.abstract: Proteins and nucleic acids form non-Newtonian liquids with complex rheological properties that contribute to their function in vivo. Here we investigate the rheology of the transcription factor NANOG, a key protein to maintain embryonic stem cell pluripotency. We find that at high concentrations, NANOG forms macroscopic aging gels that are dependent on its intrinsically disordered domain. By combining molecular dynamics simulations, mass photometry and Cryo-EM, we also discover that -- in contrast with unbounded condensates formed by other intrinsically disordered proteins -- NANOG forms self-limiting micelles with exposed DNA-binding domains. We show that these micelles can stabilize DNA entanglements and in turn modulate DNA dynamics. Based on our findings, we conjecture that NANOG may contribute to regulate gene expression by creating local gel-like environments that restrict genome dynamics and that its aging may ingrain mechanical memory in gene regulatory networks.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“结合分子动力学模拟、质谱光度法、冷冻电镜”，同时包含实验表征和计算模拟。；研究对象：转录因子NANOG蛋白及其形成的自限制胶束，以及这些胶束对DNA动力学和溶胶-凝胶转变的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: NANOG在高浓度下通过其内在无序结构域形成宏观老化凝胶，并自组装成具有暴露DNA结合域的自限制胶束，这些胶束能稳定DNA缠结并调节DNA动力学。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：NANOG在高浓度下通过其内在无序结构域形成宏观老化凝胶，并自组装成具有暴露DNA结合域的自限制胶束，这些胶束能稳定DNA缠结并调节DNA动力学。；创新点：发现NANOG形成的是自限制胶束而非其他无序蛋白常见的无界凝聚体，且这些胶束能诱导溶胶-凝胶转变并调控DNA动力学，暗示其可能通过创造局部凝胶环境来限制基因组动力学并赋予基因调控网络机械记忆。
papers.method_zh: 分子动力学模拟、质谱光度法、冷冻电镜（Cryo-EM）、流变学测量。

papers.title: Nonequilibrium Green Functions Simulations for Large Correlated Systems
papers.abstract: Correlated real-time dynamics in large, spatially inhomogeneous quantum systems remain difficult to access with nonequilibrium many-body methods. Two-time nonequilibrium Green functions (NEGF) retain dynamical correlations but their computational runtime grows cubically with the number of time steps $N_\mathrm{t}$. This scaling bottleneck could recently be overcome by introducing the G1--G2 scheme that is linear in $N_\mathrm{t}$, but requires propagation of a two-particle correlation function and may suffer from numerical instabilities. This has restricted simulations to small systems with $N_\mathrm{b} \sim 10^2$ basis states. Here we introduce a quantum-fluctuation formulation of nonequilibrium Green functions, denoted $δ$NEGF, that represents dynamical two-particle correlations through fluctuations of field-operator products, $δ\hat G$. This guarantees stable dynamics by preserving the positivity of the reduced density matrices, avoids the explicit storage of the two-particle Green function, and reduces the propagation to a finite ensemble of Hartree-Fock-like trajectories. Combined with a stochastic low-rank decomposition of the correlation functions, the method retains time-linear scaling while extending dynamical $GW$ and particle-particle and particle-hole $T$-matrix simulations to basis sizes of order $N_\mathrm{b}\sim 10^4$. We benchmark $δ$NEGF against exact and HF-GKBA results for lattice systems, finding stable correlated dynamics also at strong coupling. We further demonstrate large-scale simulations of diffusion in two-dimensional Hubbard lattices and ultrafast relaxation in graphene nanoribbon heterostructures with long-range Coulomb interactions. These results establish $δ$NEGF as a scalable route to dynamical self-energy simulations of large, spatially inhomogeneous correlated quantum systems beyond the reach of existing NEGF implementations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：nonequilibrium Green functions (NEGF)、simulations、benchmark、large-scale simulations。；研究对象：大尺度、空间非均匀的强关联量子系统，具体包括二维Hubbard晶格中的扩散过程以及具有长程库仑相互作用的石墨烯纳米带异质结中的超快弛豫。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种名为δNEGF的量子涨落表述，通过保持约化密度矩阵的正定性确保动力学稳定性，并利用随机低秩分解将可模拟的基态规模从约10²提升至约10⁴，实现了对大型关联系统稳定且可扩展的非平衡动力学模拟。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种名为δNEGF的量子涨落表述，通过保持约化密度矩阵的正定性确保动力学稳定性，并利用随机低秩分解将可模拟的基态规模从约10²提升至约10⁴，实现了对大型关联系统稳定且可扩展的非平衡动力学模拟。；创新点：通过引入δNEGF方案，解决了传统NEGF方法在时间步长上的立方标度瓶颈和数值不稳定性问题，同时避免了显式存储双粒子格林函数，首次使得对具有约10⁴个基态的大尺度、空间非均匀关联系统进行稳定的动力学自能模拟成为可能。
papers.method_zh: 基于非平衡格林函数（NEGF）的量子涨落表述（δNEGF），结合随机低秩分解，将双粒子关联函数表示为场算符乘积的涨落，从而将传播简化为有限系综的Hartree-Fock-like轨迹。该方法实现了时间线性标度，并扩展了动力学GW以及粒子-粒子/粒子-空穴T矩阵模拟。

papers.title: Dynamical Partition Functions of Stochastic Dynamics via Variational Flows
papers.abstract: Nonequilibrium thermodynamics is governed by the dynamical partition function, and its computation in high-dimensional continuous-state dynamics is a longstanding challenge. The Feynman-Kac formalism provides a rigorous representation for generating functions of arbitrary path observables; however, practical evaluation beyond low dimensions or the weak-noise limit is hindered by the curse of dimensionality and the exponentially growing replica demands of trajectory-based methods. Here we develop a mesh-free neural variational framework that realizes the Feynman-Kac theorem with generative flow models, recasting tilted stochastic evolution as a time-dependent optimization problem. This approach enables the direct computation of both finite-time and asymptotic trajectory thermodynamics in a unified manner. The method applies to general observables, enabling the evaluation of work, entropy production, and current fluctuations. We demonstrate the accuracy and scalability of this method in various nonequilibrium systems including high-dimensional cases.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：neural variational framework、generative flow models、optimization problem。；研究对象：非平衡随机动力学（stochastic dynamics）中的热力学，特别是高维连续状态系统中的动力学配分函数（dynamical partition function）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种基于神经变分流（neural variational flow）的无网格框架，能够直接、统一地计算有限时间和渐近轨迹热力学量，克服了传统方法在高维系统中的维度灾难和指数增长的副本需求。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种基于神经变分流（neural variational flow）的无网格框架，能够直接、统一地计算有限时间和渐近轨迹热力学量，克服了传统方法在高维系统中的维度灾难和指数增长的副本需求。；创新点：将生成流模型与Feynman-Kac形式结合，首次实现了对高维连续状态非平衡动力学中任意路径可观测量的直接变分计算，无需依赖低维或弱噪声近似。
papers.method_zh: 基于Feynman-Kac定理，利用生成流模型（generative flow models）将倾斜随机演化（tilted stochastic evolution）转化为时间依赖的优化问题，实现无网格（mesh-free）的神经变分计算。

papers.title: Spontaneous translation of charged droplets during evaporation on dry surfaces
papers.abstract: Evaporating sessile droplets are usually treated as capillary objects, but droplets generated by routine handling can carry tens to hundreds of picocoulombs of electric charge. Here we combine Faraday-cup charge measurements with optical imaging to determine how such charge evolves as water droplets evaporate on dry polymer substrates. A zero-time protocol shows that a reproducible initial charge is preserved on poly(methylpentene) (PMP), whereas PDMS, SOCAL-coated surfaces, and polystyrene either exchange, dissipate, or inject charge on contact. On PMP, ensemble-resolved measurements reveal two regimes: the charge remains nearly constant during early evaporation and then decreases abruptly once the droplet reaches a small-volume state. This charge collapse coincides with spontaneous lateral translation rather than jetting or breakup. A Rayleigh-normalized analysis, including a spherical-cap stress correction and measured contact-angle retention scale, shows that motion occurs only after evaporation drives the droplet into a high electro-pinning state. High-speed imaging and kinematic analysis support a picture in which the subsequent motion is governed by repeated contact-line depinning and re-pinning: the total distance traveled is strongly affected by dry-surface pinning, whereas the peak translational velocity serves as a more robust indicator of the discharge strength. These results identify a dry-substrate mode of evaporation-driven electrostatic relaxation, distinct from Coulomb fission on lubricated surfaces, in which substrate electrostatic passivity enables charge retention, droplet geometry selects the instability onset, and whole-droplet translation provides the charge-release pathway.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：Faraday-cup charge measurements、optical imaging、high-speed imaging、kinematic analysis。；研究对象：带电水滴在干燥聚合物基底上蒸发时的自发平移现象，具体涉及聚甲基戊烯（PMP）、聚二甲基硅氧烷（PDMS）、SOCAL涂层表面和聚苯乙烯等基底上的液滴电荷演化与运动行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在干燥聚合物基底（如PMP）上，液滴蒸发过程中电荷先保持恒定，随后在达到小体积状态时突然下降，并伴随自发横向平移（而非喷射或碎裂），这种平移由接触线的反复去钉扎与再钉扎驱动，峰值平移速度可作为放电强度的可靠指标。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在干燥聚合物基底（如PMP）上，液滴蒸发过程中电荷先保持恒定，随后在达到小体积状态时突然下降，并伴随自发横向平移（而非喷射或碎裂），这种平移由接触线的反复去钉扎与再钉扎驱动，峰值平移速度可作为放电强度的可靠指标。；创新点：识别出一种干燥基底上蒸发驱动的静电弛豫新模式，区别于润滑表面上的库仑碎裂：基底静电惰性使电荷得以保留，液滴几何形状决定不稳定性触发条件，而整个液滴的平移提供了电荷释放途径。
papers.method_zh: 法拉第杯电荷测量结合光学成像；零时间协议确定初始电荷；球冠应力修正与接触角保持标度的瑞利归一化分析；高速成像与运动学分析。

papers.title: Spin polarisation signatures of Fractionally Charged Skyrmions in Fractional Quantum Hall states
papers.abstract: We investigate spin polarisation and low-energy excitations in fractional quantum Hall (FQH) states using cavity-polariton spectroscopy of high-mobility GaAs quantum wells. By measuring the optical coupling strength of interband Landau-level excitations over the range $1/3 \le ν\le 1$, we extract the spin polarisation of the electron system as a function of filling factor. Complete suppression of the oscillator strength of the lowest energy excitation, characteristic of singlet trion formation in fully polarised systems, is reported for the first time in this regime. At large magnetic fields, fully polarised FQH states exhibit symmetric depolarisation away from their quantised fillings, analogous to Skyrmionic behaviour near $ν=1$. The depolarisation follows an empirical law $S=ν^*$, where $S$ is the number of spin flips per added magnetic flux quantum and $ν^*$ the effective Composite Fermion filling factor. We interpret this behaviour as evidence for Minimal Fractionally Charged Skyrmions (MFCS) formed from bound spin-flip and quasiparticle excitations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“使用腔-极化子光谱学（cavity-polariton spectroscopy）对高迁移率GaAs量子阱进行测量”，并报告了光学耦合强度、自旋极化等实验数据。；研究对象：分数量子霍尔（FQH）态中的自旋极化与低能激发，具体涉及填充因子ν在1/3到1之间的高迁移率GaAs量子阱二维电子系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 首次在分数量子霍尔态区域观察到最低能量激发振荡器强度的完全抑制（特征为全极化系统中的单重态三子形成）；在强磁场下，全极化FQH态在远离其量子化填充因子时表现出对称的去极化行为，类似于ν=1附近的斯格明子行为，且去极化遵循经验规律S=ν*，被解释为最小分数电荷斯格明子（MFCS）的证据。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：首次在分数量子霍尔态区域观察到最低能量激发振荡器强度的完全抑制（特征为全极化系统中的单重态三子形成）；在强磁场下，全极化FQH态在远离其量子化填充因子时表现出对称的去极化行为，类似于ν=1附近的斯格明子行为，且去极化遵循经验规律S=ν*，被解释为最小分数电荷斯格明子（MFCS）的证据。；创新点：首次在分数量子霍尔态区域（1/3 ≤ ν ≤ 1）报告了最低能量激发振荡器强度的完全抑制，并将去极化行为与最小分数电荷斯格明子（MFCS）的形成联系起来，提出了自旋翻转与准粒子激发束缚态的新解释。
papers.method_zh: 腔-极化子光谱学（cavity-polariton spectroscopy），通过测量带间朗道能级激发的光学耦合强度，提取电子系统的自旋极化随填充因子的变化。

papers.title: Layer-parity-dependent interfacial coupling in Nb$_3$Cl$_8$/graphene van der Waals heterostructures
papers.abstract: Strongly correlated two-dimensional systems provide compelling platforms for investigating exotic quantum phenomena. Niobium chloride (Nb$_3$Cl$_8$), a single-band Mott insulator, exhibits a remarkable out-of-plane polarization in its topmost layer that oscillates with layer parity, manifesting as an odd-even effect. Using atomic force microscopy (AFM) and Kelvin probe force microscopy (KPFM), this layer-parity-dependent polarization can be effectively characterized through surface morphology and potential mapping, enabling the unambiguous identification of different surface phases. We then fabricated dual-gate Hall devices by coupling different surface phases of Nb$_3$Cl$_8$ with monolayer graphene to investigate how the topmost-layer out-of-plane polarization influences interfacial coupling and the resulting transport behavior. Our results reveal significant phase-dependent variations in charge transfer, carrier densities, and hybridization gaps (25.2 meV for Phase 1 and 30.0 meV for Phase 2). Density functional theory calculations corroborate these experimental findings, showing that distinct out-of-plane polarizations in the topmost layer lead to different orbital overlaps and interfacial coupling strengths. These findings highlight the critical importance of surface polarization and orbital orientation in engineering the properties of strongly correlated van der Waals heterostructures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验与计算混合类型。判断依据：摘要中明确使用了原子力显微镜（AFM）、开尔文探针力显微镜（KPFM）等实验手段，并制备了双栅霍尔器件进行输运测量；同时，也进行了密度泛函理论（DFT）计算来佐证实验结果。；研究对象：Nb₃Cl₈/石墨烯范德华异质结。具体研究了Nb₃Cl₈（一种单带莫特绝缘体）顶层中依赖于层数奇偶性的面外极化如何影响其与单层石墨烯的界面耦合及输运行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Nb₃Cl₈顶层依赖于层数奇偶性的面外极化（奇偶效应）会显著影响其与石墨烯的界面耦合强度，导致电荷转移、载流子密度和杂化能隙（Phase 1为25.2 meV，Phase 2为30.0 meV）出现明显的相依赖变化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Nb₃Cl₈顶层依赖于层数奇偶性的面外极化（奇偶效应）会显著影响其与石墨烯的界面耦合强度，导致电荷转移、载流子密度和杂化能隙（Phase 1为25.2 meV，Phase 2为30.0 meV）出现明显的相依赖变化。；创新点：揭示了在强关联范德华异质结中，顶层材料的表面极化方向和轨道取向（具体表现为层数奇偶性依赖的极化）对界面耦合和器件性能具有关键调控作用。摘要未突出说明与以往工作的具体差异，但核心新意在于将“层奇偶效应”这一体相或表面性质，与异质结的界面耦合和输运特性直接关联起来。
papers.method_zh: 1.  **实验方法**：原子力显微镜（AFM）和开尔文探针力显微镜（KPFM）用于表征表面形貌和电势，以区分不同表面相；制备了双栅极霍尔器件，用于测量电荷转移、载流子密度和杂化能隙等输运性质。

papers.title: The Two Dimensional Dynamical Bulk Boundary Correspondence: Beyond Two Band Models
papers.abstract: A dynamical equivalent of the bulk-boundary correspondence has been suggested to occur in one and two dimensional topological models following sudden quenches. Depending on the topological invariant of the time evolving and initial phases involved large boundary contributions to a dynamical free energy occur. Moreover they occur periodically between the critical times at which this dynamical free energy becomes non-analytic, \emph{i.e.}~at dynamical quantum phase transitions. At these critical times the eigenvalue spectrum of the Loschmidt matrix which underlies the dynamical free energy closes its gap. The boundary contributions are understood to be due to zero-modes or in-gap bands of this matrix, forming a close analogy with equilibrium topological models and their edge modes. The exact cause of this phenomena and its generality remain unknown. In this article we test the dynamical bulk-boundary correspondence for a complicated two dimensional topological superconductor with a rich phase diagram, allowing quenches between many different Chern numbers. We show that there is no straightforward correspondence between the equilibrium phases quenched between and the dynamical bulk boundary correspondence. Furthermore the correspondence can depend on the orientation of the edges, suggesting a possible weak topological variant.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：dynamical bulk-boundary correspondence、topological models、sudden quenches、dynamical quantum phase transitions。；研究对象：二维拓扑超导体中的动力学体边对应关系，特别是涉及多能带（非两带模型）的淬火过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在具有丰富相图的二维拓扑超导体中，淬火前后的平衡态拓扑不变量与动力学体边对应之间不存在直接的对应关系；该对应关系可能依赖于边缘取向，暗示存在弱拓扑变体。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在具有丰富相图的二维拓扑超导体中，淬火前后的平衡态拓扑不变量与动力学体边对应之间不存在直接的对应关系；该对应关系可能依赖于边缘取向，暗示存在弱拓扑变体。；创新点：首次在非两带模型的二维拓扑超导体中系统检验动力学体边对应，发现其与平衡态拓扑不变量之间缺乏简单对应，并揭示边缘取向依赖性。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析，基于Loschmidt矩阵的本征谱（零模或能隙内带）与动力学自由能非解析行为（动力学量子相变临界时间）的关联，检验动力学体边对应在复杂二维拓扑超导体中的适用性。

papers.title: Ultra-Soft Ferrimagnetism in a High-Entropy Spinel Oxide Driven by Site-Selective Cation Disorder
papers.abstract: High-entropy materials are complex, multifunctional materials that have reshaped the design of advanced functional materials. Their chemically diverse compositions enable access to a broader compositional space than conventional solid solutions, while simultaneously posing significant challenges for fundamental structure property understanding. In this study, we introduce a new highentropy spinel oxide with an exceptionally low coercivity of 1.8 Oe at room temperature, among the lowest reported for bulk spinel oxides, and a high electrical resistivity (1560 ohm-cm). Neutron powder diffraction (NPD) and magnetic measurements reveal long-range collinear ferrimagnetic ordering (k = 0,0,0) with a transition temperature at 420 K. This rare combination of ultra-soft magnetic behavior, robust ferrimagnetic ordering well above room temperature, and high resistivity highlights its strong potential as an advanced soft-magnetic oxide for low-loss, high-frequency applications. Furthermore, X-ray absorption spectroscopy (XAS), Mossbauer spectroscopy, and NPD analyses were combined to determine the cation distribution and site selectivity across the tetrahedral and octahedral sites of the complex structure.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提及多种实验手段（中子粉末衍射、磁测量、X射线吸收谱、穆斯堡尔谱等）及具体实验数据（矫顽力1.8 Oe、电阻率1560 ohm-cm等）。；研究对象：一种新型高熵尖晶石氧化物，具体研究其亚铁磁有序、超软磁行为及阳离子占位无序对磁性的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该高熵尖晶石氧化物在室温下具有极低的矫顽力（1.8 Oe），同时保持高于室温的长程共线亚铁磁有序（转变温度420 K）和高电阻率（1560 ohm-cm），实现了超软磁性与高电阻率的罕见组合。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该高熵尖晶石氧化物在室温下具有极低的矫顽力（1.8 Oe），同时保持高于室温的长程共线亚铁磁有序（转变温度420 K）和高电阻率（1560 ohm-cm），实现了超软磁性与高电阻率的罕见组合。；创新点：在高熵尖晶石氧化物中实现了极低矫顽力（1.8 Oe）与高电阻率（1560 ohm-cm）的协同，且亚铁磁有序温度远高于室温，为低损耗高频应用提供了新型软磁氧化物材料。摘要未突出说明与已有高熵材料或传统尖晶石氧化物的具体性能对比。
papers.method_zh: 中子粉末衍射（NPD）确定磁结构（k=0,0,0）和磁转变温度；磁测量表征矫顽力和磁有序；X射线吸收光谱（XAS）、穆斯堡尔谱（Mössbauer spectroscopy）和NPD联合分析四面体与八面体位置的阳离子分布及位点选择性。

papers.title: Propagation and localization of spin excitations at altermagnetic domain walls
papers.abstract: Altermagnets (A$\ell$Ms) are spin-compensated materials in which opposite-spin sublattices are connected by a symmetry that causes a spin splitting in their elementary excitations. As there is a strong effect of altermagnetism on domain wall properties, it is quite natural to also expect an enrichment of the physics of magnetic excitations at A$\ell$M domain walls. Here, we consider the propagation of spin eigen-excitations along domain walls in easy-axial $d$-wave A$\ell$Ms. Investigating the presence of bound states localized on a domain wall, we find that the effect of the A$\ell$M on the bound states strongly depends on the orientation of the domain wall relative to the crystallographic directions. If the domain wall is oriented along a nodal direction [100] or [010], A$\ell$M does not change the number of bound states; however, it leads to a nonlinear dispersion and a tilt of the wavefront. The effect of A$\ell$M is strongest when the domain wall is oriented along the directions [110] or [$\bar{1}$10], i.e., along the directions of the strongest A$\ell$M splitting in the magnon spectrum. In this case, (i) the additional gapped bound states appear, (ii) degeneracy of the eigenstates with respect to their polarization (right-handed or left-handed precession of the N{é}el vector) is removed, and (iii) the localization area of the bound states strongly depends on the eigenfrequency. The latter may lead to strong localization of the bound state at the domain wall. We further consider the influence of a static magnetic field that is applied along the easy axis, and find that the magnetic field induces an asymmetry between the localization regions on opposite sides of the domain wall and sets an upper limit on the absolute value of the propagating eigenstate's wave vector.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：consider、investigating、find、theoretical analysis（基于对称性分析和模型计算，未提及实验或数值模拟具体方法）。；研究对象：易轴d波交变磁体（altermagnet）中畴壁上的自旋激发（自旋波/磁振子）的传播与局域化行为，特别关注畴壁取向对束缚态的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 交变磁效应在畴壁沿[110]或[1-10]方向时最强，会导致新的有能隙束缚态出现、自旋极化简并解除，以及束缚态局域区域随本征频率强烈变化；沿[100]或[010]方向时则不改变束缚态数量，但引起非线性色散和波前倾斜。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：交变磁效应在畴壁沿[110]或[1-10]方向时最强，会导致新的有能隙束缚态出现、自旋极化简并解除，以及束缚态局域区域随本征频率强烈变化；沿[100]或[010]方向时则不改变束缚态数量，但引起非线性色散和波前倾斜。；创新点：首次系统研究了交变磁体中畴壁取向对自旋波束缚态的影响，揭示了交变磁效应在不同畴壁方向下截然不同的物理后果（如束缚态数量、极化简并、局域化程度），并发现静磁场可诱导畴壁两侧局域区域的不对称性。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：基于d波交变磁体的易轴模型，研究畴壁上的自旋本征激发，分析束缚态的存在条件及其色散关系，并考虑沿易轴方向施加静磁场的影响。

papers.title: Extending Field Limits in Nanoscale Magnetic Imaging with Metamaterial-inspired Magnetic Flux Concentrators
papers.abstract: Many nanoscale magnetic imaging techniques are constrained by the maximum magnetic field that can be applied during measurements, due to geometrical limitations or interactions with the probe or the detected signal (e.g., electrons). Here, it is demonstrated that sample-integrated metamaterial-inspired magnetic flux concentrators (MFCs) locally amplify magnetic fields, allowing observation of magnetization processes beyond instrumental limits. Micrometer-sized MFCs fabricated directly on the samples are tested in photoemission electron microscopy experiments employing X-ray magnetic circular dichroism as magnetic contrast mechanism. At low applied fields, substantial amplification factors enable observation of magnetization reversal in a chain of magnetite nanoparticles synthesized by magnetotactic bacteria at an applied field of 8 mT, substantially smaller than the 50 mT predicted by simulations in absence of MFCs. At higher fields, the field enhancement extends the accessible field range by a factor of five, enabling for the first time, imaging of the field-dependent magnetic domain structure evolution of an isolated giant magnetofossil. Finally, we show how MFC geometry and material parameters can be tuned to optimize performance considering sample and experimental constraints, providing a tunable and broadly applicable strategy for extending the accessible field range in a wide variety of nanoscale magnetic imaging techniques.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：demonstrated、tested、experiments、fabricated、imaging。；研究对象：纳米尺度磁性成像技术中的磁场限制问题，以及利用超材料启发磁通集中器（MFCs）局部放大磁场以观测磁化过程。具体体系包括磁小体细菌合成的磁铁矿纳米颗粒链和孤立巨型磁化石。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 样品集成的微米级磁通集中器（MFCs）可在低外加磁场下实现显著放大因子（如8 mT下观测到原本需50 mT的磁化反转），并在高场下将可达到的磁场范围扩展五倍，首次实现对孤立巨型磁化石场依赖磁畴结构演化的成像。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：样品集成的微米级磁通集中器（MFCs）可在低外加磁场下实现显著放大因子（如8 mT下观测到原本需50 mT的磁化反转），并在高场下将可达到的磁场范围扩展五倍，首次实现对孤立巨型磁化石场依赖磁畴结构演化的成像。；创新点：提出并实验验证了一种可调谐、广泛适用的策略——通过样品集成的MFCs局部放大磁场，突破纳米磁性成像技术中因几何限制或探针/信号（如电子）相互作用导致的最大可施加磁场限制。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段：光发射电子显微镜（PEEM）结合X射线磁圆二色性（XMCD）作为磁衬度机制；在样品上直接制备微米级超材料启发磁通集中器（MFCs）。辅助手段：模拟预测（如无MFC时需50 mT的模拟结果）。

papers.title: Dichotomous electronic system in a bilayer Ni$^{1+}$ nickelate
papers.abstract: ``Infinite layer'' nickelates (ILNs) ${\cal R}$NiO$_2$ (${\cal R}$=rare earth elements), having empty apical O sites, become superconducting upon hole doping. They display a secondary electron Fermi surface (FS), giving hole doping, arising not from atomic orbitals but from a band based on interstitial density. Newly reported La$_3$Ni$_2$O$_5$F, formally Ni$^{1+}$, provides an unexpected example of ILN with essentially ideal two dimensional character. A partially occupied single band $E^*$, based on interstitial density, has distinct properties, as its strongly anisotropic shape extends over the three ``apical'' layers and leads to a cylindrical electron FS giving self-doping. This interstitial density is associated with a {\it network of valence bands}, including a Ni $d_{xz},d_{yz}$ pair that partners with $E^*$ to provide an incipient non-analytic Dirac point, leading to an unusual type of interstitial density--$d$ band coupling. The $E^*$ electron band and the conventional Ni $dpσ$ band will display a dichotomy of hole and electron quasiparticle behavior in normal state transport and far-IR properties, and likely resulting in unconventional superconducting state properties even for nickelates.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中主要讨论能带结构、费米面、狄拉克点等理论概念，未提及具体实验手段或计算模拟方法。；研究对象：双层镍酸盐 La₃Ni₂O₅F（名义价态 Ni¹⁺），属于“无限层”镍酸盐（ILN）体系，研究其电子结构、费米面及非常规超导可能性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该材料中存在一个基于间隙态密度的部分占据单能带 E*，其强各向异性形状延伸至三个“顶角”层，形成圆柱形电子费米面并导致自掺杂；E* 与 Ni d_{xz}, d_{yz} 能带耦合，产生非解析狄拉克点，导致电子与空穴准粒子行为的二分性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该材料中存在一个基于间隙态密度的部分占据单能带 E*，其强各向异性形状延伸至三个“顶角”层，形成圆柱形电子费米面并导致自掺杂；E* 与 Ni d_{xz}, d_{yz} 能带耦合，产生非解析狄拉克点，导致电子与空穴准粒子行为的二分性。；创新点：首次在名义 Ni¹⁺ 的无限层镍酸盐中发现基于间隙态密度的 E* 能带，并揭示其与 d 能带的非常规耦合（非解析狄拉克点），以及由此导致的电子-空穴二分性，为理解镍酸盐超导提供新视角。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体计算方法或理论框架（如 DFT、模型哈密顿量等），仅基于能带分析和费米面拓扑进行理论讨论。

papers.title: Optical-like interference control polar-phonons dispersions in 2D materials
papers.abstract: It has been argued that the polar phonon modes of two-dimensional (2D) materials should show a linear dependence close to the Brillouin zone center due to the reduced problem dimensionality compared to a three-dimensional crystal, leading to a vanishing LO-TO splitting. Revisiting this question using a mirror-charge framework derived from classical electrostatics, we show that it is not always true: with perfectly-reflective dielectric interfaces, it is possible to recover a LO-TO splitting, or an equivalent phenomenon for the out-of-plane modes. Effectively, the dispersion of polar phonon modes is governed by optical-like constructive and destructive interferences of the source potential with its reflection at the dielectric interfaces. This work highlights the critical role of dielectric boundary conditions to understand phonon-related properties in 2D materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“mirror-charge framework derived from classical electrostatics”等理论框架，未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：二维材料中的极性声子模（polar phonon modes），特别是其色散关系在布里渊区中心附近的行为，以及LO-TO分裂现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 二维材料极性声子模在布里渊区中心附近并不总是呈现线性色散和消失的LO-TO分裂；通过引入完美反射的介电界面，可以恢复LO-TO分裂或面外模的等效现象。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：二维材料极性声子模在布里渊区中心附近并不总是呈现线性色散和消失的LO-TO分裂；通过引入完美反射的介电界面，可以恢复LO-TO分裂或面外模的等效现象。；创新点：揭示了介电边界条件（而非仅维度降低）对二维材料极性声子色散的关键调控作用，指出光学类干涉（相长与相消干涉）是决定色散行为的物理机制。
papers.method_zh: 基于经典静电学的镜像电荷框架（mirror-charge framework），分析源势与其在介电界面上的反射之间的光学类干涉效应。

papers.title: Interaction-driven dynamics in graphene flakes as a benchmark for quantum simulation
papers.abstract: We study interaction-driven ultrafast dynamics in finite graphene flakes following an optical pump quench in an interacting tight-binding model. By comparing exact real-time evolution with simulations restricted to particle-hole excitation subspaces, we assess when relaxation can be captured by low-order many-body processes and when this is not sufficient. The single-particle orbital entropy provides a compact diagnostic for dynamic correlation growth. For the systems studied here, periodic graphene flakes are well described by low-order excitations, whereas confined geometries require substantial higher-order contributions even for relatively small interaction strengths. The quench protocol combines simple initial-state preparation with strongly correlated dynamics, identifying a promising benchmark problem for future quantum-computing simulations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：exact real-time evolution、simulations、tight-binding model、quantum simulation。；研究对象：有限尺寸石墨烯薄片（graphene flakes）在光学泵浦猝灭（optical pump quench）后的相互作用驱动超快动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 周期性石墨烯薄片中的弛豫动力学可由低阶多体过程很好地描述，而受限几何构型即使在较小相互作用强度下也需要大量高阶多体贡献才能准确描述。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：周期性石墨烯薄片中的弛豫动力学可由低阶多体过程很好地描述，而受限几何构型即使在较小相互作用强度下也需要大量高阶多体贡献才能准确描述。；创新点：提出了一个结合简单初始态制备与强关联动力学的猝灭方案，为未来量子计算模拟提供了一个有前景的基准问题。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 采用相互作用紧束缚模型，通过精确实时演化与限制在粒子-空穴激发子空间中的模拟进行对比，并使用单粒子轨道熵作为动态关联增长的诊断工具。

papers.title: Probing Spin Configurations in Exchange-Coupled Magnetic Bilayers with Orthogonal Anisotropies via Anomalous Hall and Nernst Effects
papers.abstract: When two ferromagnetic thin films with different magnetic easy axes are coupled via the exchange interaction, the magnetization process becomes nontrivial. In this paper, we demonstrate that three-dimensional magnetization information in such a bilayer system can be accessed electrically by combining measurements of the anomalous Hall effect (AHE) and anomalous Nernst effect (ANE). Specifically, we investigate a CoFe$_2$O$_4$(001)/Fe bilayer, where the insulating nature of CoFe$_2$O$_4$ ensures that these transport measurements selectively probe only the conductive Fe layer. By combining the AHE and ANE results and comparing them with a simple micromagnetic simulation, we probe the magnetic configuration of antiferromagnetically coupled Fe layer and suggest the emergence of a twisted magnetic structure near the interface.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“measurements of the anomalous Hall effect (AHE) and anomalous Nernst effect (ANE)”，以及“investigate a CoFe₂O₄(001)/Fe bilayer”，属于实验测量与模拟结合的研究。；研究对象：交换耦合磁性双层膜中的自旋构型，具体体系为CoFe₂O₄(001)/Fe双层膜，其中两层具有正交磁各向异性，并通过交换相互作用耦合。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过结合反常霍尔效应（AHE）和反常能斯特效应（ANE）的电学测量，可以获取该双层膜体系的三维磁化信息，并揭示Fe层中反铁磁耦合界面附近存在扭曲磁结构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过结合反常霍尔效应（AHE）和反常能斯特效应（ANE）的电学测量，可以获取该双层膜体系的三维磁化信息，并揭示Fe层中反铁磁耦合界面附近存在扭曲磁结构。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 实验上同时测量反常霍尔效应（AHE）和反常能斯特效应（ANE），利用CoFe₂O₄的绝缘性确保输运测量仅探测导电的Fe层；理论上结合简单微磁模拟（micromagnetic simulation）对实验结果进行分析。

papers.title: SANS and magnetometry study of the magnetic phase diagram of the B20 helimagnet FeRhSi
papers.abstract: This manuscript reports the first direct neutron-scattering evidence for long-period helimagnetism in the newly identified 4d-substituted B20 compound Fe0.5Rh0.5Si. By combining SANS with low-field magnetometry, we establish the magnetic modulation, construct a field-temperature phase diagram, and identify a candidate A-phase region supported by an independent structural signature. The work is important beyond this single compound because it expands the family of chiral B20 helimagnets into Rh-substituted materials, where spin-orbit coupling, disorder, and Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interactions can be tuned. It will interest researchers in chiral magnetism, topological spin textures, magnetic neutron scattering, and quantum materials, and provides a foundation for future studies of emergent magnetic phases and topology-driven phenomena in chemically tuned chiral magnets.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：neutron-scattering evidence、SANS、magnetometry、construct a phase diagram。；研究对象：B20型手性螺旋磁体Fe₀.₅Rh₀.₅Si的磁相图，具体涉及长周期螺旋磁有序及可能的A相区域。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 首次通过中子散射直接证实了新型4d取代B20化合物Fe₀.₅Rh₀.₅Si中存在长周期螺旋磁性，并结合SANS与低场磁测量构建了其磁场-温度相图，识别出一个候选A相区域。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：首次通过中子散射直接证实了新型4d取代B20化合物Fe₀.₅Rh₀.₅Si中存在长周期螺旋磁性，并结合SANS与低场磁测量构建了其磁场-温度相图，识别出一个候选A相区域。；创新点：将手性B20螺旋磁体家族扩展至Rh取代材料体系，为通过化学调控自旋-轨道耦合、无序及Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用提供了新平台。
papers.method_zh: 小角中子散射（SANS）与低场磁测量（magnetometry）相结合。

papers.title: Moving backward to go faster: Diatom-inspired sliding reveals efficient modes of locomotion
papers.abstract: Across biological scales, from sperm cells to whales, locomotion commonly relies on undulatory gaits, in which traveling deformation waves interact with the surrounding fluid to generate thrust opposite to the direction of wave propagation. In viscous environments, microorganism locomotion is classically understood in terms of undulatory bending of slender filaments such as flagella, with optimal propulsion achieved when the deformation wavelength is comparable to the swimmer length. Inspired by diatom colonies, we identify a fundamentally different swimming mechanism based on sliding between neighboring elements within a chain. We show that sliding between stacked elongated cells generates internal shear that drives propulsion opposite to classical undulatory swimming, while achieving higher speeds and greater energetic efficiency. Remarkably, optimal performance occurs at wavelengths much larger than the chain length and at cell aspect ratios consistent with those observed in natural diatom colonies, suggesting that hydrodynamic efficiency may constitute an evolutionary selective pressure in diatom chains. Together, these results identify sliding as a previously overlooked mode of locomotion in multicellular assemblies and suggest new design principles for efficient bio-inspired microswimmers and swarm robotic systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：identify、suggest、model of locomotion、hydrodynamic efficiency）；研究对象：基于硅藻群体（diatom colonies）启发的多细胞链状结构在粘性流体中的滑动推进机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现一种与经典波动推进方向相反的滑动推进模式，该模式在波长远大于链长时能实现更高速度和更高能量效率，且最优细胞长宽比与自然硅藻链一致，提示流体力学效率可能是硅藻链的进化选择压力。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现一种与经典波动推进方向相反的滑动推进模式，该模式在波长远大于链长时能实现更高速度和更高能量效率，且最优细胞长宽比与自然硅藻链一致，提示流体力学效率可能是硅藻链的进化选择压力。；创新点：首次提出多细胞链中相邻细胞间的滑动（sliding）是一种被忽视的高效推进模式，并揭示了其与经典波动推进相反的力学原理，为仿生微型游泳器和群体机器人系统提供了新设计原则。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模与流体力学分析（摘要未明确说明具体数值方法或实验手段，仅提及基于滑动机制的物理模型推导）。

papers.title: Microscopic evidence for a Zhang-Rice triplet state in the van der Waals antiferromagnet, NiPS$_3$
papers.abstract: Quantum-entangled states underpin many emergent phenomena in quantum materials, yet their direct experimental identification remains a challenge. NiPS$_3$, a van der Waals antiferromagnet exhibiting a resolution-limited magnetic exciton in its ordered phase, has been proposed to host a many-body entangled Zhang-Rice triplet state. Here, using $^{33}$S nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) on $^{33}$S-enriched NiPS$_3$ single crystals, we provide microscopic evidence for this charge-transfer state. The $^{33}$S and $^{31}$P Knight shifts as a function of temperature reveal a unified spin-triplet configuration arising from strong hybridization between a self-doped hole in the S $3p$ orbitals and a hole in Ni $3d$ orbitals. Furthermore, the $^{33}$S nuclear spin-lattice relaxation rate exhibits a power-law divergence as it approaches the Néel temperature $T_N=155$ K, indicating critical slowing down of collective charge fluctuations consistent with spin-nematic correlations. These results reveal a spin-charge-intertwined ground state and establish the microscopic foundation for the exceptional coherence of the magnetic exciton in NiPS$_3$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：使用核磁共振（NMR）实验手段，关键词包括“nuclear magnetic resonance”、“Knight shifts”、“nuclear spin-lattice relaxation rate”。；研究对象：范德华反铁磁体NiPS₃，具体研究其有序相中出现的张-瑞斯（Zhang-Rice）三重态（triplet state）以及相关的自旋-电荷纠缠基态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过³³S和³¹P的奈特位移测量，证实了NiPS₃中存在由S 3p轨道自掺杂空穴与Ni 3d轨道空穴强杂化形成的统一自旋三重态构型，为张-瑞斯三重态提供了微观证据；同时，³³S核自旋-晶格弛豫率在奈尔温度附近呈幂律发散，表明存在与自旋向列关联一致的集体电荷涨落临界慢化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过³³S和³¹P的奈特位移测量，证实了NiPS₃中存在由S 3p轨道自掺杂空穴与Ni 3d轨道空穴强杂化形成的统一自旋三重态构型，为张-瑞斯三重态提供了微观证据；同时，³³S核自旋-晶格弛豫率在奈尔温度附近呈幂律发散，表明存在与自旋向列关联一致的集体电荷涨落临界慢化。；创新点：首次通过核磁共振手段直接提供了NiPS₃中张-瑞斯三重态存在的微观实验证据，并揭示了该电荷转移态与自旋-电荷纠缠基态及磁激子相干性的内在联系。
papers.method_zh: 使用³³S同位素富集的NiPS₃单晶，进行³³S和³¹P核磁共振（NMR）测量，包括奈特位移（Knight shift）随温度的变化以及³³S核自旋-晶格弛豫率（spin-lattice relaxation rate）的温度依赖性分析。

papers.title: Virial stress in systems of active Brownian particles in the presence of translational and rotational inertia
papers.abstract: We elucidate the stress in a system of active Brownian particles augmented with translational and rotational inertia (ABP+TRI). Stress tensors are derived for periodic systems as well as systems confined between walls by employing Lagrange's equations of motion of the first kind for the rotational motion. Using Langevin simulations of an ideal active gas in two dimensions, we confirm the existence of an equation of state for periodic systems that depends on translational and rotational inertia in general. Confinement implies a strong polarization of the propulsion direction near a wall and an enhanced density, both of which increase with increasing rotational inertia. This affects the local stress tensor normal to the confining walls, leading to a breakdown of the equation of state. Yet the local stress in the bulk part of the confined systems is identical with that of the periodic system. Importantly, for both kinds of boundary conditions, the so-called swim stress is not included in the local stress tensor; thus, in general, the swim stress is not representative of the stress in systems of ABP+TRIs.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：derive、Langevin simulations、equation of state）；研究对象：具有平动和转动惯性的活性布朗粒子（ABP+TRI）体系中的应力，包括周期系统和受限系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在周期系统中存在依赖于平动和转动惯性的状态方程；在受限系统中，壁附近推进方向强烈极化且密度增强，导致状态方程失效，但体相局部应力与周期系统一致。此外，游泳应力不包含在局部应力张量中，因此不能代表ABP+TRI体系的应力。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在周期系统中存在依赖于平动和转动惯性的状态方程；在受限系统中，壁附近推进方向强烈极化且密度增强，导致状态方程失效，但体相局部应力与周期系统一致。此外，游泳应力不包含在局部应力张量中，因此不能代表ABP+TRI体系的应力。；创新点：首次系统阐明了平动和转动惯性对活性布朗粒子体系应力的影响，并明确指出游泳应力不适用于描述此类体系的局部应力。
papers.method_zh: 采用第一类拉格朗日运动方程推导应力张量，并通过二维理想活性气体的朗之万模拟进行验证。

papers.title: Strain-programmable exciton diffusion in moiré heterostructures
papers.abstract: Moiré superlattices in van der Waals heterostructures have recently gained significant attention as an intriguing platform for studying correlated electronic systems and exotic excitonic properties. Previous reports, however, focused on creating and modulating moiré heterostructures through interlayer twisting or lattice constant mismatches, limiting controls on symmetry of heterostructures. In this work, we show that strain significantly alters the geometry of moiré superlattices by breaking the C3 rotational symmetry. We realize strain-induced moiré superlattices by intentionally regulating interlayer strain in WSe2-MoSe2 heterostructures, which is manifested by linearly polarized interlayer exciton emission coupled to the strain direction. Furthermore, interlayer exciton diffusion was preferentially guided along the stretched moiré superlattice orientations over a wide spatial range, reflecting the strain-modified moiré potentials. Our work highlights strain tuning as a versatile tool for designing moiré superlattices and programming excitonic transport, which opens pathways for van der Waals logic and information processing devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“realize strain-induced moiré superlattices”、“manifested by linearly polarized interlayer exciton emission”等实验观测结果。；研究对象：WSe₂-MoSe₂范德华异质结中的莫尔超晶格，以及应变调控下的激子扩散行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过调控层间应变可以打破莫尔超晶格的C₃旋转对称性，并引导层间激子沿拉伸的莫尔超晶格取向优先扩散，实现激子输运的可编程控制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过调控层间应变可以打破莫尔超晶格的C₃旋转对称性，并引导层间激子沿拉伸的莫尔超晶格取向优先扩散，实现激子输运的可编程控制。；创新点：突破了以往仅通过层间扭转或晶格失配来调控莫尔超晶格对称性的局限，首次展示了应变作为一种通用工具来设计莫尔超晶格并编程激子输运。
papers.method_zh: 通过有意调控WSe₂-MoSe₂异质结中的层间应变来构建应变诱导的莫尔超晶格；利用线性偏振的层间激子发光来表征应变方向；通过观测激子扩散的空间范围来反映应变修饰的莫尔势。

papers.title: Finite-Time Orientational Relaxation Restructures Collective Motion in Polar Active Matter
papers.abstract: We introduce a Langevin formulation of Vicsek-like active particles in which orientations evolve through finite-rate relaxation toward the local mean direction, with alignment strength $J$ and rotational diffusivity $D_r$, thereby combining Vicsek-type local consensus with XY-like orientational dynamics. Using large-scale numerical simulations, we determine the nonequilibrium phase diagram as a function of activity and alignment rate. Increasing the alignment rate drives a sequence of transitions from a homogeneous isotropic state to polar bands, a cross-sea phase of intersecting bands, a homogeneous polar state, and ultimately a micro-clustered regime. The isotropic-to-polar transition is strongly first order, as evidenced by Binder cumulants and bimodal distributions of local polarization and density, indicating coexistence of gas-like and liquid-like regions. Near the onset of collective motion, band size increases with activity but depends non-monotonically on alignment rate. Further increasing the alignment rate drives the system through the cross-sea and homogeneous polar phases before enhanced density fluctuations lead to micro-clustering. Our results demonstrate that finite-time orientational relaxation acts as a control parameter that qualitatively restructures collective behavior in polar active matter.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：Langevin formulation、large-scale numerical simulations、nonequilibrium phase diagram。；研究对象：极性活性物质（polar active matter）中粒子的集体运动，具体为Vicsek类活性粒子在有限时间取向弛豫下的动力学行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 有限时间取向弛豫（通过取向对齐强度J和旋转扩散系数Dr控制）可作为调控参数，使系统经历从均匀各向同性态到极性带、交叉海相、均匀极性态，最终到微团簇态的系列相变，且各向同性-极性相变为强一级相变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：有限时间取向弛豫（通过取向对齐强度J和旋转扩散系数Dr控制）可作为调控参数，使系统经历从均匀各向同性态到极性带、交叉海相、均匀极性态，最终到微团簇态的系列相变，且各向同性-极性相变为强一级相变。；创新点：将Vicsek型局部共识与XY型取向动力学（有限时间取向弛豫）相结合，揭示了取向弛豫速率作为控制参数可定性重构极性活性物质的集体行为，并发现了交叉海相（cross-sea phase）等新相。
papers.method_zh: 采用朗之万方程（Langevin formulation）描述Vicsek类活性粒子，其中粒子取向通过有限速率弛豫向局部平均方向演化；通过大规模数值模拟确定非平衡相图，并使用Binder累积量和局域极化/密度双峰分布分析相变性质。

papers.title: Electrical Spectroscopy of Intervalley Relaxation in WSe$_2$ Transistors
papers.abstract: We show that the transconductance of multilayer WSe$_2$ field-effect transistors serves as a direct electrical spectrometer of the intervalley relaxation time $τ_{\rm iv}$, previously accessible only by ultrafast optical techniques. Extending an equilibrium valley-thermodynamics framework with a single relaxation equation for the $Γ$-valley carrier fraction $f_Γ(t)$, we predict three signatures: (i)~a Lorentzian transconductance $g_m(ω)=g_{m,0}+g_{m,v}^0/(1+iωτ_{\rm iv})$, whose imaginary part peaks at $ω_c=τ_{\rm iv}^{-1}$ with opposite signs for bilayer and trilayer; (ii)~a two-stage current transient after a gate step, exhibiting bilayer overshoot or trilayer undershoot; and (iii)~sweep-rate-proportional hysteresis whose gate-voltage profile and layer-number sign reversal distinguish valley from trap-induced dynamics. All three signatures provide quantitative electrical access to $τ_{\rm iv}$ with standard rf and dc instrumentation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论+实验混合类型。判断依据：摘要中既有理论框架的扩展（“extending an equilibrium valley-thermodynamics framework”），又有实验预测（“predict three signatures”），并提及标准射频和直流仪器可实现测量。；研究对象：多层WSe₂场效应晶体管中的谷间弛豫时间τ_iv，具体涉及Γ谷载流子分数f_Γ(t)的动力学行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 多层WSe₂晶体管的跨导可直接作为谷间弛豫时间τ_iv的电学谱仪，通过三种特征信号（洛伦兹型跨导、栅阶跃后的两阶段电流瞬态、与扫描速率成正比的磁滞）实现定量电学测量，此前该参数仅能通过超快光学技术获取。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：多层WSe₂晶体管的跨导可直接作为谷间弛豫时间τ_iv的电学谱仪，通过三种特征信号（洛伦兹型跨导、栅阶跃后的两阶段电流瞬态、与扫描速率成正比的磁滞）实现定量电学测量，此前该参数仅能通过超快光学技术获取。；创新点：首次提出利用跨导作为直接电学谱仪来测量谷间弛豫时间，替代了传统超快光学方法，并揭示了双层与三层WSe₂中跨导虚部峰值的符号反转现象。
papers.method_zh: 扩展了平衡态谷热力学框架，引入Γ谷载流子分数f_Γ(t)的单弛豫方程；理论预测了跨导的频率响应、时域瞬态和直流磁滞行为；使用标准射频和直流仪器进行电学测量。

papers.title: One-Step Self-Organized Multifunctional Micromotors via Evaporative Liquid-Liquid Phase Separation
papers.abstract: Active microcarriers capable of transporting multiple functional components and navigating complex environments are highly desirable for biomedical applications, yet their fabrication typically requires complex multistep processes. Here we show that evaporation-induced liquid-liquid phase separation in all aqueous polymer and protein mixtures provides a simple one-step route to multifunctional micromotors. During droplet evaporation, micron-sized condensates spontaneously form and encapsulate enzymes, nanoparticles, and drugs. Evaporation-induced Marangoni flows and interfacial adsorption generate asymmetric internal self-organization of nanoparticles, producing Janus-like architectures and spontaneously emergent shape anisotropy without the need for patterned fabrication. Dual functionality with internal magnetic anisotropy allowed catalytic propulsion steered by magnetic torque, enabling directional motion even in homogeneous environments. Thus, we present a versatile platform for the one-step construction of biocompatible, multifunctional micromotors with internally asymmetric architectures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：one-step route、fabrication、self-organization、experimental observation。；研究对象：基于蒸发诱导液-液相分离（liquid-liquid phase separation）制备的多功能微马达（micromotors），具体体系为全水相高分子与蛋白质混合物。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过简单的蒸发诱导液-液相分离，可一步自发形成具有Janus-like非对称内部结构的多功能微马达，无需复杂多步加工；该微马达兼具催化推进与磁控转向的双重功能，能在均匀环境中实现定向运动。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过简单的蒸发诱导液-液相分离，可一步自发形成具有Janus-like非对称内部结构的多功能微马达，无需复杂多步加工；该微马达兼具催化推进与磁控转向的双重功能，能在均匀环境中实现定向运动。；创新点：提出一种基于蒸发诱导相分离的一步法自组织策略，无需图案化加工即可获得内部非对称结构（Janus-like构型）与形状各向异性，同时实现多功能集成与生物相容性。
papers.method_zh: 利用液滴蒸发过程中的Marangoni流与界面吸附，实现纳米颗粒、酶和药物的自发封装与内部非对称自组织；通过引入磁性纳米颗粒赋予内部磁各向异性，实现磁力矩控制的催化推进。

papers.title: Energetics of Nucleation in Finitely Deformed, Phase-Transforming Soft Solids
papers.abstract: Classical nucleation theory describes the rate at which stable nuclei form within a metastable parent phase by crossing a free-energy barrier set by competing bulk and interfacial energies. In an elastic material, a pre-existing stress state modifies this barrier through an elastic contribution to the bulk driving force. This contribution is well characterized for linear elastic materials, but the corresponding finite-deformation result for soft solids remains less developed. The gap is computationally significant: in simulations that sample candidate nuclei throughout a stressed body, direct evaluation of the elastic contribution to free-energy change would require solving a new nonlinear elasticity boundary-value problem for each possible nucleus. Here, we derive an asymptotic expansion of the equilibrium elastic potential energy change for a hyperelastic body before and after formation of a small transformed region. The expansion is with respect to the amplitude of an isotropic transformation strain, while the pre-existing deformation and stress may be finite. At leading order, the elastic contribution to the formation energy is determined entirely by the known untransformed equilibrium fields, with additional terms accounting for stiffness contrast between the parent and transformed phases. Incorporating this into classical nucleation theory yields the stress-shifted transformation temperature, critical radius, and nucleation barrier. Representative results are shown for a compressible neo-Hookean solid under hydrostatic, uniaxial, and equibiaxial loading; tensile stresses promote nucleation and compressive stresses suppress it when transformation strain is expansive. Comparison with the corresponding linear-elastic result shows that finite-deformation effects can substantially change the predicted energy barrier at moderate stretches.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“derive an asymptotic expansion”“classical nucleation theory”等理论推导和建模方法，未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：有限变形下发生相变的软固体（soft solids）中的成核过程，具体为超弹性材料（hyperelastic body）在有限预变形和应力下，由亚稳母相形成稳定新相核的能垒问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 推导了有限变形下超弹性体形成小尺寸相变核时弹性势能变化的渐近展开式，发现有限变形效应在中等拉伸下可显著改变经典成核理论预测的能垒，且拉伸应力促进成核、压缩应力抑制成核（当相变应变为膨胀型时）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：推导了有限变形下超弹性体形成小尺寸相变核时弹性势能变化的渐近展开式，发现有限变形效应在中等拉伸下可显著改变经典成核理论预测的能垒，且拉伸应力促进成核、压缩应力抑制成核（当相变应变为膨胀型时）。；创新点：将经典成核理论中弹性贡献的处理从线性弹性推广到有限变形情形，推导了适用于软固体在有限预变形下成核能垒的解析表达式，填补了该领域在有限变形结果上的空白。
papers.method_zh: 基于经典成核理论，采用渐近展开方法推导了有限变形下超弹性体形成小相变区域前后的平衡弹性势能变化，以各向同性相变应变的振幅为小参数展开，并考虑了母相与新相之间的刚度对比。最终将结果用于计算应力偏移的相变温度、临界半径和成核能垒，并以可压缩neo-Hookean固体在静水、单轴和等双轴加载下的结果为例进行展示。

papers.title: Edge slip stabilizes confined active vortices by suppressing localized instabilities
papers.abstract: Confined active systems can sustain persistent vortical flows whose stability is strongly influenced by boundary conditions. At the individual level, active units generate internal stresses that drive spontaneous flows, which in turn advect and reorient the particles. This nonlinear coupling between active flow and orientational order is significantly mediated by the system's boundaries, where the specific slip condition governs how these internal stresses generate active flow then rearrange the local orientations. However, a quantitative understanding of how boundary slip dictates their dynamical stability remains lacking. Here, we study how the slip boundary condition controls the stability of a steady vortex state in a circularly confined active nematic system. Using a continuum model in a flow-dominated regime, we perform a linear stability analysis and derive an explicit criterion incorporating the slip velocity and flow-alignment coupling. We find that increasing slip velocity suppresses localized linear instabilities, thereby promoting the persistence of the steady vortex state. This reveals a relaxing the boundary friction actually stabilizes the macroscopic coherent structure by depressing flow induced reorientation that typically destroys single-vortex states. Our findings establish boundary slip as a nontrivial hydrodynamic control parameter for engineering stable active flows.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：continuum model（连续介质模型）、linear stability analysis（线性稳定性分析）、explicit criterion（显式判据）。；研究对象：圆形受限活性向列相体系中的稳态涡旋（steady vortex state），具体研究边界滑移条件（slip boundary condition）对该涡旋态动力学稳定性的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 增大边界滑移速度可抑制局域线性不稳定性，从而促进稳态涡旋的持续存在；即放松边界摩擦实际上通过抑制通常破坏单涡旋态的流动诱导重取向，稳定了宏观相干结构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：增大边界滑移速度可抑制局域线性不稳定性，从而促进稳态涡旋的持续存在；即放松边界摩擦实际上通过抑制通常破坏单涡旋态的流动诱导重取向，稳定了宏观相干结构。；创新点：将边界滑移确立为一种非平庸的流体动力学控制参数，用于工程化设计稳定的活性流动。摘要未突出说明与已有研究的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 采用流主导（flow-dominated regime）的连续介质模型，进行线性稳定性分析，推导出包含滑移速度与流动-取向耦合（flow-alignment coupling）的显式稳定性判据。

papers.title: Supermoiré Chern mosaic in helical trilayer WSe2
papers.abstract: Helically twisted multilayers offer access to moiré physics beyond the single-superlattice paradigm, yet their correlated and topological transport properties remain largely unexplored in semiconductor moiré materials. Here we report magnetotransport measurements of helical trilayer WSe2, in which two coupled moiré patterns relax into a supermoiré landscape composed of inequivalent local topological domains with distinct electronic structures and unequal spatial areas. By electrostatic tuning, we identify a trilayer-hybridized regime where interactions and real-space reconstruction combine to generate a plethora of magnetic and topological states absent in the twisted bilayers. At moiré filling factor $ν$ = -1, we observe a ferromagnetic insulating state that is robust against magnetic field and accompanied by a non-quantized anomalous Hall response ~-4 kOhms. This behaviour is consistent with a time-reversal-symmetry-breaking supermoiré Chern mosaic, in which the Hall response arises from the non-cancelling contributions of local domains with opposite Chern character arranged by the relaxed structure. Under strong magnetic fields, a symmetry-broken Chern insulating state (C = 1) emerges near $ν$ = -2/3, displaying a much larger positive Hall response together with strongly enhanced longitudinal resistance, suggestive of field-reconstructed topological minibands and domain-boundary scattering. These results establish relaxed supermoiré semiconductor trilayers as a platform for spatially organized magnetism and topology beyond the bilayer limit.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：magnetotransport measurements（磁输运测量）、electrostatic tuning（静电调控）、observations of ferromagnetic insulating state and anomalous Hall response（观测到铁磁绝缘态和反常霍尔响应）。；研究对象：螺旋三层WSe2（helical trilayer WSe2）中的超摩尔条纹（supermoiré）拓扑电子态，具体研究其关联性和拓扑输运性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在螺旋三层WSe2中，通过静电调控进入三层杂化区域，观测到时间反演对称性破缺的超摩尔条纹陈数镶嵌（supermoiré Chern mosaic）现象，表现为在ν=-1填充因子处出现铁磁绝缘态及非量子化的反常霍尔响应（~-4 kOhms）；在强磁场下，ν=-2/3附近出现对称性破缺的陈绝缘体态（C=1），伴随增强的正霍尔响应和纵向电阻。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在螺旋三层WSe2中，通过静电调控进入三层杂化区域，观测到时间反演对称性破缺的超摩尔条纹陈数镶嵌（supermoiré Chern mosaic）现象，表现为在ν=-1填充因子处出现铁磁绝缘态及非量子化的反常霍尔响应（~-4 kOhms）；在强磁场下，ν=-2/3附近出现对称性破缺的陈绝缘体态（C=1），伴随增强的正霍尔响应和纵向电阻。；创新点：首次在半导体摩尔材料中实验探索螺旋多层结构（超越单超晶格范式）的关联和拓扑输运性质，揭示了由两个耦合摩尔图案弛豫形成的超摩尔条纹景观中，不等价局域拓扑畴（具有不同陈数）的非抵消贡献导致的反常霍尔效应，以及强磁场下拓扑微带重构和畴界散射导致的陈绝缘体态。
papers.method_zh: 磁输运测量（magnetotransport measurements）、静电调控（electrostatic tuning）改变摩尔填充因子ν，分析霍尔电阻和纵向电阻随磁场和填充因子的变化。

papers.title: Superheating field of clean superconductors near the type-I--type-II boundary: the low-temperature Meissner stability limit of niobium
papers.abstract: We calculate the low-temperature superheating field $B_{\rm sh}$ of clean superconductors near the boundary between type-I and type-II superconductivity, with particular emphasis on Nb. The calculation is based on the self-consistent nonlinear nonlocal Eilenberger theory and the linear stability analysis of the Meissner state. For a Nb-like material with $κ_{\rm GL}=0.7$, we obtain $B_{\rm sh}\simeq 290\,{\rm mT}$ at $T/T_c=0.2$, using $B_{c0}\simeq 200\,{\rm mT}$. This value is substantially higher than the value obtained by naively extrapolating the Ginzburg--Landau result near $T_c$ to $T\ll T_c$. For a TESLA-shaped Nb accelerator cavity, it corresponds to an intrinsic Meissner-stability limit of about $67\,{\rm MV/m}$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：calculate, self-consistent nonlinear nonlocal Eilenberger theory, linear stability analysis）；研究对象：清洁超导体在I型与II型超导边界附近的过热场（superheating field），特别关注铌（Nb）材料。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于类铌材料（κ_GL=0.7），在低温下（T/T_c=0.2）计算得到的过热场约为290 mT，显著高于从Ginzburg-Landau理论在T_c附近结果直接外推至低温所得到的值。对于TESLA形状的铌加速腔，这对应约67 MV/m的固有Meissner稳定性极限。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于类铌材料（κ_GL=0.7），在低温下（T/T_c=0.2）计算得到的过热场约为290 mT，显著高于从Ginzburg-Landau理论在T_c附近结果直接外推至低温所得到的值。对于TESLA形状的铌加速腔，这对应约67 MV/m的固有Meissner稳定性极限。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。

papers.title: Antiferromagnetic order and magnetic polarons in lightly doped Li$_x$CoO$_2$ (x $\sim$ 0.9)
papers.abstract: We investigate the magnetic properties of Li$_x$CoO$_2$ (x$\sim$0.9) using bulk magnetization, specific heat, nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) and electron paramagnetic resonance (EPR) spectroscopy measurements. The dc magnetization, specific heat and NMR measurements, which probe the macroscopic response, indeed show that this compound partially undergoes an antiferromagnetic transition below $T_N \sim$ 10 K. In addition, we observed a weak ferromagnetic response, which gives rise to the history dependence in magnetization measurements at low fields and is observed at temperatures above room temperature. We propose that there are ferromagnetic clusters at high temperatures due to the formation of magnetic polarons out of doped holes. In EPR measurements performed at the $X$-band frequency, only a fraction of the total spins contribute and show Curie-like paramagnetic behavior as reflected in the temperature dependence of the EPR intensity. The temperature variation of the EPR spectra can be understood in the framework of the diffusion of magnetic polarons.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到了使用多种实验测量手段（bulk magnetization, specific heat, NMR, EPR）。；研究对象：轻掺杂的锂钴氧化物 LiₓCoO₂ (x ~ 0.9) 的磁性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该化合物在约10 K以下部分发生反铁磁相变，同时存在由掺杂空穴形成的磁极化子导致的弱铁磁响应，该响应在室温以上仍可观测到。

papers.title: Higher-winding phases in one-dimensional non-Hermitian topological superconductors
papers.abstract: Non-Hermitian topological superconductors provide a setting in which point-gap topology, non-Hermitian skin effects, and Majorana zero modes are strongly intertwined. In this work, we adopt a coefficient-based approach for computing winding numbers and deriving analytical expressions for phase boundaries in one-dimensional non-Hermitian topological superconductors characterized by point-gap topology with $\mathbb{Z}$ invariants. We apply this approach to two non-Hermitian topological superconducting lattice models, with and without sublattice degrees of freedom, including longer-range hoppings, thereby accessing a much broader parameter space. These extensions generate higher-order polynomials and support phases with higher winding numbers, reflecting the underlying $\mathbb{Z}$ topology. We further clarify how a weak perturbation suppresses the non-Hermitian skin effect while preserving the sublattice-symmetry-protected invariant associated with Majorana zero modes. The predicted winding numbers are verified by open-boundary spectra, where one or multiple pairs of zero-energy boundary modes appear consistently with the bulk invariant. We also examine the stability of these modes against onsite disorder through the inverse participation ratio. Our results provide a systematic and efficient route to constructing topological phase diagrams for higher-winding non-Hermitian topological superconductors.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：计算 winding numbers、推导解析表达式、构建相图。；研究对象：一维非厄米拓扑超导体，特别是具有点隙拓扑（point-gap topology）和 $\mathbb{Z}$ 拓扑不变量、支持高缠绕数（higher-winding）的体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过基于系数的方法，可以在包含长程跃迁的一维非厄米拓扑超导晶格模型中系统地构建高缠绕数拓扑相图，并发现弱扰动可以抑制非厄米趋肤效应，同时保持与马约拉纳零模相关的子晶格对称性保护不变量。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过基于系数的方法，可以在包含长程跃迁的一维非厄米拓扑超导晶格模型中系统地构建高缠绕数拓扑相图，并发现弱扰动可以抑制非厄米趋肤效应，同时保持与马约拉纳零模相关的子晶格对称性保护不变量。；创新点：提出了一种系统且高效的基于系数的方法，用于构建具有高缠绕数（反映 $\mathbb{Z}$ 拓扑）的非厄米拓扑超导体的拓扑相图，并揭示了弱扰动对非厄米趋肤效应与马约拉纳零模保护机制的不同影响。

papers.title: Improved selector behavior in ultrathin chromium-doped V$_2$O$_3$ films
papers.abstract: Devices based on the negative differential resistance effect in chromium doped V$_2$O$_3$ are considered to be promising as selector elements for use in emerging memory technologies, as well as for neuromorphic applications. It is shown by electrical measurements, that the switching effect is maintained for very thin films down to 5 nm, and even improved properties such as a low leakage current and an abrupt transition are observed. For these thicknesses, the behavior of crystalline and amorphous films becomes very similar; most strikingly, a forming step is required in both. Transmission electron microscopy reveals this to be likely due to a thin amorphous layer that forms at the interface to the TiN electrode. Elemental mapping further shows a complex distribution of the chromium dopants, as well as a diffusion of Ti into the layer from the electrode, which might be responsible for the improved properties.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“electrical measurements”、“Transmission electron microscopy”、“Elemental mapping”等实验手段。；研究对象：超薄铬掺杂V₂O₃薄膜中的负微分电阻效应及其在选通器（selector）中的应用。

papers.title: Neural electron backscatter diffraction
papers.abstract: In a polycrystalline microstructure, orientation and dislocation content vary smoothly within grains, and the grain boundaries between them are continuous curves. Electron backscatter diffraction (EBSD) records this continuum on a discrete grid with every subsequent analysis (from indexing to advanced pattern processing) confined to that grid. We introduce neural EBSD, which treats an EBSD scan as a continuous, differentiable four-dimensional field of Kikuchi diffraction intensity (in specimen--detector domain) and then represents it with a coordinate-based neural network. We develop and compare two formulations: a joint formulation that maps all four coordinates to intensity, and a factorized formulation that combines continuous specimen-domain coefficient fields with learned detector-domain basis patterns. Tested on recrystallized and additively manufactured Inconel 718, the factorized formulation shows better accuracy in reconstructing Kikuchi patterns that have map-averaged errors below 1% of the maximum intensity. Beyond reconstruction, it provides full-pattern super-resolution in the specimen frame, continuous querying along arbitrary off-grid paths, as well as spatially continuous boundary and heterogeneity localization from analytical spatial derivatives. Storing the network weights and learned bases in place of the raw patterns in a large dataset offers a 700-fold compression while preserving on-demand access to the full patterns for downstream analyses.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：coordinate-based neural network、representation、reconstruction、compression。；研究对象：多晶微结构中的电子背散射衍射（EBSD）数据，具体材料为再结晶和增材制造的Inconel 718镍基高温合金。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种基于坐标神经网络的“神经EBSD”方法，将离散的EBSD扫描数据表示为连续可微的四维菊池衍射强度场，其中因子化形式在重建精度、超分辨率和数据压缩（700倍）方面表现优异。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种基于坐标神经网络的“神经EBSD”方法，将离散的EBSD扫描数据表示为连续可微的四维菊池衍射强度场，其中因子化形式在重建精度、超分辨率和数据压缩（700倍）方面表现优异。；创新点：首次将EBSD扫描数据从离散网格表示转化为连续可微的神经场表示，实现了全图案超分辨率、任意离网格路径的连续查询以及基于解析空间导数的连续边界定位，同时实现700倍数据压缩。
papers.method_zh: 采用坐标神经网络（coordinate-based neural network）对EBSD数据进行连续表示。具体开发并比较了两种形式：联合形式（joint formulation，将四个坐标直接映射到强度）和因子化形式（factorized formulation，结合连续样品域系数场与学习得到的探测器域基函数）。通过重建菊池图案的误差、超分辨率、沿任意路径的连续查询以及空间导数的边界定位来评估性能。

papers.title: Magnetic HIP-NN for spin dynamics in disordered itinerant magnets
papers.abstract: We present a magnetic extension of the Hierarchically Interacting Particle Neural Network (HIP-NN) that enables large-scale simulations of electron-mediated spin dynamics in disordered itinerant magnets. The resulting magnetic HIP-NN (mHIP-NN) incorporates rotationally invariant spin correlations directly into hierarchical message-passing layers, enabling the network to learn emergent magnetic energy landscapes and effective local fields from coupled geometric-spin environments while preserving spin-rotation symmetry. As a benchmark application, we consider structurally disordered itinerant $s$-$d$ exchange models in which the effective magnetic forces arise dynamically from the instantaneous electronic structure and are computationally prohibitive to evaluate using conventional exact-diagonalization-based approaches. We show that mHIP-NN accurately reproduces the local torques governing Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert dynamics and faithfully captures the nonequilibrium evolution of spatial spin correlations following thermal quenches. Our results establish symmetry-aware hierarchical message-passing networks as an efficient and scalable framework for large-scale simulations of frustrated itinerant spin systems and nonequilibrium magnetic dynamics. More broadly, because the learned energy functional remains fully differentiable with respect to both atomic coordinates and spin variables, the framework also provides a natural foundation for spin-dependent interatomic potentials and coupled atom-spin dynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据关键词：neural network、simulations、computationally prohibitive、symmetry-aware hierarchical message-passing networks。；研究对象：无序巡游磁体中的电子介导自旋动力学，具体以结构无序的s-d交换模型为基准体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 磁层级相互作用粒子神经网络（mHIP-NN）能够准确复现控制Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert动力学的局域力矩，并忠实捕捉热淬火后空间自旋关联的非平衡演化，为大规模模拟阻挫巡游自旋系统和非平衡磁动力学提供了高效可扩展框架。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：磁层级相互作用粒子神经网络（mHIP-NN）能够准确复现控制Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert动力学的局域力矩，并忠实捕捉热淬火后空间自旋关联的非平衡演化，为大规模模拟阻挫巡游自旋系统和非平衡磁动力学提供了高效可扩展框架。；创新点：将旋转对称性感知的层级消息传递网络首次应用于巡游磁体的自旋动力学模拟，使得学习到的能量泛函对原子坐标和自旋变量完全可微，为自旋依赖的原子间势和耦合原子-自旋动力学提供了自然基础。
papers.method_zh: 提出了磁层级相互作用粒子神经网络（mHIP-NN），该网络将旋转不变的自旋关联直接嵌入层级消息传递层，从耦合的几何-自旋环境中学习涌现的磁能量景观和有效局域场，同时保持自旋旋转对称性。

papers.title: Vortex pinning of Ba$_{0.62}$K$_{0.38}$BiO$_3$ investigated by magneto-optical Kerr-effect and magnetization measurements
papers.abstract: Vortex pinning plays a crucial role in determining properties of type-II superconductors. For example, it governs the irreversible magnetic response as well as dissipation caused by vortex motion. Here, we study vortex pinning in the three-dimensional oxide superconductor Ba1-xKxBiO3 using ultra-high-resolution magneto-optical Kerr effect (MOKE) and detailed magnetization measurements. We find that the zero-field MOKE signal in the superconducting state exhibits a pronounced magnetic-history dependence. This behavior closely resembles the remanent magnetization caused by trapped vortices. Furthermore, we demonstrate that the observed evolution of the MOKE signals is well described by Bean's critical-state model for trapped vortices. Our results establish MOKE as a viable optical and mesoscopic probe of vortex pinning in type-II superconductors, providing a new complementary approach to investigate mixed-state phenomena. We also find that the training-field dependence of the MOKE is linear near zero training field, without any anomalies indicative of spontaneous time-reversal-symmetry breaking in an unconventional superconducting state. Our study defines a clear protocol to distinguish vortex-induced MOKE responses from those associated with a time-reversal-symmetry broken superconducting order parameter.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提及“使用超高分辨率磁光克尔效应（MOKE）和详细的磁化测量”进行实验研究。；研究对象：三维氧化物超导体Ba₁₋ₓKₓBiO₃（具体组分为Ba₀.₆₂K₀.₃₈BiO₃）中的涡旋钉扎现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 零场MOKE信号在超导态中表现出显著的磁历史依赖性，该行为与捕获涡旋引起的剩磁高度相似，且可用Bean临界态模型很好地描述。此外，MOKE信号随训练场的变化在零场附近呈线性，未发现任何自发时间反演对称性破缺的异常迹象。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：零场MOKE信号在超导态中表现出显著的磁历史依赖性，该行为与捕获涡旋引起的剩磁高度相似，且可用Bean临界态模型很好地描述。此外，MOKE信号随训练场的变化在零场附近呈线性，未发现任何自发时间反演对称性破缺的异常迹象。；创新点：建立了MOKE作为一种可行的光学和介观尺度探针来研究第二类超导体的涡旋钉扎，为研究混合态现象提供了新的互补方法；同时明确了区分涡旋诱导的MOKE响应与时间反演对称性破缺超导序参量引起的MOKE响应的实验协议。
papers.method_zh: 超高分辨率磁光克尔效应（MOKE）和详细的磁化测量。

papers.title: Coherent manipulation of Kondo Majoranas in two-channel Kondo setups
papers.abstract: We study coherent manipulation of Majorana zero modes emerging in overscreened two-channel Kondo systems. Using compactified lattice models, we show that these interacting Kondo Majoranas support non-local qubits and admit teleportation, fusion, and braiding operations. In particular, we identify a distinction between non-topological and genuinely topological Y-junction geometries, the latter realizing a non-Abelian geometric holonomy. Our results establish a proof-of-principle route toward coherent control of non-Abelian anyons beyond conventional free-fermion platforms.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：overscreened two-channel Kondo systems、compactified lattice models、non-Abelian geometric holonomy。；研究对象：过屏蔽双通道近藤体系中涌现的马约拉纳零模，以及基于这些相互作用马约拉纳零模的相干操控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 证明了在过屏蔽双通道近藤体系中，马约拉纳零模可以支持非局域量子比特，并实现隐形传态、融合和编织操作；其中Y型结几何结构可实现非阿贝尔几何相位，区别于非拓扑的Y型结。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：证明了在过屏蔽双通道近藤体系中，马约拉纳零模可以支持非局域量子比特，并实现隐形传态、融合和编织操作；其中Y型结几何结构可实现非阿贝尔几何相位，区别于非拓扑的Y型结。；创新点：在相互作用近藤体系中实现了对非阿贝尔任意子的相干控制，突破了传统无费米子平台（如自由费米子体系）的限制，并区分了非拓扑与拓扑Y型结几何结构。
papers.method_zh: 采用紧致化格点模型（compactified lattice models）进行理论分析，通过构造特定几何结构（如Y型结）研究马约拉纳零模的量子操控。

papers.title: Robust AI-Driven Discovery of Electronic Metal Phosphide Semiconductors
papers.abstract: Metal phosphides have diverse bonding motifs and coordination environments, making them promising for optoelectronic and thermoelectric applications, but their chemical space remains underexplored. Here we report an AI-driven high-throughput discovery workflow that combines generative materials design, machine-learning interatomic potentials, and targeted density functional theory (DFT) calculations. ICSD-derived Wyckoff-site substitution and MatterGen-based conditional structure generation are used to expand the candidate space beyond existing phosphide databases. A domain-finetuned DPA3 machine-learning potential then enables efficient prescreening of thermodynamic and dynamical stability before DFT validation. This workflow identifies 3,574 previously unreported stable phosphide structures, including 196 semiconductors with HSE06 band gaps of 0-3.0 eV. By screening these new semiconductors together with experimentally known phosphide semiconductors, we identify 30 promising optoelectronic candidates and 26 promising thermoelectric candidates, including seven newly discovered optoelectronic materials and eight newly discovered thermoelectric materials. These results provide a candidate pool for experimental synthesis and show that combining generative AI with machine-learning interatomic potentials can accelerate the discovery of functional semiconductor materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：AI-driven high-throughput discovery, machine-learning interatomic potentials, density functional theory (DFT) calculations）；研究对象：电子金属磷化物半导体（Electronic Metal Phosphide Semiconductors），具体为通过AI方法预测的、具有光电和热电应用潜力的新型磷化物材料。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过结合生成式AI与机器学习原子间势能，该工作发现了3,574种此前未报道的稳定磷化物结构，并从中筛选出196种带隙在0-3.0 eV的半导体，最终识别出30种有前景的光电候选材料和26种有前景的热电候选材料，其中包括7种新发现的光电材料和8种新发现的热电材料。

papers.title: Finite-temperature Fe K-edge X-ray absorption simulations reveal local structural dynamics of an iron(II) photosensitizer in solution and the crystalline phase
papers.abstract: Interpreting metal K-edge spectra of flexible photosensitizers requires a structural model that separates electronic signatures from thermal motion, solvent disorder, and crystal-packing effects. We combine Fe K-edge X-ray absorption measurements with second-generation Car--Parrinello ab initio molecular dynamics and all-electron Gaussian and augmented-plane-wave simulations for an iron(II) N-heterocyclic carbene photosensitizer in acetonitrile solution and in the crystalline phase. Ensemble-averaged spectra reproduce the main near-edge features in both environments and preserve the experimentally observed similarity of the first Fe coordination shell upon dissolution. Comparison with radial distributions extracted from extended fine-structure measurements validates the Fe--N and Fe--C coordination shells sampled by the trajectories, while element-resolved pair distributions explain why higher-shell experimental contrast is rapidly lost. The same dynamical ensembles reveal a broad out-of-plane distribution of the terpyridine nitrogen atom and a nearly octahedral distribution of the Fe-centered coordination planes. The results show that finite-temperature X-ray absorption simulations can provide a compact structural-dynamics picture of molecular transition metal photosensitizers by linking local spectra, solvent-phase ligand motion, and medium-range structural disorder within one trajectory-based description.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。关键词：X-ray absorption measurements、Car–Parrinello ab initio molecular dynamics、all-electron Gaussian and augmented-plane-wave simulations。；研究对象：一种铁(II) N-杂环卡宾光敏剂在乙腈溶液和晶相中的局域结构动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 有限温度下的X射线吸收模拟能够通过单一基于轨迹的描述，将局域光谱、溶剂相配体运动和中程结构无序联系起来，从而提供过渡金属光敏剂的紧凑结构动力学图像。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：有限温度下的X射线吸收模拟能够通过单一基于轨迹的描述，将局域光谱、溶剂相配体运动和中程结构无序联系起来，从而提供过渡金属光敏剂的紧凑结构动力学图像。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段：Fe K边X射线吸收测量（包括近边和扩展精细结构）。计算方法：第二代Car–Parrinello从头算分子动力学、全电子高斯与增广平面波模拟。

papers.title: Graphlet Histogram Representation Database of Inorganic Crystals
papers.abstract: Machine learning models for materials property prediction increasingly rely on representations learned end-to-end from large density-functional-theory databases, limiting their applicability when only scarce experimental data are available. Domain-knowledge-driven representations precomputed from crystal structures alone offer a data-efficient, interpretable alternative, but existing approaches capture at most composition or bonding connectivity and discard local structural geometry. Here, we present Graphlet-MP, a database of graphlet histogram representations for 149,082 inorganic crystals from the Materials Project (MP). Seventy-nine distributions describe each material over three hierarchical graphlet orders: atomic sites, bonded pairs, and bond-angle triplets, extracted via screened Voronoi tessellation from the crystallographic information file. We provide a complete technical specification of the representation, an Earth Mover's Distance metric for comparing materials in this space, and the full precomputed database. An accompanying open-source codebase enables users to generate graphlet histograms for arbitrary crystal structures, including experimentally determined ones, and to extend the database to new materials or target properties.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/数据驱动文章。判断依据：关键词为“machine learning models”、“density-functional-theory databases”、“precomputed database”、“open-source codebase”。；研究对象：无机晶体材料的结构表示方法，具体为基于图元直方图（graphlet histogram）的晶体结构描述符数据库，涵盖149,082种来自Materials Project的无机晶体。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种基于图元直方图的晶体结构表示方法（Graphlet-MP），通过三个层次（原子位点、成键对、键角三元组）的79种分布描述晶体结构，并构建了完整数据库，为材料性质预测提供了一种数据高效、可解释的替代方案。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种基于图元直方图的晶体结构表示方法（Graphlet-MP），通过三个层次（原子位点、成键对、键角三元组）的79种分布描述晶体结构，并构建了完整数据库，为材料性质预测提供了一种数据高效、可解释的替代方案。；创新点：与现有仅捕捉组成或键连性的方法不同，该工作通过图元直方图保留了局部结构几何信息，并提供了完整的预计算数据库和可扩展的开源代码，支持任意晶体结构（包括实验测定结构）的表示生成。
papers.method_zh: 采用筛选后的Voronoi镶嵌（screened Voronoi tessellation）从晶体学信息文件（CIF）中提取结构信息，生成三个层次（原子位点、成键对、键角三元组）的图元直方图表示；使用推土机距离（Earth Mover’s Distance）作为材料间相似性度量；提供预计算数据库及开源代码库。

papers.title: Pressure-Driven Structural Phase Competition and Functional Response in Layered LiInP2S6
papers.abstract: Understanding how hydrostatic pressure modifies interlayer interactions and competing ionic configurations is essential for controlling the emergent functional properties of layered quantum materials. Here, using first-principles density-functional theory calculations, we investigate the pressure-dependent structural, mechanical, electronic, and optical properties of three competing LiInP2S6 polymorphs: the monoclinic C2/c phase and the trigonal P-31c phase in both in-layer and in-gap configurations. Our results reveal a pressure-induced structural phase transition from the monoclinic ground-state C2/c phase to a trigonal P-31c in-layer phase at ~0.38 GPa, driven by enhanced interlayer coupling and anisotropic lattice compression. In contrast, the trigonal P-31c in-gap phase remains energetically unfavorable due to its stronger interlayer ionic interactions and reduced compressibility. All phases remain mechanically stable under compression (0-26 GPa) and exhibit enhanced mechanical rigidity, elastic wave velocities, and Debye temperatures with increasing pressure. Remarkably, the electronic and optical properties within each phase remain highly robust under pressure, with only moderate changes in the band gap and optical absorption edge (UV-Visible range) under pressure; however, substantial modifications emerge across the pressure-induced structural phase transition. These findings establish LiInP2S6 as a pressure sensitive ionic-vdW material in which subtle changes in interlayer interactions govern structural stability and functional properties.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：first-principles density-functional theory calculations（第一性原理密度泛函理论计算）。；研究对象：层状材料LiInP2S6的三种竞争多型（polymorphs）：单斜C2/c相、三角P-31c相（包括层内构型和层间间隙构型），以及压力诱导的结构相变与功能响应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在约0.38 GPa压力下，LiInP2S6从单斜C2/c基态相转变为三角P-31c层内相，该相变由增强的层间耦合和各向异性晶格压缩驱动；各相在0-26 GPa范围内保持力学稳定，电子和光学性质在相变前后发生显著变化，但在同一相内对压力高度鲁棒。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在约0.38 GPa压力下，LiInP2S6从单斜C2/c基态相转变为三角P-31c层内相，该相变由增强的层间耦合和各向异性晶格压缩驱动；各相在0-26 GPa范围内保持力学稳定，电子和光学性质在相变前后发生显著变化，但在同一相内对压力高度鲁棒。；创新点：揭示了LiInP2S6作为压力敏感的离子-范德华（ionic-vdW）材料，其层间相互作用的微小变化即可调控结构稳定性与功能性质，并首次明确了低压下（~0.38 GPa）的竞争相变路径。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理密度泛函理论（DFT）计算，用于研究压力依赖的结构、力学、电子和光学性质。

papers.title: Microscopic Investigation of the Superconducting State in CuCo$_{2}$S$_{4}$: Evidence for an Intermediate-Coupling Fully Gapped Superconductor
papers.abstract: The thiospinel compound CuCo$_2$S$_4$ provides an attractive platform for exploring superconductivity in transition-metal chalcogenide spinels. Here, we report the first microscopic investigation of the superconducting state in CuCo$_2$S$_4$ using muon spin rotation and relaxation ($μ$SR) measurements, complemented by magnetization and heat-capacity experiments. The temperature dependence of the superconducting depolarization rate obtained from transverse-field $μ$SR measurements indicates a fully gapped superconducting order parameter. The extracted gap ratio $2Δ(0)/(k_{\mathrm{B}}T_\mathrm{SC}) = 3.95(2)$ exceeds the BCS weak-coupling value of 3.53, placing CuCo$_2$S$_4$ in the intermediate electron-phonon coupling regime. Zero-field $μ$SR measurements were performed to probe possible time-reversal symmetry breaking (TRSB) in the superconducting state. Within the experimental resolution, no additional spontaneous internal magnetic fields are observed below $T_c$. However, due to the presence of a ferromagnetic impurity phase and the associated fast-relaxing signal component, the sensitivity of the present measurements to weak spontaneous fields is reduced. Consequently, while no evidence for TRSB is detected, its existence cannot be definitively ruled out. Overall, our combined thermodynamic and $μ$SR results demonstrate that CuCo$_2$S$_4$ exhibits a fully gapped superconducting state with intermediate coupling strength, consistent with conventional $s$-wave superconductivity in this cobalt-based thiospinel system.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：muon spin rotation and relaxation (μSR) measurements、magnetization、heat-capacity experiments。；研究对象：硫尖晶石化合物 CuCo₂S₄ 的超导态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: CuCo₂S₄ 是一个完全能隙的超导体，其能隙比 2Δ(0)/(k_B T_SC) = 3.95(2) 超过 BCS 弱耦合值，属于中等电子-声子耦合强度；未观测到超导态中时间反演对称性破缺的证据，但受铁磁杂质相影响，无法完全排除其存在。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：CuCo₂S₄ 是一个完全能隙的超导体，其能隙比 2Δ(0)/(k_B T_SC) = 3.95(2) 超过 BCS 弱耦合值，属于中等电子-声子耦合强度；未观测到超导态中时间反演对称性破缺的证据，但受铁磁杂质相影响，无法完全排除其存在。；创新点：首次对 CuCo₂S₄ 超导态进行微观尺度的 μSR 研究，明确了其完全能隙和中等耦合特性，并初步探测了时间反演对称性破缺的可能性。
papers.method_zh: μ子自旋旋转与弛豫（μSR）测量（包括横向场和零场模式），辅以磁化强度测量和比热实验。
