papers.title: Beyond the Markovian limit: Exact solutions for active motion in a power-law viscoelastic bath
papers.abstract: Active particles from bacteria to synthetic microswimmers often navigate viscoelastic media with complex relaxation dynamics. The classical active Brownian model that assumes instantaneous friction is clearly not applicable to describe such motility, while the non-Markovian processes combined with viscoelasticity are relatively unexplored. Here, we develop an analytical theory for an active particle in a power-law viscoelastic medium by solving coupled non-Markovian generalized Langevin equations for translational and rotational degrees of freedom. The viscoelastic memory results in novel phenomena such as fractional short-time transport, enhanced long-time persistence, and de-correlation of the instantaneous force and the swimmer orientation. We demonstrate that the memory kernel controls the anomalous scaling exponents, while the activity determines the crossover between sub-diffusive, ballistic and diffusive regimes. Our work provides a framework for theoretical description of biological and synthetic micro swimmers in complex biological and polymeric environments.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：analytical theory、solving coupled non-Markovian generalized Langevin equations。；研究对象：在幂律粘弹性介质中运动的活性粒子（如细菌、合成微游动器），具体研究其非马尔可夫动力学行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 粘弹性记忆效应导致分数阶短时输运、增强的长时持久性以及瞬时力与游动方向之间的去关联；记忆核控制反常标度指数，活性决定亚扩散、弹道扩散与正常扩散之间的交叉行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：粘弹性记忆效应导致分数阶短时输运、增强的长时持久性以及瞬时力与游动方向之间的去关联；记忆核控制反常标度指数，活性决定亚扩散、弹道扩散与正常扩散之间的交叉行为。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 通过求解平动和转动自由度的耦合非马尔可夫广义朗之万方程，建立活性粒子在幂律粘弹性介质中的解析理论。

papers.title: Synthesis and Characterization of Atomically-Sharp Superconductor-Dielectric Interface
papers.abstract: Modification of superconductor-dielectric interfaces is known to strongly impact coherence times of superconducting quantum devices. This relationship is thought to arise from differences in the concentration of "two-level system" defects in the disordered dielectrics and superconductor-dielectric interfaces; these defects couple to electromagnetic modes in the device and cause dissipation. Zirconium oxide barrier layers on niobium have emerged as a promising pathway to low-loss interfaces in recent years, evidently due to the crystalline nature of these layers in comparison to the amorphous niobium native oxide. We explain the unique ability of zirconium oxide to form a crystalline layer, to maintain a sharp interface with metallic niobium, and to prevent niobium oxide re-growth in terms of the chemical properties of ZrO$_2$ and the Nb-Zr-O ternary system. We demonstrate a new method to grow air-stable zirconium oxide layers on niobium with a higher level of crystallinity and a sharper oxide-metal interface than previously shown, and provide the first comprehensive microscopic analysis of ZrO$_2$ capping layer properties. These developments pave the way toward vital performance advances in superconducting quantum devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“demonstrate a new method to grow...”、“provide the first comprehensive microscopic analysis”，涉及材料生长与表征。；研究对象：超导体-介电质界面，具体为铌（Nb）上生长的氧化锆（ZrO₂）覆盖层，以及该界面的原子级锐利性与晶体结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 氧化锆能够在铌表面形成晶体层、保持与金属铌的锐利界面、并阻止铌氧化物再生，这一能力源于ZrO₂的化学性质及Nb-Zr-O三元体系的特性。作者展示了比以往更高质量（更高结晶度、更锐利界面）的空气稳定氧化锆覆盖层生长方法。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：氧化锆能够在铌表面形成晶体层、保持与金属铌的锐利界面、并阻止铌氧化物再生，这一能力源于ZrO₂的化学性质及Nb-Zr-O三元体系的特性。作者展示了比以往更高质量（更高结晶度、更锐利界面）的空气稳定氧化锆覆盖层生长方法。；创新点：首次提供了ZrO₂覆盖层性质的全面微观分析，并实现了比以往更高结晶度、更锐利界面的氧化锆层生长，为理解其抑制超导量子器件退相干机制提供了关键材料学依据。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体表征手段，但提及“首次全面的微观分析”（first comprehensive microscopic analysis），暗示使用了高分辨率透射电镜（HRTEM）、X射线衍射（XRD）、X射线光电子能谱（XPS）等界面与薄膜表征技术。生长方法为一种新开发的工艺，具体细节摘要未展开。

papers.title: Predicting Defect States: A Quick Screening Protocol for Substitutional Point Defect Engineering
papers.abstract: Point defects in crystalline materials play a central role in determining electronic, optical, and magnetic properties. However, systematic exploration of defect configurations remains computationally expensive because large supercell calculations are required to approximate isolated defects under periodic boundary conditions. We present a unit-cell-based tight-binding protocol that enables rapid pre-screening of substitutional defects. The protocol extracts Wannier tight-binding Hamiltonians from small, fully relaxed unit cells of the host and defect-like systems, replicates the host Hamiltonian to construct a supercell model, and introduces the defect by modifying only the on-site energies at the substitution site while leaving the hopping parameters unchanged. We validate the protocol across three diverse systems: isostructural substitutional defects in transition-metal dichalcogenides (M$_\mathrm{Mo}$ MoS$_2$, M = Ce, Zr, Nb, Tc, and Ru), symmetry-breaking carbon substitutions in hexagonal boron nitride (C$_\mathrm{B}$C$_\mathrm{N}$ h-BN), and nitrogen-vacancy (NV$^-$) centers in diamond. These case studies span two-dimensional and three-dimensional hosts, simple substitutions, and substitution-vacancy complexes. In all cases, the protocol successfully captures the number of in-gap states, their degeneracies, and their shallow or deep character relative to host band edges, despite some quantitative deviations in absolute energy positions. We further identify limitations for vacancies of highly electronegative atoms and for charge-state or spin-polarization effects, both of which involve self-consistent charge redistribution not captured by the protocol.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：tight-binding protocol、Wannier tight-binding Hamiltonians、supercell model。；研究对象：晶体材料中的替代式点缺陷，具体包括过渡金属二硫族化物（M$_\mathrm{Mo}$ MoS₂，M = Ce, Zr, Nb, Tc, Ru）、六方氮化硼中的碳替代（C$_B$C$_N$ h-BN）以及金刚石中的氮-空位（NV⁻）中心。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种基于单胞的紧束缚预筛选协议，能够快速预测替代式点缺陷的能级数量、简并度以及相对于宿主带边的浅/深能级特征，尽管在绝对能量位置上存在定量偏差。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种基于单胞的紧束缚预筛选协议，能够快速预测替代式点缺陷的能级数量、简并度以及相对于宿主带边的浅/深能级特征，尽管在绝对能量位置上存在定量偏差。；创新点：提出了一种无需大超胞计算即可快速预筛选替代式点缺陷的协议，显著降低了计算成本，并在多种二维和三维宿主材料中验证了其有效性。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 从完全弛豫的小型宿主和类缺陷单胞中提取Wannier紧束缚哈密顿量，复制宿主哈密顿量构建超胞模型，仅修改替代位点的在位能（on-site energies）而不改变跳跃参数（hopping parameters）来引入缺陷。

papers.title: Correlation-driven phonon renormalisation and the equation of state of $γ$-cerium
papers.abstract: We investigate the thermodynamic properties of elemental cerium by assessing the crucial role of phonon free energy within the framework of dynamical mean-field theory (DMFT). While conventional density functional theory (DFT) often fails to capture the intricate energy landscape of $f$-electron materials, our approach integrates many-body electronic correlations with lattice dynamics to achieve a more rigorous description of the equation of state. We calculate the total energy as a function of the lattice constant at both the DFT and DFT+DMFT levels, subsequently incorporating the vibrational free energy derived from the phonon density of states. Our findings reveal that electronic renormalisation of the force constants significantly alters the phonon spectra, particularly in the strongly correlated $γ$-phase. By applying these phonon corrections to the energy profiles, we observe a substantial refinement in the predicted equilibrium volumes. Using principal-component-based machine learning, we interpolate phonon dispersions continuously from a finite set of first-principles calculations and compare them to experiment, finding significantly closer agreement compared to conventional DFT and DFT+U calculations that neglect dynamical many-body correlations. This study underlines the necessity of accounting for both electronic and vibrational entropy when evaluating the phase stability and structural transitions of lanthanide systems under varying pressures and temperatures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：dynamical mean-field theory (DMFT)、density functional theory (DFT)、first-principles calculations、machine learning。；研究对象：元素铈（cerium）的γ相（γ-phase），具体研究其热力学性质、声子谱重整化以及状态方程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 电子关联效应会显著重整化γ-铈的力常数和声子谱，将由此得到的声子自由能修正加入总能后，能大幅改善对平衡体积的预测，且与实验的吻合度优于忽略动力学多体关联的常规DFT和DFT+U计算。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：电子关联效应会显著重整化γ-铈的力常数和声子谱，将由此得到的声子自由能修正加入总能后，能大幅改善对平衡体积的预测，且与实验的吻合度优于忽略动力学多体关联的常规DFT和DFT+U计算。；创新点：在DMFT框架下同时考虑了电子多体关联与晶格动力学，揭示了电子关联驱动的声子重整化对γ-铈状态方程的关键影响，并引入机器学习方法实现声子色散的连续插值。
papers.method_zh: 采用DFT和DFT+DMFT两种层次计算总能随晶格常数的变化，再结合从声子态密度导出的振动自由能；利用基于主成分分析的机器学习方法，从有限的第一性原理计算数据连续插值得到声子色散，并与实验对比。

papers.title: Atomic-scale visualization of the toroidal order in a trimeric Dy(III) single-molecule toroic
papers.abstract: Single-molecule toroics (SMTs) offer a unique platform for next-generation quantum devices utilizing head-to-tail spin alignments in the compounds. Presence of toroidal moments in SMTs has been essentially based on magnetometry and ab initio calculations. Here, we report observation and probe of the toroidal moment in [Dy3(OH)(teaH2)3(paa)3]Cl(OMe) [teaH3: triethanolamine; paaH: N-(2-pyridyl)-acetoacetamide] from mapping of Dy3+ magnetic susceptibility tensors by polarized neutron diffraction (PND). Neutron diffraction under variable magnetic fields demonstrates field-induced magnetization along the c-axis with toroidal moments anti-parallelly stacked, providing definite proof of the toroidal moment. Magnetometry studies confirm the toroidal ground state. For the first time, the combined use of PND, variable-field neutron diffraction, ab initio calculations, and magnetometry is introduced as a robust and quantitative methodology to probe molecular-scale toroidal magnetism. This integrated approach overcomes limitations of earlier indirect methods, establishes a benchmark framework for investigating SMTs, and provides valuable insights for the design of molecular quantum materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：polarized neutron diffraction, variable-field neutron diffraction, magnetometry, ab initio calculations）；研究对象：三核镝(III)单分子环磁体（[Dy₃(OH)(teaH₂)₃(paa)₃]Cl(OMe)）中的环状磁有序（toroidal order）
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过极化中子衍射直接观测到Dy³⁺离子磁化率张量的环状排列，并结合变场中子衍射证实了环状磁矩沿c轴反平行堆叠，从而首次提供了单分子环磁体中环状磁矩的明确实验证据。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过极化中子衍射直接观测到Dy³⁺离子磁化率张量的环状排列，并结合变场中子衍射证实了环状磁矩沿c轴反平行堆叠，从而首次提供了单分子环磁体中环状磁矩的明确实验证据。；创新点：首次将极化中子衍射、变场中子衍射、从头计算和磁强测量四种方法联合使用，建立了一种定量且可靠的分子尺度环状磁性探测方法，克服了以往间接方法的局限性。
papers.method_zh: 极化中子衍射（PND）、变场中子衍射、从头计算（ab initio calculations）、磁强测量（magnetometry）

papers.title: Jittery Quantum Boomerang Effect
papers.abstract: We study the dynamics of a spin-polarized wave packet in a disordered Rashba two-dimensional electron gas and identify a jittery quantum boomerang effect in which longitudinal and transverse motion return to the origin through fundamentally distinct mechanisms. Starting from an initial state with finite momentum along $x$ and spin polarized along $z$, we calculate the time evolution by combining a Chebyshev expansion of the time-evolution operator with a disorder ensemble average. In the weak-scattering regime, equations of motion derived from the quantum kinetic equation reproduce the numerical trends and show that impurity scattering acts as a viscous damping mechanism that suppresses the transient Zitterbewegung and drives the transverse displacement back to $y=0$ at long times. In contrast, the longitudinal dynamics show a Drude-like saturation at weak disorder. These results are consistent with the vanishing intrinsic spin Hall conductivity in the disordered Rashba model and with experimental observations of a transient intrinsic spin Hall effect in the time-domain. As disorder increases, the longitudinal dynamics evolve to a partial return toward the origin, which signals a transition from weak antilocalization to Anderson localization in 2D.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：Chebyshev expansion、quantum kinetic equation、disorder ensemble average。；研究对象：无序Rashba二维电子气中自旋极化波包的动力学行为，具体研究纵向与横向运动中的“抖动量子回旋镖效应”。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在弱散射条件下，纵向与横向运动通过根本不同的机制返回原点：横向位移由杂质散射作为粘性阻尼抑制瞬态Zitterbewegung并驱动回零，而纵向位移呈现Drude型饱和；随无序增强，纵向动力学演变为部分回零，标志着从弱反局域化到二维安德森局域化的转变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在弱散射条件下，纵向与横向运动通过根本不同的机制返回原点：横向位移由杂质散射作为粘性阻尼抑制瞬态Zitterbewegung并驱动回零，而纵向位移呈现Drude型饱和；随无序增强，纵向动力学演变为部分回零，标志着从弱反局域化到二维安德森局域化的转变。；创新点：首次在无序Rashba二维电子气中识别出“抖动量子回旋镖效应”，并揭示纵向与横向回零机制的本质区别，同时将纵向部分回零与弱反局域化-安德森局域化转变联系起来。
papers.method_zh: 采用Chebyshev展开时间演化算符结合无序系综平均进行数值计算，并基于量子动力学方程推导运动方程以解释数值趋势。

papers.title: Dominant in-plane anomalous Hall effect in a monoclinic room-temperature ferromagnet
papers.abstract: Ferromagnetic metals are characterized by enhanced dissipationless transverse transport responses via the anomalous Hall effect, offering a route towards magnetic sensing and spintronic readout functionalities. In most ferromagnets, the anomalous Hall current is constrained to lie in the plane perpendicular to the magnetization (or applied magnetic field). Recently, it has been recognized that selected symmetries can also permit a Hall response in a traditionally forbidden configuration, where the Hall current lies in the same plane as the magnetization, realizing an in-plane anomalous Hall effect. Reported realizations of this effect, however, are typically much weaker than the conventional Hall response in the same material. Here, through engineering specific crystallographic mirror symmetry-breaking, we realize a strongly enhanced in-plane anomalous Hall response in monoclinic Cr3Te4 with room-temperature ferromagnetism. Remarkably, the in-plane anomalous Hall signal exceeds the out-of-plane response by a factor of five, with which we demonstrate a unique in-plane field and current sensing functionality. Combined with density functional theory calculations, our results establish low-crystalline-symmetry ferromagnets with near-Fermi-level Weyl points as a practical platform for symmetry-engineered Hall responses, and point to a route towards room-temperature, geometry-flexible sensing devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（辅以计算）。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了实验实现（“we realize a strongly enhanced in-plane anomalous Hall response”），并提及结合了密度泛函理论计算（“Combined with density functional theory calculations”）。；研究对象：单斜晶系室温铁磁体 Cr₃Te₄ 中的面内反常霍尔效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过工程化特定晶体镜面对称性的破缺，在单斜晶系室温铁磁体 Cr₃Te₄ 中实现了显著增强的面内反常霍尔效应，其信号强度是传统面外反常霍尔效应的五倍。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过工程化特定晶体镜面对称性的破缺，在单斜晶系室温铁磁体 Cr₃Te₄ 中实现了显著增强的面内反常霍尔效应，其信号强度是传统面外反常霍尔效应的五倍。；创新点：首次在室温铁磁体中实现了远超传统面外响应的面内反常霍尔效应（增强五倍），并展示了其独特的平面内场和电流传感功能，为低对称性铁磁体在几何灵活传感器件中的应用开辟了道路。
papers.method_zh: 实验上通过材料合成实现特定晶体对称性破缺，测量了反常霍尔效应；理论上结合了密度泛函理论（DFT）计算，分析了能带结构（特别是费米能级附近的Weyl点）与对称性工程化霍尔响应的关联。

papers.title: Distribution of Majorana modes in the extended-range Kitaev chain
papers.abstract: The topological properties of the Kitaev chain model with extended-range interactions are investigated, focusing on cases where the topological winding number is preserved. We assume that the pairing and hopping terms decay algebraically in space with exponents $α$ and $β$, respectively. We show that in the truncated-range scenario, there are as many distinct topological phases as the number of coupled neighboring sites. In addition, an explicit analytical formulation is provided to evaluate the topological invariant and the phase transitions that emerge in these systems. Besides the analytical description, we introduce a new physical insight into the topological excitations of the ground-state by measuring the spatial distribution of the edge modes with the Majorana average position. Taking the next-nearest neighbor Kitaev chains as a probe, various numerical calculations of Majorana edge states were performed in finite-size clusters to determine the sensitivity of the topological zero energy modes to the parameters of interest. The occupation of edge-to-edge non-local fermion states is computed and defined as an effective parity. Such an effective parity exhibits new interesting features beyond the energetic exchange from the ground-state fermion parity switches, which are related to the distribution of the respective edge modes. Our calculations show a direct correlation between the ground-state fermion parity and the edge occupation numbers, which are translated into localization and delocalization of the Majorana average position.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：拓扑性质、解析公式、数值计算、拓扑不变量）；研究对象：具有扩展相互作用的Kitaev链模型，具体研究配对和跳跃项在空间上呈代数衰减（指数α和β）时，拓扑马约拉纳模的分布。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在截断范围相互作用下，拓扑相的数量等于耦合近邻格点数；基态费米子宇称与边缘占据数之间存在直接关联，这反映在马约拉纳平均位置的局域化与退局域化上。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在截断范围相互作用下，拓扑相的数量等于耦合近邻格点数；基态费米子宇称与边缘占据数之间存在直接关联，这反映在马约拉纳平均位置的局域化与退局域化上。；创新点：引入马约拉纳平均位置作为刻画基态拓扑激发空间分布的新物理量；发现有效宇称在基态费米子宇称切换的能量交换之外展现出新的特征，并与边缘模的分布直接相关。
papers.method_zh: 解析推导拓扑不变量和相变条件；通过马约拉纳平均位置测量边缘模的空间分布；在有限尺寸团簇上对次近邻Kitaev链进行数值计算，分析拓扑零能模对参数的敏感性；计算边缘-边缘非局域费米子态的占据数并定义为有效宇称。

papers.title: Exactly solvable non-planar $\mathbb{Z}_{2}$ dimer liquids on checkerboard and ruby lattices
papers.abstract: We generalize an influential framework for exactly solvable quantum dimer models with dual Ising gauge theory descriptions realizing the $\mathbb{Z}_{2}$ topological phase from trivalent to tetravalent parent lattices. The resulting quantum dimer models live on crossed-medial lattices and possess the remarkable feature of having crossed plaquettes, leading to transition graphs with generically intersecting loops. This non-planar structure runs counter to established templates for analytically tractable dimer liquids. As the simplest realization of the construction, we introduce an exactly solvable quantum dimer model on the checkerboard lattice that allows an exact mapping to the toric code, thus providing a particularly direct connection between the latter and Anderson's short range resonating valence bond paradigm. We further show that a corresponding crossed ruby lattice construction, dual to an Ising gauge theory on the kagome lattice, naturally falls within the same framework. More generally, the construction gives rise to a broad class of exactly solvable crossed-medial quantum dimer models and admits natural iteration, generating cascades of solvable $\mathbb{Z}_{2}$ topological dimer liquids beyond the standard planar setting. We furthermore extend Kasteleyn methods to the relevant non-planar graphs, enabling controlled wave-function deformations away from the commuting-projector points while retaining efficient evaluation of correlation functions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：exactly solvable、dual Ising gauge theory、generalize framework、Kasteleyn methods。；研究对象：量子二聚体模型（quantum dimer models），具体在棋盘格（checkerboard）和红宝石（ruby）晶格上实现的非平面 \(\mathbb{Z}_2\) 二聚体液滴（non-planar \(\mathbb{Z}_2\) dimer liquids）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该工作将可精确求解的量子二聚体模型从三配位母晶格推广到四配位母晶格，构建了具有交叉plaquette的非平面结构模型，并首次在棋盘格晶格上实现了与toric code的直接精确映射，建立了与Anderson短程共振价键（RVB）图像的直接联系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该工作将可精确求解的量子二聚体模型从三配位母晶格推广到四配位母晶格，构建了具有交叉plaquette的非平面结构模型，并首次在棋盘格晶格上实现了与toric code的直接精确映射，建立了与Anderson短程共振价键（RVB）图像的直接联系。；创新点：1. 突破了传统可解二聚体液滴模型必须基于平面结构的限制，引入了非平面交叉plaquette结构。2. 在棋盘格晶格上实现了与toric code的直接精确映射，提供了从toric code到Anderson RVB范式的特别直接的联系。3. 提出了可自然迭代的构造方法，生成超越标准平面设置的一系列可解 \(\mathbb{Z}_2\) 拓扑二聚体液滴级联。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：基于对偶Ising规范场论描述的可精确求解量子二聚体模型框架；推广了Kasteleyn方法以处理相关的非平面图，从而允许在保持关联函数高效计算的前提下，对波函数进行远离对易投影子点的可控形变。

papers.title: Fabry-Perot Interference, g-factor Anisotropy, and Gate-Tunable Quantum dot in Chiral Tellurium Nanowires
papers.abstract: Chiral materials with strong spin-orbit coupling offer a unique platform for exploring the interplay between topology, chirality, and quantum transport yet the quantum coherent regime in elemental tellurium nanostructures remains largely unexplored. Here we demonstrate phase-coherent quasi-ballistic transport, anisotropic Zeeman spectroscopy, and gate-tunable quantum dot formation in hydrothermally grown t-tellurium nanowires. Single nanowire field-effect transistors exhibit p-type transport with hole mobilities rising from approx. 80 cm2 V-1 s-1 at 210 K to approx. 190 cm2 V-1 s-1 at 1 K, consistent with a crossover from phonon-limited to Coulomb scattering dominated regimes near 50 K. Notably, devices segregate into two distinct regimes based on their room temperature two-terminal resistance : low-resistance devices (< 30 kOhm) exhibit Fabry-Perot interference, whereas high resistance devices (> 30 kOhm) display Coulomb-blockade behavior revealing a two-terminal resistance-driven transition between quasi-ballistic and strongly localized transport regimes. Zeeman spectroscopy in in-plane and out-of-plane magnetic fields yields highly anisotropic Lande g-factors (an in-plane gparallel = 1.18 and an out-of-plane gperp = 18.41) and directly resolves a spin-orbit energy gap DeltaSO = 0.864 meV from an avoided crossing. These results establish chiral tellurium nanowires as a versatile platform for gate-defined spin qubits exploiting large, tunable g-factors and for hybrid tellurium-superconductor architectures targeting Majorana zero modes in an elemental vdW system.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：demonstrate、exhibit、yields、directly resolves（均为实验观测与表征用语）。；研究对象：手性碲（t-tellurium）纳米线中的准弹道输运、各向异性塞曼谱学、以及栅极可调量子点。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在碲纳米线中观测到由两端电阻驱动的准弹道输运（Fabry-Perot干涉）与强局域输运（库仑阻塞）之间的转变，并解析出高度各向异性的朗德g因子（面内g∥=1.18，面外g⊥=18.41）以及自旋轨道能隙ΔSO=0.864 meV。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在碲纳米线中观测到由两端电阻驱动的准弹道输运（Fabry-Perot干涉）与强局域输运（库仑阻塞）之间的转变，并解析出高度各向异性的朗德g因子（面内g∥=1.18，面外g⊥=18.41）以及自旋轨道能隙ΔSO=0.864 meV。；创新点：首次在元素碲纳米线中实现相位相干准弹道输运，并揭示电阻驱动的输运机制转变；直接解析出高度各向异性的g因子和自旋轨道能隙，为基于碲纳米线的栅控自旋量子比特和超导-碲混合体系（如马约拉纳零模）提供了实验基础。
papers.method_zh: 水热法生长碲纳米线；单纳米线场效应晶体管电输运测量（变温迁移率分析、两端电阻分类）；面内/面外磁场下的塞曼谱学（提取g因子与自旋轨道能隙）；栅极调控量子点形成。

papers.title: Quantum-geometric origin of superfluid weight in quasicrystals with critical states
papers.abstract: A distinctive feature of many quasiperiodic systems is the presence of critical states that are neither extended nor exponentially localized. We investigate the geometric effect on the superfluid weight in quasiperiodic systems with critical states at zero temperature. We employ both real-space and momentum-space approaches to superfluid weight in quasicrystals, which allows us to separate the conventional and quantum geometric contributions. We find that the superfluid weight is dominated by the geometric contribution in quasiperiodic systems with critical states. This finding reveals a fundamental interplay between superconductivity and critical states in quasicrystals.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“investigate the geometric effect”、“employ both real-space and momentum-space approaches”，属于理论分析框架。；研究对象：准晶中具有临界态（critical states）的准周期系统，以及其超流重量（superfluid weight）的量子几何起源。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在具有临界态的准周期系统中，超流重量主要由量子几何贡献（quantum geometric contribution）主导，揭示了准晶中超导与临界态之间的基本相互作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在具有临界态的准周期系统中，超流重量主要由量子几何贡献（quantum geometric contribution）主导，揭示了准晶中超导与临界态之间的基本相互作用。；创新点：首次在准晶临界态体系中明确区分并指出超流重量的量子几何贡献占主导地位，揭示了临界态与超导性的几何起源关联。
papers.method_zh: 采用实空间（real-space）和动量空间（momentum-space）两种方法计算准晶中的超流重量，并分离出常规贡献与量子几何贡献。

papers.title: Anatomy of fast current-induced skyrmion motion in synthetic antiferromagnets
papers.abstract: The high mobility of current-driven skyrmions in synthetic antiferromagnets (SAFs) is widely explained by the macroscopic suppression of the skyrmion Hall effect through gyrotropic force compensation. This established view, however, overlooks a concurrent and significant reduction in the Gilbert damping parameter α, a key factor in the Thiele equation governing skyrmion velocity. Here, we show that this damping attenuation originates from a reconfigured magnon-electron scattering landscape. Using a microscopic s-d model, we demonstrate that the strong antiferromagnetic interlayer Ruderman-Kittel-Kasuya-Yosida (RKKY) exchange coupling in SAFs increases the magnonic gap of skyrmion collective modes, thereby suppressing the thermal magnon population and, consequently, the magnon-electron scattering rate that dominates damping in metallic ferromagnets. Our work establishes a dual-mechanism framework to fully explain the superior kinetics of SAF skyrmions: the macroscopic topological effect rectifies the motion direction, while the microscopic dissipation mechanism reduces the drag. This synergy enables high-speed and efficient motion, providing a fundamental elucidation of the enhanced mobility reported in recent studies such as the work by Pham et al. [Science 384, 307-312 (2024)].
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“使用微观s-d模型”、“建立双机制框架”等理论推导和模型构建关键词，未提及实验数据或计算模拟。；研究对象：合成反铁磁体（SAFs）中电流驱动斯格明子的高速运动机制，具体关注其阻尼参数降低的微观起源。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 合成反铁磁体中斯格明子高速运动的根源不仅在于宏观拓扑效应（斯格明子霍尔效应的抑制），还在于微观耗散机制：强层间RKKY交换耦合增大了斯格明子集体模式的磁振子能隙，抑制了热磁振子布居，从而降低了主导金属铁磁体阻尼的磁振子-电子散射率。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：合成反铁磁体中斯格明子高速运动的根源不仅在于宏观拓扑效应（斯格明子霍尔效应的抑制），还在于微观耗散机制：强层间RKKY交换耦合增大了斯格明子集体模式的磁振子能隙，抑制了热磁振子布居，从而降低了主导金属铁磁体阻尼的磁振子-电子散射率。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用微观s-d模型，理论分析合成反铁磁体中RKKY交换耦合对磁振子-电子散射景观的重构，并结合Thiele方程讨论阻尼参数α的降低。

papers.title: Computing phase diagrams using a convex hull algorithm
papers.abstract: We present a simple universal computational algorithm for computing compositional phase diagrams of rocks and their melts at given temperature and pressure. It makes use of the mathematical concept of the convex hull of a set of points in the space spanned by the composition and the Gibbs free energy. All the complexities of determining the stability or separation of phases, the localization and orientation of tie lines, as well as the determination of characteristic points, curves and surfaces such as the solidus, liquidus, solvus, and the eutectic/peritectic points etc, are taken care of by the algorithm that computes the convex hull, supplemented with an algorithm to physically classify the resulting simplices. For the convex hull computation, the publicly available Qhull package can be used, which is available in SciPy. This makes this method accessible and intuitive for a broad set of scientific and educational applications. Although the method is not practical for systems of a large number of components, it is remarkably stable and efficient for systems of up to four. We present our implementation of the method as a publicly available Python package.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：computational algorithm、convex hull、Python package。；研究对象：岩石及其熔体的成分相图（compositional phase diagrams），即在给定温度和压力下，多组分体系的相平衡与相分离行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种基于凸包（convex hull）算法的通用计算方法，能够自动确定相图中固相线、液相线、溶线、共晶/包晶点等特征，无需手动处理相稳定性或相分离的复杂判断。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种基于凸包（convex hull）算法的通用计算方法，能够自动确定相图中固相线、液相线、溶线、共晶/包晶点等特征，无需手动处理相稳定性或相分离的复杂判断。；创新点：将凸包算法系统性地应用于岩石及其熔体的成分相图计算，使相图构建过程自动化、直观化，适用于最多四组分体系，且对教育和科研应用具有较好的可及性。摘要未突出说明与已有相图计算方法的定量对比。
papers.method_zh: 利用成分与吉布斯自由能张成空间中的凸包数学概念，结合公开的Qhull包（集成于SciPy）进行凸包计算，并辅以物理分类算法对所得单纯形（simplices）进行物理解释。作者将实现方法以公开Python包形式发布。

papers.title: Quantum Otto and Carnot Cycles via Skew Ising Model
papers.abstract: We investigate the thermodynamic performance of quantum heat engines and refrigerators based on a two-spin system subject to a skew magnetic field. The working substance is described by an interacting spin model that incorporates both spin--spin coupling and anisotropy induced by a tilted magnetic field. We analyze and compare quantum Carnot and Otto cycles, showing that the Carnot cycle exhibits a universal, entropy-driven behavior with smooth phase boundaries, while the Otto cycle displays a much richer structure governed by the interplay between the energy spectrum and nonequilibrium population differences. In particular, we identify a crossover in both efficiency and coefficient of performance as a function of the interaction strength, which arises from the competition between the interaction energy scale and the magnetic field. We further demonstrate that the skew angle induces state hybridization, modifying both the energy levels and occupation probabilities. Our results highlight that interactions and anisotropy, when properly tuned, can enhance thermodynamic performance, and emphasize the importance of multi-level effects in the design of quantum thermal machines.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“investigate”“analyze”“demonstrate”等理论分析词汇，未提及实验或计算模拟方法。；研究对象：基于倾斜磁场下两自旋系统（skew Ising model）的量子热机和制冷机，具体为量子奥托循环和卡诺循环的热力学性能。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 卡诺循环表现出由熵驱动的普适行为和平滑的相边界，而奥托循环则展现出由能谱与非平衡布居差相互作用导致的更丰富结构；相互作用强度与磁场之间的竞争导致效率和性能系数出现交叉行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：卡诺循环表现出由熵驱动的普适行为和平滑的相边界，而奥托循环则展现出由能谱与非平衡布居差相互作用导致的更丰富结构；相互作用强度与磁场之间的竞争导致效率和性能系数出现交叉行为。；创新点：揭示了倾斜角度诱导的状态杂化对能级和占据概率的调控作用，并指出相互作用和各项异性（倾斜磁场）的适当调节可增强量子热机的热力学性能，强调了多能级效应在量子热机设计中的重要性。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析框架：基于倾斜磁场下两自旋相互作用的伊辛模型（skew Ising model），通过分析能谱、非平衡布居差、熵驱动行为等，对比量子卡诺循环与奥托循环的热力学性能。

papers.title: Algorithmic and Minimax Complexities in Kernel Bandits
papers.abstract: Gaussian-process upper confidence bound (GP-UCB) and decision-estimation-coefficient (DEC) methods may appear, at first sight, to belong to different theories. This paper places the two viewpoints in a common algorithmic-information language for frequentist RKHS bandits. GP-UCB fixes an algorithmic, rather than true, Gaussian-process prior and exploits realized-trajectory complexity together with computational tractability, whereas MAMS optimizes a robust class-wide MAIR/DEC envelope. Through the unified MAIR framework and heterogeneous positive-semidefinite algorithmic priors, we generalize both the GP-UCB analysis and the MAMS algorithm, propose a safeguarded master that combines their advantages, and provide a kernel-bandit construction showing that algorithmic complexity can be more informative than class-wide minimax or DEC certificates in overparameterized models. The resulting message is that algorithmic information and class-wide minimax coefficients answer different questions and can lead to different gaps; kernel bandits provide a clean setting in which this distinction becomes mathematically visible.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：algorithmic-information language、frequentist RKHS bandits、theoretical framework、analysis。；研究对象：核函数赌博机（kernel bandits）中的算法复杂度与极小极大复杂度。具体涉及高斯过程上置信界（GP-UCB）与决策估计系数（DEC）方法在再生核希尔伯特空间（RKHS）赌博机问题中的理论对比与统一。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 算法信息（algorithmic complexity）与类宽极小极大系数（class-wide minimax coefficients）回答不同的问题，在过参数化模型中算法复杂度可能比类宽极小极大或DEC证书提供更多信息；核函数赌博机为这一区别提供了清晰的数学展示。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：算法信息（algorithmic complexity）与类宽极小极大系数（class-wide minimax coefficients）回答不同的问题，在过参数化模型中算法复杂度可能比类宽极小极大或DEC证书提供更多信息；核函数赌博机为这一区别提供了清晰的数学展示。；创新点：将GP-UCB（基于固定算法先验与实现轨迹复杂度）与MAMS（基于鲁棒类宽MAIR/DEC包络）两种看似属于不同理论的方法置于统一的算法信息语言中，并证明算法复杂度与类宽极小极大复杂度之间存在可量化的差距。
papers.method_zh: 通过统一的MAIR（最大算法信息比）框架和异质半正定算法先验，对GP-UCB分析和MAMS算法进行推广，并提出一种结合两者优势的“受保护主算法”（safeguarded master）。采用核函数赌博机构造来展示算法复杂度的信息优势。

papers.title: The Yang-Baxter Equation for the Chiral Potts Model and Integrable Parafermions
papers.abstract: A new type of Yang-Baxter equation (YBE) for $R$-matrices parameterized by three spectral parameters is constructed from the star-triangle and star-star relations for the chiral Potts model. As the $Z_N$ symmetric generalization to the Ising model, its Boltzmann weights are known to depend on two variables describing a curve with genus larger than one for $N>2$, except for the self-dual point corresponding to the Fateev-Zamolodchikov chain. This combined with the fact that the quantum Hamiltonians of edge models like Ising contain both nearest neighbor interaction and onsite potential terms results in the extra spectral parameter of the $R$-operator. My construction extends the recent unification of solvable edge and vertex models which recasts Onsager's star-triangle relation from a mere alternative form of the YBE for edge models to its underlying ingredient.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要聚焦于构造新型Yang-Baxter方程、推广可积模型，属于数学物理理论推导，未涉及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：手征Potts模型及其对应的可积边缘模型（edge models），特别是其与Ising模型的Z_N对称推广，以及相关的parafermion系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过手征Potts模型的星-三角和星-星关系，构造了一种由三个谱参数参数化的新型Yang-Baxter方程，并指出该R-算符的额外谱参数源于边缘模型哈密顿量中同时包含最近邻相互作用和局域势项。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过手征Potts模型的星-三角和星-星关系，构造了一种由三个谱参数参数化的新型Yang-Baxter方程，并指出该R-算符的额外谱参数源于边缘模型哈密顿量中同时包含最近邻相互作用和局域势项。；创新点：将Onsager的星-三角关系从边缘模型Yang-Baxter方程的替代形式提升为其基础构成要素，并扩展了近期对可解边缘模型与顶点模型的统一化工作。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导：基于手征Potts模型的玻尔兹曼权重（依赖于描述亏格大于1的曲线的两个变量），利用星-三角和星-星关系重新表述并推广Yang-Baxter方程，统一了可解边缘模型与顶点模型。

papers.title: The UZH protocol: Separating errors and constructing improved CP2K basis sets and pseudopotentials
papers.abstract: Reliable density-functional simulations require numerical settings whose residual errors are smaller than the chemical and materials trends being interpreted. In CP2K/Quickstep, this requirement is complicated by the joint use of atom-centered Gaussian basis sets and norm-conserving pseudopotentials: a code-to-code discrepancy usually contains both contributions. We present the UZH protocol, a closed-loop CP2K workflow that calibrates molecularly optimized Gaussian basis sets on small molecules, validates the resulting settings in unary-crystal equation-of-state benchmarks, identifies whether the limiting approximation is the Gaussian basis or the pseudopotential. The diagnosis is then used to revise the parameter files. The central diagnostic is a three-way comparison between production CP2K-GTH-UZH calculations, SIRIUS calculations using the same Goedecker--Teter--Hutter pseudopotential in a systematic plane-wave representation, and all-electron full-potential linearized augmented-plane-wave SIRIUS references. This construction decomposes the practical CP2K error into a Gaussian-basis component and a pseudopotential component. The protocol distinguishes basis-limited noble-gas and heavy-element cases from pseudopotential-limited transition-metal cases, guides targeted revisions with the CP2K basis and pseudopotential optimizers, and produces improved MOLOPT basis sets and GTH pseudopotentials as explicit outputs of the workflow. The UZH protocol is therefore constructive: it does not merely measure or reduce errors a posteriori, but allows turning verification outliers into validated CP2K parameter files for simulations across molecules and condensed phases.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：density-functional simulations（密度泛函模拟）、CP2K/Quickstep、SIRIUS、plane-wave representation、all-electron full-potential linearized augmented-plane-wave。；研究对象：CP2K软件中联合使用的原子中心高斯基组和模守恒赝势的误差分离与参数优化。具体体系包括小分子、单质晶体（unary-crystal）的态方程基准测试，以及稀有气体、重元素和过渡金属元素。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了UZH协议，通过三路对比（CP2K-GTH-UZH计算、相同赝势的平面波SIRIUS计算、全势线性缀加平面波SIRIUS参考），将CP2K的实际计算误差分解为高斯基组误差和赝势误差，并据此定向优化参数文件，最终输出改进的MOLOPT基组和GTH赝势。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了UZH协议，通过三路对比（CP2K-GTH-UZH计算、相同赝势的平面波SIRIUS计算、全势线性缀加平面波SIRIUS参考），将CP2K的实际计算误差分解为高斯基组误差和赝势误差，并据此定向优化参数文件，最终输出改进的MOLOPT基组和GTH赝势。；创新点：提出了一种建设性的、闭环的误差分离与参数优化协议，不仅事后测量或减少误差，而是将验证中的异常值转化为经过验证的CP2K参数文件，适用于分子和凝聚相模拟。摘要未突出说明与已有基组/赝势优化方法的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 采用闭环CP2K工作流：1）在小分子上校准分子优化的高斯基组；2）在单质晶体态方程基准测试中验证设置；3）通过三路对比诊断限制性近似来源（高斯基组或赝势）；4）利用CP2K基组和赝势优化器进行定向修订。计算框架包括CP2K/Quickstep、SIRIUS（平面波表示）和全势线性缀加平面波SIRIUS参考。

papers.title: Revealing the topology of quantum states via Kirkwood-Dirac quasiprobabilities
papers.abstract: We discuss a theoretical approach to discriminate whether two states of a many-body quantum system belong or not to different topology classes. This approach is based on expressing a strange correlator - a recently established tool for quantum topology discrimination - between the states as a function of Kirkwood-Dirac quasiprobabilities (KDQs). KDQs provide a first-principles representation of two-time quantum correlators. The link between strange correlators and KDQs allows to establish that strange correlators are weak values of an observable converting an initial trivial state into a topologically non-trivial one. We thus propose a quantum topology witness that is achievable measuring the prior and subsequent effects on a many-body system of a sudden quench transformation that realizes the transition between trivial and topological phases. The witness is evaluated on a probe quantum state whose main features are detailed within the paper. Finally, directly exploiting schemes that allows for the complete reconstruction of KDQs, we address an interferometric protocol for topology discrimination, along with a general discussion of the main lines and challenges towards its implementation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“theoretical approach”、“propose”、“discuss”，以及基于Kirkwood-Dirac准概率的理论框架推导，未涉及具体实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：多体量子系统的拓扑态分类与判别，具体关注如何区分两个量子态是否属于不同拓扑类。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将“奇异关联子”表示为Kirkwood-Dirac准概率的函数，建立了奇异关联子与弱值之间的联系，从而提出一种基于突然淬火过程的量子拓扑见证，可用于判别拓扑相变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将“奇异关联子”表示为Kirkwood-Dirac准概率的函数，建立了奇异关联子与弱值之间的联系，从而提出一种基于突然淬火过程的量子拓扑见证，可用于判别拓扑相变。；创新点：首次将Kirkwood-Dirac准概率与奇异关联子直接关联，揭示了奇异关联子作为弱值的物理本质，并据此提出一种可实验实现的拓扑判别方案。摘要未突出说明与已有拓扑判别方法（如拓扑纠缠熵、拓扑不变量计算）的具体对比优势。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导：利用Kirkwood-Dirac准概率（KDQs）作为两时量子关联函数的第一性原理表示，将奇异关联子重新解释为将初始平庸态转化为拓扑非平庸态的观测量的弱值。提出通过测量突然淬火前后对多体系统的影响来构建拓扑见证，并讨论了基于KDQ完全重构的干涉测量协议。

papers.title: Revisiting Cherenkov radiation in anisotropic chiral matter: exact calculation reveals threshold-free emission
papers.abstract: We explore Cherenkov radiation in anisotropic chiral matter within the framework of Carroll-Field-Jackiw electrodynamics, where the axion angle exhibits a linear dependence on position. By deriving closed-form expressions for the polarization modes of electromagnetic fields in cylindrical coordinates and the space-frequency domain, we solve the modified Maxwell's equations. To enforce causality, we impose outgoing wave boundary conditions at a cylindrical surface at infinity, which yields the dispersion relations. Our analysis uncovers the specific angles and frequency ranges that allow for zero, one, or two Cherenkov cones. We also obtain the spectral energy distribution of the radiation in all cases. Notably, one sector of the model exhibits a novel phenomenon: Cherenkov radiation can be generated by slowly moving charges without a threshold, but only within a specific frequency range. This behavior is not observed in standard materials. Using our exact calculations, we also investigate the reliability of an approximate method previously proposed based on the calculation of the Green's function for the system.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：Carroll-Field-Jackiw电动力学、解析求解、色散关系、格林函数近似方法检验。；研究对象：各向异性手性物质中的切伦科夫辐射，具体采用Carroll-Field-Jackiw电动力学框架，其中轴子角随位置线性变化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在该模型的一个扇区中，慢速运动的电荷可以在无阈值条件下产生切伦科夫辐射，但仅限于特定频率范围。这一现象在标准材料中不存在。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在该模型的一个扇区中，慢速运动的电荷可以在无阈值条件下产生切伦科夫辐射，但仅限于特定频率范围。这一现象在标准材料中不存在。；创新点：首次通过精确计算揭示了各向异性手性物质中无阈值切伦科夫辐射的存在，并系统分析了零个、一个或两个切伦科夫锥对应的特定角度和频率范围。
papers.method_zh: 采用柱坐标系和空间-频率域中的电磁场极化模式闭式表达式，求解修正的麦克斯韦方程组；通过在无穷远柱面施加出射波边界条件来确保因果性，从而导出色散关系；并基于精确解评估了此前基于格林函数近似方法的可靠性。

papers.title: Inherent flux crosstalk and coupler-driven single-qubit gates in superconducting circuits
papers.abstract: Crosstalk refers to unwanted qubit addressing. This is particularly detrimental when scaling up quantum information systems because unintended interactions limit their overall performance. For superconducting qubits, tunable couplings and frequency tunability achieved through externally applied magnetic fluxes enable high-fidelity entangling gates; however, they also introduce crosstalk through unintended flux coupling. In this work, we investigate the impact of time-dependent external magnetic fluxes in quantized circuits on superconducting qubit couplings. We find that non-trivial cross-voltage driving emerges between capacitively linked qubits when the magnetic flux threading the SQUID loop of a qubit varies in time, in a manner analogous to Faraday's law of induction. Crucially, we show that this effect enables fast single qubit control through the coupler element in standard tunable-coupler architectures, potentially eliminating the need for individual microwave $XY$ control lines.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“investigate”“find”“show”等理论分析词汇，并基于法拉第感应定律进行推导，未提及实验或计算模拟细节。；研究对象：超导量子比特电路中，由时变外部磁通引起的串扰效应，以及通过耦合器实现单量子比特门操控的机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现当量子比特SQUID环中的磁通随时间变化时，电容耦合的量子比特之间会产生非平凡的交叉电压驱动（类似法拉第感应定律），这一效应可在标准可调耦合器架构中实现快速单量子比特控制，可能消除对独立微波XY控制线的需求。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现当量子比特SQUID环中的磁通随时间变化时，电容耦合的量子比特之间会产生非平凡的交叉电压驱动（类似法拉第感应定律），这一效应可在标准可调耦合器架构中实现快速单量子比特控制，可能消除对独立微波XY控制线的需求。；创新点：揭示了可调耦合器架构中由磁通串扰引发的交叉电压驱动效应，并指出该效应可被利用来实现无需独立XY控制线的单量子比特门操作。
papers.method_zh: 基于量子化电路理论，分析时变外部磁通对超导量子比特耦合的影响，类比法拉第电磁感应定律进行物理机制推导。

papers.title: A kinetic model of shear-induced rupture of short dsDNA
papers.abstract: Force-induced dissociation of short double-stranded DNA (dsDNA) is central to single-molecule biophysics and DNA nanotechnology, yet a physically grounded kinetic description of shear-induced rupture for finite-length constructs remains lacking. Here we develop a master equation framework built on a force-dependent nucleation-zipper pathway with single-base transitions, enabling direct calculation of dissociation rates and transition state distances over a broad force range. Applied to a DNA-gold nanoparticle-DNA construct under constant shear force, the model accurately reproduces the experimental room-temperature data in the covered force regime and provides a unified interpretation of prior measurements on similarly sheared duplexes across all force regimes. A central result is that the three-dimensional helical geometry of dsDNA is essential for correctly defining the end to end distance under shear in the rod-like polymer model of short dsDNA. We further show that the extracted transition state distances are robust to variations in ssDNA polymer parameters within the experimentally relevant regime. Finally, we analyze the temperature dependence of the transition state distance and discuss how our framework captures globally-heated rupture while identifying the additional complications introduced by localized plasmonic heating in gold nanoparticle-coupled constructs. These results provide a predictive kinetic foundation for interpreting force-rupture experiments and for designing force- and temperature-actuated DNA nanostructures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：kinetic model（动力学模型）、master equation framework（主方程框架）、direct calculation（直接计算）。；研究对象：短双链DNA（short dsDNA）在剪切力诱导下的断裂动力学，具体涉及DNA-金纳米颗粒-DNA复合结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 三维螺旋几何结构对正确定义剪切力下短dsDNA的端到端距离至关重要；提取的过渡态距离对单链DNA聚合物参数变化具有鲁棒性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：三维螺旋几何结构对正确定义剪切力下短dsDNA的端到端距离至关重要；提取的过渡态距离对单链DNA聚合物参数变化具有鲁棒性。；创新点：首次为有限长度短dsDNA在剪切力诱导断裂提供了有物理基础的动力学描述，统一解释了先前所有力区间的剪切双链实验测量结果，并揭示了局部等离激元加热带来的额外复杂性。
papers.method_zh: 基于力依赖的成核-拉链路径（nucleation-zipper pathway）和单碱基跃迁（single-base transitions）构建主方程框架，直接计算解离速率和过渡态距离，并与恒定剪切力下的实验数据对比验证。

papers.title: Topological origin of flow distributions in disordered porous media
papers.abstract: We investigate steady Stokes flow through porous media composed of two-dimensional disordered arrays of circular obstacles. We develop a theory for the statistics of flow rates based on a pore-network model that captures local flow correlations. We show that the flow rate distribution across the ensemble of pore bodies follows a Gamma distribution, and that the flow rate distribution through pore throats is fully determined in terms of it. Furthermore, this Gamma distribution can be directly linked to simple geometrical properties such as the coefficient of variation of pore throat widths, rendering the model parameterisable from minimal medium information. The resulting predictions agree closely with computational fluid dynamics simulations and show markedly better agreement than prior mean-field models that neglect local flow-rate correlations, clarifying how local splitting and merging shape flow in disordered porous networks.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有计算验证）。关键词：theory、pore-network model、computational fluid dynamics simulations。；研究对象：无序多孔介质中稳态斯托克斯流（Stokes flow）的流速分布统计规律，具体为二维圆形障碍物无序排列构成的多孔介质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 孔体流速分布服从Gamma分布，且孔喉流速分布可由该Gamma分布完全确定；该Gamma分布可直接关联到孔喉宽度的变异系数等简单几何性质，从而仅需最小介质信息即可参数化模型。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：孔体流速分布服从Gamma分布，且孔喉流速分布可由该Gamma分布完全确定；该Gamma分布可直接关联到孔喉宽度的变异系数等简单几何性质，从而仅需最小介质信息即可参数化模型。；创新点：揭示了局部流速分裂与合并如何塑造无序多孔网络中的流动分布，并建立了从简单几何性质直接预测流速分布的理论框架，相比忽略局部相关性的平均场模型显著提高了预测精度。
papers.method_zh: 基于孔隙网络模型（pore-network model）建立理论，捕捉局部流动相关性；通过计算流体动力学（CFD）模拟进行验证，并与忽略局部流速相关性的平均场模型进行对比。

papers.title: Low-Dose 3D Bonding Mapping Through "Soft" Core-Loss EELS Tomography and Unsupervised Deep Learning
papers.abstract: Resolving the 3D chemical configuration of beam-sensitive nanomaterials at high spatial resolution remains a persistent frontier in scanning transmission electron microscopy (STEM). The main limitation lies in the trade-off between high electron dose required for analytical signals and the large number of projections needed for tomographic reconstruction. Here, we achieve dose-efficient 3D bonding mapping of FeO/Fe$_3$O$_4$ core-shell nanocubes with high resolution via electron energy loss spectroscopy (EELS). Our approach relies on two developments. First, a standardless "soft" core-loss EELS methodology exploiting Fe-M$_{2,3}$ edges provides ${\sim}50\times$ higher dose efficiency than conventional Fe-L$_{2,3}$ edges, using the latter only as a source of FeO and Fe$_3$O$_4$ standards. Second, we introduce multi-channel deep image prior with total variation regularization (DIPm-TV), an unsupervised method for spectroscopic tomography that jointly reconstructs multiple channels by exploiting spatial correlations under sparse-view and low-dose conditions. Using simulated datasets, high-quality reconstructions are obtained from as few as nine projections over $-70^\circ$ to $+70^\circ$, without HAADF-STEM signal or symmetry constraints. Applied to FeO/Fe$_3$O$_4$ nanocubes, Fe-M$_{2,3}$ EELS maps show improved SNR and spatial resolution, revealing a thin outer FeO shell surrounding the magnetite shell. DIPm-TV yields ${\sim}1$ nm isotropic resolution oxidation-state volumes preserving cubic morphology, recovering the outer FeO shell, and revealing a small internal void, features not accessible with conventional reconstruction methods. This work establishes a pathway for low-dose 2D and 3D analytical mapping of beam-sensitive materials using shallow core-loss edges, enabling orders-of-magnitude dose reduction while maintaining spectral fidelity and reliable 3D information.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：scanning transmission electron microscopy (STEM)、electron energy loss spectroscopy (EELS)、tomographic reconstruction、experimental application to FeO/Fe₃O₄ nanocubes）；研究对象：FeO/Fe₃O₄核壳纳米立方体（core-shell nanocubes）的三维化学键合构型（3D bonding configuration），具体为氧化态分布与空间结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过结合“软”芯损失EELS方法与无监督深度学习重建算法，实现了对电子束敏感材料的高分辨率、低剂量三维化学键合成像，成功揭示了FeO/Fe₃O₄纳米立方体中薄的外层FeO壳层及内部微小空洞。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过结合“软”芯损失EELS方法与无监督深度学习重建算法，实现了对电子束敏感材料的高分辨率、低剂量三维化学键合成像，成功揭示了FeO/Fe₃O₄纳米立方体中薄的外层FeO壳层及内部微小空洞。；创新点：1）首次利用Fe-M₂,₃边（而非传统Fe-L₂,₃边）实现约50倍剂量效率提升，用于三维键合映射。2）引入无监督深度学习（DIPm-TV）方法，仅需9个投影（-70°至+70°）即可获得高质量三维重建，无需HAADF-STEM信号或对称性约束，显著降低电子剂量需求。
papers.method_zh: 1）实验手段：扫描透射电子显微镜（STEM）结合电子能量损失谱（EELS），采用基于Fe-M₂,₃边的“软”芯损失EELS方法（无需标准样品），以Fe-L₂,₃边作为FeO和Fe₃O₄的标准参考源。2）重建算法：多通道深度图像先验结合全变分正则化（DIPm-TV），一种无监督的谱学层析成像方法，在稀疏投影和低剂量条件下联合重建多个通道。

papers.title: Generating functions for aggregation and fragmentation: review
papers.abstract: In this work, we review and revisit the generating function techniques that provide exact analytical solutions for aggregation and fragmentation equations across several physical regimes including spontaneous and collisonal shattering. For discrete coagulation-fragmentation equations with size-independent rates under monodisperse initial conditions, we show the derivation of sevaral explicit closed-form solutions. We also briefly report the exact solutions for continuous, three-particle, $D$-particle collisions and two-component generalizations. Source-driven aggregation yields steady distributions featuring a universal $s^{-3/2}$ power-law decay and a cutoff mass scaling $s_{*} \sim t^{2}$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：review, generating function techniques, exact analytical solutions, derivation。；研究对象：聚集与碎裂方程（aggregation and fragmentation equations），涵盖自发碎裂、碰撞碎裂、离散与连续方程、三粒子及D粒子碰撞、双组分推广、源驱动聚集等物理体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过生成函数技术，在单分散初始条件下获得了离散凝聚-碎裂方程的多个显式闭式解；源驱动聚集产生稳态分布，具有普适的 \( s^{-3/2} \) 幂律衰减和截止质量标度 \( s_{*} \sim t^{2} \)。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过生成函数技术，在单分散初始条件下获得了离散凝聚-碎裂方程的多个显式闭式解；源驱动聚集产生稳态分布，具有普适的 \( s^{-3/2} \) 幂律衰减和截止质量标度 \( s_{*} \sim t^{2} \)。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 生成函数技术（generating function techniques），用于推导聚集与碎裂方程的精确解析解。

papers.title: UnReal-B : Real-Space DFT Solver for Matter in Extreme Magnetic Fields
papers.abstract: As new observational technologies reveal increasingly detailed properties of neutron star surfaces, the demand for accessible and extensible theoretical modeling tools continues to grow. We present UnReal-B, a real-space Density Functional Theory solver for one-dimensional chains of matter in extreme magnetic fields $B \approx 10^{12} - 10^{15},\mathrm{G}$. By employing the adiabatic approximation, UnReal-B, provides a streamlined numerical framework for calculating the electronic structure of strongly magnetized condensed matter. The solver is benchmarked against published results for several astrophysically relevant elements, demonstrating excellent agreement while maintaining a comparatively simple and transparent implementation. Released as open-source software, UnReal-B facilitates reproducible and community-driven investigations of neutron-star surface matter and provides a foundation for future developments motivated by emerging observational constraints.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：real-space Density Functional Theory solver、numerical framework、benchmarked、open-source software。；研究对象：中子星表面物质在极端磁场（B ≈ 10¹²–10¹⁵ G）下的一维原子链的电子结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: UnReal-B 软件能够高效、准确地计算强磁场下凝聚态物质的电子结构，与已发表的若干天体物理相关元素的计算结果吻合良好。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：UnReal-B 软件能够高效、准确地计算强磁场下凝聚态物质的电子结构，与已发表的若干天体物理相关元素的计算结果吻合良好。；创新点：提供了一个相对简单且透明的开源数值框架，便于可重复研究和社区驱动的中子星表面物质探索，并为未来基于观测约束的发展奠定基础。摘要未突出说明与已有DFT求解器在算法或性能上的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 采用绝热近似的实空间密度泛函理论（real-space DFT）求解器，针对一维原子链体系进行数值计算。

papers.title: Chiral Plasma under Strong Magnetic Fields: A Holographic Analysis of Transport Phenomena
papers.abstract: Chiral plasma appears in several areas of physics, historically starting from primordial plasma in the early Universe, then in quark-gluon plasma produced in heavy ion collisions, and, more recently, in Dirac and Weyl semimetals. The major signature of the plasma is the non-conservation of the axial current due to the chiral anomaly and the emergence of new, anomaly-induced transport phenomena. In this paper, we study the plasma exposed to arbitrarily strong constant magnetic and weak electric fields. Employing all-order gradient resummation, we write down constitutive relations for electric and axial currents parameterized by thirteen momentum- and magnetic- field-dependent transport coefficient functions. The latter are computed utilizing a theoretical lab for a realistic plasma, namely a holographic $U(1)_V \times U(1)_A$ Maxwell--Chern--Simons theory in Schwarzschild--AdS$_5$, in the probe limit. As an application, we revisit the phenomena of negative magnetoresistance and chiral magnetic waves, beyond the naive hydrodynamic limit.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：holographic analysis、constitutive relations、transport coefficient functions、hydrodynamic limit。；研究对象：手征等离子体（chiral plasma）在强磁场下的输运现象，具体涉及早期宇宙原初等离子体、重离子碰撞产生的夸克-胶子等离子体，以及狄拉克和外尔半金属中的手征等离子体。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过全息方法计算了在任意强恒定磁场和弱电场下，手征等离子体的电导率和轴电流输运系数函数，并重新审视了负磁电阻和手征磁波现象，超越了传统流体力学极限。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过全息方法计算了在任意强恒定磁场和弱电场下，手征等离子体的电导率和轴电流输运系数函数，并重新审视了负磁电阻和手征磁波现象，超越了传统流体力学极限。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用全息对偶方法，具体构建了 Schwarzschild–AdS₅ 背景下的 \(U(1)_V \times U(1)_A\) Maxwell–Chern–Simons 理论，并在探针极限下进行全阶梯度重求和（all-order gradient resummation），推导出由13个依赖于动量和磁场的输运系数函数参数化的本构关系。

papers.title: Hawking--Page Universality, Thermodynamic Dipoles and Categorical Defects
papers.abstract: We reconsider the Hawking--Page transition using the common thermodynamic vector field whose zeros include the Davies and Hawking--Page points. In the elementary AdS branch their winding numbers are $w_{\rm D}=-1$ and $w_{\rm HP}=+1$, so the pair has zero total charge but a non-zero signed first moment. After normalization by the Davies scales this moment gives the familiar universal ratios $C_S$ and $C_T$; in four dimensions $C_S=2$ and $C_T=2/\sqrt{3}-1$. We check the construction for Schwarzschild--AdS, grand-canonical Reissner--Nordström--AdS, charged non-rotating black holes in arbitrary dimension, and Kerr--AdS at fixed angular velocity. The same reduced geometry gives a barrier $B=1/3$ in four dimensions and $B(d)=1/[(d-1)(d-3)]$. Finally we propose a formulation involving a defect-resolved version for categorical or non-invertible symmetry sectors.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：thermodynamic vector field、winding numbers、universal ratios、defect-resolved formulation。；研究对象：黑洞热力学中的Hawking–Page相变，具体涉及Schwarzschild–AdS、Reissner–Nordström–AdS、Kerr–AdS等AdS时空中的黑洞体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过公共热力学矢量场的零点分析，发现Davies点和Hawking–Page点的缠绕数分别为-1和+1，构成总电荷为零但非零一阶矩的偶极子；该矩经Davies标度归一化后给出普适比值C_S和C_T（四维下C_S=2，C_T=2/√3-1），并推广到任意维度和带角速度的黑洞。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过公共热力学矢量场的零点分析，发现Davies点和Hawking–Page点的缠绕数分别为-1和+1，构成总电荷为零但非零一阶矩的偶极子；该矩经Davies标度归一化后给出普适比值C_S和C_T（四维下C_S=2，C_T=2/√3-1），并推广到任意维度和带角速度的黑洞。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用热力学矢量场（thermodynamic vector field）的拓扑方法，通过计算零点缠绕数（winding numbers）和归一化一阶矩，推导出普适比值；并引入缺陷分辨（defect-resolved）形式处理范畴性或非可逆对称性扇区。

papers.title: Anomalous mobility edges and extended-localized transition in a quasiperiodic emitter-cavity array
papers.abstract: The manipulation of localization in quasiperiodic systems by mobility edges or localization transition holds significant physical importance. In this letter, we demonstrated that the dissipation can induce the emergence of anomalous mobility edges and extended-localized transition in emitter-cavity arrays controlled by quasiperiodic potentials. Specifically, we observe that the localization properties of emitters is governed by the nature of quantum bound states, either discrete or embedded in continuum, providing a unified mechanism linking the emitter-photon bound physics to quasiperiodic criticality. Depending on the bound state discrete or continuumlike, the induced effective excitation hopping exhibits either exponentially decaying or sinusoidally oscillating, giving rise to the formation of localized or critical states, respectively. Through a generalized duality transformation, we analytically determine the anomalous mobility edges and the critical strength of potential, enabling the construction of a full phase diagram. The study reveals that the physical characteristics of cavity exert a significant influence on excitation localization. Therefore, the manipulation of excitation localization can be achieved solely by adjusting the cavity fields.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用了“demonstrated”、“analytically determine”、“generalized duality transformation”等关键词，表明主要采用理论分析与解析推导的方法。；研究对象：准周期势调控的发射器-腔阵列（emitter-cavity array）中的局域化现象，具体研究由耗散诱导的反常迁移率边（anomalous mobility edges）以及扩展态-局域态转变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 耗散可以诱导准周期发射器-腔阵列中出现反常迁移率边和扩展-局域转变。发射器的局域化性质由量子束缚态（分立或嵌入连续谱）的本质决定，这为发射器-光子束缚物理与准周期临界性提供了统一的机制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：耗散可以诱导准周期发射器-腔阵列中出现反常迁移率边和扩展-局域转变。发射器的局域化性质由量子束缚态（分立或嵌入连续谱）的本质决定，这为发射器-光子束缚物理与准周期临界性提供了统一的机制。；创新点：揭示了耗散（dissipation）在准周期系统中诱导反常迁移率边的新机制，并将发射器-光子束缚态（分立态与连续谱嵌入态）的物理与准周期系统的局域化临界性联系起来。摘要未突出说明与以往工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 通过广义对偶变换（generalized duality transformation）进行解析分析，确定了反常迁移率边和临界势强度，并构建了完整的相图。

papers.title: Unsupervised Deep Learning for Limited-Angle STEM-EDX Tomography -- Application to 3D Chemical Analysis of Phase-Change Memory Devices
papers.abstract: Energy Dispersive X-ray (EDX) tomography in Scanning Transmission Electron Microscopy (STEM) enables 3D compositional and elemental mapping at the nanoscale, but its use is limited by restricted tilt ranges and low-dose conditions required to avoid beam damage. Limited-angle acquisition introduces missing-wedge artefacts such as elongation and anisotropic resolution, while noisy low-dose data further degrade reconstruction quality and quantitative reliability. Here, we introduce an unsupervised deep learning framework based on Deep Image Prior with total variation regularization (DIP-TV) for limited-angle STEM-EDX tomography. We extend it to a multi-channel formulation (DIPm-TV) that jointly reconstructs multiple elemental maps by exploiting spatial correlations. Using a synthetic 3-channel phantom, we show that the method compensates for severe missing-wedge artefacts corresponding to approximately $100^\circ$ of missing angular range under moderate noise, outperforming simultaneous iterative reconstruction technique and compressed sensing approaches. We apply the method to 3D chemical analysis of Ge-Sb-Te (GST) memory devices in virgin (as-fabricated) and SET (crystalline) operational states. Samples were prepared as cross-sectional focused ion beam lamellae and acquired under a limited-angle tilt range from $-40^\circ$ to $+40^\circ$ with $5^\circ$ steps and a dose of $2.0\times10^5$ $e^-/Ang^2$. The multi-channel approach enables voxel-by-voxel elemental reconstruction using only EDX signals without external structural priors such as high-angle annular dark-field imaging. The reconstructed volumes show near-isotropic spatial resolution and reveal compositional heterogeneities associated with device operation. This approach enables 3D chemical characterization in experimentally accessible sample geometries where conventional methods fail due to severe angular limitations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/方法文章。关键词：unsupervised deep learning framework, Deep Image Prior, multi-channel formulation, synthetic phantom, reconstruction。；研究对象：相变存储器（Phase-Change Memory Devices）中的Ge-Sb-Te（GST）材料，具体分析其原始（virgin）和SET（结晶）工作状态下的三维化学成分分布。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于多通道深度图像先验（DIPm-TV）的无监督深度学习框架，可在有限角度（约100°缺失角）和低剂量条件下，有效补偿STEM-EDX层析成像中的缺失楔伪影，实现近各向同性空间分辨率的元素三维重建，并揭示与器件操作相关的成分不均匀性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：基于多通道深度图像先验（DIPm-TV）的无监督深度学习框架，可在有限角度（约100°缺失角）和低剂量条件下，有效补偿STEM-EDX层析成像中的缺失楔伪影，实现近各向同性空间分辨率的元素三维重建，并揭示与器件操作相关的成分不均匀性。；创新点：首次将多通道深度图像先验（DIPm-TV）应用于有限角度STEM-EDX层析成像，仅利用EDX信号即可实现逐体素的元素重建，无需高角环形暗场像（HAADF）等外部结构先验信息。
papers.method_zh: 采用无监督深度学习框架Deep Image Prior结合全变分正则化（DIP-TV），并扩展为多通道版本（DIPm-TV）以联合重建多个元素图。使用合成三通道体模进行验证，并与同步迭代重建技术（SIRT）和压缩感知方法对比。实验数据来自扫描透射电子显微镜（STEM）下的能量色散X射线（EDX）层析成像，样品为聚焦离子束（FIB）制备的截面薄片，在-40°至+40°的有限角度范围内以5°步长采集，剂量为2.0×10⁵ e⁻/Å²。

papers.title: Precision measurements at the interface between unitary and non-unitary encoding
papers.abstract: We investigate precision scaling at the interface between unitary and non-unitary encoding under generalized noise including single-particle and collective dephasing and decay. Using linear response theory and the error propagation formula, we derive analytic precision expressions for both the unitary parameter $Ω$ and the dissipation strength $γ$. For unitary encoding, when the observable commutes with a Hermitian noise operator, the optimal encoding time is independent of $N$, yielding the Heisenberg limit $ΔΩ\propto 1 / N$; otherwise the precision degrades to the standard quantum limit or ceases to improve with $N$. For non-unitary encoding, when $[\hat{A}, \hat{O}] = 0$, the precision is insensitive to intrinsic dynamics and encoding time, scaling as $Δγ\propto \sqrt{γ/ \expval*{\hat{L}^\dagger \hat{L}}}$. Notably, for collective decay, the Dicke state reaches the Heisenberg limit $Δγ\propto 1 / N$, demonstrating that entanglement can enhance non-unitary estimation. Our results provide a unified framework and practical guidance for designing quantum metrology protocols in noisy environments.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：linear response theory, error propagation formula, analytic precision expressions。；研究对象：量子计量学中，在广义噪声（包括单粒子和集体退相位、衰减）影响下，幺正编码与非幺正编码界面处的精度标度行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于幺正编码，当可观测量与厄米噪声算符对易时，最优编码时间与粒子数N无关，可实现海森堡极限（ΔΩ∝1/N）；否则精度退化为标准量子极限或不再随N改善。对于非幺正编码，当算符对易时，精度对内在动力学和编码时间不敏感；集体衰减下，Dicke态可达海森堡极限（Δγ∝1/N），表明纠缠可增强非幺正估计。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于幺正编码，当可观测量与厄米噪声算符对易时，最优编码时间与粒子数N无关，可实现海森堡极限（ΔΩ∝1/N）；否则精度退化为标准量子极限或不再随N改善。对于非幺正编码，当算符对易时，精度对内在动力学和编码时间不敏感；集体衰减下，Dicke态可达海森堡极限（Δγ∝1/N），表明纠缠可增强非幺正估计。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 利用线性响应理论和误差传播公式，推导了幺正参数Ω和耗散强度γ的解析精度表达式。

papers.title: Rank Collapse, Fixed Points, and the Renormalization Group Structure of MLP Residual Networks
papers.abstract: The analogy between deep neural network forward passes and renormalization group (RG) flows has been repeatedly noted in the literature, but existing treatments remain qualitative: depth is described as a coarse-graining scale, attention is likened to a partition function, and representations are said to flow toward fixed points. No existing work has defined a measurable RG order parameter, tested it under controlled variation of the input distribution, or made quantitative predictions that are empirically verified. We study the simplest architecture for which the analogy is tractable: a pure MLP residual stack trained on masked token prediction over synthetic Markov chain sequences with known spectral properties. We report three findings. (i) The effective rank of the residual stream decreases monotonically with depth after training, consistent with progressive integration of irrelevant degrees of freedom. (ii) This rank collapse is selective: it occurs for chains with short correlation length approximately 1 but is absent for chains with long correlation length approximately 7, measured at the position level to control for mean-pooling artifacts. The network preserves exactly the degrees of freedom relevant to the prediction task, the content of the RG relevance criterion. (iii) Inter-layer kernel drift is concentrated at one or two specific transitions, with the remainder of the network near a fixed point, consistent with a discrete fixed-point plateau. Together these findings constitute the first quantitative, position-level evidence that MLP residual networks implement a selective coarse-graining procedure governed by the spectral structure of the input distribution.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：renormalization group (RG) flows、fixed points、quantitative predictions、empirically verified。；研究对象：MLP残差网络（MLP residual networks）在合成马尔可夫链序列上的掩码标记预测任务（masked token prediction）中的表示学习行为，类比于重正化群流。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 训练后，残差流的有效秩随深度单调下降（秩坍缩），且该坍缩具有选择性：仅当输入序列的关联长度短（约1）时发生，长关联长度（约7）时则不发生；层间核漂移集中在少数几个特定过渡层，其余部分接近不动点，表明网络实现了离散的不动点平台结构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：训练后，残差流的有效秩随深度单调下降（秩坍缩），且该坍缩具有选择性：仅当输入序列的关联长度短（约1）时发生，长关联长度（约7）时则不发生；层间核漂移集中在少数几个特定过渡层，其余部分接近不动点，表明网络实现了离散的不动点平台结构。；创新点：首次定义了可测量的重正化群序参量（有效秩），并在输入分布受控变化下进行定量测试与经验验证，提供了位置级（position-level）证据表明MLP残差网络实现了由输入分布谱结构支配的选择性粗粒化过程。
papers.method_zh: 通过训练纯MLP残差网络在已知谱性质的合成马尔可夫链序列上进行掩码标记预测，测量残差流的有效秩作为重正化群序参量，并控制输入分布（关联长度）进行定量验证。

papers.title: Unidirectional-like Edge Transport Induced by Non-Hermitian Skin Effects
papers.abstract: Non-Hermitian skin effects (NHSEs) enable dramatic boundary accumulation of waves, yet their experimental realization typically demands engineered nonreciprocity or spatially patterned loss. Here we demonstrate theoretically and experimentally that uniform loss provides a simple and previously overlooked mechanism for enforcing unidirectional-like edge transport in photonic crystals (PhCs) that breaks time-reversal symmetry in the presence of nonchiral edge states. Using a core cladding geometry where domains share identical Chern numbers but possess distinct bulk polarizations, we show that uniform loss activates NHSEs that reshape the spectral topology of edge bands, giving rise to point gap windings that dictate a one way propagation. Near field measurements confirm that loss converts intrinsically bidirectional interface states into a unidirectional-like circulation around the entire domain wall, showing excellent agreement with theory. Our results establish uniform loss as a universal and structurally simple route for achieving unidirectional-like wave transport.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（理论+实验）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“demonstrate theoretically and experimentally”，并包含“Near field measurements confirm”等实验验证描述。；研究对象：光子晶体（PhCs）中由非厄米趋肤效应（NHSEs）诱导的类单向边缘输运现象，具体采用芯-包层几何结构，其中两个区域具有相同的陈数但不同的体极化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 均匀损耗可以激活非厄米趋肤效应，重塑边缘带的谱拓扑，产生点隙缠绕（point gap windings），从而将原本双向传播的界面态转变为沿整个畴壁的类单向循环输运。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：均匀损耗可以激活非厄米趋肤效应，重塑边缘带的谱拓扑，产生点隙缠绕（point gap windings），从而将原本双向传播的界面态转变为沿整个畴壁的类单向循环输运。；创新点：发现均匀损耗（而非工程化的非互易性或空间图案化损耗）是一种此前被忽视的、简单且普适的实现类单向边缘输运的机制，并首次在实验中验证了该机制。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析结合近场测量实验。理论框架包括非厄米拓扑能带理论、点隙拓扑与谱缠绕数分析；实验手段为光子晶体中的近场扫描测量，通过引入均匀损耗实现非厄米趋肤效应。

papers.title: Filamentary Transport and Thermoelectric Effects in Mushroom Phase Change Memory Cells
papers.abstract: We performed a 2D finite-element electrothermal computational study of thermoelectric effects and filamentary electronic transport in Ge$_2$Sb$_2$Te$_5$ mushroom phase change memory cells during Reset and Set operations, accounting for spatial activation energy variations in amorphous Ge$_2$Sb$_2$Te$_5$ and phase-change dynamics. Reset operations with current going from the top electrode to the narrow 4 nm bottom electrode require $\sim$3x less energy and power, and $\sim$2x lower current to achieve the same Reset resistance, compared to the opposite polarity, due to thermoelectric effects. Filamentary conduction, electrical breakdown, thermal runaway, and local crystallization of amorphous Ge$_2$Sb$_2$Te$_5$ depend on current polarity and thermal boundary conditions, and determine the location, shape, and volume of the programming region, which may be significantly smaller than the semi-cylindrical mushroom region. The programming volume does not scale with contact dimensions larger than 10 nm. Larger contact areas introduce increased device-to-device and cycle-to-cycle variability due to filamentary conduction but are expected to lead to higher reliability and endurance.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“2D finite-element electrothermal computational study”（二维有限元电热计算研究）。；研究对象：Ge₂Sb₂Te₅（GST）蘑菇型相变存储单元中的丝状输运和热电效应，具体涉及Reset和Set操作过程中的电子输运、相变动力学及编程区域演化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 热电效应导致电流极性对Reset操作的能量、功率和电流需求有显著影响（反向极性时能量和功率降低约3倍，电流降低约2倍）；编程区域的位置、形状和体积由丝状导电、电击穿、热失控及局部结晶共同决定，且当接触尺寸大于10 nm时，编程体积不再随接触尺寸缩放。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：热电效应导致电流极性对Reset操作的能量、功率和电流需求有显著影响（反向极性时能量和功率降低约3倍，电流降低约2倍）；编程区域的位置、形状和体积由丝状导电、电击穿、热失控及局部结晶共同决定，且当接触尺寸大于10 nm时，编程体积不再随接触尺寸缩放。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用二维有限元电热计算模拟，考虑了非晶Ge₂Sb₂Te₅中空间变化的激活能以及相变动力学过程。

papers.title: Multifractal Signatures of Ageing and Dementia Development: A Multifractal Space-Filling Curve Analysis
papers.abstract: Multifractality is an effective formalism for quantifying the nonlinear, scale-free properties of complex data. In this study, we propose a novel and efficient methodology, termed Multifractal Space-filling Curve Analysis (MFSCA), for quantifying the correlation structure of multidimensional data. Within this framework, the original multidimensional data - while preserving both local and long-range organisational properties - are projected onto a one-dimensional representation using a fractal space-filling curve. The resulting one-dimensional signal is then analysed using multifractal algorithms. We demonstrate the utility of the method using both artificially generated multifractal structures and real data. In particular, we apply MFSCA to analyse magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) data from Alzheimer patients at different stages of dementia. Based on the results, we estimate the multifractal profiles of the brain for healthy subjects of different ages as well as for dementia patients. The analysis reveals that the spatial organization of brain structures, as measured by the degree of multifractality, progressively weakens with age and the development of dementia. A transition from multifractality to monofractality is observed both in control groups, when comparing the Young Control and Elderly Control groups, and among dementia subjects of similar age but at different stages of the disease, namely early dementia and mild cognitive impairment. Thus, from the perspective of multiscaling properties, the heterogeneous characteristics of spatial brain organization deteriorate under worsening conditions, leading to a homogeneous and weakly correlated structure. These findings not only effectively capture key aspects of brain organisation, but also demonstrate that the multifractality of MRI data can serve as a marker of structural brain changes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：提出新方法（Multifractal Space-filling Curve Analysis）、分析人工生成数据和真实数据、未提及实验操作。；研究对象：脑部磁共振成像（MRI）数据，具体为阿尔茨海默病不同阶段患者及不同年龄健康对照者的脑结构空间组织。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 脑结构的空间组织随年龄增长和痴呆发展，其多重分形性逐渐减弱，出现从多重分形向单分形的转变，表明脑组织从异质、强相关结构退化为均质、弱相关结构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：脑结构的空间组织随年龄增长和痴呆发展，其多重分形性逐渐减弱，出现从多重分形向单分形的转变，表明脑组织从异质、强相关结构退化为均质、弱相关结构。；创新点：提出了一种将多维数据通过分形空间填充曲线降维后再进行多重分形分析的高效新框架，并首次将其应用于阿尔茨海默病不同阶段及不同年龄健康对照的脑MRI数据，揭示脑结构多重分形性随衰老和痴呆进展的退化规律。
papers.method_zh: 提出一种名为“多重分形空间填充曲线分析（MFSCA）”的新方法：先用分形空间填充曲线将多维数据（MRI图像）投影为一维信号，再对一维信号应用多重分形算法进行相关性结构量化。

papers.title: Determining universal spectra from probability distributions
papers.abstract: The probability distribution of a two-particle correlation function computed over background auxiliary field configurations, used to generate the interactions, has been shown to inform about the spectra of universal $n$-body clusters [1]. Here, we utilize two approaches, a numerical lattice computation and an analytic expansion in the limit of large numbers of identical species, in an attempt to refine the initial predictions. Exploratory calculations in these directions are presented, and future investigations laid out.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有数值计算）。关键词：analytic expansion、numerical lattice computation。；研究对象：通用n体团簇的能谱（universal spectra of n-body clusters），通过双粒子关联函数的概率分布来研究。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体的物理结论，仅指出通过两种方法（数值格点计算和大数量相同物种极限下的解析展开）尝试改进对通用能谱的初始预测。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：摘要未明确说明具体的物理结论，仅指出通过两种方法（数值格点计算和大数量相同物种极限下的解析展开）尝试改进对通用能谱的初始预测。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 数值格点计算（numerical lattice computation）以及在大数量相同物种极限下的解析展开（analytic expansion in the limit of large numbers of identical species）。

papers.title: Collective drift and pinning in active rotator networks with Kuramoto coupling and mixed-sign feedback disorder
papers.abstract: Active rotator models provide a minimal phase description of excitable and oscillatory systems, and have long been used to study mutual entrainment, synchronization, and collective transitions. Here, we investigate fully connected active rotator networks with Kuramoto coupling, where a common intrinsic drive competes with local feedback amplitudes drawn from a zero-mean Gaussian distribution. This produces a competition between local pinning and collective phase alignment. Using mean absolute late-time drift and the fractions of positive and negative drifting oscillators, we construct numerical regime maps in the feedback-disorder-coupling plane. At weak coupling, increasing the feedback disorder strength suppresses drift, while stronger coupling can restore positive late-time drift when feedback disorder is not too strong. We interpret these regimes using analytical limits for the uncoupled and coherent strong-coupling cases. We also examine finite-size effects and zero-mean distributed intrinsic frequencies. Together, these results show that mixed-sign local feedback alone can reshape the balance between pinning and drifting in coupled active rotator networks, even when the intrinsic drive is homogeneous.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：active rotator models、numerical regime maps、analytical limits、finite-size effects。；研究对象：具有Kuramoto耦合的全连接活性转子网络，其中共同本征驱动与来自零均值高斯分布的局域反馈振幅竞争，导致局域钉扎与集体相位排列之间的竞争。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 混合符号的局域反馈本身即可重塑耦合活性转子网络中钉扎与漂移之间的平衡，即使本征驱动是均匀的。在弱耦合下，增加反馈无序强度会抑制漂移；而在反馈无序不太强时，较强耦合可恢复正晚期漂移。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：混合符号的局域反馈本身即可重塑耦合活性转子网络中钉扎与漂移之间的平衡，即使本征驱动是均匀的。在弱耦合下，增加反馈无序强度会抑制漂移；而在反馈无序不太强时，较强耦合可恢复正晚期漂移。；创新点：揭示了仅通过混合符号的局域反馈（而非传统上依赖本征频率分布）即可调控活性转子网络中的钉扎-漂移竞争，为理解无序驱动系统中的集体动力学提供了新视角。
papers.method_zh: 采用数值方法构建反馈无序-耦合强度平面上的相图，使用平均绝对晚期漂移以及正、负漂移振荡器的比例作为序参量；同时结合无耦合和强耦合相干极限下的解析分析，并考察有限尺寸效应和零均值分布的本征频率。

papers.title: Absence of poor local minima in matrix product states
papers.abstract: Quantum circuits suffer from severe trainability issues: even shallow circuits are swamped with poor local minima. Yet matrix product states (MPS), which can be prepared by sequential circuits, are remarkably trainable in practice -- as demonstrated by decades of successful density matrix renormalization group calculations. In this work, we resolve this apparent paradox by proving that the energy landscapes of MPS are free from poor local minima, under the same setting where brickwork circuits are not. The key insight is that the gauge freedom of MPS creates an effective local overparametrization that causes local minima to concentrate near the global minimum, analogous to overparametrized classical neural networks. We rigorously prove that the local minimum distribution of the MPS energy landscape is invariant under moves of the orthogonality center. Numerical experiments further confirm that the optimization of sequential circuits converges to near-optimal solutions even for random Hamiltonians, in stark contrast to brickwork circuits. Our findings highlight the pivotal role of effective local overparametrization in determining trainability, providing a valuable guide for overcoming the trainability bottleneck of variational quantum algorithms.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：prove、rigorously prove、theoretical framework、energy landscapes）；研究对象：矩阵乘积态（MPS）的能量景观，以及与之相关的变分量子算法的可训练性问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 证明了在砖墙电路存在大量不良局部极小值的相同条件下，矩阵乘积态的能量景观中不存在不良局部极小值，其局部极小值分布集中在全局最小值附近。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：证明了在砖墙电路存在大量不良局部极小值的相同条件下，矩阵乘积态的能量景观中不存在不良局部极小值，其局部极小值分布集中在全局最小值附近。；创新点：揭示了MPS中有效局部过参数化在决定可训练性中的关键作用，解释了MPS在实际中（如DMRG）可训练而量子电路却存在严重可训练性问题的矛盾。
papers.method_zh: 理论证明（利用MPS的规范自由度导致有效局部过参数化，证明局部极小值分布对正交中心移动的不变性）与数值实验（对比顺序电路与砖墙电路在随机哈密顿量下的优化收敛性）。

papers.title: Bootstrap Cone of the Multicritical Deconfined Quantum Critical Point
papers.abstract: The deconfined quantum critical point (DQCP) provides a prominent example of the unconventional phase transitions beyond the Landau-Ginzburg-Wilson paradigm and its nature has been controversial for decades. The DQCP has been extensively studied and the results lead to two opposite scenarios with pseudo-criticality or multicriticality. The pseudo-criticality is a prevailing scenario of DQCP which interprets the approximately scale invariant numerical results with the walking behavior near complex fixed points. In contrast, the multicriticality scenario conjectures the DQCP is a unitary fixed point with a relevant $SO(5)$ singlet scalar. In this work we provide substantial evidence for the multicriticality scenario using conformal bootstrap. We start with the observation that the large scale Quantum Monte Carlo (QMC) results nearly saturate the bootstrap bounds. After imposing suitable sparseness condition the bootstrap bound forms a sharp cone in the three-dimensional parameter space. The bootstrap cone is close to the QMC data. We use the navigator algorithm to locate the apex of the cone and extract the extremal solutions. We find striking consistencies between the bootstrap solutions and the fuzzy sphere data of DQCP, including the coefficients in the operator product expansions (OPEs) and the higher spectrum! The bootstrap cone unifies the QMC and the fuzzy sphere data into a unitary conformal field theory with a relevant $SO(5)$ singlet scalar, thus strongly supporting the multicriticality scenario of DQCP. The agreement between the conformal bootstrap, QMC and fuzzy sphere results is a surprise towards solving DQCP and decoding the profound phase diagram of the two-dimensional quantum magnets.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词为“conformal bootstrap”（共形自举）、“navigator algorithm”（导航算法）、“operator product expansions”（算符乘积展开），属于解析与数值结合的理论研究。；研究对象：去禁闭量子临界点（DQCP）的多临界性（multicriticality）场景，具体涉及二维量子磁体中可能存在的具有SO(5)单态标量场的幺正固定点。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过共形自举方法，发现量子蒙特卡洛（QMC）和模糊球（fuzzy sphere）数据均落在自举约束形成的尖锐锥体内，且自举解与模糊球数据在算符乘积展开系数及高能谱上高度一致，强有力地支持DQCP为多临界幺正固定点（而非赝临界行走行为）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过共形自举方法，发现量子蒙特卡洛（QMC）和模糊球（fuzzy sphere）数据均落在自举约束形成的尖锐锥体内，且自举解与模糊球数据在算符乘积展开系数及高能谱上高度一致，强有力地支持DQCP为多临界幺正固定点（而非赝临界行走行为）。；创新点：首次通过共形自举将QMC与模糊球两种独立数值方法的数据统一到同一个幺正共形场论框架下，为DQCP的多临界性场景提供了决定性证据，解决了长期以来关于DQCP本质的争议。
papers.method_zh: 采用共形自举（conformal bootstrap）方法，结合稀疏性条件（sparseness condition）在三维参数空间中形成自举锥，并使用导航算法（navigator algorithm）定位锥顶并提取极值解。同时对比了量子蒙特卡洛（QMC）和模糊球（fuzzy sphere）数值数据。

papers.title: Tame the Umklapp Processes in Real-Time Lattice Simulation for Hydrodynamics: An Ising Field Theory Study
papers.abstract: We calculate the real-time symmetric correlation function of the stress-energy tensor for a non-integrable Ising field theory consisting of three stable scalar particles via lattice Hamiltonian simulation. Using classical exact diagonalization and the matrix product state tensor network methods, we find that in the scaling region of the lattice theory, Umklapp processes are suppressed and the sound modes of relativistic hydrodynamics emerge at long wavelength and late time. The extracted ratio of bulk viscosity to entropy density is $ζ/s=14.19\pm 0.90$ and the speed of sound is $c_s/c=0.76 \pm 0.02$ at the temperature $T\approx 7.14$ in units of the lowest stable particle's mass. Our study demonstrates the utility of real-time lattice Hamiltonian simulation for describing hydrodynamization and calculating transport coefficients nonperturbatively.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：lattice Hamiltonian simulation、classical exact diagonalization、matrix product state tensor network methods）；研究对象：非可积Ising场论中的流体动力学行为，具体研究三个稳定标量粒子构成的系统在实时间格点模拟中的应力-能量张量关联函数。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在格点理论的标度区中，Umklapp过程被抑制，长波长、晚时间下出现相对论流体动力学的声模；提取了体粘滞系数与熵密度之比ζ/s=14.19±0.90以及声速c_s/c=0.76±0.02（温度T≈7.14，以最轻稳定粒子质量为单位）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在格点理论的标度区中，Umklapp过程被抑制，长波长、晚时间下出现相对论流体动力学的声模；提取了体粘滞系数与熵密度之比ζ/s=14.19±0.90以及声速c_s/c=0.76±0.02（温度T≈7.14，以最轻稳定粒子质量为单位）。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用经典精确对角化（exact diagonalization）和矩阵乘积态张量网络方法（matrix product state tensor network methods）进行实时间格点哈密顿量模拟。
